p: Os bororo falam a ele: “Se demoradamente as almas tu irás ficar com sono, suas mãos vão ficar preguiçosas, seus pés vão ficar preguiçosos, irás ficar frouxo.”
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe egore ji, enogituware tu itonaregeduroguji.
source: Boe egore ji, enogituware tu itonaregeduroguji.
p: As pessoas falam com ele, aconselham assim o meu filhinho.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Inogituware ji pugeje:
source: Inogituware ji pugeje:
p: Eu o aconselhei novamente:
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: “Na, awiapagado aedagamage enogwaji, amanamage enogwaji; boe jokodu jire egoino ai, ekaregure amearudu pagado. Kodibá enogwa kodure inogwa kodaji ai?
source: “Na, awiapagado aedagamage enogwaji, amanamage enogwaji; boe jokodu jire egoino ai, ekaregure amearudu pagado. Kodibá enogwa kodure inogwa kodaji ai?
p: “Deste modo, escutas dos teus padrinhos, dos teus irmãos mais velhos as suas palavras. É verdade o que eles dizem a você, não é à toa que te fazem ouvi-a. Por que suas palavras tomam o mesmo rumo que as minhas com você?
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Amearutorudo. Mearutorureu mearutorure. Mearutorekareu mearutorukare.
source: Amearutorudo. Mearutorureu mearutorure. Mearutorekareu mearutorukare.
p: Acreditas. Naquilo que tu crês, tu acreditarás. Aquele que não obedeceu quando pequeno será desacreditado mais tarde.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe ekare pu reore, boe ekare turugadu. Pemegare boere, pegare boere. Mearutorureu boere, mearutoru bokwareu boere.”
source: Boe ekare pu reore, boe ekare turugadu. Pemegare boere, pegare boere. Mearutorureu boere, mearutoru bokwareu boere.”
p: As pessoas não são iguais, as coisas não são perfeitas. Há os bons, há os maus. Há os que acreditam, há os que não acreditam.”
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Icare erijodure. Icare inagore: “Akire, arokagado. Arokagado awo bai managejewu bu, arokagado awo bororo akudo, arokagado aije mugaji, arokagado awu mano kadaji.
source: Icare erijodure. Icare inagore: “Akire, arokagado. Arokagado awo bai managejewu bu, arokagado awo bororo akudo, arokagado aije mugaji, arokagado awu mano kadaji.
p: Nesse tempo ele cresceu. Nessa ocasião eu disse a ele: “É contigo, seja firme! Experimenta-te nesta casa central, experimenta-te a limpar o pátio de cerimônias, prova-te no local onde ficam os espíritos (aije), prova-te no percurso do mano (corrida).
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Arokagado ai karo bogai, ia barogo bogai. Awiremode du otodai, akoremode du otodai.
source: Arokagado ai karo bogai, ia barogo bogai. Awiremode du otodai, akoremode du otodai.
p: Mostra as tuas ações às pessoas: atrás de matar um peixe, atrás de um bicho. Antes de teres mulher, antes de teres filho.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awirimode, akoremode.
source: Awirimode, akoremode.
p: Tu irás desposar-te, irás ter filho.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akonaregedu uke boimode ji. Akoreduje uke boimode ji, ukudawumodukare.
source: Akonaregedu uke boimode ji. Akoreduje uke boimode ji, ukudawumodukare.
p: Teu filho irá sentir fome. Tua mulher irá sentir fome, ela não terá roupa.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akonaregedu ukudawu modukare. Pega, pogurumode.
source: Akonaregedu ukudawu modukare. Pega, pogurumode.
p: Teu filho não terá roupa. É ruim. Ele irá sentir vergonha se não tiver isso.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akonaregedu jokumode, akoreduje jokumode jice ia karo boe, barogo boe. Apogurumode”.
source: Akonaregedu jokumode, akoreduje jokumode jice ia karo boe, barogo boe. Apogurumode”.
p: Teu filho olhará, tua mulher irá colocar seus olhos lá num peixe, num bicho. Tu irás sentir vergonha.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe epogurure, mare Icare awu maiwu boe, taboguru... Taeruduwakare boe epoguru bogai, kodi karega inagoino.
source: Boe epogurure, mare Icare awu maiwu boe, taboguru... Taeruduwakare boe epoguru bogai, kodi karega inagoino.
p: As pessoas se envergonham, mas vós novos, vossas vergonhas... Vós não sabeis o que envergonha os bororo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Jawu boerema epogurure. Jawu boe epagudure, egugudure, enogudure.
source: Jawu boerema epogurure. Jawu boe epagudure, egugudure, enogudure.
p: Agora os bororo antigos tinham vergonha. Os bororo antigos tinham receios, incômodos, tinham aflição.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Du kare awu maiwuge. Pagi, tagi.
source: Du kare awu maiwuge. Pagi, tagi.
p: E não são assim esses novos. Inclusive vós”. Eu falei:
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Inagore:  “Arokagado. Awiremode. Mare kajao, akodo mai.”
source: Inagore:  “Arokagado. Awiremode. Mare kajao, akodo mai.”
p: “Esforça-te. Ainda vais ter mulher. Mas aguarde, ainda és novo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe etonaregedu ricore. Ure karo bito, ure barogo bito, ure bororo akudo, ure bai mugudo, ure bai pemegado.
source: Boe etonaregedu ricore. Ure karo bito, ure barogo bito, ure bororo akudo, ure bai mugudo, ure bai pemegado.
p: Os filhos dos bororo ficam crescidos. Ele mata peixe, ele mata bicho, ele limpa o pátio de cerimônias, ele constrói casa, ele conserta casa.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Turomode toreduje ukudae bogai, toreduje uke bogai, toreduje uwai bogai boe, toreduje aidu bogai.
source: Turomode toreduje ukudae bogai, toreduje uke bogai, toreduje uwai bogai boe, toreduje aidu bogai.
p: Para dar conta da roupa de sua mulher, da comida de sua mulher, da casa da sua mulher, do desejo da sua mulher.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ica,  aredu aidure ji.
source: Ica,  aredu aidure ji.
p: E eis que mulher o quer.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akore : “Uh! Itaidure imuguwo jewu akonaregedu apo”.
source: Akore : “Uh! Itaidure imuguwo jewu akonaregedu apo”.
p: ‘Sim! Meu desejo é ficar com aquele seu filho’”.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Inagore: “Oh! Itaidure. Mare kodo mai, matadu, joruduwa bokwa. Ukare karo, barogo bito roga”.
source: Inagore: “Oh! Itaidure. Mare kodo mai, matadu, joruduwa bokwa. Ukare karo, barogo bito roga”.
p: Eu disse: “Sim, eu quero. Mas ele ainda é novo, é bobo, ele não sabe nada. Ele ainda não matou peixe, bicho”.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boro, ure bito, ro bokwa karega ure, ako bokwakare kodi karega inagoino, mare koduwo toro todobiji pemega pugeje du bogaire inagoino.
source: Boro, ure bito, ro bokwa karega ure, ako bokwakare kodi karega inagoino, mare koduwo toro todobiji pemega pugeje du bogaire inagoino.
p: Não, ele matou. Não é que ele não fez nada ainda, ele ainda não tem qualidades para casar, por isso que eu estou falando, mas para ele ficar pronto para casar, por isso que estou falando.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Dukeje Icare uwirere, ca.
source: Dukeje Icare uwirere, ca.
p: Então ele teve esposa.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Cewu iwire. Imedugodu. Iwire, iwimode.
source: Cewu iwire. Imedugodu. Iwire, iwimode.
p: Depois da minha morte. Estou cansado. Morrer, irei morrer.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ica. Itonaregedure akurumode imugato pugeje.
source: Ica. Itonaregedure akurumode imugato pugeje.
p: Nesse caso. Meu filho irá passar para o meu lugar novamente.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Iwimode toro mare itonaregedu akurumode imugato, imearudae, awu itaidu tabo pemega pugeje. Ainore boere.
source: Iwimode toro mare itonaregedu akurumode imugato, imearudae, awu itaidu tabo pemega pugeje. Ainore boere.
p: Irei morrer lá, mas meu filho irá passar para o meu lugar com o meu pensamento, com o que eu quero de bom outra vez. Assim é que são as coisas.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Kodibá? Iorudukare boe ewoduji. Iorudukare: “Bakoro Kudu, Ki Bakororo, Kaigu, Akaruio Bokodori, iorudukare ewoduji.
source: Kodibá? Iorudukare boe ewoduji. Iorudukare: “Bakoro Kudu, Ki Bakororo, Kaigu, Akaruio Bokodori, iorudukare ewoduji.
p: Por quê? Eu não vi os bororo surgirem. Eu não vi: BAKORO KUDU, KI BAKORORO KAIGU, AKARUIO BOKODORI (chefes míticos), eu não vi eles nascerem.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Kodibá nowu ikedu kimore nowu ewadaruji oino ewogai?
source: Kodibá nowu ikedu kimore nowu ewadaruji oino ewogai?
p: Por que ainda estou segurando as suas palavras assim para eles?
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Du reore itonaregeduwo imugato imearudae, iwadaru tabo toro pemega pugeje.
source: Du reore itonaregeduwo imugato imearudae, iwadaru tabo toro pemega pugeje.
p: Do mesmo jeito meu filho deve ficar no meu lugar com os meus pensamentos, com as palavras boas deles para frente novamente.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Onaregedumode aino toro otobiji, pemega pugeje. Oto pa bokwawo.
source: Onaregedumode aino toro otobiji, pemega pugeje. Oto pa bokwawo.
p: O filho dele deve ser assim lá na ponta para lá, bom novamente. Para não ter fim.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Mare awu barae ewadaru koiare Icare ure paro okwado, pamearudae okwado, awu boe ero okwado. Barae ewadaru koia.
source: Mare awu barae ewadaru koiare Icare ure paro okwado, pamearudae okwado, awu boe ero okwado. Barae ewadaru koia.
p: Mas por causa das palavras desses brancos é que nossas coisas desapareceram, nossos pensamentos sumiram, a tradição dos bororo desapareceu. Por causa das palavras dos brancos.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Imi rema, imi karega. Boe remawu nure imi.
source: Imi rema, imi karega. Boe remawu nure imi.
p: Eu, ao contrário, não. Eu sou bororo legítimo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ire braedu tugu ii, mare inure braedu tugu ii.
source: Ire braedu tugu ii, mare inure braedu tugu ii.
p: Eu coloquei o branco em mim e estou colocando o branco em mim.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Braedu karega ure imi, ikaregure braedudo imi. Braedu kudawure ire tugu ii, mare ikare braedudo imi.
source: Braedu karega ure imi, ikaregure braedudo imi. Braedu kudawure ire tugu ii, mare ikare braedudo imi.
p: Eu não sou branco, não me fiz de branco. As roupas dos branco que eu coloquei em mim, mas eu não me tornei branco.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Marigudu boe emerure tuwaga kedo tabo, tomogo kedo tabo.
source: Marigudu boe emerure tuwaga kedo tabo, tomogo kedo tabo.
p: Há muito tempo atrás as pessoas andavam com seu pênis nu, com sua vagina nua.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu
editorial_note: Numeração documental: este segmento Bororo é o item 50; a tradução portuguesa correspondente está impressa como 51, seguida por outro item também numerado 51. Provável erro de numeração na tradução impressa.

b: Boe eiamedu boe, brae jamedu.
source: Boe eiamedu boe, brae jamedu.
p: Todas as pessoas, o branco também.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu brae ewaga kedore, etomogo kedore, ewiri kedore jamedu. Paiamedure ure oino.
source: Awu brae ewaga kedore, etomogo kedore, ewiri kedore jamedu. Paiamedure ure oino.
p: Os brancos estiveram com seus pênis nus, suas vaginas nuas. Eles estavam nus também. Todos nós éramos assim.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu nowu otobiji Icare pare pagera bu bu, paeku bu bu.
source: Awu nowu otobiji Icare pare pagera bu bu, paeku bu bu.
p: Depois disso então fomos colocando nossas mãos aqui, ali, fomos olhando isso, aquilo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Pare bai paru onado pai, pare bai onado pai, gu, gu, gu...
source: Pare bai paru onado pai, pare bai onado pai, gu, gu, gu...
p: Fomos colocando folhas em nós, fomos colocando casa em nós, indo, indo, indo...
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Pagera jore awuiato rugadu.
source: Pagera jore awuiato rugadu.
p: Nossas mãos foram em cima do pano mesmo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ica, awu braere Icare etonagodu aroiaji boe epiji ta.
source: Ica, awu braere Icare etonagodu aroiaji boe epiji ta.
p: E a esses brancos então pertenceu o pano antes dos bororo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Etonagodu meririji boe epiji.
source: Etonagodu meririji boe epiji.
p: Eles foram os donos do metal antes dos bororo.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boere ekodu aroiaji jao, boere ekodure meririji jao, du kodia karega Ica braere Icare...
source: Boere ekodu aroiaji jao, boere ekodure meririji jao, du kodia karega Ica braere Icare...
p: Os bororo chegaram ao pano há pouco tempo. Os bororo chegaram ao metal há pouco tempo, por isso um outro não é.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe eekudure tu nowu meririji, aroiaji etogi pugeje.
source: Boe eekudure tu nowu meririji, aroiaji etogi pugeje.
p: E os brancos nesse momento... Os bororo admiram esse metal, o pano na frente deles novamente.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Du koare ia biri kedore tu jewu ia boe bokware pugeje.
source: Du koare ia biri kedore tu jewu ia boe bokware pugeje.
p: Por isso não há ninguém mais nu.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe emerure to ba kedo tabo, tuwiri kedo tabo jii jewu boe bokware aino pugeje.
source: Boe emerure to ba kedo tabo, tuwiri kedo tabo jii jewu boe bokware aino pugeje.
p: O que anda com seu estojo peniano de fora, com a pele nua assim, assim, não existe esse bororo assim ainda.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Imire iromode oino.
source: Imire iromode oino.
p: Eu é que vou fazer assim.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ino baare, tabo imugure tu aino.
source: Ino baare, tabo imugure tu aino.
p: Eu tenho meu estojo peniano, é com ele que estou bem assim.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Imire imerumode iwiri kedo tabo jii, jii, jii oino woe.
source: Imire imerumode iwiri kedo tabo jii, jii, jii oino woe.
p: Eu é que vou andar com minha pele nua aí, aí, aí, assim aqui.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Mare awu boe egomode:
source: Mare awu boe egomode:
p: Mas essas pessoas vão dizer:
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: “Iiui! Icare boe pegare! Icare barodugodure, Icare paeda kedomode”.
source: “Iiui! Icare boe pegare! Icare barodugodure, Icare paeda kedomode”.
p: “Iiuui! Então as coisas estão más. Então está de mau augúrio, eis que vamos ficar nus”.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Oinore egomode ii.
source: Oinore egomode ii.
p: Assim que eles vão dizer de mim.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Kodire ikare awu boe erudu, erududo awu ino baaji.
source: Kodire ikare awu boe erudu, erududo awu ino baaji.
p: Por isso que não deixo as pessoas verem o meu estojo peniano.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Oh! Oino. Ainore boe egore, boe erore.
source: Oh! Oino. Ainore boe egore, boe erore.
p: Pois é, é assim. Assim que os bororo dizem, os bororo fazem.
title: IMEDU RO AKO BOE
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe egore:
source: Boe egore:
p: Os bororo dizem:
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: “Boro, imedu, aredu. Awiapado tu boe enogwaji.
source: “Boro, imedu, aredu. Awiapado tu boe enogwaji.
p: “Não, homem, mulher. Ouça bem o que os bororo dizem.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awiapagado tu boeoto, merito.
source: Awiapagado tu boeoto, merito.
p: Ouça bem durante a noite, durante o dia.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akado boe eroi pui duji.
source: Akado boe eroi pui duji.
p: Repare como os bororo fazem um ao outro.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe ero. Ainore: boe erore, boe egore, boe ewadarure.
source: Boe ero. Ainore: boe erore, boe egore, boe ewadarure.
p: Esses são os bororo. Assim que os bororo fazem, os bororo falam, são as palavras dos bororo.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Arodo aino, akagodo aino.
source: Arodo aino, akagodo aino.
p: Faça assim, fale assim.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu reo, ia boe reo pugeje.
source: Awu reo, ia boe reo pugeje.
p: Há este, outra coisa novamente.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu reo, brae ero reo, brae ego reo.
source: Awu reo, brae ero reo, brae ego reo.
p: Há este, há a ação dos brancos, o dizer dos brancos.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akaiwodo awu barae eroji.
source: Akaiwodo awu barae eroji.
p: Repare as ações dos brancos.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akado awu boe eroji.
source: Akado awu boe eroji.
p: Olha como os bororo fazem.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu boe erogodajire akodure.
source: Awu boe erogodajire akodure.
p: É Atrás dos bororo que você vai.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu boe emearudae jire akodure.
source: Awu boe emearudae jire akodure.
p: Os pensamentos dos bororo que você vai acompanhando.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Mare awiapaga nure barae enogwaji, awiapaga nure barae ewadaruji jamedu.
source: Mare awiapaga nure barae enogwaji, awiapaga nure barae ewadaruji jamedu.
p: Mas fiques ouvindo as bocas dos brancos, fiques ouvindo as palavras dos brancos também.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Metuwo akabo, aruduiwawo barae ewadaruji.
source: Metuwo akabo, aruduiwawo barae ewadaruji.
p: Para ficar com você, para saberes o idioma dos brancos.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Baraedu jorudumode ai awara keje, makomode ai aruduiwa modukare akoi ai du kao, mearudu modukare awadaruji jamedu.
source: Baraedu jorudumode ai awara keje, makomode ai aruduiwa modukare akoi ai du kao, mearudu modukare awadaruji jamedu.
p: O branco vai te ver na estrada, ele irá falar contigo e não irás entendê-lo, também ele não compreenderá as suas palavras.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Kode awiapagado baraedu okwa bataruji tu arijodumode du otodai.
source: Kode awiapagado baraedu okwa bataruji tu arijodumode du otodai.
p: Por isso preste atenção nas palavras da boca do branco na frente antes de tu cresceres.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu akaora kugudu tabo, amearudumode boe ewadaru ji, amearudumode barae ewadaru ji.
source: Awu akaora kugudu tabo, amearudumode boe ewadaruji, amearudumode barae ewadaruji.
p: Para você com tua cabeça nova escutares a língua dos bororo, ouvires a língua dos brancos.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Mare akaora kurodumodukare, amearudumodukare, aeruduwamodukare.
source: Mare akaora kurodu modukare, amearudu modukare, aeruduwamodukare.
p: Na sua cabeça ficando dura, não irás compreender, não irás aprender.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Boe nure aki. Boe aki reo. Awuge rema barae reo”.
source: Boe nure aki. Boe aki reo. Awuge rema barae reo”.
p: Tu és bororo. Bororo és. Agora esses são brancos.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ainore boe egore botugodudogei.
source: Ainore boe egore botugodudogei.
p: Assim os bororo falam com os adolescentes:
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: “Jewu rema, jewu pegare. Jewu kugu rice, rie rice.
source: “Jewu rema, jewu pegare. Jewu kugu rice, rie rice.
p: “Aquele lá, aquele é mau. Aquele lá é kugu (corujão, animal que amedronta, bicho papão), eis o lobo.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Iiui, atu kaba toro, nowu rugodumode ai.
source: Iiui, atu kaba toro, nowu rugodumode ai.
p: Iiuui! Não vá lá, esse vai brigar com você.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Kode boe tugu aiagi jii, jii, jii, ba aregodu tabo, meri rekodu tabo.
source: Kode boe tugu aiagi jii, jii, jii, ba aregodu tabo, meri rekodu tabo.
p: Por isso coloca coisa dentro de você (o dedo, raminho jorubo, na garganta para provocar vômito) indo, indo, indo, ao nascer do sol, ao pôr-do-sol.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awarigoduwo ai.
source: Awarigoduwo ai.
p: Para te colocares leve.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awo kugu bito, awo rie bito, awo adugo bito. Awo ro pega, ako pegareu bito, emawo ukare awido.
source: Awo kugu bito, awo rie bito, awo adugo bito. Awo ro pega, ako pegareu bito, emawo ukare awido.
p: Para matares corujão, para matares lobo, para matares jaguar. O maldoso, aquele que tem más ações, matares para eles não te matarem.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Aragawo, aduruwo, boere aki kodi. Boe amaragodae reo.
source: Aragawo, aduruwo, boere aki kodi. Boe amaragodae reo.
p: Para seres forte, teres força, porque és bororo. Esses são os teus trabalhos de bororo.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Barae epadure tumaragodae keje jamedu.
source: Barae epadure tumaragodae keje jamedu.
p: Os brancos ficara em seus trabalhos também.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Barae enoe bitodure, boe enoe bitodure jamedu.
source: Barae enoe bitodure, boe enoe bitodure jamedu.
p: Os brancos têm o seu jeito de matar, também os bororo têm o seu jeito de matar.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Mare boe etugore tuginoi, barae etugore tuginoi.
source: Mare boe etugore tuginoi, barae etugore tuginoi.
p: Mas os bororo têm suas armas diferentes. Os brancos têm suas armas diferentes.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Padugo remawu reo. Atugo reo, awaiga reo, awuge reo.
source: Padugo remawu reo. Atugo reo, awaiga reo, awuge reo.
p: Essas são as nossas armas originais. Eis a tua flecha, eis o teu arco, eis a tua rede.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Awu rema baraedu utugo reo, uwuge reo, rore.
source: Awu rema baraedu utugo reo, uwuge reo, rore.
p: Agora esse é a flecha (arma) do branco, é a rede (arma) dele, ele faz.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Akado awu boe ero, arodo ji jao.
source: Akado awu boe ero, arodo ji jao.
p: Observe as ações dos bororo para praticares por primeiro.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Dukeje akaiwomode barae ero ji pugeje.
source: Du keje akaiwomode barae eroji pugeje.
p: Depois é que você deve observar as ações dos brancos novamente.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Ainore awu maiwu bakarure, oino maiwu ure.
source: Ainore awu maiwu bakarure, oino maiwu ure.
p: Assim que é esse novo, Deste modo ele é novo.
title: BOE ETUO OKITUWAI TONAREGEDU JITU
speaker: José Carlos Meriri Ekureu

b: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas, Amitai onaregedu, bogai, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo Nínive ba kurirewu kurirewu kae, amagodo ji ro pegarewu aregoduie itae duji.
source: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas, Amati onaregedu, bogai, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo Nínive bakurirewu kurirewu kae, amagodo ji ro pegarewu aregoduie itae duji.
p:
Veio a palavra do Senhor a Jonas, filho de Amitai, dizendo:
Levanta-te, vai à cidade de Nínive, e clama contra ela, porque a sua malícia subiu até à minha presença.

b: Jonas uture turegodu tabo Tarsis ba kurirewu kae, Pao piji. Ure turawuje Jope ba kurirewu kae, kejere jordure ia ika kurirewu ui tuduiagu Tarsis kae duji, ure tudumode torodu morido, icare ure taredo ika kurirewu to, tugoduwo nowu boe ebo Tarsis kae, Pao piji.
source: Jonas uture turegodu tabo Tarsis bakurirewu kae, Pao piji. Ure turawuje Jope bakurirewu kae, kejere jordure ia ika kurirewu ui tuduiagu Tarsis kae duji, ure tudumode torodu morido, icare ure taredo ika kurireuto, tugoduwo nowu boe ebo Tarsis kae, Pao piji.
p: Porém, Jonas se levantou para fugir da presença do Senhor para Társis. E descendo a Jope, achou um navio que ia para Társis; pagou, pois, a sua passagem, e desceu para dentro dele, para ir com eles para Társis, para longe da presença do Senhor.

b: Mare Paore ia bakuru rakarewu butudo pobo maerewu keje; bakuru rakaguragarewu kodire nowu ika kurirewu tuwogwaiagu pobo to.
source: Mare Paore ia bakuru rakarewu butudo pobo maerewu keje; bakuru rakaguragarewu kodire nowu ika kurirewu tuwogwaiagu poboto.
p: Mas o Senhor mandou ao mar um grande vento, e fez-se no mar uma forte tempestade, e o navio estava a ponto de quebrar-se.

b: Ika kurirewu epage epagudugodu kuricigore, eiamedu boe enogwamagudure tu tu to aroe eimejera bogai, icare, ika kurirewu barigoduwo puduidu bogaire, ere ia oroe barigu pobo to. Du tona ji Jonasre turawuje ika kurirewu upo kae, ure tuwu dukeje icare unudure rabodu.
source: Ika kurirewu epage epagudugodu kuricigore, eiamedu boe enogwamagudure tu tu to aroe eimejera bogai, icare, ika kurirewu barigoduwo puduidu bogaire, ere ia oroe barigu poboto. Du tonaji Jonasre turawuje ika kurirewu upo kae, ure tuwu dukeje icare unudure rabodu.
p: Então temeram os marinheiros, e clamavam cada um ao seu deus, e lançaram ao mar as cargas, que estavam no navio, para o aliviarem do seu peso; Jonas, porém, desceu ao porão do navio, e, tendo-se deitado, dormia um profundo sono.

b: Icare nowu jeture nowu ika kurirewu oroe jiwu ure tuburedo ji, akore kodi icare anudure? Aragojedo, akogwamagududo ako Aroe Eimejera bogai. Ia dukeje aidumode tumearudae butudo pawugeje tuwo paginorudo pawi piji.
source: Icare nowu jeture nowu ika kurirewu oroe jiwu ure tuburedo ji, akore kodi icare anudure? Aragojedo, akogwamagududo ako Aroe Eimejera bogai. Ia dukeje aidumode tumearudae butudo pawugeje tuwo paginorudo pawi piji.
p: E o capitão do navio chegou-se a ele, e disse-lhe: Que tens, dorminhoco? Levanta-te, clama ao teu Deus; talvez assim esse Deus se lembre de nós para que não pereçamos.

b: Icare metage egore oino pui pawo pageragudu caido barigu, paeruduwo ioguduba koiare ure boedo oino pai. Ere boere tugeragu caidu barigu, du buture Jonas keje.
source: Icare metage egore oino pui pawo pageragudu caido barigu, paerduwo ioguduba koiare ure boedo oino pai. Ere boere tugeragu caidu barigu, du buture Jonas keje.
p: E diziam cada um ao seu companheiro: Vinde, e lancemos sortes, para que saibamos por que causa nos sobreveio este mal. E lançaram sortes, e a sorte caiu sobre Jonas.

b: Du kodi icare egore oino ji cewie inoba ure kodiba boere oino pai? Kakoduboeba amaragodae rema Kaiba pijiba akaregodure? Kakoduwuba ako moto rema? Kakoduwu boe eiba aenare?
source: Du kodi icare egore oino ji cewie inoba ure kodiba boere oino pai? Kakoduboeba amaragodae rema Kaiba pijiba akaregodure? Kakoduwuba ako moto rema? Kakoduwu boe eiba aenare?
p: Então lhe disseram: Declara-nos tu agora, por causa de quem nos sobreveio este mal. Que ocupação é a tua? Donde vens? Qual é a tua terra? E de que povo és tu?

b: Akore oino ei hebreinure imi. Imearutorure Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu ji, duwu ure pobo maerewu, moto, towuje.
source: Akore oino ei hebrei nure imi. Imearutorure Aroe Eimejera baru tadawuji, duwu ure pobo maerewu, moto, towuje.
p: E ele lhes disse: Eu sou hebreu, e temo ao Senhor, o Deus do céu, que fez o mar e a terra seca.

b: Nowu ime epagudugodu kuricigore, ere boe pa rekodu raaboduie Pao piji duji; enoragodure ji inoba arore?
source: Nowu ime epagudugodu kuricigore, ere boe pa rekodu raaboduie Pao piji duji; enoragodure ji inoba arore?

b: Egore oino ji kimo inoba ceromode ai, pobo maerewu butugugoduwo cei du bogai? Paga karega, ui taogadodu kodure tao kae.
source: Egore oino ji kimo inoba ceromode ai, pobo maerewu butugugoduwo cei du bogai? Paga karega, ui taogadodu kodure tao kae.

b: Jonas Akore oino ei tageragu ii, iwarigu pobo maereuto, nono, pobo maerewu butugugodumode tai; paga karega, iorduware igoiaie boere oino tai duji.
source: Jonas Akore oino ei tageragu ii, iwarigu pobo maereuto, nono, pobo maerewu butugugodumode tai; paga karega, iorduware igoiaie boere oino tai duji.

b: Icare nowu imere tudaraiga jodo pobo keje tuduru jamedu boe tabo taregoduwo pobo okwa pa kae, mare eroiwakare, pobuto boe ekodure tao kae kodi.
source: Icare nowu imere tudaraiga jodo pobo keje tuduru jamedu boe tabo taregoduwo pobo okwa pa kae, mare eroiwakare, pobuto boe ekodure tao kae kodi.

b: Du kodi icare enogwamagudure Aroe Eimejera bogai, egore Pagimejera, cewogwa kawo awu imedu jiboe koia, akaba ro pegakarewu boe ku ku butudo cewugeje, akire arore nono akaidu reore kodi.
source: Du kodi icare enogwamagudure Aroe Eimejera bogai, egore Pagimejera, cewogwa kawo awu imedu jiboe koia, akaba ro pegakarewu boe ku ku butudo cewugeje, akire arore nono akaidu reore kodi.

b: Tagoi oino dutabo icare ere tugeragu Jonas ji, ere barigu pobo maereuto, icare boe butugugodure.
source: Tagoi oino dutabo icare ere tugeragu Jonas ji, ere barigu pobo maereuto, icare boe butugugodure.

b: Du kodi icare nowu ime emearutoru kuricigore Pao ji, ere tomea maku ai, ere turomededu boe to ai.
source: Du kodi icare nowu ime emearutoru kuricigore Pao ji, ere tomea maku ai, ere turomededu boe to ai.

b: Paore ia karo kuricigorewu udo Jonas kowuje, meture nowu karo kuri tada merire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.
source: Paore ia karo kuricigorewu udo Jonas kowuje, meture nowu karo kuri tada merire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

b: Du keje icare Paore nowu karo owearigo Jonas apo kugaru keje.
source: Du keje icare Paore nowu karo owearigo Jonas apo kugaru keje.

b: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas bogai pugeje, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo bakurirewu kurirewu iere Nínive cedu kae, ewie imagomode aiwu bakaruji.
source: Pao bataru aregodure Jonas bogai pugeje, tagoi oino dutabo aragojedo, atudo bakurirewu kurirewu iere Nínive cedu kae, ewie imagomode aiwu bakaruji.

b: Icare Jonas ure turagojedo, uture Nínive kae, Pao bakaru rekodaji. Bakurirewu kuricigorewu nure Ninivece; merimode pobe kma jewu metuia bokware boe epaduwo kajeje.
source: Icare Jonas ure turagojedo, uture Nínive kae, Pao bakaru rekodaji. Bakurirewu kuricigorewu nure Ninivece; merimode pobe kma jewu metuia bokware boe epaduwo kajeje.

b: Jonas merure nowu bakurirewu kao meri jameduji jii meri butu kae. Oiogwarire oino merimode pagera awubodure pobe puibiji dukeje, Nínive pegadodumode.
source: Jonas merure nowu bakurirewu kao meri jameduji jii meri butu kae. Oiogwarire oino merimode pagera awubodure pobe puibiji dukeje, Nínive pegadodumode.

b: Nínive kejewu boe emearutorure Pao ji. Eimejerage egore boe eiamedu boe etodorogaiagu pudui, du kodi icare biegareuge, kurireuge eiamedu ere aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo.
source: Nínive kejewu boe emearutorure Pao ji. Eimejerage egore boe eiamedu boe etodorogaiagu pudui, du kodi icare biegareuge, kurireuge eiamedu ere aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo.

b: Awu bakaru aregodure Nínive kejewu brae eimejera kurirewu biaja kae. Icare ure turagojedo tumuga piji, ure opore pudabowu aroia boarewu tawuje tubiji, ure aroia iku kurirewu tugu pudui, ure tumugudu jorugudu tada. Nowu brae eimejera, nowu utugarege kurireuge, egore nowu uwadodureuge ewadoduwo boe etae, egowo oino boe ji boe, barege, tapiradoge, barege kugure, emodukare boe ko, ekudumodukare poboce. Boe, barege, emode aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo. Emagomode Aroe Eimejera ji tuduru tabo, emode tukirimi tudawara pegarewu piji, emode turo pegare tugera tabodu pijido jamedu. Boe jokodukare kare, Pao umodukana tudaru, umode tugirimi tuibagi, umode tugera ra boe korii pui dupiji, ma, pawogwa kawo.
source: Awu bakaru aregodure Nínive kejewu brae eimejera kurirewu biaja kae. Icare ure turagojedo tumuga piji, ure opore pudabowu aroia boarewu tawuje tubiji, ure aroia iku kurirewu tugu pudui, ure tumugudu jorugudu tada. Nowu brae eimejera, nowu utugarege kurireuge, egore nowu uwadodureuge ewadoduwo boe etae, egowo oino boe ji boe, barege, tapiradoge, barege kugure, emodukare boe ko, ekudumodukare poboce. Boe, barege, emode aroia iku kurirewu opodo pudabo. Emagomode Aroe Eimejera ji tuduru tabo, emode tukirimi tudawara pegarewu piji, emode turo pegare tugera tabodu pijido jamedu. Boe jokodukare kare, Pao umodukana tudaru, umode tugirimi tuibagi, umode tugera ra boe korii pui dupiji, ma, pawogwa kawo.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera jordure eroi oino duji, ei tudaru tudawara pegarewu piji duji, icare okudure ebo, uro turo pegamode eidu bokwado.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera jordure eroi oino duji, ei tudaru tudawara pegarewu piji duji, icare okudure ebo, uro turo pegamode eidu bokwado.

b: Pao butugugodui Nínive bakurirewu jitu keje, Jonas kiarigodu kuricigore, korigodure pudui.
source: Pao butugugodui Nínive bakurirewu jitu keje, Jonas kiarigodu kuricigore, korigodure pudui.

b: Du kodi icare akore oino Pao ji Ikimejera, nowu inoduji karega inagoino iragoje kimoi ino moto keje dutabo? Du kodire icare ire akedo ii iregoduwo Tarsis kae; mare paga karega, iorduwa pemegare Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu okudurewu iure aki; awudugugodure ai akorigoduji, are amode eiwo pegadodu akedudo taci apiji. Kodi icare inogwamagudumode oino ai, awo iragoja kedodo; ure turugadu iwiwo, iragoje kawo.
source: Du kodi icare akore oino Pao ji Ikimejera, nowu inoduji karega inagoino iragoje kimoi ino moto keje dutabo? Du kodire icare ire akedo ii iregoduwo Tarsis kae; mare paga karega, iorduwa pemegare Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu okudurewu iure aki; awudugugodure ai akorigoduji, are amode eiwo pegadodu akedudo taci apiji. Kodi icare inogwamagudumode oino ai, awo iragoja kedodo; ure turugadu iwiwo, iragoje kawo.

b: Mare Pao akore oino ji boe rugadu akorigodure oino nowu inodu koia?
source: Mare Pao akore oino ji boe rugadu akorigodure oino nowu inodu koia?

b: Jonas ure tudawuje nowu bakurirewu piji, icare ure tumugudo meri rutu jaogwai, nono icare ure ia bai mugudo pudai, nonore icare ure tumugudo tuwo tamudo ia boetugu kuda, tubaga taba inoba boemode bakurirewu jitu bogai.
source: Jonas ure tudawuje nowu bakurirewu piji, icare ure tumugudo meri rutu jaogwai, nono icare ure ia bai mugudo pudai, nonore icare ure tumugudo tuwo tamudo ia boetugu kuda, tubaga taba inoba boemode bakurirewu jitu bogai.

b: Icare Paore ia i ricodudo nowu Jonas uwai aogeje, tuwo boetugudo aora joki, ma kiarigodu kawo. Jonas jekare kuricigore nowu i mugui tuwai aogeje duji.
source: Icare Paore ia i ricodudo nowu Jonas uwai aogeje, tuwo boetugudo aora joki, ma kiarigodu kawo. Jonas jekare kuricigore nowu i mugui tuwai aogeje duji.

b: Mare ia barogwato, Paore nowu i arogodo ukua rugadu kowuje, du kodi icare nowu i kidure.
source: Mare ia barogwato, Paore nowu i arogodo ukua rugadu kowuje, du kodi icare nowu i kidure.

b: Dukodi icare, meri joku aregodu keje, Paoi ia bakuru ururewu aregodudo meri rutu piji dukeje, icare meri urugu rakarewu jore Jonas aora keje, dukodire ure tuwiiagu; icare okwamagudure tuwiwo du bogai, tagoi oino dutabo pemegare ii iwiwo iemode dupiji.
source: Du kodi icare, meri joku aregodu keje, Paoi ia bakuru ururewu aregodudo meri rutu piji dukeje, icare meri urugu rakarewu jore Jonas aora keje, du kodire ure tuwiiagu; icare okwamagudure tuwiwo du bogai, tagoi oino dutabo pemegare ii iwiwo iemode dupiji.

b: Icare Pao akore oino Jonas ji emearudae kana akagoiwamoduie akorigoduwo awu i keje? Akore boe jokodu boekorire ii iwiwo du bogai.
source: Icare Pao akore oino Jonas ji emearudae kana akagoiwamoduie akorigoduwo awu i keje? Akore boe jokodu boekorire ii iwiwo du bogai.

b: Mare Pao akore are amorora amagadudo ai i keje, dure maragodukare ji, aetukare ji, dure ia boeco keje jere, ia boco keje bire. Kode imi, inogudmodukare Nínive bakurirewu apo, boe emagaguragai tada tukai boe pa jice wojedu tabo, barege emagaguragai tada dutabo jamedu?
source: Mare Pao akore are amorora amagadudo ai i keje, dure maragodukare ji, aetukare ji, dure ia boeco keje jere, ia boco keje bire. Kode imi, inogudmodukare Nínive bakurirewu apo, boe emagaguragai tada tukai boe pa jice wojedu tabo, barege emagaguragai tada dutabo jamedu?

b: Jorure pobe brae eimejera ji Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure boture ikera awubowuto mito, boe tojiwu meri keje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, Salatiel naregedu Sorobabel, Judá kejewu brae eimejera, ai, Josedec naregedu Salatiel, Pao burejoiage eimejera, ai jamedu oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore awu boe egore boe emode Pao Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado pugeje dukejewu meri aregodukare raga!
source: Jorure pobe brae eimejerai Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure boture ikera awubowuto mito, boetojiwu meri keje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, Salatiel naregedu Sorobabel, Judá kejewu brae eimejera, ai, Josedec naregedu Salatiel, Pao burejoiage eimejera, ai jamedu oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore awu boe egore boe emode Pao Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado pugeje du kejewu meri aregodukare raga!

b: Dukodi icare Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo umode turugadu tamuguwo bai todure irá moturewu tabowu tada, Pao uwai pegadodu tonaji?
source: Du kodi icare Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo umode turugadu tamuguwo bai todure irá moturewu tabowu tada, Pao uwai pegadodu tonaji?

b: Kode, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarore jiboe ji! Tare boe tugudu kuricigodo, mare takare tageragu du kurido boture moto pijiboe ji; tagogwagere mare tagogwa amogodukare; tagudure mare pobo boi taidu akedukare; tagudae meture tai mare ukare tawiri urudo: maragodurewu ure tumaragodae mori tugu ia micigu pororewu tada!
source: Kode, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarore jiboeji! Tare boe tugudu kuricigodo, mare takare tageragu du kurido boture moto pijiboeji; tagogwagere mare tagogwa amogodukare; tagudure mare pobo boi taidu akedukare; tagudae meture tai mare ukare tawiri urudo: maragodurewu ure tumaragodae mori tugu ia micigu pororewu tada!

b: Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarorewu boe ji! Taru torikodu ao kae, iguru arego, iwai mugudo; nono iwudugugodu mode tada, itagaru kuridodu mode, oinore Pao akore.
source: Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore tawiapagado tarorewu boeji! Taru torikodu ao kae, iguru arego, iwai mugudo; nono iwudugugodu mode tada, itagaru kuridodu mode, oinore Pao akore.

b: Jorure pobe brae eimejera Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure buture ikera awu bowu to pobe, merire ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure buture ikera awubowuto mito, dukeje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo amagodo Salatiel naregedu, Judá kejewuge eimejera, Zorobabel ji, Josedec onaregedu Pao burejoiage eimejera Josué ji, boe eiamedu boe ekobo boeji, akagoi oino dutabo kakoduwu tagiba taerdure awu bai urugu boe tojiwu ji, inoba ure taegai oino pugeje? Biega jokodukare taegai? Kode, Zorobabel, atugu ato. Oinore Pao akore. Josué, Josedec onaregedu, Pao burejoiage eimejerage eimejera, atugu ato; moto kejewu boe, tadugu tado, oinore Pao akore; tamaragodudo, iragojere tagabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Imago magai tai, tai tadawuje Egito piji dukeje, du reorere itaroe mugure tagoiadoda. Tabagudu kaba; oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Boe raimodukare dukeje imode baru, moto, amagadudo; imode pobo maerewu, moto jamedu boe amagadudo; imode boe epadui pumekejeboe eiamedu boe etamagadudo; boe eiamedu boe enoroe aregodumode; imode awu iwai korobadudo irugu tabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Ino nure meri kigadurewu, meri ekurewu, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Awu maiwu bai urugu kodumode boetojiwu urugu kori, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore; imode awu bai jiwo aidugirido. Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore.
source: Jorure pobe brae eimejera Dário cedu keje, arii ikera awubodure buture ikera awubowuto pobe, merire ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure buture ikera awubowuto mito, dukeje, Pao bataru aregodure profeta Ageu jabiji, tagoi oino dutabo amagodo Salatiel naregedu, Judá kejewuge eimejera, Zorobabel ji, Josedec onaregedu Pao burejoiage eimejera Josué ji, boe eiamedu boe ekobo boeji, akagoi oino dutabo kakoduwu tagiba taerdure awu bai urugu boetojiwuji, inoba ure taegai oino pugeje? Biega jokodukare taegai? Kode, Zorobabel, atugu ato. Oinore Pao akore. Josué, Josedec onaregedu, Pao burejoiage eimejerage eimejera, atugu ato; moto kejewu boe, tadugu tado, oinore Pao akore; tamaragodudo, iragojere tagabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Imago magai tai, tai tadawuje Egito piji dukeje, du reorere itaroe mugure tagoiadoda. Tabagudu kaba; oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Boe raimodukare dukeje imode baru, moto, amagadudo; imode pobo maerewu, moto jamedu boe amagadudo; imode boe epadui pumekejeboe eiamedu boe etamagadudo; boe eiamedu boe enoroe aregodumode; imode awu iwai korobadudo irugu tabo, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Ino nure meri kigadurewu, meri ekurewu, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore. Awu maiwu bai urugu kodumode boetojiwu urugu kori, oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore; imode awu bai jiwo aidugirido. Oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore.

b: Imearudure imearudu kurire jiwu mako ji. Emare aregodure oino, tui taredo torekaridoge etaogeje dutabo, tui taredo aoporudoge etaogeje dutabo.
source: Imearudure imearudu kurire jiwu makoji. Emare aregodure oino, tui taredo torekaridoge etaogeje dutabo, tui taredo aoporudoge etaogeje dutabo.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu ure nono ia pobogo ukigareure, ure nono ia kaidagaparure. Emare rakojere oino motori kuje ji taiwo tabo bai poro ji mato, toebatodu tabo meriri padui pugajejedu piji.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu ure nono ia pobogo ukigareure, ure nono ia kaidagaparure. Emare rakojere oino motori kujei taiwo tabo baiporoji mato, toebatodu tabo meriri padui pugajejedu piji.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu makore ii, akore oino aragojedo imedago, inagu metugu gigiri motureudo, marigu mato! Icare biaku akedure, bubutu ure marigudu. Okureboe boture pago moto piji, boe eragodure kejeboe aregodure; pamearudure pago moto keje metugu gigiri akoji. Arii tudu boture, parera okure tumaedo boe joki. Aragojedo, imedago, motureudo, mato! Inagu metugu, iordudo ai, tori poro tada, motori poro tada, imearududo amago ji. Paga karega, awadaru beture, ae moture kodi.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu makore ii, akore oino aragojedo imedago, inagu metugu gigiri motureudo, marigu mato! Icare biaku akedure, bubutu ure marigudu. Okureboe boture pago moto piji, boe eragodure kejeboe aregodure; pamearudure pago moto keje metugu gigiri akoji. Arii tudu boture, parera okure tumaedo boe joki. Aragojedo, imedago, motureudo, mato! Inagu metugu, iordudo ai, tori poro tada, motori poro tada, imearududo amago ji. Paga karega, awadaru beture, ae moture kodi.

b: Imearudu kurire jiwu, ino nure ema, imire o nure imi jamedu.
source: Imearudu kurire jiwu, ino nure ema, imire o nure imi jamedu.

b: Oinore aredu okogereudo akore boecoji iemarure ipa keje itaroe mearudure jiboe bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.
source: Oinore aredu okogereudo akore boecoji iemarure ipa keje itaroe mearudure jiboe bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.

b: Imode iragojedo imerumode bakurirewu kao, bakurirewu uwororo boe kao, iemaru tabo itaroe mearudu kurire jiwu bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.
source: Imode iragojedo imerumode bakurirewu kao, bakurirewu uwororo boe kao, iemaru tabo itaroe mearudu kurire jiwu bogai. Iemarure bogai, mare iordukare ji.

b: Oebatodure bakurirewu jiwuge emerure, eerdure ii taerdure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji?
source: Oebatodure bakurirewu jiwuge emerure, eerdure ii taerdure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji?

b: Ikodui ekori dutabo, iordure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji.
source: Ikodui ekori dutabo, iordure itaroe mearudu kurire jiwuji.

b: Itugu awaboto akanato ia kruca reore. Paga karega, boe ewi reorere boe emearudu kuriae rema. Boe etagemo akedumodukare nono boe ewi akedu bokwa reore.
source: Itugu awaboto akanato ia kruca reore. Paga karega, boe ewi reorere boe emearudu kuriae rema. Boe etagemo akedumodukare nono boe ewi akedu bokwa reore.

b: Akemore nono jeriri reore, joru aroerewu.
source: Akemore nono jeriri reore, joru aroerewu.

b: Pobore kurirewu umodukare boe emearudu kuriae bito, okwamodukare pobo boeto. Iaboe umode tuwai tadawu toroe jamedu boe maku, tuwo boe emearudu kuriae aru ma, urumode tugeragu tu boe ekiaraeji.
source: Pobore kurirewu umodukare boe emearudu kuriae bito, okwamodukare pobo boeto. Iaboe umode tuwai tadawu toroe jamedu boe maku, tuwo boe emearudu kuriae aru ma, urumode tugeragu tu boe ekiaraeji.

b: Bapera paru.
source: Bapera paru.

b: Paulo, Jesus Cristo o apóstolo, mare pawie Sóstenes
source: Paulo, Jesus Cristo o apóstolo, mare pawie Sóstenes

b: Pao uwobe emugui Corinto bakurireu kejewuge ewogai, pemegagodure Cristo koiawuge eiamedu bogai, duwugere Pao makore ewogai tuwo tubemegado, jeture ia tuieda kejewuge eiamedu boe enogwamagudui Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jiwuge ebo.
source: Pao uwobe emugui Corinto bakurireu kejewuge ewogai, pemegagodure Cristo koiawuge eiamedu bogai, duwugere Pao makore ewogai tuwo tubemegado, jeture ia tuieda kejewuge eiamedu boe enogwamagudui Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jiwuge ebo.

b: Boe pemegareu, boe butugureu aregodui Pao pijiwu, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo pijiwu, makuduwo tagai.
source: Boe pemegareu, boe butugureu aregodui Pao pijiwu, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo pijiwu, makuduwo tagai.

b: Jii je ire tukutaido Paoji taigoia, o boe pemegareu makudui tagai Jesus Cristo koia du koia.
source: Jii je ire tukutaido Paoji taigoia, o boe pemegareu makudui tagai Jesus Cristo koia du koia.

b: Koiare ure tagoroe pemegareu kuricigodo boe ewadaru jamedu boe tabo, boe eerduwa jamedu boe tabo.
source: Koiare ure tagoroe pemegareu kuricigodo boe ewadaru jamedu boe tabo, boe eerduwa jamedu boe tabo.

b: Du inodu koiare o bataru metu rakare tagabo.
source: Du inodu koiare o bataru metu rakare tagabo.

b: Nowu inodu tabo, tabagai Jesus Cristo umode towadudo du bogai du tabo, boe pemegareu kurireu ia okwakare tagai.
source: Nowu inodu tabo, tabagai Jesus Cristo umode towadudo du bogai du tabo, boe pemegareu kurireu ia okwakare tagai.

b: Emare umode taroiwa rakado jii oto kae, duma tagiwo tagi rugadu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode jiwu meri keje ukawo boe pegado tai.
source: Emare umode taroiwa rakado jii oto kae, duma tagiwo tagi rugadu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode jiwu meri keje ukawo boe pegado tai.

b:
Pao kodure tuwadaru rekodaji, emare makore tawogai tameduiawo Onaregedu Pagimejera Jesus Cristoce.
Pao uwobe ei tuginoi tuginoidu.
source:
Pao kodure tuwadaru rekodaji, emare makore tawogai tameduiawo Onaregedu Pagimejera Jesus Cristoce.
Pao uwobe ei tuginoi tuginoidu.

b: Iwiemage, inogwamagudumode tai, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, taiamedu boe emearduwo pu meardae reore, takawo tado tuginoi tuginoi, taedudo tabemegai pui du tabo, tameardae, tagaidae mito du tabo.
source: Iwiemage, inogwamagudumode tai, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, taiamedu boe emearduwo pu meardae reore, takawo tado tuginoi tuginoi, taedudo tabemegai pui du tabo, tameardae, tagaidae mito du tabo.

b: Paga karega, iwiemage, Cleo uwobe ere iwie tagorigoduie pui duji.
source: Paga karega, iwiemage, Cleo uwobe ere iwie tagorigoduie pui duji.

b: Kodiba inagoino? Kodiba karega, ia tagi tagagore: Imire ionare Pauloji, imire ionare Apoloji, imire ionare Cefaji, imire ionare Cristoji.
source: Kodiba inagoino? Kodiba karega, ia tagi tagagore: Imire ionare Pauloji, imire ionare Apoloji, imire ionare Cefaji, imire ionare Cristoji.

b: Kode, Cristo kadodu kana jice woje tubiji? Paulona padudodure cruz keje tagai? Paulo ie tabo kana tagao pegododure?
source: Kode, Cristo kadodu kana jice woje tubiji? Paulona padudodure cruz keje tagai? Paulo ie tabo kana tagao pegododure?

b: Iegarere Paoji: ikare ia tagi ia tagi tagao pegodo, Crispo, Caio, epiji tu je.
source: Iegarere Paoji: ikare ia tagi ia tagi tagao pegodo, Crispo, Caio, epiji tu je.

b: Oino du tabo iaboe iaboe egomodukare tao pegododuie ikie tabo duji.
source: Oino du tabo iaboe iaboe egomodukare tao pegododuie ikie tabo duji.

b: Ire Estéfanas uwobe etao pegodo jamedu. Awuge epiji toro, iwiabutukare ii iage etao pegodo rakuduie.
source: Ire Estéfanas uwobe etao pegodo jamedu. Awuge epiji toro, iwiabutukare ii iage etao pegodo rakuduie.

b:
Cristo ure irojai, mare iwo boe etao pegodo du bogai karega, mare imagowo bakaru pemegareuji du bogai. Awu inodu tabo, imagokare ji boe ewadaru motureu tabo, ikawo Cristo o cruz barigududo pudui.
Awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa, mare Pao uwobe eerduwa.
source:
Cristo ure irojai, mare iwo boe etao pegodo du bogai karega, mare imagowo bakaru pemegareuji du bogai. Awu inodu tabo, imagokare ji boe ewadaru motureu tabo, ikawo Cristo o cruz barigududo pudui.
Awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa, mare Pao uwobe eerduwa.

b: Cruz jiwu bakaru pegajagu nure ure tuwogwadowuge etai, mare inorudodureuge pagai, Pao ro rakareu nure ema.
source: Cruz jiwu bakaru pegajagu nure ure tuwogwadowuge etai, mare inorudodureuge pagai, Pao ro rakareu nure ema.

b:
Atugododure oino: “Imode jorduwareuge eerduwa pegado, imode meardae rakareuge emeardae okwado” 
 (Is 29,14).
source:
Atugododure oino: “Imode jorduwareuge eerduwa pegado, imode meardae rakareuge emeardae okwado” 
 (Is 29,14).

b: Kaiba jorduwareu rakojere? Kaiba jorduware tuwadaru tumago jiwu rakojere? Kaiba awu moto kejewu unora kigodureu rakojere? Kode, Pao akokare awu moto kejewu mearduwareboe jorduwareboeie boe pegareu rema?
source: Kaiba jorduwareu rakojere? Kaiba jorduware tuwadaru tumago jiwu rakojere? Kaiba awu moto kejewu unora kigodureu rakojere? Kode, Pao akokare awu moto kejewu mearduwareboe jorduwareboeie boe pegareu rema?

b: Kode awu moto kejewu jorduwareboe mearduwareboe ekare boe pawuje Paoji tuiorduwareu tumearduwareu tabo; nowu inodu tabo Pao aidure tuwo meartorureuge einorudo to bataru matadureu cere kogado jitu tabo.
source: Kode awu moto kejewu jorduwareboe mearduwareboe ekare boe pawuje Paoji tuiorduwareu tumearduwareu tabo; nowu inodu tabo Pao aidure tuwo meartorureuge einorudo to bataru matadureu cere kogado jitu tabo.

b: Judeudoge enogwamagudure ia boe tuginoiwu kurireu tuguwo pudai du bogai; Grécia kejewuge eemarure jorduwareboe bogai.
source: Judeudoge enogwamagudure ia boe tuginoiwu kurireu tuguwo pudai du bogai; Grécia kejewuge eemarure jorduwareboe bogai.

b: Cegirema cereadodure Jesus padui cruz keje duji. Duwure judeudogere tumeardae pegareudo ema, judeukare emawuge ere iaboe matadureudo ema tuiegai.
source: Cegirema cereadodure Jesus padui cruz keje duji. Duwure judeudogere tumeardae pegareudo ema, judeukare emawuge ere iaboe matadureudo ema tuiegai.

b: Mare pemegareuge emedui judeudoge, gregodoge etadadu, Pao ro rakareu jorduwa rakareu rema etai.
source: Mare pemegareuge emedui judeudoge, gregodoge etadadu, Pao ro rakareu jorduwa rakareu rema etai.

b: Mare paga karega, Pao o matadureboe jorduwa rakareboe rema ime eerduwa kori, Pao o rorakakareboe emare rorakareboe rema ime ero raka kori.
source: Mare paga karega, Pao o matadureboe jorduwa rakareboe rema ime eerduwa kori, Pao o rorakakareboe emare rorakareboe rema ime ero raka kori.

b: Tagi, iwiemage, tagado ure tudo tadoda boeji: tadoda jorduwa rakareuge emagakare ime eegai, rorakareuge emagakare jamedu, ema remawugere emawuge bokware jamedu.
source: Tagi, iwiemage, tagado ure tudo tadoda boeji: tadoda jorduwa rakareuge emagakare ime eegai, rorakareuge emagakare jamedu, ema remawugere emawuge bokware jamedu.

b: Mare Pao ure awu moto kejewu boe matadureboe tawuje tuwo jorduwareuge eerduwa bokwado. Pao ure awu moto rakakareboe tawuje tuwo rorakareuge eroiwa bokwado jamedu.
source: Mare Pao ure awu moto kejewu boe matadureboe tawuje tuwo jorduwareuge eerduwa bokwado. Pao ure awu moto rakakareboe tawuje tuwo rorakareuge eroiwa bokwado jamedu.

b: Paore awu moto jekaiwu boe pegareu, boe barigodudodureu, boekare emawu, ure tawuje, uwo boe remaboe bokwado.
source: Paore awu moto jekaiwu boe pegareu, boe barigodudodureu, boekare emawu, ure tawuje, uwo boe remaboe bokwado.

b: Oinowo ia ime ia ime ekawo tojarodo pudui Pao jekai.
source: Oinowo ia ime ia ime ekawo tojarodo pudui Pao jekai.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu koiare tamedure Cristo tada. Duwure Paore boe eerduwa rakareudo ema, boe jetororeudo ema, boe pemegareudo ema, ure boe einorudowudo ema pagai.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu koiare tamedure Cristo tada. Duwure Paore boe eerduwa rakareudo ema, boe jetororeudo ema, boe pemegareudo ema, ure boe einorudowudo ema pagai.

b: Uwo nono bapera atugo reore: “Cewu ure tojarodo puduiwu umode tojarodo pudui Pagimejera tada” (Jer 9,23).
source: Uwo nono bapera atugo reore: “Cewu ure tojarodo puduiwu umode tojarodo pudui Pagimejera tada” (Jer 9,23).

b: Paulo uwadodui Corinto bakurireu kejedu.
source: Paulo uwadodui Corinto bakurireu kejedu.

b: Imi jamedu, iture tagae du keje, itukare tagae iwadaru makareu tabo du kare, iorduwa rakareu tabo du kare, iwo tawie Pao bataruji.
source: Imi jamedu, iture tagae du keje, itukare tagae iwadaru makareu tabo du kare, iorduwa rakareu tabo du kare, iwo tawie Pao bataruji.

b: Imeardaere iorduwakai iaboe boeji tadoda, mare tu Jesus Cristoji, mare Cristo padui cruz keje duji tu je.
source: Imeardaere iorduwakai iaboe boeji tadoda, mare tu Jesus Cristoji, mare Cristo padui cruz keje duji tu je.

b: Imugure tadoda iro rakareu bokwa tabo, imorora amagadui ii du tabo, ipagudu tabo.
source: Imugure tadoda iro rakareu bokwa tabo, imorora amagadui ii du tabo, ipagudu tabo.

b: Iwadaru inogituwa puredukare jorduwa rakareu ime ewadaruji; mare paci oino, mare Pao Utaroe, Pao o jorduwa rakareboe pawujeduwo, du jire imagore tawiegai,
source: Iwadaru inogituwa puredukare jorduwa rakareu ime ewadaruji; mare paci oino, mare Pao Utaroe, Pao o jorduwa rakareboe pawujeduwo, du jire imagore tawiegai,

b: Duma tameartorae aregodukawo ime eerduwa rakareu piji, mare tu Pao jorduwa rakareu piji.
source: Duma tameartorae aregodukawo ime eerduwa rakareu piji, mare tu Pao jorduwa rakareu piji.

b: Mare inogituware pemegareuge eiboe, boe eerduwa remawu rema; mare awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa karega, awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage eerduwa karega jamedu, duwuge etagedumode.
source: Mare inogituware pemegareuge eiboe, boe eerduwa remawu rema; mare awu moto kejewu boe eerduwa karega, awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage eerduwa karega jamedu, duwuge etagedumode.

b: Cewadodure Pao jorduware jiboeji, boe eremodukare toboe, boe emodukare pawujeboe jire cemagore. Pao ure awu inodudo oino, boe towujedumodedu otodai, paegareaece, pagaidaece.
source: Cewadodure Pao jorduware jiboeji, boe eremodukare toboe, boe emodukare pawujeboe jire cemagore. Pao ure awu inodudo oino, boe towujedumodedu otodai, paegareaece, pagaidaece.

b: Awu jorduwa rakareboe, awu moto kejewu iaboe iaboe boe eimejerage eerduwakare ji; boe eerduwamode inoduji ma, boe emodukare Pagimejera, boe pemegareu kurireu jeture apowu, bu cruz keje.
source: Awu jorduwa rakareboe, awu moto kejewu iaboe iaboe boe eimejerage eerduwakare ji; boe eerduwamode inoduji ma, boe emodukare Pagimejera, boe pemegareu kurireu jeture apowu, bu cruz keje.

b: Mare bapera atugo pemegareu akore: Boe eerduwakare jiboe, boe emeardukare jiboe Paore jetu otorogado cewu meardu kurire jiwuge ewogai.
source: Mare bapera atugo pemegareu akore: Boe eerduwakare jiboe, boe emeardukare jiboe Paore jetu otorogado cewu meardu kurire jiwuge ewogai.

b: Mare Pao ure inodu awadudo paegai Utaroe koia, paga karega, Aroe jorduware boe jamedu boeji, jamedu Pao o boe biareuji jamedu.
source: Mare Pao ure inodu awadudo paegai Utaroe koia, paga karega, Aroe jorduware boe jamedu boeji, jamedu Pao o boe biareuji jamedu.

b: Mare ioguduba jorduware ime tadaboeji? Kode, imedu utaroe metui tadadure jorduware tu ji rugadu. Du reorere iaboe iaboe eerduwakare Pao ogere emawugei, mare tu Pao Utaroe tu rugadu.
source: Mare ioguduba jorduware ime tadaboeji? Kode, imedu utaroe metui tadadure jorduware tu ji rugadu. Du reorere iaboe iaboe eerduwakare Pao ogere emawugei, mare tu Pao Utaroe tu rugadu.

b: Aró, kode, awu moto kejewu aroe makudukare pagai, mare u Pao Utaroe tu rugadu, duwu koiare ure paerduwado Pao o boe pemegareu makudui pagai duji.
source: Aró, kode, awu moto kejewu aroe makudukare pagai, mare u Pao Utaroe tu rugadu, duwu koiare ure paerduwado Pao o boe pemegareu makudui pagai duji.

b: Cere inodu kogado, mare boe ere ceerduwado jiwu boe ewadaru tabo karega, mare Aroere ceerduwado jiwu bataru tabo. Awu Aroe makore aroe jiboeji, aroe o bataru tabo.
source: Cere inodu kogado, mare boe ere ceerduwado jiwu boe ewadaru tabo karega, mare Aroere ceerduwado jiwu bataru tabo. Awu Aroe makore aroe jiboeji, aroe o bataru tabo.

b: Mare awu moto kejewu imedu aidukare aregodure Pao Utaroe pijiboeji, mare paga karega, nowu inodure matadureboe reoreboere ai, jamedu umodukare nowu inodu pawuje, mare paga karega, tu Aroe koiare ure boedo boe pawuje ji.
source: Mare awu moto kejewu imedu aidukare aregodure Pao Utaroe pijiboeji, mare paga karega, nowu inodure matadureboe reoreboere ai, jamedu umodukare nowu inodu pawuje, mare paga karega, tu Aroe koiare ure boedo boe pawuje ji.

b: Mare biapagare Aroe jiwu imedu, ure tugogado boe jamedu boeji, iaboe iaboe ukare tugogado ji.
source: Mare biapagare Aroe jiwu imedu, ure tugogado boe jamedu boeji, iaboe iaboe ukare tugogado ji.

b: "Ioguduba jorduware Pao meardaeji tuwo jorduwado?“ (Is 40,13). Pagirema pameardaere Jesus Cristo meardaeji.
source: "Ioguduba jorduware Pao meardaeji tuwo jorduwado?“ (Is 40,13). Pagirema pameardaere Jesus Cristo meardaeji.

b: Ure Pao o bataru kogadowuge emaragodae.
source: Ure Pao o bataru kogadowuge emaragodae.

b: Imi, iwiemage, iroiwakare imagowo tai biapagare Aroe jiwu ime eidu reore, mare imagore tai nono biapagare tugodu jiboe ei du reore, Cristo aiwu boe etore kugure ei du reore.
source: Imi, iwiemage, iroiwakare imagowo tai biapagare Aroe jiwu ime eidu reore, mare imagore tai nono biapagare tugodu jiboe ei du reore, Cristo aiwu boe etore kugure ei du reore.

b: Ire mokuru kurureboe maku tagai, mare tagiwa rakamodukare jiwu boe eke karega. Tagiwa rakakare ji, tagorogu kugudu kimore du koia.
source: Ire mokuru kurureboe maku tagai, mare tagiwa rakamodukare jiwu boe eke karega. Tagiwa rakakare ji, tagorogu kugudu kimore du koia.

b: Paga karega, tadoda tagorire pui, tarugodure pui, du kodire tawiapaga nure tagoduji kimo, tare nono awu moto kejewu ime ereore kimo.
source: Paga karega, tadoda tagorire pui, tarugodure pui, du kodire tawiapaga nure tagoduji kimo, tare nono awu moto kejewu ime ereore kimo.

b: Paga karega, tagagoi: ionare Pauloji, ionare Apoloji, oino du tabo, takare nono biapagare tugodu jiwu ime ereore?
source: Paga karega, tagagoi: ionare Pauloji, ionare Apoloji, oino du tabo, takare nono biapagare tugodu jiwu ime ereore?

b: Kode, kaboba Paulo rema? Kaboba Apolo rema? U! Boe karega ure emage, utugare boe nure tu emage. Eigoiare ere tameartoru maku tagai, Pao ui maku tu tu boe etai du reore.
source: Kode, kaboba Paulo rema? Kaboba Apolo rema? U! Boe karega ure emage, utugare boe nure tu emage. Eigoiare ere tameartoru maku tagai, Pao ui maku tu tu boe etai du reore.

b: Ire boe tugu, Apolore pegodo, Paorema ure ricodudo.
source: Ire boe tugu, Apolore pegodo, Paorema ure ricodudo.

b: Oino ure tuguwu boe karega, jamedu ure pegodowu boe karega jamedu, mare Pao tu rugadu, koiare ure ricodudo.
source: Oino ure tuguwu boe karega, jamedu ure pegodowu boe karega jamedu, mare Pao tu rugadu, koiare ure ricodudo.

b: Ure tuguwu, ure pegodowu ere nono pureore, mare mori makudumode etai nono emaragodae reore.
source: Ure tuguwu, ure pegodowu ere nono pureore, mare mori makudumode etai nono emaragodae reore.

b: Cegi cemaragodure Pao apo, tagire cere towujewu Pao o boepa nure tagi. Pao uwai nure tagi.
source: Cegi cemaragodure Pao apo, tagire cere towujewu Pao o boepa nure tagi. Pao uwai nure tagi.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu makudure inai du rekodaji, ire bai oiagejewu bure tugu, ii bai mugudodu epa remawui imi du tabo, iare aogejewu towuje. Tagaiwodo tu tu inoba umode ao jiwu towuje.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu makudure inai du rekodaji, ire bai oiagejewu bure tugu, ii bai mugudodu epa remawui imi du tabo, iare aogejewu towuje. Tagaiwodo tu tu inoba umode ao jiwu towuje.

b: Boe emodukare ia bai oiagejewu bure towuje pugeje, mare cewu bure tugudure tu rugadu, dure Jesus Cristo rema tu rugadu.
source: Boe emodukare ia bai oiagejewu bure towuje pugeje, mare cewu bure tugudure tu rugadu, dure Jesus Cristo rema tu rugadu.

b: Ia boe emode bai mugudo awu aogeje ia meriri ekureu tabo, ia meriri kigadureu tabo rabodu, ia tori motureu tabo rabodu, iarema ia ira tabo rabodu, ia boebutu tabo rabodu, ia bai tabo rabodu.
source: Ia boe emode bai mugudo awu aogeje ia meriri ekureu tabo, ia meriri kigadureu tabo rabodu, ia tori motureu tabo rabodu, iarema ia ira tabo rabodu, ia boebutu tabo rabodu, ia bai tabo rabodu.

b: Nowu inodu umode towadudo ia meriji nowu roinowuge etai. Nowu meriji, joru umode boe emaragodae udo towadudo, umode maragodureuge emaragodae bu tu tu ewugeje.
source: Nowu inodu umode towadudo ia meriji nowu roinowuge etai. Nowu meriji, joru umode boe emaragodae udo towadudo, umode maragodureuge emaragodae bu tu tu ewugeje.

b: Joru umodukare nowu bai kowu du keje, ure towu mori makudumode ai.
source: Joru umodukare nowu bai kowu du keje, ure towu mori makudumode ai.

b: Mare kodumode du keje, mori bokwamode ji, umode cinorudo, mare umode tuwu joru kajeje.
source: Mare kodumode du keje, mori bokwamode ji, umode cinorudo, mare umode tuwu joru kajeje.

b: Kode, taerduwakare Pao uwaie ure tagiduji? Taerduwakare Pao Utaroe muguie tadoda duji?
source: Kode, taerduwakare Pao uwaie ure tagiduji? Taerduwakare Pao Utaroe muguie tadoda duji?

b: Cewu umode Pao uwai pegadowu, Pao umode pegado jamedu, paga karega, Pao uwai, duwuge nure tagi, boe pemegareu rema.
source: Cewu umode Pao uwai pegadowu, Pao umode pegado jamedu, paga karega, Pao uwai, duwuge nure tagi, boe pemegareu rema.

b: Tagaba taekuri pagado tagaobiji. Ia tagi tamode taerduwa rakado tadoda awu moto kejeboe rekodaji ma, kode, tado nono ia matadureboe reore, duwo nono taerduwa rakaguragaiedu jiwore.
source: Tagaba taekuri pagado tagaobiji. Ia tagi tamode taerduwa rakado tadoda awu moto kejeboe rekodaji ma, kode, tado nono ia matadureboe reore, duwo nono taerduwa rakaguragaiedu jiwore.

b: Paga karega, awu moto kejewu jorduwa rakareboe matadureboe nure ema Pao jekai. Paga karega, atugododure oino: “Imode ikeragu jorduwa rakareugei emeardae pegareu koia” (Jo 5, 13).
source: Paga karega, awu moto kejewu jorduwa rakareboe matadureboe nure ema Pao jekai. Paga karega, atugododure oino: “Imode ikeragu jorduwa rakareugei emeardae pegareu koia” (Jo 5, 13).

b: Ia keje, atugododure oino jamedu: “Pagimejera jorduware jorduwa rakareuge emeardaeji, jorduware boe paga pagawuie ema duji”  (S1 93,11).
source: Ia keje, atugododure oino jamedu: “Pagimejera jorduware jorduwa rakareuge emeardaeji, jorduware boe paga pagawuie ema duji”  (S1 93,11).

b: Du kodire tagaba tameartoru bu ime ewugeje. Boe jamedu boe tago nure ema.
source: Du kodire tagaba tameartoru bu ime ewugeje. Boe jamedu boe tago nure ema.

b: Paulo, Apolo, Pedro, awu moto, jereboe, bireboe, awu meri jiboe, barogwatoboe, jamedu boe tago nure ema.
source: Paulo, Apolo, Pedro, awu moto, jereboe, bireboe, awu meri jiboe, barogwatoboe, jamedu boe tago nure ema.

b: Mare tagi, Cristo oge nure tagi. Pao o nure Cristoce.
source: Mare tagi, Cristo oge nure tagi. Pao o nure Cristoce.

b: Tu Paore umode tugogado maragodure pudaiwugei.
source: Tu Paore umode tugogado maragodure pudaiwugei.

b: Kode eiamedu boe emode cedo nono maragodure Cristo aiwuge ereore, jeture Pao o boe biareu pemegareu jiwuge ereore.
source: Kode eiamedu boe emode cedo nono maragodure Cristo aiwuge ereore, jeture Pao o boe biareu pemegareu jiwuge ereore.

b: Aró, kode, jeture boe jiwu jetoromode turo boeji.
source: Aró, kode, jeture boe jiwu jetoromode turo boeji.

b: Ipagudukare tadugui iiduji, ipagudukare boe eimejerage ei tugogado iiduji; imi jamedu imodukare ikogado ii itaobiji.
source: Ipagudukare tadugui iiduji, ipagudukare boe eimejerage ei tugogado iiduji; imi jamedu imodukare ikogado ii itaobiji.

b: Itadaboe umodukare ipogurudo ia iro keje. Mare inodu tabo, imagomodukare jetororeboeie ure imi duji. Pagimejera umode tugogado ii.
source: Itadaboe umodukare ipogurudo ia iro keje. Mare inodu tabo, imagomodukare jetororeboeie ure imi duji. Pagimejera umode tugogado ii.

b: Kode, tadugu kaba boei boe aregodukai pudae du otodai, mare tawudugugudo jii Pagimejera aregodu kae. Umode boe urugudo biadodure coreboe tadaboeji. Umode boe edo boe pawuje ime emeardaeji. Nowu inodu keje Pao mako pemegamode pai tu tu pareore.
source: Kode, tadugu kaba boei boe aregodukai pudae du otodai, mare tawudugugudo jii Pagimejera aregodu kae. Umode boe urugudo biadodure coreboe tadaboeji. Umode boe edo boe pawuje ime emeardaeji. Nowu inodu keje Pao mako pemegamode pai tu tu pareore.

b: Inagore nowu inodu jamedu boeji, iiboeji, Apolo jiboeji, taigoia: taerduwawo, tagodu kawo nowu bapera atugo ao kae, iaboe iaboe enojarokawo pudui, tuwiapagai jice woje cei.
source: Inagore nowu inodu jamedu boeji, iiboeji, Apolo jiboeji, taigoia: taerduwawo, tagodu kawo nowu bapera atugo ao kae, iaboe iaboe enojarokawo pudui, tuwiapagai jice woje cei.

b: Kakoduwu koiaba ure akurido? Ure akaboboe jamedu boe makudukare akai? Kode, makududodure akai ma, kodiba akojarore ai, makudu karega ure akai du kodiwore?
source: Kakoduwu koiaba ure akurido? Ure akaboboe jamedu boe makudukare akai? Kode, makududodure akai ma, kodiba akojarore ai, makudu karega ure akai du kodiwore?

b: Taguredure, tagoroe kuricigore, boe eimejerage nure tagi ceiageje. Ica, boe eimejerage jokodu remawugedo tagi, boe eimejeragewo cegi tagabo jamedu.
source: Taguredure, tagoroe kuricigore, boe eimejerage nure tagi ceiageje. Ica, boe eimejerage jokodu remawugedo tagi, boe eimejeragewo cegi tagabo jamedu.

b: Imeardaere Paoie apostolodoge cegi cedudo boe opo kejeduji, bimodeboe reore: Cedure moto keje boe eerdaece, boe eegai, tupadoge eegai jamedu.
source: Imeardaere Paoie apostolodoge cegi cedudo boe opo kejeduji, bimodeboe reore: Cedure moto keje boe eerdaece, boe eegai, tupadoge eegai jamedu.

b: Cristo jiboe koiare cere cedo nono matadureboe reore, tagirema taerduwa rakaguragare. Cegi ceragakare, tagirema taragare. Tagire boe eerdu kurire tai, cegirema boere cewarigodudo cei.
source: Cristo jiboe koiare cere cedo nono matadureboe reore, tagirema taerduwa rakaguragare. Cegi ceragakare, tagirema taragare. Tagire boe eerdu kurire tai, cegirema boere cewarigodudo cei.

b: Jii oino cemagudure cege boi kai, marenarure cegi, boe erorerure cei, cemuga kidagodureu bokwa.
source: Jii oino cemagudure cege boi kai, marenarure cegi, boe erorerure cei, cemuga kidagodureu bokwa.

b: Jii oino cemedugodure cemaragodui cegera tabo du tabo. Boe enogwaguru pegare cedabo du keje, cenogwaguru pemegare boe ebo, boe etonare cei du keje, cere cegiwa rakado; boe emago pegai cei du keje, cenogituwa pemegado boei.
source: Jii oino cemedugodure cemaragodui cegera tabo du tabo. Boe enogwaguru pegare cedabo du keje, cenogwaguru pemegare boe ebo, boe etonare cei du keje, cere cegiwa rakado; boe emago pegai cei du keje, cenogituwa pemegado boei.

b: Jii oino cere nono awu moto kejewu boe gigudu reore, boe eiamedu boere cebijido.
source: Jii oino cere nono awu moto kejewu boe gigudu reore, boe eiamedu boere cebijido.

b: Ire bapera atugodo awu inodu jamedu boeji, mare iwo tabogurudo du bogai karega, mare iwo taerduwado nono imeardu kurire jiwu itoreie ure tagi duji.
source: Ire bapera atugodo awu inodu jamedu boeji, mare iwo tabogurudo du bogai karega, mare iwo taerduwado nono imeardu kurire jiwu itoreie ure tagi duji.

b: Paga karega, umode taerduwadowuge emagaguragamode Cristo tada, mare taomage emagaguragakare; igoiare ire itoredo tagi Cristo tada, bakaru pemegareu koia.
source: Paga karega, umode taerduwadowuge emagaguragamode Cristo tada, mare taomage emagaguragakare; igoiare ire itoredo tagi Cristo tada, bakaru pemegareu koia.

b: Kodire inogwamagudu nure tai, tagoduwo iro rekodaji.
source: Kodire inogwamagudu nure tai, tagoduwo iro rekodaji.

b: Kodire ire imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedu Timóteo, upore Pao apowu, rojai tawogai. Ema umode tawia jetu ino boe eroiaguduji, imagai boe eerduwado ji Igreja jamedu boe keje du reore.
source: Kodire ire imeardu kurire jiwu itonaregedu Timóteo, upore Pao apowu, rojai tawogai. Ema umode tawia jetu ino boe eroiaguduji, imagai boe eerduwado ji Igreja jamedu boe keje du reore.

b: Ia tagi tameardaere imodukae ikirimi tawogai pugeje duji, du koia enojarore pudui.
source: Ia tagi tameardaere imodukae ikirimi tawogai pugeje duji, du koia enojarore pudui.

b: Mare maigodu kuri je itumode tagae pugeje, Pao aidu keje. Nono, imode ikogado nowu ocarore puduiwuge ewadaruji karega, mare ero rakareu pemegareuji.
source: Mare maigodu kuri je itumode tagae pugeje, Pao aidu keje. Nono, imode ikogado nowu ocarore puduiwuge ewadaruji karega, mare ero rakareu pemegareuji.

b: Paga karega, boe ewadaru tada karega Pao o boe pemegareu mugure, mare boe ero pemegareu tada.
source: Paga karega, boe ewadaru tada karega Pao o boe pemegareu mugure, mare boe ero pemegareu tada.

b: Kode, kakoduwu jiba tagaidure? Ituwo tagae iwara tabo, iarema inogudureu tabo kana?
source: Kode, kakoduwu jiba tagaidure? Ituwo tagae iwara tabo, iarema inogudureu tabo kana?

b: Paulo korigodure Corinto tadawu Pao uwobei, ia ro pegareu meture etada kodi.
source: Paulo korigodure Corinto tadawu Pao uwobei, ia ro pegareu meture etada kodi.

b: Boe ego egore tadodaie iaboe ekera keadure, duwuge ero pega kodure ao pegokareuge ero pega kori. Ia tagi tadoda mugure tuo oreduje apo jamedu.
source: Boe ego egore tadodaie iaboe ekera keadure, duwuge ero pega kodure ao pegokareuge ero pega kori. Ia tagi tadoda mugure tuo oreduje apo jamedu.

b: Du inodu tabo tagojarore tai. Tagiarigodukare inodu koia, takare nowu roinowu tawujeduie tabiji.
source: Du inodu tabo tagojarore tai. Tagiarigodukare inodu koia, takare nowu roinowu tawujeduie tabiji.

b: Kode, imi boe jokodure, iragoje jaere tai, mare itaroe mugure tagabo. Itugure nowu roinowuji marigudu nono iragojei tadodadu kodiwore.
source: Kode, imi boe jokodure, iragoje jaere tai, mare itaroe mugure tagabo. Itugure nowu roinowuji marigudu nono iragojei tadodadu kodiwore.

b: Tado pui itaroe tabo, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ro rakareu tabo, pawo pagogado ji.
source: Tado pui itaroe tabo, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ro rakareu tabo, pawo pagogado ji.

b: Kode, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo awu imedu kodu makudumode maereboe ai, duma utaroedo cinorudo pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meriji.
source: Kode, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo awu imedu kodu makudumode maereboe ai, duma utaroedo cinorudo pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meriji.

b: Tagi tare tagojarodo tai paga tu je. Taerduwakare boe okoi puidu umode jamedu boe kugu jamedu pegado duji?
source: Tagi tare tagojarodo tai paga tu je. Taerduwakare boe okoi puidu umode jamedu boe kugu jamedu pegado duji?

b: Kode okore puiwu pegareu jaowu barigu tabiji, duma tawo nono ia boekugu maiwu pemegareure. Mare paga karega, tare nono amireu okokare puiwore. Mare paga karega, Cristore ceno Pascoa rema, dure bitodure.
source: Kode okore puiwu pegareu jaowu barigu tabiji, duma tawo nono ia boekugu maiwu pemegareure. Mare paga karega, tare nono amireu okokare puiwore. Mare paga karega, Cristore ceno Pascoa rema, dure bitodure.

b: Awu inodu tabo, pawo pago Páscoa parudo, mare okore puiwu codureu tabo karega, okore puiwu pegareu tabo karega, mare okokare puiwu amireu tabo, boe pemegareu tabo, boe rikireu tabo.
source: Awu inodu tabo, pawo pago Páscoa parudo, mare okore puiwu codureu tabo karega, okore puiwu pegareu tabo karega, mare okokare puiwu amireu tabo, boe pemegareu tabo, boe rikireu tabo.

b: Ia ino bapera atugo tada imagore tai tagawo tabodo poguru bokwareuge ebo.
source: Ia ino bapera atugo tada imagore tai tagawo tabodo poguru bokwareuge ebo.

b: Mare imagokare awu moto kejewu ro pegareboeji: okwa kidu ierikareuge, iwogu kigodureuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, awu moto ro pegareugei karega inagoino tawiegai; iarema tadu rumode awu moto piji kodi karega.
source: Mare imagokare awu moto kejewu ro pegareboeji: okwa kidu ierikareuge, iwogu kigodureuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, awu moto ro pegareugei karega inagoino tawiegai; iarema tadu rumode awu moto piji kodi karega.

b: Mare imagore tagaiagu tabodo cewu akore pawieie pudumi boe eegai, mare du inodu tabo rore boe pegareuji, iarema okwa kidu ierikare, iarema meartorure paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei, iarema ure tumedage ewarigodudo pudui tuwadaru tabo, iarema joku baibaire, iarema iwogu kigodure, du apo tagogwagekaba jamedu.
source: Mare imagore tagaiagu tabodo cewu akore pawieie pudumi boe eegai, mare du inodu tabo rore boe pegareuji, iarema okwa kidu ierikare, iarema meartorure paga pagawu aroe eimejeragei, iarema ure tumedage ewarigodudo pudui tuwadaru tabo, iarema joku baibaire, iarema iwogu kigodure, du apo tagogwagekaba jamedu.

b: Kode kodiba imode ikogado okwacere baawadu jaogwaiwugei? Tu tadodawuge eire tamode tagogado.
source: Kode kodiba imode ikogado okwacere baawadu jaogwaiwugei? Tu tadodawuge eire tamode tagogado.

b: Toro baawadu jaogwaiwuge, Pao umode tugogado ei. Aorareu tawuje tabiji.
source: Toro baawadu jaogwaiwuge, Pao umode tugogado ei. Aorareu tawuje tabiji.

b: Ao pegokareuge ekawo tugogado ao pegoreugei.
source: Ao pegokareuge ekawo tugogado ao pegoreugei.

b: Ia tagi tagorigodure pui du keje, kodiba tadumode ao pegokareuge etae ewo tugogado tai? Kodiba tadukare tamanamage ao pegoreuge etae?
source: Ia tagi tagorigodure pui du keje, kodiba tadumode ao pegokareuge etae ewo tugogado tai? Kodiba tadukare tamanamage ao pegoreuge etae?

b: Taerduwakare ao pegoreu pemegareuge emode tugogado awu moto kejewuge eiduji? Kode, tamode tagogado awu motoji ma, kode, tamodukare tarugadu tawo tagogado biegareboeji?
source: Taerduwakare ao pegoreu pemegareuge emode tugogado awu moto kejewuge eiduji? Kode, tamode tagogado awu motoji ma, kode, tamodukare tarugadu tawo tagogado biegareboeji?

b: Taerduwakare pamoduie pagogado tupadoge eiduji? Kode, awu moto kejewu boe biegareboe paroiwamodukana pawo pagogado ji?
source: Taerduwakare pamoduie pagogado tupadoge eiduji? Kode, awu moto kejewu boe biegareboe paroiwamodukana pawo pagogado ji?

b: Kode, tagorigodumode pui awu inodu keje, tageragu ia biegare tu Pao uwai tadawuji uwo tugogado tai.
source: Kode, tagorigodumode pui awu inodu keje, tageragu ia biegare tu Pao uwai tadawuji uwo tugogado tai.

b:
Inagore awu inoduji tai iwo tabogurudo. Boe eerdumodukare ia jorduwa rakare tadodawu ui mito tu je duji uwo tugogado tawiemagei?
Pao uwobe emodukare tumagu turo pegareu kai.
source:
Inagore awu inoduji tai iwo tabogurudo. Boe eerdumodukare ia jorduwa rakare tadodawu ui mito tu je duji uwo tugogado tawiemagei?
Pao uwobe emodukare tumagu turo pegareu kai.

b: Mare tadoda, ia uwiemage pujewuge ekorigodu nure pui, jamedu ao pegokareuge eegai.
source: Mare tadoda, ia uwiemage pujewuge ekorigodu nure pui, jamedu ao pegokareuge eegai.

b: Tamago pegai puidu, taro pegareu rema, kodiba takare tadurudo boe ekoriji? Kodiba tabemegakare boei turopegado tai du keje?
source: Tamago pegai puidu, taro pegareu rema, kodiba takare tadurudo boe ekoriji? Kodiba tabemegakare boei turopegado tai du keje?

b: Mare du inodu tabo, tagi rugadu boe korire tai, tare boe eekuri pagado, tarore awu inoduji tawiemagei jamedu.
source: Mare du inodu tabo, tagi rugadu boe korire tai, tare boe eekuri pagado, tarore awu inoduji tawiemagei jamedu.

b: Taerduwakare jetorokareuge emedukae Pao o boe pemegareu tadaduji? Tagaba tae kuri pagado: jerebarikareuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, areme ecebage,
source: Taerduwakare jetorokareuge emedukae Pao o boe pemegareu tadaduji? Tagaba tae kuri pagado: jerebarikareuge, meartorure paga pagau aroe eimejerage eiwuge, areme ecebage,

b: Ure tudo nono areme eiwuge, meridoge, iwogu kigodureuge, jetorireuge, joku baibaireuge, bataru pegareuge, ukigodure boe ewidowuge, ia emage eiamedu emedumodukare Pao o boe pemegareu tada.
source: Ure tudo nono areme eiwuge, meridoge, iwogu kigodureuge, jetorireuge, joku baibaireuge, bataru pegareuge, ukigodure boe ewidowuge, ia emage eiamedu emedumodukare Pao o boe pemegareu tada.

b: Ia tagi tare nono nowuge ereore marigudu. Mare du inodu tabo tagabidure, tagagaru moture, taedorogodure tai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, Pao Utaroe koia.
source: Ia tagi tare nono nowuge ereore marigudu. Mare du inodu tabo tagabidure, tagagaru moture, taedorogodure tai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, Pao Utaroe koia.

b: Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare jamedu boe ukare turugadu inai. Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare imodukare iaboedo irodo taidu reore.
source: Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare jamedu boe ukare turugadu inai. Ire irugadu iwo boe jamedu boe towuje, mare imodukare iaboedo irodo taidu reore.

b: Boe eke jare boe ekuri rema, boe ekurire boe eke ja rema, mare Paomode ui pobedu pegado. Boe ekodu boe ewiri ukare boe ero pegareu ai, mare Pagimejera ai, Pagimejerare pagodu kai.
source: Boe eke jare boe ekuri rema, boe ekurire boe eke ja rema, mare Paomode ui pobedu pegado. Boe ekodu boe ewiri ukare boe ero pegareu ai, mare Pagimejera ai, Pagimejerare pagodu kai.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera umode paewodudo bireuge epiji turo rakareu tabo nono tumagai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jewodudo du reore.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera umode paewodudo bireuge epiji turo rakareu tabo nono tumagai Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jewodudo du reore.

b: Taerduwakare tagodu uie ure Cristo koduce duji? Kode imodukana aredu ropegareudo kodudo Jesus Cristo koduce? Iromodukare ino rugadu.
source: Taerduwakare tagodu uie ure Cristo koduce duji? Kode imodukana aredu ropegareudo kodudo Jesus Cristo koduce? Iromodukare ino rugadu.

b: Taerduware cewu ure tubodo ropegareu aredu apowu uie ure turedudo mitotu apo duji. Mare paga karega, atugododure oino: “Ei pobedu emode nono tureduie mitotu jedu kodiwore”  (Gen 2,24).
source: Taerduware cewu ure tubodo ropegareu aredu apowu uie ure turedudo mitotu apo duji. Mare paga karega, atugododure oino: “Ei pobedu emode nono tureduie mitotu jedu kodiwore”  (Gen 2,24).

b: Mare cewu ure tubodo Pao apowu umode aroedo mitotu pudumi apo.
source: Mare cewu ure tubodo Pao apowu umode aroedo mitotu pudumi apo.
