b: Eragodure ia turagodure jiboe maiwuji, nowu Pao muga otodai. Iaboe iaboe eroiwakare turagoduwo eragodure jiboeji, mare tu cewu 144.000 cedu, duwugere etarudodure moto piji tu rugadu.
source: Eragodure ia turagodure jiboe maiwuji, nowu Pao muga otodai. Iaboe iaboe eroiwakare turagoduwo eragodure jiboeji, mare tu cewu 144.000 cedu, duwugere etarudodure moto piji tu rugadu.

b: Awugere ekera keadukare aremei, iaboe iaboe jetukare etaroeto kodi. Emagere ekodure Cordeiro apo kodureu jamedu boe kae. Etawujedure ime epiji, makudure boetijiboere emage Pao ai, Cordeiro ai.
source: Awugere ekera keadukare aremei, iaboe iaboe jetukare etaroeto kodi. Emagere ekodure Cordeiro apo kodureu jamedu boe kae. Etawujedure ime epiji, makudure boetijiboere emage Pao ai, Cordeiro ai.

b:
Boe eerdukare ewadararodaeji eiabiji; ero, emago pegareu bokwa Pao jekai.
Tupadogere boei tugogadodu awadudo.
source:
Boe eerdukare ewadararodaeji eiabiji; ero, emago pegareu bokwa Pao jekai.
Tupadogere boei tugogadodu awadudo.

b: Icare iordure ia tupa kodui baru oia jiduji, iedui bakaru maiwu akedu bokwareuji tuwo kogado moto kejewuge etai, padure pumekejewu boe eiamedu boe etai.
source: Icare iordure ia tupa kodui baru oia jiduji, iedui bakaru maiwu akedu bokwareuji tuwo kogado moto kejewuge etai, padure pumekejewu boe eiamedu boe etai.

b: Ure tumago rakaguragado tagoi oino du tabo: - Tabagududo Paoji, ie kurido. Icare boe aregodure umode tugogado boei du kae. Tabujodo cewu ure baru, moto, pobo maereu, pobojari boe towujewuji.
source: Ure tumago rakaguragado tagoi oino du tabo: - Tabagududo Paoji, ie kurido. Icare boe aregodure umode tugogado boei du kae. Tabujodo cewu ure baru, moto, pobo maereu, pobojari boe towujewuji.

b: Ia tupa kodure rekodaji, tagoi oino du tabo: - Bakurireu iei Babilônia cedu buture, buture, ure moto padui pumekejedu boe ekududo turo pegareuce, tuboguru bokwareuce kodi .
source: Ia tupa kodure rekodaji, tagoi oino du tabo: - Bakurireu iei Babilônia cedu buture, buture, ure moto padui pumekejedu boe ekududo turo pegareuce, tuboguru bokwareuce kodi .

b: Ia tupa kodure eregodajiwu akore tumago raka tabo: - Iaboe emode tubujodo barogoji, iarema ureoreduji, iarema etaidumode o kruca paduwo tuieri keje, iarema tugera keje ma, 10eerduwamode Pao kodu kagiriae remawuji. Jorubo ekureu o joru umode eerdudo tujebaeji, baru tadawu tupadoge eegai, Cordeiro jekai.
source: Ia tupa kodure eregodajiwu akore tumago raka tabo: - Iaboe emode tubujodo barogoji, iarema ureoreduji, iarema etaidumode o kruca paduwo tuieri keje, iarema tugera keje ma, 10eerduwamode Pao kodu kagiriae remawuji. Jorubo ekureu o joru umode eerdudo tujebaeji, baru tadawu tupadoge eegai, Cordeiro jekai.

b: Nowu ecebae uredudu rutumode baruto boe jameduji jii je. Ure tubujodo barogo jiwuge, barogo ureoredu jiwuge, barogo ie kruca makudure aiwuge, etamudodumodukare meriji, boecoji jii je.
source: Nowu ecebae uredudu rutumode baruto boe jameduji jii je. Ure tubujodo barogo jiwuge, barogo ureoredu jiwuge, barogo ie kruca makudure aiwuge, etamudodumodukare meriji, boecoji jii je.

b: Awu inodu koiare pemegareuge eduru awadudodure, cewu rore nono Paoi boe eroiagudu jiwuge, meartorure Jesus jiwuge.
source: Awu inodu koiare pemegareuge eduru awadudodure, cewu rore nono Paoi boe eroiagudu jiwuge, meartorure Jesus jiwuge.

b:
Imeardure iaboe emagoi baru piji duji, akore ii: - Awu inodu bu bapera keje: Aroe Pemegareu akore: U! Eiwo aidugiri nure ewire Pao iera kejewuge, ewo tamudo tumaragodaeji. Ero, ego, kodumode eregodaji.
Boei jepara jodo parera iguru enari kejedu.
source:
Imeardure iaboe emagoi baru piji duji, akore ii: - Awu inodu bu bapera keje: Aroe Pemegareu akore: U! Eiwo aidugiri nure ewire Pao iera kejewuge, ewo tamudo tumaragodaeji. Ero, ego, kodumode eregodaji.
Boei jepara jodo parera iguru enari kejedu.

b: Itaiwore kimo: ia boetugu kigadureu kejere ia Imedu Onaregedureboe mugure keje. Ia meriri ekureu kogure aogajeje, iedure ia jepara o micigireuji.
source: Itaiwore kimo: ia boetugu kigadureu kejere ia Imedu Onaregedureboe mugure keje. Ia meriri ekureu kogure aogajeje, iedure ia jepara o micigireuji.

b: Ia tupare tudawuje Pao uwai piji tumago rakaguraga tabo cewu mugure boetugu kejewu ae, akore: - Aebara jodo, boe kado. Icare boe aregodure pudae boewo boe kado, moto kejeboe kurodure kodi.
source: Ia tupare tudawuje Pao uwai piji tumago rakaguraga tabo cewu mugure boetugu kejewu ae, akore: - Aebara jodo, boe kado. Icare boe aregodure pudae boewo boe kado, moto kejeboe kurodure kodi.

b: Icare mugure nowu boetugu kejewu ure tuiebara jodo, icare moto kejeboe kadodure.
source: Icare mugure nowu boetugu kejewu ure tuiebara jodo, icare moto kejeboe kadodure.

b: Icare ia tupare tudawuje baru tadawu Pao uwai piji. Uiebara o micigireure jamedu.
source: Icare ia tupare tudawuje baru tadawu Pao uwai piji. Uiebara o micigireure jamedu.

b:
Icare ia tupa, cewu jeonare joru jiwu, ure tudawuje altar piji, makore tumago raka
guragareu tabo cewu uiebara o micigireu ae, akore: - Aebara o micigireu jodo boe keje, awu moto kejewu parera iguru ekenari kado, ekenari kurodure kodi.
source:
Icare ia tupa, cewu jeonare joru jiwu, ure tudawuje altar piji, makore tumago raka
guragareu tabo cewu uiebara o micigireu ae, akore: - Aebara o micigireu jodo boe keje, awu moto kejewu parera iguru ekenari kado, ekenari kurodure kodi.

b: Icare tupare tuiebara o micigireu jodo moto keje, ure parera iguru kado, ure ekenari barigu boemode tuwure jodo kejeboeto, mare tagoino du tabore, Pao kodu kagirae jire akoino.
source: Icare tupare tuiebara o micigireu jodo moto keje, ure parera iguru kado, ure ekenari barigu boemode tuwure jodo kejeboeto, mare tagoino du tabore, Pao kodu kagirae jire akoino.

b: Boere tuwure jodo keje bakurireu kujei, du kejere boe eku ure tadawuje piji. Nowu boe eku aregodure jii kawarudoge eia tadawu meriri kae, ure tumaedodu kuricigodo moto joki.
source: Boere tuwure jodo keje bakurireu kujei, du kejere boe eku ure tadawuje piji. Nowu boe eku aregodure jii kawarudoge eia tadawu meriri kae, ure tumaedodu kuricigodo moto joki.

b: Pao jiwu jora kurireu.
source: Pao jiwu jora kurireu.

b: Iordure iaboeji kimo baru tada, ia motu rakaguragareboeji: tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu ekedure boe ecebae boiwu ui ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto duji. Eigoiare emode Pao kodu kagirae oto bu nowu boiwu boe ecebae tabo.
source: Iordure iaboeji kimo baru tada, ia motu rakaguragareboeji: tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu ekedure boe ecebae boiwu ui ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto duji. Eigoiare emode Pao kodu kagirae oto bu nowu boiwu boe ecebae tabo.

b: Iordure ia pobo maereu ui nono meriri kuru reoreboeji, joru padure oiei. Ure tumorido barogo pegareu jiwuge, ure tumorido nowu barogo ureoredu jiwuge, ure tumorido nowu barogo ie oto pa jiwuge eragojere nowu pobo maereu meriri kurureu bukeje tugedui Pao o citaradoge ei du tabo.
source: Iordure ia pobo maereu ui nono meriri kuru reoreboeji, joru padure oiei. Ure tumorido barogo pegareu jiwuge, ure tumorido nowu barogo ureoredu jiwuge, ure tumorido nowu barogo ie oto pa jiwuge eragojere nowu pobo maereu meriri kurureu bukeje tugedui Pao o citaradoge ei du tabo.

b: Eragodure Pao utugare Moisés o joraji, Cordeiro o joraji, egore: - Ure tumorido boe jamedu jiwu Pao baru tadawu, aró, akago kuricigo remawu nure; jeture moto padui pumekejedu jamedu boe jiwu Pao, boe jetororeu, boe jokodureu nure akawarace.
source: Eragodure Pao utugare Moisés o joraji, Cordeiro o joraji, egore: - Ure tumorido boe jamedu jiwu Pao baru tadawu, aró, akago kuricigo remawu nure; jeture moto padui pumekejedu jamedu boe jiwu Pao, boe jetororeu, boe jokodureu nure akawarace.

b: Awu inodu rekodaji, iordure Pao bataru meture tadawu ira mugure tadawu Pao uwai ui tuiado duji.
source: Awu inodu rekodaji, iordure Pao bataru meture tadawu ira mugure tadawu Pao uwai ui tuiado duji.

b: Nowu Pao uwai pijire tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu ere tuiebu tugedui nowu boe ecebae ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto duji. Aroia pemegareu kigadureu meture ei, aroia boareu meriri ekureu kogure emorora kajeje.
source: Nowu Pao uwai pijire tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu ere tuiebu tugedui nowu boe ecebae ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto duji. Aroia pemegareu kigadureu meture ei, aroia boareu meriri ekureu kogure emorora kajeje.

b: Cewu jereboe ei pobe puibijidu ia ure ruwobo meriri ekureuge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu maku nowu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu etai, enorogobadure Pao jere jii jewu kodu kagirae tabo.
source: Cewu jereboe ei pobe puibijidu ia ure ruwobo meriri ekureuge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu maku nowu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowotodu etai, enorogobadure Pao jere jii jewu kodu kagirae tabo.

b:
Icare nowu Pao uwai korobadure aregodure Pao urugu pijiwu ro raka pijiwu jeredudu tabo. Iaboe iaboe eroiwakare tuwo turemo nowu Pao uwaito, nowu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu eroi boe ecebae tabo boei kimodu otonaji.

16.
source:
Icare nowu Pao uwai korobadure aregodure Pao urugu pijiwu ro raka pijiwu jeredudu tabo. Iaboe iaboe eroiwakare tuwo turemo nowu Pao uwaito, nowu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu eroi boe ecebae tabo boei kimodu otonaji.

16.

b: Du kodi icare nowu boetojiwure meture turuwobo tadaboe redo moto joki, icare ia boe enogurodudae pegareu ure tudowuje cewu barogo pegareu kruca padure kejewuge eiogi, ure tubujodo ure nono reoredu jiwuge eiogi.
source: Du kodi icare nowu boetojiwure meture turuwobo tadaboe redo moto joki, icare ia boe enogurodudae pegareu ure tudowuje cewu barogo pegareu kruca padure kejewuge eiogi, ure tubujodo ure nono reoredu jiwuge eiogi.

b: Icare boeru rakareure ime ekowu, emago pegare Pao ieji, ui boe ecebae rodo boe eiduji. Etaidukare tuwo tuiedorodo, etaidukare tuwo ie kurido.
source: Icare boeru rakareure ime ekowu, emago pegare Pao ieji, ui boe ecebae rodo boe eiduji. Etaidukare tuwo tuiedorodo, etaidukare tuwo ie kurido.

b: Pagera awubodureure meture turuwobo tadaboe redo barogo pegareu muga joki. Icare boecodure jeture jiwuge eiogi, utugarege ere toedo tugeruji tujebae kori koia.
source: Pagera awubodureure meture turuwobo tadaboe redo barogo pegareu muga joki. Icare boecodure jeture jiwuge eiogi, utugarege ere toedo tugeruji tujebae kori koia.

b: Emago pegare baru tadawu Paoji, boe korii pudui du koia, ekare tuiaedo turo pegareu piji.
source: Emago pegare baru tadawu Paoji, boe korii pudui du koia, ekare tuiaedo turo pegareu piji.

b: Eregodajiwure meture turuwobo tadaboe barigu pobo kurireu iei Eufrates cedu joki, icare pobo biture tuwo awara jado meri rutu jaogwaiwu boe eimejerage kurireuge etai.
source: Eregodajiwure meture turuwobo tadaboe barigu pobo kurireu iei Eufrates cedu joki, icare pobo biture tuwo awara jado meri rutu jaogwaiwu boe eimejerage kurireuge etai.

b: Icare iordure ia aroe pegareuge ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, ere nono ruiere, ere tudawuje nowu aroe tarigo ja piji, nowu barogo pegareu ja piji, nowu paga pagawu profeta ja piji.
source: Icare iordure ia aroe pegareuge ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, ere nono ruiere, ere tudawuje nowu aroe tarigo ja piji, nowu barogo pegareu ja piji, nowu paga pagawu profeta ja piji.

b: Aroe Aroe pegareu reuge nure emage, ere turo tuginoiwu towuje, eture moto jamedu kejewu boe eimejerage ewogai, tuwo eto pui, ewo tudo turugadu turugoduwo nowu Pao ro rakareu o meri kurireu aregodumodedu keje.
source: Aroe Aroe pegareu reuge nure emage, ere turo tuginoiwu towuje, eture moto jamedu kejewu boe eimejerage ewogai, tuwo eto pui, ewo tudo turugadu turugoduwo nowu Pao ro rakareu o meri kurireu aregodumodedu keje.

b: Pao akore: - Ca! Iwogureboe aregodu reorere itaregodumode. Jiwo aidugirireure umode tugudae pado pemegado, merumodukare tuwiri kedo tabo, umodukare boe eerdudo tuboguraeji.
source: Pao akore: - Ca! Iwogureboe aregodu reorere itaregodumode. Jiwo aidugirireure umode tugudae pado pemegado, merumodukare tuwiri kedo tabo, umodukare boe eerdudo tuboguraeji.

b: Ure eto pui ia boe eeda keje. Hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Armagedon (boe ewadaru tabo: Boe Eimejerage Ewire Kejeboe).
source: Ure eto pui ia boe eeda keje. Hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Armagedon (boe ewadaru tabo: Boe Eimejerage Ewire Kejeboe).

b: Kodure boigodu eregodajiwu ure meture turuwobo tadaboe barigu baru otoji, icare ia boe emago rakareu aregodure nowu Pao muga piji, akore:  - Ure turugadu. Oino.
source: Kodure boigodu eregodajiwu ure meture turuwobo tadaboe barigu baru otoji, icare ia boe emago rakareu aregodure nowu Pao muga piji, akore:  - Ure turugadu. Oino.

b: Icare boe jeragudure, boe emagore, boiarurugodure, ia moto amagadu kurireure, boekare ino jii boe eedui moto kejedu paru piji.
source: Icare boe jeragudure, boe emagore, boiarurugodure, ia moto amagadu kurireure, boekare ino jii boe eedui moto kejedu paru piji.

b: Nowu bakurireu remawu kadodure tuiado pobe ma jewu metuia bokware. Moto padui pumekejedu kejewu bakurireuge ewudure. Pao biabuture nowu bakurireu iei Babilônia cedu keje tuwo udo turokogado tugodu kagirae korireuce.
source: Nowu bakurireu remawu kadodure tuiado pobe ma jewu metuia bokware. Moto padui pumekejedu kejewu bakurireuge ewudure. Pao biabuture nowu bakurireu iei Babilônia cedu keje tuwo udo turokogado tugodu kagirae korireuce.

b: Pobo aiare tabowu moto jamadu boe eregodure. Torekaridoge eiamedu boe ewogware pi tuku je.
source: Pobo aiare tabowu moto jamadu boe eregodure. Torekaridoge eiamedu boe ewogware pi tuku je.

b: Poborireu kuricigoreu buture baru piji ime ewugeje. Ime emago pegare Paoji ui tujebaedo poborireu ceduji, awure pega jokodure kodi.
source: Poborireu kuricigoreu buture baru piji ime ewugeje. Ime emago pegare Paoji ui tujebaedo poborireu ceduji, awure pega jokodure kodi.

b: Babilônia ucebae.
source: Babilônia ucebae.

b: Icare cewu iedure turuwobo jiwu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, ia emage, uture mato itae, akore ii: - Mato, imode aerdudo mugure pobo maereu aogejewu aredu ro pegareudo ucebaeji.
source: Icare cewu iedure turuwobo jiwu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, ia emage, uture mato itae, akore ii: - Mato, imode aerdudo mugure pobo maereu aogejewu aredu ro pegareudo ucebaeji.

b: Awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage ero pegare apo. Ure moto kejewuge etaora bai baido, tui ekududo tumeardae pegareuce du tabo.
source: Awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage ero pegare apo. Ure moto kejewuge etaora bai baido, tui ekududo tumeardae pegareuce du tabo.

b: Icare ure irego itaroe tabo toro boe makodureuto. Iordure ia aredu mugui ia barogo pegareu kujagureu keje duji; boe enogirudodae pegareu padure jamedu keje; aoradogere ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ukigadogere ikera awubodure.
source: Icare ure irego itaroe tabo toro boe makodureuto. Iordure ia aredu mugui ia barogo pegareu kujagureu keje duji; boe enogirudodae pegareu padure jamedu keje; aoradogere ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ukigadogere ikera awubodure.

b: Nowu aredu ukudae kujagu rakareure meture ji, oroere meriri ekureuce, tori mori kuricigoreuce, tori motureuce; iedure ia ruwobo meriri ekureu okorobadui turo, tago, tagemo pegareu tabo duji.
source: Nowu aredu ukudae kujagu rakareure meture ji, oroere meriri ekureuce, tori mori kuricigoreuce, tori motureuce; iedure ia ruwobo meriri ekureu okorobadui turo, tago, tagemo pegareu tabo duji.

b: Ia boe ekie bioreure padure jeri keje: - Babilnia, bakurireu kurireu, awu moto kejewu boe ero pegareu boe emeardae pegareu jamedu boe etuje.
source: Ia boe ekie bioreure padure jeri keje: - Babilnia, bakurireu kurireu, awu moto kejewu boe ero pegareu boe emeardae pegareu jamedu boe etuje.

b: Iordure nowu aredu joku pegai pemegareuge eku tabo, ure tuiwodo Jesus aiwuge eku tabo duji.
source: Iordure nowu aredu joku pegai pemegareuge eku tabo, ure tuiwodo Jesus aiwuge eku tabo duji.

b: Mare nowu tupa akore oino ii: Kodiba apagudugodure? Imi rugadure imode aerduwado nowu aredu kodiboeji, nowu aoradogere ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ukigadogere ikera pudogidure, oredure nowu aredu apowu barogo pegareu kodiboeji.
source: Mare nowu tupa akore oino ii: Kodiba apagudugodure? Imi rugadure imode aerduwado nowu aredu kodiboeji, nowu aoradogere ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ukigadogere ikera pudogidure, oredure nowu aredu apowu barogo pegareu kodiboeji.

b: Aerdure jiwu barogo pegareu ure marigudu, ukare pugeje, mare jepadumode jewoduio piji, utumode tuwogwadodu kae. Mugure awu moto kejewuge, ie padure bapera jereu keje boe paru pijiwuge, eebogodu kuricigomode tuiordui barogo pegareu ui tuguo pugeje duji.
source: Aerdure jiwu barogo pegareu ure marigudu, ukare pugeje, mare jepadumode jewoduio piji, utumode tuwogwadodu kae. Mugure awu moto kejewuge, ie padure bapera jereu keje boe paru pijiwuge, eebogodu kuricigomode tuiordui barogo pegareu ui tuguo pugeje duji.

b: Mare oino, ure turugadu boewo tumeardae tugu. Nowu barogo aoradogei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, ere nono torekodudogei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, du ewugejere nowu aredu mugure.
source: Mare oino, ure turugadu boewo tumeardae tugu. Nowu barogo aoradogei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, ere nono torekodudogei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, du ewugejere nowu aredu mugure.

b: Nowu barogo aoradogei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, ure nono brae eimejerage ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto jamedu. Ei ikera awubodu reoreuge ewudure marigudu, ia rakoje kimore, boigoduwu aregodukare roga, mare aregodu keje rakoje raigirimoduka.
source: Nowu barogo aoradogei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, ure nono brae eimejerage ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto jamedu. Ei ikera awubodu reoreuge ewudure marigudu, ia rakoje kimore, boigoduwu aregodukare roga, mare aregodu keje rakoje raigirimoduka.

b: Nowu barogo pegareu ure marigudu mare ukare pugejewu, ure ikera awubodure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware ikera awubowutowu brae eimejera rema. Ia nowuge emeduia nure ema, utumode tuwogwarewo kae.
source: Nowu barogo pegareu ure marigudu mare ukare pugejewu, ure ikera awubodure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware ikera awubowutowu brae eimejera rema. Ia nowuge emeduia nure ema, utumode tuwogwarewo kae.

b: Ca! Cewu aerdure jiwu ukigadoge ei ikera pudogiduredu ere nono ia brae eimejerage ei ikera pudogiduredu remage, duwugere eetukare boei roga, mare eedumode boei kobori tu je nowu barogo pegareu apo.
source: Ca! Cewu aerdure jiwu ukigadoge ei ikera pudogiduredu ere nono ia brae eimejerage ei ikera pudogiduredu remage, duwugere eetukare boei roga, mare eedumode boei kobori tu je nowu barogo pegareu apo.

b: Emeardaemode nono pu meardaere, ewo turo raka maku barogo pegareu ai.
source: Emeardaemode nono pu meardaere, ewo turo raka maku barogo pegareu ai.

b: Erugodumode Cordeiroji, mare Cordeiro umode tumorido ei, emare boe eimejerage eimejera rema, boe eimejerage kurireuge eimejera kurireu nure ema kodi. Nowu jeture apowuge, makore ewogaiwuge, ure tugeragu ji pudaiwuge, meartorure jiwuge, emode tumorido apo jamedu.
source: Erugodumode Cordeiroji, mare Cordeiro umode tumorido ei, emare boe eimejerage eimejera rema, boe eimejerage kurireuge eimejera kurireu nure ema kodi. Nowu jeture apowuge, makore ewogaiwuge, ure tugeragu ji pudaiwuge, meartorure jiwuge, emode tumorido apo jamedu.

b:
Nowu tupa akore ii pugeje: - 
Aerdure jiwu pobodoge aredu mugure kejewuge ere nono moto padui pumekejewuge ereore, boe makareuge ereore, boe ewadaru padui pumekejewuge ereore.
source:
Nowu tupa akore ii pugeje: - 
Aerdure jiwu pobodoge aredu mugure kejewuge ere nono moto padui pumekejewuge ereore, boe makareuge ereore, boe ewadaru padui pumekejewuge ereore.

b: Nowu aerdure jiwu barogo ukigadoge ei ikera pudogiduredu ekodu kagirimode nowu aredu pegareudoji. Emode ukudae tawuje piji, emode biri kedodo, emode kodu kowuje, emode kowu joru tabo.
source: Nowu aerdure jiwu barogo ukigadoge ei ikera pudogiduredu ekodu kagirimode nowu aredu pegareudoji. Emode ukudae tawuje piji, emode biri kedodo, emode kodu kowuje, emode kowu joru tabo.

b: Paga karega, Paore etaidudo erowo tumeardae reore, erowo puapo ewo tugerabraredo barogo pegareuji jii boe kodui Pao bataru rekodaji du kae.
source: Paga karega, Paore etaidudo erowo tumeardae reore, erowo puapo ewo tugerabraredo barogo pegareuji jii boe kodui Pao bataru rekodaji du kae.

b: Aerdure jiwu aredu ure nono bakurireu kurireu reore, dure jeture moto kejewu brae eimejeragei.
source: Aerdure jiwu aredu ure nono bakurireu kurireu reore, dure jeture moto kejewu brae eimejeragei.

b: Babilônia buturedu.
source: Babilônia buturedu.

b: Nowu inodu rekodaji, iordure ia tupai turawuje baru pijiduji, du ro rakaguragare, ure moto urugudo tuiorugu tabo.
source: Nowu inodu rekodaji, iordure ia tupai turawuje baru pijiduji, du ro rakaguragare, ure moto urugudo tuiorugu tabo.

b: Ure tumago rakaguragado tagoi oino du tabo: - Buture. Babilônia kurireu buture.  Aroe pegareuge eeda, aroe pegareuge eiari, kiege pegareuge eiari nure ema pugeje.
source: Ure tumago rakaguragado tagoi oino du tabo: - Buture. Babilônia kurireu buture.  Aroe pegareuge eeda, aroe pegareuge eiari, kiege pegareuge eiari nure ema pugeje.

b: Paga karega, moto padui pumekejedu eiamedu boe ekudure ro ako pegareu kodu kagiraece, moto kejewu brae eimejerage ero pegare apo, awu moto kejewu ure akirodo boejiwuge ere toroe kuricigodo oroe kuricigoreu tabo.
source: Paga karega, moto padui pumekejedu eiamedu boe ekudure ro ako pegareu kodu kagiraece, moto kejewu brae eimejerage ero pegare apo, awu moto kejewu ure akirodo boejiwuge ere toroe kuricigodo oroe kuricigoreu tabo.

b: Imeardure ia boe emagoji pugeje, akore: - Iwobe, taebu piji, tarokawo nono ro pega reore, takawo metagedo tagi ucebae keje.
source: Imeardure ia boe emagoji pugeje, akore: - Iwobe, taebu piji, tarokawo nono ro pega reore, takawo metagedo tagi ucebae keje.

b: Paga karega, ro pegareu itodure, aregodure baruto, Pao biabuture ro pegareu keje.
source: Paga karega, ro pegareu itodure, aregodure baruto, Pao biabuture ro pegareu keje.

b: Ro magai tai du reorere taromode ji jamedu, ro pegareu mori maku ai tao kae. Ure tagududo towu ruwobo, okorawu, maku ai pugeje tao kae.
source: Ro magai tai du reorere taromode ji jamedu, ro pegareu mori maku ai tao kae. Ure tagududo towu ruwobo, okorawu, maku ai pugeje tao kae.

b: Umagai boe eerdudo toroe kurireu jitu reore, tamode ucebae, oragudu, maku ai jamedu. Paga karega, akore oino tuwabo keje: imugure boe eimejerage emuga keje boe eimejeragoi imi du tabo, mare oredu bireu aredu reore karega, imarenarudumodukare iaboe keje iaboe keje.
source: Umagai boe eerdudo toroe kurireu jitu reore, tamode ucebae, oragudu, maku ai jamedu. Paga karega, akore oino tuwabo keje: imugure boe eimejerage emuga keje boe eimejeragoi imi du tabo, mare oredu bireu aredu reore karega, imarenarudumodukare iaboe keje iaboe keje.

b: Du kodire awu ucebae boe aregodumode ae meri mitoduji: boe ewi, boe etoragudu, boe eke boi jidu, jorumode akedudo, mare paga karega, ure tugogado jiwu Pagimejera Aroe Eimejera ro rakare.
source: Du kodire awu ucebae boe aregodumode ae meri mitoduji: boe ewi, boe etoragudu, boe eke boi jidu, jorumode akedudo, mare paga karega, ure tugogado jiwu Pagimejera Aroe Eimejera ro rakare.

b: Ro pegare apowu awu moto kejewu brae eimejerage etoragudu kuricigomode bukeje, erdui jeredudui tudawuje piji du keje.
source: Ro pegare apowu awu moto kejewu brae eimejerage etoragudu kuricigomode bukeje, erdui jeredudui tudawuje piji du keje.

b: Eragoje jaemode ji tubagudu koia ucebae roi jituji, egomode: - Iai, iai! Babilônia bakurireu! Babilônia bakurireu! Boe raigirikare boei tugogado ai du tabo!
source: Eragoje jaemode ji tubagudu koia ucebae roi jituji, egomode: - Iai, iai! Babilônia bakurireu! Babilônia bakurireu! Boe raigirikare boei tugogado ai du tabo!

b: Awu moto kejewu baare akiró tabowuge etoragudumode etogeamode bukeje jamedu, ure akirodo enoroe jiboe bokware pugeje kodi.
source: Awu moto kejewu baare akiró tabowuge etoragudumode etogeamode bukeje jamedu, ure akirodo enoroe jiboe bokware pugeje kodi.

b: Enoroe meriri ekureu, meriri kigadureu, tori mori kuricigoreu! tori motureu, aroia kigadureu, aroia kujagureu, aroia kurukurureu, aroia kujagu rakaguragareu, awu ira boe roreu jamedu boe, enoroe barege eto rakareu, enoroe ira mori kuricigoreu, enoroe meriri kujagureu, meriri koadureu.
source: Enoroe meriri ekureu, meriri kigadureu, tori mori kuricigoreu! tori motureu, aroia kigadureu, aroia kujagureu, aroia kurukurureu, aroia kujagu rakaguragareu, awu ira boe roreu jamedu boe, enoroe barege eto rakareu, enoroe ira mori kuricigoreu, enoroe meriri kujagureu, meriri koadureu.

b: Enoroe tori kororogodureu, ia enoe roreboe padui pumekejedu jamedu boe, bokadoboe roreu, eke boe parera kuru, boe kaguru, eke iro boe, eguiee jamedu boe, eguiee ovelhadoge, kawarudoge, eno imarido boe, etugarege boe, ime boe.
source: Enoroe tori kororogodureu, ia enoe roreboe padui pumekejedu jamedu boe, bokadoboe roreu, eke boe parera kuru, boe kaguru, eke iro boe, eguiee jamedu boe, eguiee ovelhadoge, kawarudoge, eno imarido boe, etugarege boe, ime boe.

b: Akagemore jiboe rugadu akedure akoe kuri inodu, boe urugu boe akedure, aerdumodukare inoduji pugeje.
source: Akagemore jiboe rugadu akedure akoe kuri inodu, boe urugu boe akedure, aerdumodukare inoduji pugeje.

b: Ure akirodo awu inodu boe jiwuge emode tuburedodu jaedo tubagudu tabo ucebaece, etoragudumode etogeamode, tagoi oino du tabo: -
source: Ure akirodo awu inodu boe jiwuge emode tuburedodu jaedo tubagudu tabo ucebaece, etoragudumode etogeamode, tagoi oino du tabo: -

b: Jiwo pegareu bakurireu kurireu! Ure aroia pemegareu, aroia kujagureu, aroia kurukurureu upodo pudabo, ure cenawudo meriri ekureu tabo, tori mori kuricigoreu tabo, tori motureu tabo.
source: Jiwo pegareu bakurireu kurireu! Ure aroia pemegareu, aroia kujagureu, aroia kurukurureu upodo pudabo, ure cenawudo meriri ekureu tabo, tori mori kuricigoreu tabo, tori motureu tabo.

b: Mare awu oroe kuri inodu jamedu boe akedure pi tuku je. Ure ika kurireu redowuge eiamedu boe, pobo maereu kaowuge eiamedu boe, ika kurireu epage eiamedu boe, maragodure pobo kaowuge eiamedu boe ere tuburedodu jaedo ji.
source: Mare awu oroe kuri inodu jamedu boe akedure pi tuku je. Ure ika kurireu redowuge eiamedu boe, pobo maereu kaowuge eiamedu boe, ika kurireu epage eiamedu boe, maragodure pobo kaowuge eiamedu boe ere tuburedodu jaedo ji.

b:
Etaiwoi jeredudui tudawuje nowu joru cei nowu bakurireuto du piji du kae, egore: 
Kakoduwu bakurireu ure nono awu bakurireu kurireu reore?
source:
Etaiwoi jeredudui tudawuje nowu joru cei nowu bakurireuto du piji du kae, egore: 
Kakoduwu bakurireu ure nono awu bakurireu kurireu reore?

b:
Ere moto rugudu tugu taoto, toragudu tabo, tumago tabo: 
Jiwo pegareu bakurireu kurireu! Ure ika kurireu epage eiamedu boe enoroe kuricigodo toe kurireu tabo. Mare akedure pi tuku je.
source:
Ere moto rugudu tugu taoto, toragudu tabo, tumago tabo: 
Jiwo pegareu bakurireu kurireu! Ure ika kurireu epage eiamedu boe enoroe kuricigodo toe kurireu tabo. Mare akedure pi tuku je.

b: Aki, baru, aegaredo ji, tagi jamedu, pemegareuge, apostolodoge, profetadoge, taegaredo ji, paga karega, Paore tugogado ji tui tamorido du tabo.
source: Aki, baru, aegaredo ji, tagi jamedu, pemegareuge, apostolodoge, profetadoge, taegaredo ji, paga karega, Paore tugogado ji tui tamorido du tabo.

b: Icare ia tupa ro rakareu ure tugeragu ia tori kurireuji, ure barigu pobo maereuto, akore: - Oinore Babilônia bakurireu kurireu barigudumode, boe eerdumodukare ji pugeje.
source: Icare ia tupa ro rakareu ure tugeragu ia tori kurireuji, ure barigu pobo maereuto, akore: - Oinore Babilônia bakurireu kurireu barigudumode, boe eerdumodukare ji pugeje.

b: Boe emeardumodukare awugeje iera akore citara jiwuge ekera akoji, urareuge eraji, okwa akoreuge enogwa akoji pugeje. Boe eerdumodukare atoda ia maragodureboeji pugeje, boe emeardumodukare atoda pugeje ure boe a kududowu tori akoji pugeje.
source: Boe emeardumodukare awugeje iera akore citara jiwuge ekera akoji, urareuge eraji, okwa akoreuge enogwa akoji pugeje. Boe eerdumodukare atoda ia maragodureboeji pugeje, boe emeardumodukare atoda pugeje ure boe a kududowu tori akoji pugeje.

b: Jorugu ja urugumodukare awugeje pugeje, boe emeardumodukare awugeje uwirereu, ukogereudo emagoji pugeje. Paga karega, ure akirodo akoroe taboboe awu moto kejeboe eimejerare emage moto padui pumekejedu eiamedu boe ere tuwogwado boeto aro pegareu koia.
source: Jorugu ja urugumodukare awugeje pugeje, boe emeardumodukare awugeje uwirereu, ukogereudo emagoji pugeje. Paga karega, ure akirodo akoroe taboboe awu moto kejeboe eimejerare emage moto padui pumekejedu eiamedu boe ere tuwogwado boeto aro pegareu koia.

b: Awugejere boe eerdure profetadoge ekuji, pemegareuge ekuji, cewu bitodure moto kejewuge eiamedu boe ekuji.
source: Awugejere boe eerdure profetadoge ekuji, pemegareuge ekuji, cewu bitodure moto kejewuge eiamedu boe ekuji.

b: Baru tadawu jora.
source: Baru tadawu jora.

b: Oinodu rekodaji imeardure baru tada ia makareboe eragoduji. Egore: - Paegarewo. Pao ore boe einorudae, urugureboe, rorakareboe.
source: Oinodu rekodaji imeardure baru tada ia makareboe eragoduji. Egore: - Paegarewo. Pao ore boe einorudae, urugureboe, rorakareboe.

b: Paoi tugogado boeidu rikire, jetorogodure. Ure tugogado cewu aredu kurireudo, ro pegareudoji, duwudo ure moto pegado turo pegareu tabo.
source: Paoi tugogado boeidu rikire, jetorogodure. Ure tugogado cewu aredu kurireudo, ro pegareudoji, duwudo ure moto pegado turo pegareu tabo.

b: Ure tugogado ji tudugarege eku mori bogai. Du kejere icare eragodure pugeje, egore: - Paegarewo, nowu aredu pegareudo uredudu rutumode baruto boe jameduji jii je kodi.
source: Ure tugogado ji tudugarege eku mori bogai. Du kejere icare eragodure pugeje, egore: - Paegarewo, nowu aredu pegareudo uredudu rutumode baruto boe jameduji jii je kodi.

b: Du keje icare cewu Paopegadogei ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure pobepuibiji pugejedu, cewu jereboe ei pobepuibijidu ere tubujodo Pao ui tumugudo nowu mugureu keje duji, egore: - Oino rugadu! Paegarewo!
source: Du keje icare cewu Paopegadogei ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure pobepuibiji pugejedu, cewu jereboe ei pobepuibijidu ere tubujodo Pao ui tumugudo nowu mugureu keje duji, egore: - Oino rugadu! Paegarewo!

b: Nowu muga piji iaboe emago aregodure, akore: - Tagi taiamedu boe, Pao utugarege biegareuge, kurireuge tabagudui cedu, tarago ji.
source: Nowu muga piji iaboe emago aregodure, akore: - Tagi taiamedu boe, Pao utugarege biegareuge, kurireuge tabagudui cedu, tarago ji.

b: Awu inodu keje imeardure ia makareuge eragoduji, eiarurure nono pobo makareuge eiarurure, ure nono boiaruru rakareuge eiarurure, egore: - Paegarewo, Pagimejera Pao ro rakareu jeture boei kodi.
source: Awu inodu keje imeardure ia makareuge eragoduji, eiarurure nono pobo makareuge eiarurure, ure nono boiaruru rakareuge eiarurure, egore: - Paegarewo, Pagimejera Pao ro rakareu jeture boei kodi.

b: Paegarewo, paegare kuricigowo, pawo akaru kurido. Paga karega, nowu Cordeiro iera makudumode aredu aidu puredugodu nure, nowu iera makudumode aiwudo ure tudo turugadu kodi.
source: Paegarewo, paegare kuricigowo, pawo akaru kurido. Paga karega, nowu Cordeiro iera makudumode aredu aidu puredugodu nure, nowu iera makudumode aiwudo ure tudo turugadu kodi.

b: Boere jeonado aroia pemegareu motureuji, awu aroia jebatodure pemegareuge ero pemegareuji.
source: Boere jeonado aroia pemegareu motureuji, awu aroia jebatodure pemegareuge ero pemegareuji.

b: Du kejera akore oino ii: - Awu inodu bu bapera keje: Returudodure ewogaiwuge eerduwo Cordeiro iera makudui aredu aidu jiwuge eiwo aidugiri nure. Icare akore oino ii kimo: - Awu Pao bataru boe rikireu nure ema.
source: Du kejera akore oino ii: - Awu inodu bu bapera keje: Returudodure ewogaiwuge eerduwo Cordeiro iera makudui aredu aidu jiwuge eiwo aidugiri nure. Icare akore oino ii kimo: - Awu Pao bataru boe rikireu nure ema.

b:
Iwudure bure paru iwo ipujodo ji, mare akore oino ii: - Aro kaba ino! Pao utugare nure imi areore, amanamage emeatorure Jesus bataru jiwuge ereore. Pao jire amode apujodo. Boe jokodu Jesus Cristo bataru jire profetadoge emagore.
Cristo ui tumorido barege pegareuge eidu.
source:
Iwudure bure paru iwo ipujodo ji, mare akore oino ii: - Aro kaba ino! Pao utugare nure imi areore, amanamage emeatorure Jesus bataru jiwuge ereore. Pao jire amode apujodo. Boe jokodu Jesus Cristo bataru jire profetadoge emagore.
Cristo ui tumorido barege pegareuge eidu.

b: Iordure kimo baru jaji: ia kawaru kigadureu jepadure piji. Mugure kejeboe iere Boe Rikireu, Boe Jokodureu; boe jetororeu tabore ure tugogado boei, rugodure tonare jiwugei.
source: Iordure kimo baru jaji: ia kawaru kigadureu jepadure piji. Mugure kejeboe iere Boe Rikireu, Boe Jokodureu; boe jetororeu tabore ure tugogado boei, rugodure tonare jiwugei.

b: Joku jeragudure. Boe etaogajejewu makare aogajeje, ia boe eerduwakare jiwu boe ekie padure keje, ema mitotu jere jorduware ji.
source: Joku jeragudure. Boe etaogajejewu makare aogajeje, ia boe eerduwakare jiwu boe ekie padure keje, ema mitotu jere jorduware ji.

b: Ia aroia, boekure jokiwure, meture ji. Iere Pao o Bataru rema.
source: Ia aroia, boekure jokiwure, meture ji. Iere Pao o Bataru rema.

b: Baru tadawu tugobaigarege emugui kawaru kigadureuge ewugejedure ekodure apo, aroia kigadureu motureu meture ei.
source: Baru tadawu tugobaigarege emugui kawaru kigadureuge ewugejedure ekodure apo, aroia kigadureu motureu meture ei.

b: Ia toriga raireu ore puibijiwure aregodure ja piji, uwo padure pumekejewu meartorukareuge etogorido tabo. Umode tuwure jodo boere tuwure jodo parera kejeboe okorobadui Pao kodu kagirae tabodu keje.
source: Ia toriga raireu ore puibijiwure aregodure ja piji, uwo padure pumekejewu meartorukareuge etogorido tabo. Umode tuwure jodo boere tuwure jodo parera kejeboe okorobadui Pao kodu kagirae tabodu keje.

b: Opore apowu aroia keje, upeagajejewu keje, atugododure oino: Boe eimejerage Eimejera, boe eimejerage kurireuge Eimejera Kurireu.
source: Opore apowu aroia keje, upeagajejewu keje, atugododure oino: Boe eimejerage Eimejera, boe eimejerage kurireuge Eimejera Kurireu.

b: Icare iordure ia tupa rakojei meri joku bukeje duji, akore tumago raka tabo kodure baru otojiwu kiege baregei: - Tado pui mato, Paore tagogwage kuricigomode jiboe udo turugado du kae.
source: Icare iordure ia tupa rakojei meri joku bukeje duji, akore tumago raka tabo kodure baru otojiwu kiege baregei: - Tado pui mato, Paore tagogwage kuricigomode jiboe udo turugado du kae.

b: Tawo brae eimejerage ekodu kowuje, tawo tugobaigarege eimejerage ekodu, ro rakareuge ekodu kowuje, tawo kawarudoge ekodu, mugure ewugejewuge ekodu kowuje, tawo boe etugarekare emawuge, boe etugare emawuge, biegareuge, kurireuge ime ekodu kowuje.
source: Tawo brae eimejerage ekodu kowuje, tawo tugobaigarege eimejerage ekodu, ro rakareuge ekodu kowuje, tawo kawarudoge ekodu, mugure ewugejewuge ekodu kowuje, tawo boe etugarekare emawuge, boe etugare emawuge, biegareuge, kurireuge ime ekodu kowuje.

b: Iordure cewu barogo pegareuji, iordure awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage ei tudo pui to tugobaigarege ebo, turugoduwo cewu mugure nowu kawaru kejewu tugobaigarege ei jamedu du bogai.
source: Iordure cewu barogo pegareuji, iordure awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage ei tudo pui to tugobaigarege ebo, turugoduwo cewu mugure nowu kawaru kejewu tugobaigarege ei jamedu du bogai.

b: Mare cewu barogo pegareu ieragogudodure, cewu profeta pegareu apo, dure ure turo tuginoiwu towuje tui cewu barogo pegareu kruca padure ewugejewuge, ure tubujodo ure nono reoredu jiwuge eekuri pagado du tabo. Ei pobedu ewarigudodure jorubo ekureu ure nono kuruga reoreboe uruto.
source: Mare cewu barogo pegareu ieragogudodure, cewu profeta pegareu apo, dure ure turo tuginoiwu towuje tui cewu barogo pegareu kruca padure ewugejewuge, ure tubujodo ure nono reoredu jiwuge eekuri pagado du tabo. Ei pobedu ewarigudodure jorubo ekureu ure nono kuruga reoreboe uruto.

b: Cewu mugure kawaru kejewu ure iage ewido cewu aregodure tuiabijiwu tariga raireu tabo. Kiege barege eiamedu boe ere tuguredudo nowuge ekodu tabo.
source: Cewu mugure kawaru kejewu ure iage ewido cewu aregodure tuiabijiwu tariga raireu tabo. Kiege barege eiamedu boe ere tuguredudo nowuge ekodu tabo.

b: Aroe tarigoreu jeonare jiboe.
source: Aroe tarigoreu jeonare jiboe.

b: Icare iordure ia tupai turawuje baru piji duji, iedure jewoduio baiporo epaji, iedure ia meriri iku rairewuji.
source: Icare iordure ia tupai turawuje baru piji duji, iedure jewoduio baiporo epaji, iedure ia meriri iku rairewuji.

b: Ure tugeragu nowu aroe tarigoreuji, nowu mariguduwu awagu, duwu  Aroe pegareuge eimejara rema, ure iera gogudo jii jorumode mil cedu kae.
source: Ure tugeragu nowu aroe tarigoreuji, nowu mariguduwu awagu, duwu  Aroe pegareuge eimejara rema, ure iera gogudo jii jorumode mil cedu kae.

b: Ure barigu jewoduioto, ure baiporo mi baiporo epa tabo, ure ia kruca bu baiporo keje, ukawo boe epadui pumekejedu eekuri pagado pugeje, jii jorumode mil cedu akedumode du kae. Awu inodu rekodaji ieragoga kiwujedumode biega tu je.
source: Ure barigu jewoduioto, ure baiporo mi baiporo epa tabo, ure ia kruca bu baiporo keje, ukawo boe epadui pumekejedu eekuri pagado pugeje, jii jorumode mil cedu akedumode du kae. Awu inodu rekodaji ieragoga kiwujedumode biega tu je.

b: Iordure boe emuga boeji, kejere umode tugogado boeiwuge emugure, cewu itoru kadodure egoi Pao bataruji, Jesus bataru jitu koiawuge etaroe rabodu, cewu ukare tubujodo barogo pegareu jiwuge, ureoredu jiwuge, kruca padukare eri kejewuge, ekera kejewuge eiamedu boe rabodu, eedodu maidure, eeture boei Cristo apo jorure mil ceduji.
source: Iordure boe emuga boeji, kejere umode tugogado boeiwuge emugure, cewu itoru kadodure egoi Pao bataruji, Jesus bataru jitu koiawuge etaroe rabodu, cewu ukare tubujodo barogo pegareu jiwuge, ureoredu jiwuge, kruca padukare eri kejewuge, ekera kejewuge eiamedu boe rabodu, eedodu maidure, eeture boei Cristo apo jorure mil ceduji.

b: Cewu ia bireuge emodukare tugirimi tuibagi, eewodumodukare jii jorumode mil cedu akedumodedu kae. Dure boetojiwu boe eewodu reno.
source: Cewu ia bireuge emodukare tugirimi tuibagi, eewodumodukare jii jorumode mil cedu akedumodedu kae. Dure boetojiwu boe eewodu reno.

b: Cewu rakojere jewodure ca boetojiwuge ebowu, pemegare, jiwo aidugirire. Boe ewi rekodajiwu ro rakamodukare ji, mare Pao burejoiadogemode emage, Cristo burejoiadoge mode emage, etumode apo boei jorumode mil ceduji.
source: Cewu rakojere jewodure ca boetojiwuge ebowu, pemegare, jiwo aidugirire. Boe ewi rekodajiwu ro rakamodukare ji, mare Pao burejoiadogemode emage, Cristo burejoiadoge mode emage, etumode apo boei jorumode mil ceduji.

b: Jorumode mil cedu akedu keje,  Aroe pegareuge eimejera umode tudawuje tuwaicoreu piji.
source: Jorumode mil cedu akedu keje,  Aroe pegareuge eimejera umode tudawuje tuwaicoreu piji.

b: Umode tudawuje tuwo boe padui pumekeje moto okwajidu (Gog, Magog) eekuri pagado du bogai. Umode eeto pui turugoduwo. Emagaguragamode nono pobo maereu tadawu kugaru reore. Emode taodo moto joki, emode bakuredo pemegareuge eedaji, Pao meardu kurire jiwu bakurireuji.
source: Umode tudawuje tuwo boe padui pumekeje moto okwajidu (Gog, Magog) eekuri pagado du bogai. Umode eeto pui turugoduwo. Emagaguragamode nono pobo maereu tadawu kugaru reore. Emode taodo moto joki, emode bakuredo pemegareuge eedaji, Pao meardu kurire jiwu bakurireuji.

b:
Mare ia jorure tudawuje baru piji, ure erugadu kowu. Nowu ure ekuri pagadowu Aroe pegareu, barigududodure ia jorubo ekureu kuruga uruto; 10cewu barogo pegareu meture tada marigudu nowu profeta pagareu apo duto. Du tadare ewudugugodumodukare boekoriji meriji, boecoji, boe jameduji jii je.
Paoi tugogado boe jamedu boe jitu.
source:
Mare ia jorure tudawuje baru piji, ure erugadu kowu. Nowu ure ekuri pagadowu Aroe pegareu, barigududodure ia jorubo ekureu kuruga uruto; 10cewu barogo pegareu meture tada marigudu nowu profeta pagareu apo duto. Du tadare ewudugugodumodukare boekoriji meriji, boecoji, boe jameduji jii je.
Paoi tugogado boe jamedu boe jitu.

b: Icare iordure ia boe emuga kurireu urugureuji. Iaboe ure tumugudo keje. Baru, moto eregodure je piji, icare boe eerdumodukare eedumode kejeboeji.
source: Icare iordure ia boe emuga kurireu urugureuji. Iaboe ure tumugudo keje. Baru, moto eregodure je piji, icare boe eerdumodukare eedumode kejeboeji.

b: Iordure bireuge kurireuge, biegareuge eragojei nowu muga otodai duji. Baperadogere tuiado, ia baperare tuiado jamedu, bapera jereu. Boere tugogado bireugei, boe padu magai nowu bapera kejedu reore, ero boe rekodaji.
source: Iordure bireuge kurireuge, biegareuge eragojei nowu muga otodai duji. Baperadogere tuiado, ia baperare tuiado jamedu, bapera jereu. Boere tugogado bireugei, boe padu magai nowu bapera kejedu reore, ero boe rekodaji.

b: Pobo maereure meture tudodawuge emagu. Du reorere meture boe ewi tadawuge, moto tadawuge emagudure jamedu. Boere tugogado ei, ero boe rekodaji.
source: Pobo maereure meture tudodawuge emagu. Du reorere meture boe ewi tadawuge, moto tadawuge emagudure jamedu. Boere tugogado ei, ero boe rekodaji.

b: Boe ewi, bireuge eeda moto kudawu, barigududodure kuruga joruto. Nowu kuruga joru boe ewi rekodajiwu nure ema.
source: Boe ewi, bireuge eeda moto kudawu, barigududodure kuruga joruto. Nowu kuruga joru boe ewi rekodajiwu nure ema.

b: Cewu ie padukare bapera jereu kejewu, barigudure kuruga joruto.
source: Cewu ie padukare bapera jereu kejewu, barigudure kuruga joruto.

b: Baru tadawu Jerusalém.
source: Baru tadawu Jerusalém.

b: Icare iordure ia baru maiwuji, ia moto maiwuji, mare boetojiwu baru, boetojiwu moto ewogware, pobo maereu bokware pugeje.
source: Icare iordure ia baru maiwuji, ia moto maiwuji, mare boetojiwu baru, boetojiwu moto ewogware, pobo maereu bokware pugeje.

b: Iordure bakurireu pemegareu Jerusalém maiwu ui turawuje baru piji duji, ia aredu magai tugera pemegado pudui toredu togidu reore.
source: Iordure bakurireu pemegareu Jerusalém maiwu ui turawuje baru piji duji, ia aredu magai tugera pemegado pudui toredu togidu reore.

b: Du tonajire imeardure ia boe emago kurireu aregodui nowu boe mugureu piji duji. Akore: - Pao mugui ime ebowu uwai reo. Mugumode ebo, uwobemode emage. Pao rugadure rakojemode ebo.
source: Du tonajire imeardure ia boe emago kurireu aregodui nowu boe mugureu piji duji. Akore: - Pao mugui ime ebowu uwai reo. Mugumode ebo, uwobemode emage. Pao rugadure rakojemode ebo.

b: Umode eeguru rugadu kabi. Boe ewimodukare pugeje, boe emarenarudumodukare pugeje, boe enoiogwarimodukare pugeje, boe ecebaemodukare pugeje, mariguduboe akedure kodi.
source: Umode eeguru rugadu kabi. Boe ewimodukare pugeje, boe emarenarudumodukare pugeje, boe enoiogwarimodukare pugeje, boe ecebaemodukare pugeje, mariguduboe akedure kodi.

b: Icare cewu mugure tumuga kejewu akore: - Ca! Imode boe jamedu boe maidudo pugeje. Akore oino kimo: Awu inodu boe bu bapera keje, mare awu bataru boe remawu boe jokodu nure ema kodi.
source: Icare cewu mugure tumuga kejewu akore: - Ca! Imode boe jamedu boe maidudo pugeje. Akore oino kimo: Awu inodu boe bu bapera keje, mare awu bataru boe remawu boe jokodu nure ema kodi.

b: Akore oino pugeje: - Ure turugadu! Alfa nure imi, Omega nure imi. Dure oino: Boe paru boe oto nure imi. Imode pobo jari pijiwu po jereu makudu pagado pobo boire jiwu ai, kuduwo ce.
source: Akore oino pugeje: - Ure turugadu! Alfa nure imi, Omega nure imi. Dure oino: Boe paru boe oto nure imi. Imode pobo jari pijiwu po jereu makudu pagado pobo boire jiwu ai, kuduwo ce.

b: Awu jamedu boe makudumode umode tumoridowu ai. Uomode imi, itonaregedumode ema.
source: Awu jamedu boe makudumode umode tumoridowu ai. Uomode imi, itonaregedumode ema.

b:
Uru barigodureuge, poguru bokwareuge, ropegareuge, ure tubujodo boe pega jiwuge, batararodureuge eiamedu boe, jorubo ekureu urukori rakareu, rekodajiwu boe ewi, makudumode etai. 
Baru tadawu bakurireu motu.
source:
Uru barigodureuge, poguru bokwareuge, ropegareuge, ure tubujodo boe pega jiwuge, batararodureuge eiamedu boe, jorubo ekureu urukori rakareu, rekodajiwu boe ewi, makudumode etai. 
Baru tadawu bakurireu motu.

b: Du keje icare cewu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu eedure turuwobo boe enorogobadui boiwu boe ecebae tabodu ia emeduia aregodure, akore oino ii: - Mato, imode aerdudo Cordeiro mugumode apowu areduji.
source: Du keje icare cewu tupadoge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu eedure turuwobo boe enorogobadui boiwu boe ecebae tabodu ia emeduia aregodure, akore oino ii: - Mato, imode aerdudo Cordeiro mugumode apowu areduji.

b: Ure irego itaroe tada ia torekari rico raireu ao kae, ure iordudo bakurireu pemegareuji, aregodure baru pijiwu puredu Pao pijiwu Jerusalemji.
source: Ure irego itaroe tada ia torekari rico raireu ao kae, ure iordudo bakurireu pemegareuji, aregodure baru pijiwu puredu Pao pijiwu Jerusalemji.

b: Meture Pao urugu tada duji. Nowu urugu ure nono meriri kurureu tori motureu reore.
source: Meture Pao urugu tada duji. Nowu urugu ure nono meriri kurureu tori motureu reore.

b: Motori okwatorureu ricoraireure padure oiei, baiporodogere ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowuto. Tupadogei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu eragojere nowu baiporodoge ewugeje tuietu tabo ei. Israeldoge etuwobe ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ekie padure nowu baiporodoge ewugeje.
source: Motori okwatorureu ricoraireure padure oiei, baiporodogere ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowuto. Tupadogei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu eragojere nowu baiporodoge ewugeje tuietu tabo ei. Israeldoge etuwobe ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ekie padure nowu baiporodoge ewugeje.

b: Baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware meri rutu jaogwai, ecerae eiaogwaire baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, tugarege eiaogwaire baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, meri butu jaogwaire baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.
source: Baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware meri rutu jaogwai, ecerae eiaogwaire baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, tugarege eiaogwaire baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, meri butu jaogwaire baiporodogere pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

b: Nowu motori padui bakurireu oieidu bure jore toridogei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu keje, nowu Cordeiro utugarege ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ekie padure ewugeje.
source: Nowu motori padui bakurireu oieidu bure jore toridogei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu keje, nowu Cordeiro utugarege ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ekie padure ewugeje.

b: Nowu makore iiboe iedure ia iwarameriri ekureuji, tuwo nowu bakurireu baiporodoge, motori padui oieidu remagu tabo.
source: Nowu makore iiboe iedure ia iwarameriri ekureuji, tuwo nowu bakurireu baiporodoge, motori padui oieidu remagu tabo.

b: Nowu bakurireu ure nono ia quadrado reore: raire nono boare. Kodi icare ure nowu bakurireu remagu nowu to iwarameriri ekureu tabo. Remagudure estadiodogei 11.000 cedu reore. Rai, boa, rico ure nono pureore.
source: Nowu bakurireu ure nono ia quadrado reore: raire nono boare. Kodi icare ure nowu bakurireu remagu nowu to iwarameriri ekureu tabo. Remagudure estadiodogei 11.000 cedu reore. Rai, boa, rico ure nono pureore.

b: Ure nowu motori remagu jamedu, remagudure boe ekana ra ui 144 cedu reore. Oinore Tupare boe remagu boe eno boe remagudu tabo.
source: Ure nowu motori remagu jamedu, remagudure boe ekana ra ui 144 cedu reore. Oinore Tupare boe remagu boe eno boe remagudu tabo.

b: Nowu motori padure bakurireu oieidu, tori motureu nure jamedu boece. Meriri ekureure nowu bakurireu rema, ure nono meriri kuru ri reoreboe reore.
source: Nowu motori padure bakurireu oieidu, tori motureu nure jamedu boece. Meriri ekureure nowu bakurireu rema, ure nono meriri kuru ri reoreboe reore.

b: Tori mori kuricigoreu padure pumekejewure padure nowu motori bure jore kejeboe keje. Boetojiwu torire jaspe rema, rekodajiwu safira rema, eregodajiwu calcedônia rema, calcedônia rekodajiwu torikuieje kawarureu rema,
source: Tori mori kuricigoreu padure pumekejewure padure nowu motori bure jore kejeboe keje. Boetojiwu torire jaspe rema, rekodajiwu safira rema, eregodajiwu calcedônia rema, calcedônia rekodajiwu torikuieje kawarureu rema,

b: Eregodajiwu sardônio rema, sardônio rekodajiwure cornalina rema, cornalina rekodajiwure crisálito rema, rekodajiwure berilo rema, rekodajiwure topázio rema, rekodajiwure crisóparo rema, rekodajiwure jacinto rema, boigoduwure ametista rema.
source: Eregodajiwu sardônio rema, sardônio rekodajiwure cornalina rema, cornalina rekodajiwure crisálito rema, rekodajiwure berilo rema, rekodajiwure topázio rema, rekodajiwure crisóparo rema, rekodajiwure jacinto rema, boigoduwure ametista rema.

b: Nowu baiporodogere ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu todure tu tu mitotu jewu tori tabo. Nowu ewororore meriri ekureu remawu rema, ure nono meriri kuru reore.
source: Nowu baiporodogere ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu todure tu tu mitotu jewu tori tabo. Nowu ewororore meriri ekureu remawu rema, ure nono meriri kuru reore.

b: Iordukare ia uwaiji toda, mare paga karega, Pagimejera Pao ro rakareure boe ewai pemegareure ema, Cordeiro jamedu.
source: Iordukare ia uwaiji toda, mare paga karega, Pagimejera Pao ro rakareure boe ewai pemegareure ema, Cordeiro jamedu.

b: Nowu bakurireu okeakare merijoku bogai, ari bogai, eruguwo ji, mare Pao urugure jore keje, nowu urugure Cordeiro rema.
source: Nowu bakurireu okeakare merijoku bogai, ari bogai, eruguwo ji, mare Pao urugure jore keje, nowu urugure Cordeiro rema.

b: Boe epadui pumekejedu emerumode uruguji. Moto kejewu boe eimejerage emode tugurireboe reko bogai.
source: Boe epadui pumekejedu emerumode uruguji. Moto kejewu boe eimejerage emode tugurireboe reko bogai.

b: Uwaiporodoge emodukare tumi boe jameduji, boecomodukare kodi.
source: Uwaiporodoge emodukare tumi boe jameduji, boecomodukare kodi.

b: Boe etaregodumode tuwo moto padui pumekejedu kurireboe reko bogai.
source: Boe etaregodumode tuwo moto padui pumekejedu kurireboe reko bogai.

b:
Ia pegareboe umodukare turemo to, ia ro pegareu, batararodureu umodukare turemo to, mare ie padure Cordeiro o bapera jereu kejewuge tu rugadu emode turemo to.

22.
source:
Ia pegareboe umodukare turemo to, ia ro pegareu, batararodureu umodukare turemo to, mare ie padure Cordeiro o bapera jereu kejewuge tu rugadu emode turemo to.

22.

b: Boe paru.
source: Boe paru.

b: Imeduia Teófilo, nowu boetojiwu ino bapera keje, ire Jesus rore jiboe jamedu boe, ure boe eerduwado jiboe jamedu boe, bu, 2jii paru piji jii ruture baruto du kae, tui to apostolodoge eerduwado Aroe Pemegareu koia du keje.
source: Imeduia Teófilo, nowu boetojiwu ino bapera keje, ire Jesus rore jiboe jamedu boe, ure boe eerduwado jiboe jamedu boe, bu, 2jii paru piji jii ruture baruto du kae, tui to apostolodoge eerduwado Aroe Pemegareu koia du keje.

b:
Ica, ure tuiwodo du rekodaji icare ure towadudo tuie tabo to apostolodoge eegai, tui eerduwadodu makaguragado du tabo. Merire ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du tonajire ure towadudo eegai, tumagoi Pao baru tadawu o boe pemegareuji ewiegai du tabo.
Jesus rutui baru todu.
source:
Ica, ure tuiwodo du rekodaji icare ure towadudo tuie tabo to apostolodoge eegai, tui eerduwadodu makaguragado du tabo. Merire ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du tonajire ure towadudo eegai, tumagoi Pao baru tadawu o boe pemegareuji ewiegai du tabo.
Jesus rutui baru todu.

b: Nowu boigoduwu togwagei ebodu keje, makore ei ekawo tuiaedo Jerusalém piji, mare epagawo nono jii Tuo makore jiboe ui tudowuje du kae, - du jire tameardure iiabiji. Oinore akore. -
source: Nowu boigoduwu togwagei ebodu keje, makore ei ekawo tuiaedo Jerusalém piji, mare epagawo nono jii Tuo makore jiboe ui tudowuje du kae, - du jire tameardure iiabiji. Oinore akore. -

b: Paga karega, João ure boe etaimo pobo tabo, tagirema, tagao pegododumode Aroe Pemegareu tabo oino maigodu.
source: Paga karega, João ure boe etaimo pobo tabo, tagirema, tagao pegododumode Aroe Pemegareu tabo oino maigodu.

b: Emagerema, tui tudo pui du tabore, enorare ji, egore: - Cegimejera, oino maigodu kana amode Israeldoge eeda pemegado pugeje?  Akore ei: -
source: Emagerema, tui tudo pui du tabore, enorare ji, egore: - Cegimejera, oino maigodu kana amode Israeldoge eeda pemegado pugeje?  Akore ei: -

b: Piji, ukare turugadu taerduwawo Pao ure biado pudabo boeji.
source: Piji, ukare turugadu taerduwawo Pao ure biado pudabo boeji.

b: Mare ica, Aroe Pemegareu umode turawuje tawugeje, umode tabewudo, du koiare tamagomode iiboeji Jerusalém tada, Samaria o moto jamedu keje, jii moto okwa kae toro.
source: Mare ica, Aroe Pemegareu umode turawuje tawugeje, umode tabewudo, du koiare tamagomode iiboeji Jerusalém tada, Samaria o moto jamedu keje, jii moto okwa kae toro.

b: Akoinodu tonajire icare ruture baruto eegai, icare okware pi tuku eeku piji boetugu tada.
source: Akoinodu tonajire icare ruture baruto eegai, icare okware pi tuku eeku piji boetugu tada.

b: Etaiwore ji du tonajire icare ime ei pobedu, ekudae kigadure eidu, ere towadudo eegai, egore ei:  -
source: Etaiwore ji du tonajire icare ime ei pobedu, ekudae kigadure eidu, ere towadudo eegai, egore ei:  -

b:
Galiléia pijiwu ime, kodiba tagaiwore baruto tu oino tamugui? Ica, awu Jesus arudure tabiji barutowu, umode turawuje tuibagi pugeje, umagai taerdure rutui barutodu jitu du reore pugeje.
Apostolodoge.
source:
Galiléia pijiwu ime, kodiba tagaiwore baruto tu oino tamugui? Ica, awu Jesus arudure tabiji barutowu, umode turawuje tuibagi pugeje, umagai taerdure rutui barutodu jitu du reore pugeje.
Apostolodoge.

b: Du kejere icare ere tugirimi Jerusalemto, cewu mugu puredure tu Jerusalemji boe aoporu iei Oliveira cedu piji, jae karega, ure nono Sábado jiwu awara tu je.
source: Du kejere icare ere tugirimi Jerusalemto, cewu mugu puredure tu Jerusalemji boe aoporu iei Oliveira cedu piji, jae karega, ure nono Sábado jiwu awara tu je.

b: Ere turemo cewu togwagere Jesus apo tadawu baito, erudure toro bai cobojewuto, cewu emugu emugure tadawuto. Emagereo: Pedro, João, Tiago, André, Filipe, Tomé, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tiago (cewu Alfeu onaregedu), Simão (cewu Zelota), mare Judas (nowu Tiago onaregedu).
source: Ere turemo cewu togwagere Jesus apo tadawu baito, erudure toro bai cobojewuto, cewu emugu emugure tadawuto. Emagereo: Pedro, João, Tiago, André, Filipe, Tomé, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tiago (cewu Alfeu onaregedu), Simão (cewu Zelota), mare Judas (nowu Tiago onaregedu).

b:
Emugure tuiamedu tabo tumagoi baruto du tabo; ia areme emugure ebo jamedu, duwuge etoiado Jesus uce Maria rema; Jesus uwiemage emugure ebo jamedu.
Ere Matias tawuje muguwo Judas mugato.
source:
Emugure tuiamedu tabo tumagoi baruto du tabo; ia areme emugure ebo jamedu, duwuge etoiado Jesus uce Maria rema; Jesus uwiemage emugure ebo jamedu.
Ere Matias tawuje muguwo Judas mugato.

b: Icá emugui nono du keje, ia meri keje, Pedrore turagojedo tuwiemage etada, ere nono 120, icare akore ei: -
source: Icá emugui nono du keje, ia meri keje, Pedrore turagojedo tuwiemage etada, ere nono 120, icare akore ei: -

b: Iwiemage, umode turugadu uwo nono Aroe Pemegareure Davi makodo cewu uture ure tugeragu Jesus jiwuge etododaiwu iei Judas cedu jiboere.
source: Iwiemage, umode turugadu uwo nono Aroe Pemegareure Davi makodo cewu uture ure tugeragu Jesus jiwuge etododaiwu iei Judas cedu jiboere.

b: Emare remagudure apostolodoge cedoda, maragodure cedabo jamedu.
source: Emare remagudure apostolodoge cedoda, maragodure cedabo jamedu.

b: Awu imedu ure moto aru turo pegareu mori tabo. Du kejere icare buture togea tabo, icare ure tuwo toiagi, icare peguru kubiri jamedure tuwowuje jamedu.
source: Awu imedu ure moto aru turo pegareu mori tabo. Du kejere icare buture togea tabo, icare ure tuwo toiagi, icare peguru kubiri jamedure tuwowuje jamedu.

b: Awu inodu akaru ure taodo Jerusalém kejewuge ewiegai, du koiare cewu moto iere Acéldama, oino ewadaru tabo, du jire boe egore Boe Eku Pa, oino ji.
source: Awu inodu akaru ure taodo Jerusalém kejewuge ewiegai, du koiare cewu moto iere Acéldama, oino ewadaru tabo, du jire boe egore Boe Eku Pa, oino ji.

b: Paga karega, judeudoge ekeroia epa bapera kejere atugododure oino: “Uwai bioromode, boe emugumodukare tada”. Ia pugeje atugododure oino pugeje: “Ia tuginoiwu muguwo mugato” (Sl 68,26; 108,5).
source: Paga karega, judeudoge ekeroia epa bapera kejere atugododure oino: “Uwai bioromode, boe emugumodukare tada”. Ia pugeje atugododure oino pugeje: “Ia tuginoiwu muguwo mugato” (Sl 68,26; 108,5).

b: Du kodi icare umode turugadu, mugure pagabo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo rakojei padodadu tonaji jii João o boe etao pegododu piji jii arudui pabiji jiwu meri kaewu ime, 22ia etada mitotu jewu readoduwo cedabo Jesus jewodui tuwi piji duji.
source: Du kodi icare umode turugadu, mugure pagabo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo rakojei padodadu tonaji jii João o boe etao pegododu piji jii arudui pabiji jiwu meri kaewu ime, 22ia etada mitotu jewu readoduwo cedabo Jesus jewodui tuwi piji duji.

b: Icare ere etawuje pobe, duwugere José iei Barsabá cedu, iei Jetororeu cedu, mare Matias remage.
source: Icare ere etawuje pobe, duwugere José iei Barsabá cedu, iei Jetororeu cedu, mare Matias remage.

b: Icare emagore Paoji eparu tabo, egore: - Pao Aroe Eimejera, akire aerduware boe ewabo jameduji, kode, ceerduwado awuge ei pobedu kakoduwu bogaiba amagore, 25muguwo Judas mugato awu cemaragodae keje, paga karega, cewure ure tuwarigu tuduwo ia tuieda kae.
source: Icare emagore Paoji eparu tabo, egore: - Pao Aroe Eimejera, akire aerduware boe ewabo jameduji, kode, ceerduwado awuge ei pobedu kakoduwu bogaiba amagore, 25muguwo Judas mugato awu cemaragodae keje, paga karega, cewure ure tuwarigu tuduwo ia tuieda kae.

b: Icare ere tuiwa aidugirireboe barigu, du koiare ere tugeragu Matiasji duwure icare metagere apostolodogece.
source: Icare ere tuiwa aidugirireboe barigu, du koiare ere tugeragu Matiasji duwure icare metagere apostolodogece.

b: Aroe Pemegareu aregodu.
source: Aroe Pemegareu aregodu.

b: Judeudoge ia eno peta iei Pentecoste cedu o meriji, nowu Jesusre jorduwadowuge emugure tuiamedu tabo nowu bai mitodu tada.
source: Judeudoge ia eno peta iei Pentecoste cedu o meriji, nowu Jesusre jorduwadowuge emugure tuiamedu tabo nowu bai mitodu tada.

b: Du kejere icare ia biaruru aregodure pi tuku, umagai ia bakuru rakareu aregodu reore, duwure nowu emugure tadawu bai korobadudo tu.
source: Du kejere icare ia biaruru aregodure pi tuku, umagai ia bakuru rakareu aregodu reore, duwure nowu emugure tadawu bai korobadudo tu.

b: Du keje icare ia ure nono boe ekeru reoreboe jorugu ure tumaedo eiogi tu tu ewugeje.
source: Du keje icare ia ure nono boe ekeru reoreboe jorugu ure tumaedo eiogi tu tu ewugeje.

b: Icare Aroe Pemegareu ure turemo eto, ure ewabo, etaora korawu pudabo. Du kodi icare emagore ia boe tuginoiwuge ewadaruji, emagore nono Aroe Pemegareui emago emago du reore.
source: Icare Aroe Pemegareu ure turemo eto, ure ewabo, etaora korawu pudabo. Du kodi icare emagore ia boe tuginoiwuge ewadaruji, emagore nono Aroe Pemegareui emago emago du reore.

b: Nowu du kodi, aidure tumagowo Pao jiwu ia judeudoge makareuge, duwugere etaregodure ia moto tuginoiwuge eiamedu boe piji, eedure Jerusalém bakurireu tada.
source: Nowu du kodi, aidure tumagowo Pao jiwu ia judeudoge makareuge, duwugere etaregodure ia moto tuginoiwuge eiamedu boe piji, eedure Jerusalém bakurireu tada.

b: Icare tumeardui nowu biaruru jitu kejere icare, ia boe makareuge ere tudo pui nono, eebogodure ei, paga karega, eiamedu biapagare emagoi tuwadaru tabo duji.
source: Icare tumeardui nowu biaruru jitu kejere icare, ia boe makareuge ere tudo pui nono, eebogodure ei, paga karega, eiamedu biapagare emagoi tuwadaru tabo duji.

b: Ere tumeardu awadudo pudui, eeku kidugodure, egore: - Galiléia kejewuge karega egoino?
source: Ere tumeardu awadudo pudui, eeku kidugodure, egore: - Galiléia kejewuge karega egoino?

b: Kode, kodiba paiamedu tabore pameardure egoi pawadaru tabo duji?
source: Kode, kodiba paiamedu tabore pameardure egoi pawadaru tabo duji?

b: Parto pijiwuge, Média pijiwuge, Elam pijiwuge, Mesopotâmia pijiwuge, Capadócia, Ponto, Asia pijiwuge,
source: Parto pijiwuge, Média pijiwuge, Elam pijiwuge, Mesopotâmia pijiwuge, Capadócia, Ponto, Asia pijiwuge,

b: Frígia pijiwuge, Egito pijiwuge, Líbia mugui puredu tu Cireneji o moto pijiwuge, Roma pijiwu awarareuge,
source: Frígia pijiwuge, Egito pijiwuge, Líbia mugui puredu tu Cireneji o moto pijiwuge, Roma pijiwu awarareuge,

b: Judeudoge, judeudoge ere jorduwadowuge, Creta pijiwuge, Arábia pijiwuge, paiamedu tabore pameardure ereadodui pawadaru tabo Pao o boe pemegareu kurireu jituji.
source: Judeudoge, judeudoge ere jorduwadowuge, Creta pijiwuge, Arábia pijiwuge, paiamedu tabore pameardure ereadodui pawadaru tabo Pao o boe pemegareu kurireu jituji.

b: Du kodi icare eiamedu matadure, eerduwakare inoba tumeardaemode duji, enora enorare pui: - Kabobao?
source: Du kodi icare eiamedu matadure, eerduwakare inoba tumeardaemode duji, enora enorare pui: - Kabobao?

b:
Iagerema egore:- Eiamedu etaora bai baire parera kuru kori koia. Ino tumago pegai ei du tabo.
Pedro uwadodae.
source:
Iagerema egore:- Eiamedu etaora bai baire parera kuru kori koia. Ino tumago pegai ei du tabo.
Pedro uwadodae.

b: Du keje icare Pedrore turagojedo tumedage ebo, icare makore tumago raka tabo, akore: - Judéia kejewu ime, Jerusalém tadawu taiamedu boe, tawiapagado iwadaruji, taerduwado.
source: Du keje icare Pedrore turagojedo tumedage ebo, icare makore tumago raka tabo, akore: - Judéia kejewu ime, Jerusalém tadawu taiamedu boe, tawiapagado iwadaruji, taerduwado.

b: Tameardaere awuge etaora bai baie, mare etaora bai bai karega ure. Tagado, meri rekare boe kao roga.
source: Tameardaere awuge etaora bai baie, mare etaora bai bai karega ure. Tagado, meri rekare boe kao roga.

b: Mare profeta Joel makore jiboere tudowuje oino.
source: Mare profeta Joel makore jiboere tudowuje oino.

b: Pao koiare ure nowu profeta akodo oino: “Ica, meri boiwu kejere imode Itaroe Pemegareu maedo boe eiamedu joki. Tagore ime, tagore areme emagomode iwadaruji. Tagore ipare eerdumode Aroei, taopegamage enuiaomode jamedu.
source: Pao koiare ure nowu profeta akodo oino: “Ica, meri boiwu kejere imode Itaroe Pemegareu maedo boe eiamedu joki. Tagore ime, tagore areme emagomode iwadaruji. Tagore ipare eerdumode Aroei, taopegamage enuiaomode jamedu.

b: Nowu meriji imode Itaroe Pemegareu maedo itugare ime eiogi, du kodi icare emagomode iwadaruji.
source: Nowu meriji imode Itaroe Pemegareu maedo itugare ime eiogi, du kodi icare emagomode iwadaruji.

b: Imode iro rakareu udo tuguo coboje baru tada, imode iro rakareu udo tuguo cebegi moto keje. Boe eku umode tumaedo, joru umode tumaedo, jeredudu umode tumaedo.
source: Imode iro rakareu udo tuguo coboje baru tada, imode iro rakareu udo tuguo cebegi moto keje. Boe eku umode tumaedo, joru umode tumaedo, jeredudu umode tumaedo.

b: Meri joku okwamode, ari umode nono boe eku reore, cewu Pao o meri kuricigoreu aregodumodedu otodai.
source: Meri joku okwamode, ari umode nono boe eku reore, cewu Pao o meri kuricigoreu aregodumodedu otodai.

b: Du keje icare makomode Pao bogaiwu jamedu boe umode cinorudo, umode tubemegado.“ (Jl 3,15) -
source: Du keje icare makomode Pao bogaiwu jamedu boe umode cinorudo, umode tubemegado.“ (Jl 3,15) -

b: Tawiapagado mato iwadaruji, Israeldoge: Nowu Jesus Nazaré kejewu, Pao jore keje taegai turo rakareu tabo, tui udo turo rakareu towuje tagoiadoda du tabo. Tagire taerduware roino duji.
source: Tawiapagado mato iwadaruji, Israeldoge: Nowu Jesus Nazaré kejewu, Pao jore keje taegai turo rakareu tabo, tui udo turo rakareu towuje tagoiadoda du tabo. Tagire taerduware roino duji.

b: Emare makududodure uwo nono Pao aidure, jorduware. Du kejere tare bito, tare ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu ime edo bu i padui pugajejedu keje.
source: Emare makududodure uwo nono Pao aidure, jorduware. Du kejere tare bito, tare ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu ime edo bu i padui pugajejedu keje.

b: Mare Paore jewodudo, ure boe ekera kogure tabowu boe ewi kado, paga karega, boe ewi jetumodukare jii pudabo kodi.
source: Mare Paore jewodudo, ure boe ekera kogure tabowu boe ewi kado, paga karega, boe ewi jetumodukare jii pudabo kodi.

b: Ica, profeta Davi makore jiboe reo: “Iordure Aroe Eimejeraji jii je itododai, paga karega, rakojere ikana pemegareu jaogwai, imegikawo jice woje, jice woje.
source: Ica, profeta Davi makore jiboe reo: “Iordure Aroe Eimejeraji jii je itododai, paga karega, rakojere ikana pemegareu jaogwai, imegikawo jice woje, jice woje.

b: Du koiare iwabo jekarere, ikerure tojarodo pudui, ikodu umode tamudo, tubaga tabo boe pemegareu bogai du tabo.
source: Du koiare iwabo jekarere, ikerure tojarodo pudui, ikodu umode tamudo, tubaga tabo boe pemegareu bogai du tabo.

b: Paga karega, amodukare akera ra ipiji bireuge eeda keje, amodukare akonaregedu kodu kodu pegado.
source: Paga karega, amodukare akera ra ipiji bireuge eeda keje, amodukare akonaregedu kodu kodu pegado.

b: Are jereboe kaewu awara iorduwado ji, amode iegaredo du kuricigodo, imugui aegai du tabo” (Sl 15,8-11).
source: Are jereboe kaewu awara iorduwado ji, amode iegaredo du kuricigodo, imugui aegai du tabo” (Sl 15,8-11).

b: Iwiemage, imode awadudo tawiegai: Paedoga Davi bire, tugudure mototo, jaore mugure padoda jii awu meri kae.
source: Iwiemage, imode awadudo tawiegai: Paedoga Davi bire, tugudure mototo, jaore mugure padoda jii awu meri kae.

b: Mare profeta nure ema, du kodire jorduware Pao akoe pudui ia tuwagedu mugumode tumuga keje duji.
source: Mare profeta nure ema, du kodire jorduware Pao akoe pudui ia tuwagedu mugumode tumuga keje duji.

b: Tuiorduwai oinoie boemode du kodire Cristo jewodumode duji, akore: Pijidodukare bireuge eeda keje, kodu pegadodukare.
source: Tuiorduwai oinoie boemode du kodire Cristo jewodumode duji, akore: Pijidodukare bireuge eeda keje, kodu pegadodukare.

b: Paore awu Jesus jewodudo, awu inodu jire ceerduware, cereadodure.
source: Paore awu Jesus jewodudo, awu inodu jire ceerduware, cereadodure.

b: Paore akaru kurido turo rakareu tabo, ure Aroe Pemegareu makai, du ure udo tumaedo boe eiogi. Oinodu jire taerdure, tameardure oino.
source: Paore akaru kurido turo rakareu tabo, ure Aroe Pemegareu makai, du ure udo tumaedo boe eiogi. Oinodu jire taerdure, tameardure oino.

b: Paga karega, Davi mitodu rutukare baruto, mare du inodu tabore akore: “Pagimejera akore Pagimejeraji: Amugudo ikana pemegareu jaogwai,
source: Paga karega, Davi mitodu rutukare baruto, mare du inodu tabore akore: “Pagimejera akore Pagimejeraji: Amugudo ikana pemegareu jaogwai,

b: Jii imode onare aiwuge ewu awure kuda du kae” (Sl 19,1).
source: Jii imode onare aiwuge ewu awure kuda du kae” (Sl 19,1).

b:
Du kodi icare Israeldoge taiamedu, taerduwa remawudo, awu Jesus tare bu i padui pugajejedu kejewu ema, jire Paore boe eimejerado, ure Cristodo ema duji.
Meartorure boetojiwuge.
source:
Du kodi icare Israeldoge taiamedu, taerduwa remawudo, awu Jesus tare bu i padui pugajejedu kejewu ema, jire Paore boe eimejerado, ure Cristodo ema duji.
Meartorure boetojiwuge.

b: Tumeardui oinodu jitu keje, ekiarigodure tuwabo tada, enoragodure Pedroji mare ia apostolodogei, egore: - Cemanamage, kode, inoba ceromode?
source: Tumeardui oinodu jitu keje, ekiarigodure tuwabo tada, enoragodure Pedroji mare ia apostolodogei, egore: - Cemanamage, kode, inoba ceromode?

b: Icare Pedro akore ei: - Tameartorudo, tae jodo taro pegareu piji, tai mito tu tu jedu tagao pegodo Jesus Cristo ie tabo ma, taro pegareu okwawo, du kejere Aroe Pemegareu makudumode tagai.
source: Icare Pedro akore ei: - Tameartorudo, tae jodo taro pegareu piji, tai mito tu tu jedu tagao pegodo Jesus Cristo ie tabo ma, taro pegareu okwawo, du kejere Aroe Pemegareu makudumode tagai.

b: Paga karega, Pao akore tumoduie maku boe etaiboe pemegareu makudumode tagai, tagore etai, meardure Pao makore jiboe jiwuge etai jamedu.
source: Paga karega, Pao akore tumoduie maku boe etaiboe pemegareu makudumode tagai, tagore etai, meardure Pao makore jiboe jiwuge etai jamedu.

b: Pedro mako kuricigore iaboeji kimo, okituwai ei oino du tabo: - Taginorudo awu boe pegareuge epiji.
source: Pedro mako kuricigore iaboeji kimo, okituwai ei oino du tabo: - Taginorudo awu boe pegareuge epiji.

b:
Icare meartorure bataru jiwuge etao pegododure. Du kodi icare, meartorureuge ere 3.000 bega bega tu je nowu meriji.
Meartorure boetojiwuge ero pemegareu.
source:
Icare meartorure bataru jiwuge etao pegododure. Du kodi icare, meartorureuge ere 3.000 bega bega tu je nowu meriji.
Meartorure boetojiwuge ero pemegareu.

b: Ere tumeartorudo apostolodoge ere boe eerduwado jiboeji, tumeardu kurii pui du tabo, togwagei baru tadawu boe eke pemegareu jitu tabo, tumagoi Pao jitu tabo.
source: Ere tumeartorudo apostolodoge ere boe eerduwado jiboeji, tumeardu kurii pui du tabo, togwagei baru tadawu boe eke pemegareu jitu tabo, tumagoi Pao jitu tabo.

b: Epagudu kuricigore, mare paga karega, apostolodoge ere turo kurireu awadudo nowu Jerusalém tada, du koiare eiamedu boe epagudu rakaguragare.
source: Epagudu kuricigore, mare paga karega, apostolodoge ere turo kurireu awadudo nowu Jerusalém tada, du koiare eiamedu boe epagudu rakaguragare.

b: Meartorureuge eiamedu boe eiore puwugeje, enoroere toroece puapo.
source: Meartorureuge eiamedu boe eiore puwugeje, enoroere toroece puapo.

b: Ere to moto, toroe jamedu, ere maku, ere pedu puiamedu ai tu tu je.
source: Ere to moto, toroe jamedu, ere maku, ere pedu puiamedu ai tu tu je.

b: Emeardu kurire pui, etu eture Pao uwaito meri jameduji. Ere amireu kado oiado tuwai tada, enogwagere ji tuiegare tabo, tuwabo jetororeu tabo.
source: Emeardu kurire pui, etu eture Pao uwaito meri jameduji. Ere amireu kado oiado tuwai tada, enogwagere ji tuiegare tabo, tuwabo jetororeu tabo.

b: Ere Pao ocaro ocarodo. Ere boe eiamedu aidu aidudo pudui. Paore iage eto eto pui etae, duwugere etaidure tuwo tubemegado.
source: Ere Pao ocaro ocarodo. Ere boe eiamedu aidu aidudo pudui. Paore iage eto eto pui etae, duwugere etaidure tuwo tubemegado.

b: Ia imedu pogora pegareu pemegagodure.
source: Ia imedu pogora pegareu pemegagodure.

b: Pedro mare João erudu nure Pao uwai kae togwamaguduwo ji meri jogodu tabo.
source: Pedro mare João erudu nure Pao uwai kae togwamaguduwo ji meri jogodu tabo.

b: Du tabore icare boere ia pogora pegare jii tuwodu tabowu imedu reko mato, dure ere mugu mugudo Pao uwaiporo iere motureu cedu paru, meri jameduji.
source: Du tabore icare boere ia pogora pegare jii tuwodu tabowu imedu reko mato, dure ere mugu mugudo Pao uwaiporo iere motureu cedu paru, meri jameduji.

b: Icare nowu imedu, tuiordui Pedroji, Joãoji, ei turemo Pao uwaito du keje, makore ei eno mea bogai.
source: Icare nowu imedu, tuiordui Pedroji, Joãoji, ei turemo Pao uwaito du keje, makore ei eno mea bogai.

b: Icare Pedrore tuioku kidudo ji, João jamedu ure tuioku kidudo ji, icare Pedro akore ji: - Akaiwodo cei.
source: Icare Pedrore tuioku kidudo ji, João jamedu ure tuioku kidudo ji, icare Pedro akore ji: - Akaiwodo cei.

b: Aiwore ei tu je, tubaga tabo ia eno mea bogai.
source: Aiwore ei tu je, tubaga tabo ia eno mea bogai.

b: Boekarema, Padro akore ji: - Ino meriri bokwa, mare imode mugure itaboboe maku akai. Nazaré pijiwu Jesus Cristo ie tabo, aragojedo, amerudo!
source: Boekarema, Padro akore ji: - Ino meriri bokwa, mare imode mugure itaboboe maku akai. Nazaré pijiwu Jesus Cristo ie tabo, aragojedo, amerudo!

b: Icare ure tugera kogudo iera kajeje, du tabore ure rakojedo. Du keje kuri je, bure, bureraparure turagoje rakado, ure taredo coboje, icare merure.
source: Icare ure tugera kogudo iera kajeje, du tabore ure rakojedo. Du keje kuri je, bure, bureraparure turagoje rakado, ure taredo coboje, icare merure.

b: Ure turemo Pao uwaito, tumerui, turerui, tui Pao ocarodo du tabo.
source: Ure turemo Pao uwaito, tumerui, turerui, tui Pao ocarodo du tabo.

b: Eiamedu boe jordure meruji, jordure ui Pao ocarodo duji.
source: Eiamedu boe jordure meruji, jordure ui Pao ocarodo duji.

b: Eerduware nowu mugu mugure Pao uwai poro motureu paru tumagoi boe eno mea bogaiwu mitodu raboduie ure duji. Du kodi icare epagudu kuricigore nowu ure tudowuje jiboe kodi.
source: Eerduware nowu mugu mugure Pao uwai poro motureu paru tumagoi boe eno mea bogaiwu mitodu raboduie ure duji. Du kodi icare epagudu kuricigore nowu ure tudowuje jiboe kodi.

b: Nowu imedu mugu puredure Pedro, João magei, du kodire jordu paga pagawu ia boe makareuge ere tudo pui etae, nowu baiporo kurireu iei Salomão cedu kae.
source: Nowu imedu mugu puredure Pedro, João magei, du kodire jordu paga pagawu ia boe makareuge ere tudo pui etae, nowu baiporo kurireu iei Salomão cedu kae.

b: Du kodi icare Pedro makore boei, akore: - Israeldoge ime, kodiba taebogodure oino? Kodiba taeku kidu barikare cei, uwo nono ceigoiaie cere awu imedu merudo du kodiwore?
source: Du kodi icare Pedro makore boei, akore: - Israeldoge ime, kodiba taebogodure oino? Kodiba taeku kidu barikare cei, uwo nono ceigoiaie cere awu imedu merudo du kodiwore?

b: Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, paedogamage eno Aroe Eimejera ure tonaregedu Jesus kurido, dure tare maku, dure tare pijido brae eimejera Pilato jekai, aidure tuwo inorudo, kodi karega.
source: Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, paedogamage eno Aroe Eimejera ure tonaregedu Jesus kurido, dure tare maku, dure tare pijido brae eimejera Pilato jekai, aidure tuwo inorudo, kodi karega.

b: Tagirema, tare imedu pemegareu pijido, tamagoi ia imeceba remawu imedu bogai du tabo.
source: Tagirema, tare imedu pemegareu pijido, tamagoi ia imeceba remawu imedu bogai du tabo.

b: Tare ure boe eiamedu boe botudowu bito, du Paore jewodudo bireuge epiji pugeje, awu inodu jire ceerduware, jire cereadodure.
source: Tare ure boe eiamedu boe botudowu bito, du Paore jewodudo bireuge epiji pugeje, awu inodu jire ceerduware, jire cereadodure.

b: Cemeartorure ie jitu du koiare, ie mitodu koiare ure awu taerdure jiwu, taerduware jiwu imedudo turagojedo. Meartorure Jesus jitu du koiare ure tubemega remawudo taiamedu jekai.
source: Cemeartorure ie jitu du koiare, ie mitodu koiare ure awu taerdure jiwu, taerduware jiwu imedudo turagojedo. Meartorure Jesus jitu du koiare ure tubemega remawudo taiamedu jekai.

b: Oinore icare, imanamage, iwiemage, iorduware, taerduwakare du koiaie tarore oino, tagimejeragere oinono jamedu.
source: Oinore icare, imanamage, iwiemage, iorduware, taerduwakare du koiaie tarore oino, tagimejeragere oinono jamedu.

b: Mare oinodu tabore Paore, makore profetadoge eiabiji turomode jiboe towuje: Tonaregedu Cristo umoduie tuiwodo.
source: Mare oinodu tabore Paore, makore profetadoge eiabiji turomode jiboe towuje: Tonaregedu Cristo umoduie tuiwodo.

b: Du kodi icare tagiarigo taro pegareuji, tameardae pemegado ma, taro pegarewu okwawo.
source: Du kodi icare tagiarigo taro pegareuji, tameardae pemegado ma, taro pegarewu okwawo.

b: Du inodu tabore boe pemegareu, boe butugureu umode tuburedo tai, Pao koia, icare umode makudumode tagaiwu Jesus Cristo rojai tagae.
source: Du inodu tabore boe pemegareu, boe butugureu umode tuburedo tai, Pao koia, icare umode makudumode tagaiwu Jesus Cristo rojai tagae.

b: Mare umode turugadu muguwo baru tada jii, moto, baru jamedu boe umode tubemegado du kae, uwo nono Pao makore profetadoge eiabiji, awu moto paru piji.
source: Mare umode turugadu muguwo baru tada jii, moto, baru jamedu boe umode tubemegado du kae, uwo nono Pao makore profetadoge eiabiji, awu moto paru piji.

b: Boekare, Moisés makore marigudu, akore: “Pao Aroe Eimejera umode ia profeta ure nono ireoreu kuo tamanamage etoiabiji, dure tameardumode bataru jameduji.
source: Boekare, Moisés makore marigudu, akore: “Pao Aroe Eimejera umode ia profeta ure nono ireoreu kuo tamanamage etoiabiji, dure tameardumode bataru jameduji.

b: Biapagamodukare awu profeta bataru jiuge eiamedu boe ewogwamode pi tuku boe epiji” (Deut 18,1519).
source: Biapagamodukare awu profeta bataru jiuge eiamedu boe ewogwamode pi tuku boe epiji” (Deut 18,1519).

b: Profetadoge eiamedu boe ereadodure nowu inoduji jii Samuel piji jii awu meri kae.
source: Profetadoge eiamedu boe ereadodure nowu inoduji jii Samuel piji jii awu meri kae.

b: Profetadoge etorere tagi. Paore tuwadaru maku taomage etai, tagai jamedu, cewu makore Abraão jitu: Awagedu koiare umode awu moto kejewu boe eiamedu boe eiwa aidugirido ma, taiameduwo taiaedo taro pegareu piji.
source: Profetadoge etorere tagi. Paore tuwadaru maku taomage etai, tagai jamedu, cewu makore Abraão jitu: Awagedu koiare umode awu moto kejewu boe eiamedu boe eiwa aidugirido ma, taiameduwo taiaedo taro pegareu piji.

b: Paore, tui Tonaregedu jewodudo du keje, ure arego tagae boetoji, uwo taiwo aidugirido ma, taiamedu boewo taiaedo taro pegareu piji.
source: Paore, tui Tonaregedu jewodudo du keje, ure arego tagae boetoji, uwo taiwo aidugirido ma, taiamedu boewo taiaedo taro pegareu piji.

b: Boere Pedro, João mage etugu baicoreuto.
source: Boere Pedro, João mage etugu baicoreuto.

b: Apostolodoge emagoi boei du tonajire icare, sacerdotedoge mare saduceudoge, mare Pao uwai tadawuge eimejera etaregodure.
source: Apostolodoge emagoi boei du tonajire icare, sacerdotedoge mare saduceudoge, mare Pao uwai tadawuge eimejera etaregodure.

b: Ekorigodure ei, enure boe eerduwado kodi, emagore boe eewodumode Jesus ie tabodu jitu kodi.
source: Ekorigodure ei, enure boe eerduwado kodi, emagore boe eewodumode Jesus ie tabodu jitu kodi.

b: Icare ere tugeragu ei, ere tugu baicoreuto jii barogwa kododu kae, boeco puredugodu nure kodi.
source: Icare ere tugeragu ei, ere tugu baicoreuto jii barogwa kododu kae, boeco puredugodu nure kodi.

b: Mare meardure ewadaru jiwu ia makareuge emeartorure ei, du kodi icare meartorureuge ere 5.000 bega bega tu je.
source: Mare meardure ewadaru jiwu ia makareuge emeartorure ei, du kodi icare meartorureuge ere 5.000 bega bega tu je.

b: Barogwatore icare, nowu boe eimejerage, nowu codudoge, nowu bapera epage, ere tudo pui nowu Jerusalém bakurireu tada.
source: Barogwatore icare, nowu boe eimejerage, nowu codudoge, nowu bapera epage, ere tudo pui nowu Jerusalém bakurireu tada.

b: Ere tudo pui nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera iei Anás cedu apo, Caifás, João, Alexandre mare sacerdotedoge eiamedu apo.
source: Ere tudo pui nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera iei Anás cedu apo, Caifás, João, Alexandre mare sacerdotedoge eiamedu apo.

b: Ere apostolodoge eragojedo toiadoda, enoragodure ei, agore: - Ioguduba ie taboba torore oinono?
source: Ere apostolodoge eragojedo toiadoda, enoragodure ei, agore: - Ioguduba ie taboba torore oinono?

b: Icare Pedro, Aroe Pemegareu metui tudada du tabore akore: - Boe eimejerage, paopegamage, tawiapagado mato iwadaruji:
source: Icare Pedro, Aroe Pemegareu metui tudada du tabore akore: - Boe eimejerage, paopegamage, tawiapagado mato iwadaruji:

b: Awuji tanora nure cei awu kogodureu bogai, ioguduba ie taboba pemegagodure du bogai.
source: Awuji tanora nure cei awu kogodureu bogai, ioguduba ie taboba pemegagodure du bogai.

b: Icá, taiamedu boe, mare Israeldoge eiamedu, taerduwado: Jesus Cristo Nazaré pijiwu, cewu tare bu i padui pugajejedu kejewu, mare Paore jewodudo bireuge epijiwu, ie mitodu tabore awu imedu pemegagodure, rakojere taegai.
