source: Icá, taiamedu boe, mare Israeldoge eiamedu, taerduwado: Jesus Cristo Nazaré pijiwu, cewu tare bu i padui pugajejedu kejewu, mare Paore jewodudo bireuge epijiwu, ie mitodu tabore awu imedu pemegagodure, rakojere taegai.

b: Tagire tare awu Jesus pijido ui nono ia ipo paga pagawu, mare ure turagojedo ure nono bai ipo remawu.
source: Tagire tare awu Jesus pijido ui nono ia ipo paga pagawu, mare ure turagojedo ure nono bai ipo remawu.

b: Iaboe iaboe koia karega boe emode tuginorudo, boe emode tubemegado, paga karega, awu baru kuda iaboe iaboe ekie makudukare ime etai du koiawo pabemegagodure, mare ie mitodu tabore umode pabemegado.
source: Iaboe iaboe koia karega boe emode tuginorudo, boe emode tubemegado, paga karega, awu baru kuda iaboe iaboe ekie makudukare ime etai du koiawo pabemegagodure, mare ie mitodu tabore umode pabemegado.

b: Tuiordui Pedro, João mage ekidagoduji du koiare icare eebogodure, paga karega, eerduware jorduwakare bapera jiwugeie emageduji. Eerduware Jesus metageie emageduji.
source: Tuiordui Pedro, João mage ekidagoduji du koiare icare eebogodure, paga karega, eerduware jorduwakare bapera jiwugeie emageduji. Eerduware Jesus metageie emageduji.

b: Mare eerdui nowu imedu pemegadodureu mugui ebodu jitu koiare, egoiwakare tumagowo ei.
source: Mare eerdui nowu imedu pemegadodureu mugui ebodu jitu koiare, egoiwakare tumagowo ei.

b: Ere apostolodoge edo tudawuje nowu emugure tadawu bai piji, du kejere icare emagore pui.
source: Ere apostolodoge edo tudawuje nowu emugure tadawu bai piji, du kejere icare emagore pui.

b: Egore: - Inoba paromode awu imei? Paga karega, ero kurireu akaru ure taodo Jerusalém tadawuge eiamedu joki, du kodire paroiwakare paerduwa bokwado eroino duji.
source: Egore: - Inoba paromode awu imei? Paga karega, ero kurireu akaru ure taodo Jerusalém tadawuge eiamedu joki, du kodire paroiwakare paerduwa bokwado eroino duji.

b: Mare awu akaru ukawo taododu kuricigodo pugeje boe ekao, pamode epagududo emago kawo awu ie tabo iaboei iaboei awu otobiji pugeje.
source: Mare awu akaru ukawo taododu kuricigodo pugeje boe ekao, pamode epagududo emago kawo awu ie tabo iaboei iaboei awu otobiji pugeje.

b: Icare emagore ewogai, egore ei emago kawo, ekawo boe eerduwado awu Jesus ieji pugeje.
source: Icare emagore ewogai, egore ei emago kawo, ekawo boe eerduwado awu Jesus ieji pugeje.

b: Icare Pedro mare João egore ewadaru jipagi: - Tamagodo ji ka: Kakoduwuba pemegamode Pao jekai: cemeartoruwo tawadaruji, iarema cemeartoruwo Pao bataruji?
source: Icare Pedro mare João egore ewadaru jipagi: - Tamagodo ji ka: Kakoduwuba pemegamode Pao jekai: cemeartoruwo tawadaruji, iarema cemeartoruwo Pao bataruji?

b: Ceroiwakare cemago kawo ceerdure jiboeji, cemeardure jiboeji.
source: Ceroiwakare cemago kawo ceerdure jiboeji, cemeardure jiboeji.

b: Du kejere icare enogituware ei pugeje, icare ere tugera ra epiji, erorerumode eidu kodiboe bokware kodi, epagudugodure boece jamedu, paga karega, boe eiamedu boe ere Pao akaru pemegado nowu ure tudowuje du kodi.
source: Du kejere icare enogituware ei pugeje, icare ere tugera ra epiji, erorerumode eidu kodiboe bokware kodi, epagudugodure boece jamedu, paga karega, boe eiamedu boe ere Pao akaru pemegado nowu ure tudowuje du kodi.

b:
Paga karega, cewu pemegadodureu imedu o jorure kodure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogiduredu kori.
Meartorureuge ere Pao kurido tuiordui apostolodegei pugeje du koia.
source:
Paga karega, cewu pemegadodureu imedu o jorure kodure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogiduredu kori.
Meartorureuge ere Pao kurido tuiordui apostolodegei pugeje du koia.

b: Nowu apostolodoge ere tudawuje nowu piji, du keje ere tugirimi tumanamage etae, ereadodure ewiegai cewu sacerdotedoge, boe codudoge, egore puduiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Nowu apostolodoge ere tudawuje nowu piji, du keje ere tugirimi tumanamage etae, ereadodure ewiegai cewu sacerdotedoge, boe codudoge, egore puduiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Tumeardui awu inodu jitu kejere icare, eiamedu boe ere tumago rakado Paoji, egore: - Cegimejera, akire are awu baru to, are awu moto to, are mugure baru tadaboe, mugure moto kejeboe jamedu to.
source: Tumeardui awu inodu jitu kejere icare, eiamedu boe ere tumago rakado Paoji, egore: - Cegimejera, akire are awu baru to, are awu moto to, are mugure baru tadaboe, mugure moto kejeboe jamedu to.

b: Akire Akaroe Pemegareu koiare akagore cewu Davi okwabiji: “Kodiba padure pumekejewu boe ekodu kagirire pui? Kodiba boe emeardaere paga tu je, kodiba?
source: Akire Akaroe Pemegareu koiare akagore cewu Davi okwabiji: “Kodiba padure pumekejewu boe ekodu kagirire pui? Kodiba boe emeardaere paga tu je, kodiba?

b: Awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage ere turagojedo, ere tudo pui tumago pegawo Paoji, tumago pegawo o Cristoji” (Sl 2,13).
source: Awu moto kejewu boe eimejerage ere turagojedo, ere tudo pui tumago pegawo Paoji, tumago pegawo o Cristoji” (Sl 2,13).

b: Paga karega, ica, Herodes, Pôncio Pilato, padure pumekejewu brae eiamedu boe mare Israeldoge ere tudo pui awu bakurireu tada, etonare atugare pemegareu Jesusji, dure are boe eimejerado ema.
source: Paga karega, ica, Herodes, Pôncio Pilato, padure pumekejewu brae eiamedu boe mare Israeldoge ere tudo pui awu bakurireu tada, etonare atugare pemegareu Jesusji, dure are boe eimejerado ema.

b: Mare du tabowo erore nono akaidure marigudu uwo tudowuje.
source: Mare du tabowo erore nono akaidure marigudu uwo tudowuje.

b: Du kodi icare, Cegimejera, akaiwodo ewadaru pegareuji, du kejere atugaregedo awadaru arego boe etae tubagudu bokwa tabo rugadu.
source: Du kodi icare, Cegimejera, akaiwodo ewadaru pegareuji, du kejere atugaregedo awadaru arego boe etae tubagudu bokwa tabo rugadu.

b: Akera raido boe ewugeje ma, boe ekogodae akeduwo, aro kurireu, aro rakareu awadudo, atugare pemegareu Jesus ie tabo.
source: Akera raido boe ewugeje ma, boe ekogodae akeduwo, aro kurireu, aro rakareu awadudo, atugare pemegareu Jesus ie tabo.

b: Awu enogwa kurireu akedu keje kuri je, nowu ere tudo pui kejewu moto amagadure, eiamedure okorobadure Aroe Pemegareu tabo, icare ereadodure Pao bataruji boe ewiegai, tubagudu bokwa tabo.
source: Awu enogwa kurireu akedu keje kuri je, nowu ere tudo pui kejewu moto amagadure, eiamedure okorobadure Aroe Pemegareu tabo, icare ereadodure Pao bataruji boe ewiegai, tubagudu bokwa tabo.

b: Meartorureuge eiamedu ure nono ia boe ewabo ui mito tu je du reore. Iaboe iaboe emagokare toroeie toroece, mare eiamedu boe boe eiamedu oroere.
source: Meartorureuge eiamedu ure nono ia boe ewabo ui mito tu je du reore. Iaboe iaboe emagokare toroeie toroece, mare eiamedu boe boe eiamedu oroere.

b: Apostolodoge eragare, ekidare du tabore ereadodure Pagimejera Jesus jewoduji. Pao o boe pemegareu awadure eiameduji.
source: Apostolodoge eragare, ekidare du tabore ereadodure Pagimejera Jesus jewoduji. Pao o boe pemegareu awadure eiameduji.

b: Iaboe iaboe marenarukare emage, paga karega, o motoreuge eiamedu boe, uwaireuge eiamedu boe, ere maku, 35ere mori arego mato, ere bu apostolodoge ewure paru, du pedodure eiamedu ai tu tu tuboi du reore.
source: Iaboe iaboe marenarukare emage, paga karega, o motoreuge eiamedu boe, uwaireuge eiamedu boe, ere maku, 35ere mori arego mato, ere bu apostolodoge ewure paru, du pedodure eiamedu ai tu tu tuboi du reore.

b: Du reorere ia imedu iei José cedu (du apostolodogere iedo Barnabé, boe ewadaru tabo: Boe Eegareae epa), ia maragodure Pao uwai tadawu, Cipre moto pijiwu, o motore.
source: Du reorere ia imedu iei José cedu (du apostolodogere iedo Barnabé, boe ewadaru tabo: Boe Eegareae epa), ia maragodure Pao uwai tadawu, Cipre moto pijiwu, o motore.

b: Icare ure maku, ure mori reko mato, ure bu apostolodoge ewure paru jamedu.
source: Icare ure maku, ure mori reko mato, ure bu apostolodoge ewure paru jamedu.

b: Ananias mare Safira ero pegareu.
source: Ananias mare Safira ero pegareu.

b: Ia imedu iei Ananias cedu, ure ia to moto maku, ure toreduje bie.
source: Ia imedu iei Ananias cedu, ure ia to moto maku, ure toreduje bie.

b: Du kejere icare ure mori kado oiado, ia kobo mugure pudabo, toreduje aidui ji jamedu du tabo, ure ia kobo reko apostolodoge ewure paru kae.
source: Du kejere icare ure mori kado oiado, ia kobo mugure pudabo, toreduje aidui ji jamedu du tabo, ure ia kobo reko apostolodoge ewure paru kae.

b: Mare Pedro akore ji: - Ananias, kodiba Aroe pegareure tuienado awaboji, du tabore awadararodure Aroe Pemegareuji? Du kodi icare awadararodure ako moto moriji.
source: Mare Pedro akore ji: - Ananias, kodiba Aroe pegareure tuienado awaboji, du tabore awadararodure Aroe Pemegareuji? Du kodi icare awadararodure ako moto moriji.

b: Umodukana turugadu amuguwo tabo, akai maku du keje, iarema ai maku du keje aroiwamodukare amuguwo mori tabo akaidui jitu keje? Kodiba ameardaere oinono awabo tada tu je? Ime ei karega, Pao jire awadararodure.
source: Umodukana turugadu amuguwo tabo, akai maku du keje, iarema ai maku du keje aroiwamodukare amuguwo mori tabo akaidui jitu keje? Kodiba ameardaere oinono awabo tada tu je? Ime ei karega, Pao jire awadararodure.

b: Tumeardui nowu bataru jitu keje kuri je, cewu Ananias buture tuwi tabo tu je. Meardure awu inodu akaru jiwuge eiamedu boe epegudugodu kuricigore.
source: Tumeardui nowu bataru jitu keje kuri je, cewu Ananias buture tuwi tabo tu je. Meardure awu inodu akaru jiwuge eiamedu boe epegudugodu kuricigore.

b: Du kejere icare ia ipare ere bireu reko nowu piji toro baawadu kae, ere tugu mototo.
source: Du kejere icare ia ipare ere bireu reko nowu piji toro baawadu kae, ere tugu mototo.

b: Boe raikare du keje, oredujere turemo jamedu, tuiorduwa bokwa tabo ure tudowuje duji.
source: Boe raikare du keje, oredujere turemo jamedu, tuiorduwa bokwa tabo ure tudowuje duji.

b: Icare Pedro unoragodure ji akore: - Aredu, amagodo iwiegai: tare tago moto maku awu inodu mori bogai?  Akore: -U! Nowu inodu bogaire cere maku.
source: Icare Pedro unoragodure ji akore: - Aredu, amagodo iwiegai: tare tago moto maku awu inodu mori bogai?  Akore: -U! Nowu inodu bogaire cere maku.

b: Icare Pedro akore ji: Kodiba tare tawadaru maku puai tawo tarokogado Aroe Pemegareuji? Ica, ure akoredu tugu mototowuge ewure mugure jice baiporo keje, emode arego jamedu.
source: Icare Pedro akore ji: Kodiba tare tawadaru maku puai tawo tarokogado Aroe Pemegareuji? Ica, ure akoredu tugu mototowuge ewure mugure jice baiporo keje, emode arego jamedu.

b: Kuri je nowu aredu buture bure paru, icare bire tu je. Du kejere icare cewu ipare ere turemo, eerdure bireduji, ere reko toro baawadu kae, ere tugu mototo tu oino toredu meki,
source: Kuri je nowu aredu buture bure paru, icare bire tu je. Du kejere icare cewu ipare ere turemo, eerdure bireduji, ere reko toro baawadu kae, ere tugu mototo tu oino toredu meki,

b:
Nowu boe eiamedu boe epagudu kuricigore; meardure akaru jiwuge epagudu kuricigore jamedu.
Apostolodoge ero kurireu.
source:
Nowu boe eiamedu boe epagudu kuricigore; meardure akaru jiwuge epagudu kuricigore jamedu.
Apostolodoge ero kurireu.

b: Du tabore icare apostolodoge ere turo kurireu makaguragado boe etoiadoda, ere tudo tudo pui cewu baiporo kurireu iei Salomão cedu keje.
source: Du tabore icare apostolodoge ere turo kurireu makaguragado boe etoiadoda, ere tudo tudo pui cewu baiporo kurireu iei Salomão cedu keje.

b: Iage epagudure tuwo tuburedo ei, boerema emago pemegaguragare ei.
source: Iage epagudure tuwo tuburedo ei, boerema emago pemegaguragare ei.

b: Meartorure Pagimejera jiwu ime areme emagagodure gu gu gu je.
source: Meartorure Pagimejera jiwu ime areme emagagodure gu gu gu je.

b: Du tabore icare ere kogodureuge etarego awara kae, ere emugudo kugadoge etada, Pedro o boetugu butuwo iage etae, kodui nono du keje.
source: Du tabore icare ere kogodureuge etarego awara kae, ere emugudo kugadoge etada, Pedro o boetugu butuwo iage etae, kodui nono du keje.

b:
Mugu puredure Jerusalém jiwu bakurireuge epijiwu ia boe makareuge etaregodure jamedu, ere kogodureuge erego mato, ere Aroe  pegareuge emedure tadawu boe erego mato, icare epemegagodure.
Braere apostolodoge etugu baicoreuto pugeje.
source:
Mugu puredure Jerusalém jiwu bakurireuge epijiwu ia boe makareuge etaregodure jamedu, ere kogodureuge erego mato, ere Aroe  pegareuge emedure tadawu boe erego mato, icare epemegagodure.
Braere apostolodoge etugu baicoreuto pugeje.

b: Du kejere icare sacerdotedoge eimejera mare okwacere jaogwaiwuge (duwugere saduceudogere emage), ere turagojedo tugori kuricigoreu tabo.
source: Du kejere icare sacerdotedoge eimejera mare okwacere jaogwaiwuge (duwugere saduceudogere emage), ere turagojedo tugori kuricigoreu tabo.

b: Ere tugeragu apostolodogei, ere etugu baicoreuto.
source: Ere tugeragu apostolodogei, ere etugu baicoreuto.

b: Boekimorema, Pao ia o tupa ure nowu baiporo jado boeco oia keje, ure eebu baawadu kae, akore ei: -
source: Boekimorema, Pao ia o tupa ure nowu baiporo jado boeco oia keje, ure eebu baawadu kae, akore ei: -

b: Toro Pao uwai kae, tareadodudo boe etae bataru pemegareuji.
source: Toro Pao uwai kae, tareadodudo boe etae bataru pemegareuji.

b: Tumeardui nowu bataru jitu tabore icare, ere turemo Pao uwaito, icare ere boe eerduwado. Du tonajire icere nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera mare okwacere tuiaogwaiwuge ere tudo pui, du kejere ere brae eiemejera kurireuge, mare codudoge eto pui, du kejere emagore apostolodoge ewogai, etuwo mato nowu baicoreu piji.
source: Tumeardui nowu bataru jitu tabore icare, ere turemo Pao uwaito, icare ere boe eerduwado. Du tonajire icere nowu sacerdotedoge eimejera mare okwacere tuiaogwaiwuge ere tudo pui, du kejere ere brae eiemejera kurireuge, mare codudoge eto pui, du kejere emagore apostolodoge ewogai, etuwo mato nowu baicoreu piji.

b: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eture toro. Boekarema, tui nowu baicoreu baiporo jado du tabore icare eerdukare ei, icare ere tugirimi tuibagi akaru tabo.
source: Icare nowu tugobaigarege eture toro. Boekarema, tui nowu baicoreu baiporo jado du tabore icare eerdukare ei, icare ere tugirimi tuibagi akaru tabo.

b: Egore: - Ceerdure baicoreu mitu pemegaji, tugobaigarege eedure baiporo keje, icare cere baiporo jado, mare ceerdukare boeji nowu bai tada.
source: Egore: - Ceerdure baicoreu mitu pemegaji, tugobaigarege eedure baiporo keje, icare cere baiporo jado, mare ceerdukare boeji nowu bai tada.

b: Nowu akaru kejere icare, nowu sacerdotedoge eimejerage mare Pao uwai tadawuge eimejerage tori buture eiagi dugu dugu, enorare pui kaboba kodiba?
source: Nowu akaru kejere icare, nowu sacerdotedoge eimejerage mare Pao uwai tadawuge eimejerage tori buture eiagi dugu dugu, enorare pui kaboba kodiba?

b: Boekarema, iage etaregodure akaru tabo, egore: - Cewu tare tugu baicoreu towu ime eedu nure toro Pao uwai tada, tui boe eerduwado du tabo.
source: Boekarema, iage etaregodure akaru tabo, egore: - Cewu tare tugu baicoreu towu ime eedu nure toro Pao uwai tada, tui boe eerduwado du tabo.

b: Du kejere icare nowu Pao uwai kejewu tugobaigarege eimejera uture tudugarege ebo toro etae, ure erego mato, mare butugu tabo, epagudure boe emode tori to pudui du koia.
source: Du kejere icare nowu Pao uwai kejewu tugobaigarege eimejera uture tudugarege ebo toro etae, ure erego mato, mare butugu tabo, epagudure boe emode tori to pudui du koia.

b: Ere erego mato, ere eremo toro brae eimejerage kurireuge ere tudo puiwo kae. Du kejere sacerdotedoge eimejera unoragodure ei, akore: -
source: Ere erego mato, ere eremo toro brae eimejerage kurireuge ere tudo puiwo kae. Du kejere sacerdotedoge eimejera unoragodure ei, akore: -

b: Cemago awadure tai takawo boe eerduwado cewu ie tabo. Du kodi karega, tare Jerusalém korawu tare boe erduwado jiboe tabo. Tagaidure tawo awu imedu ku butudo ceiogi?
source: Cemago awadure tai takawo boe eerduwado cewu ie tabo. Du kodi karega, tare Jerusalém korawu tare boe erduwado jiboe tabo. Tagaidure tawo awu imedu ku butudo ceiogi?

b: Icare Pedro mare ia apostolodoge egore bataru jipagi: - Ure turugadu cemeartoruwo Paoji ime ekori.
source: Icare Pedro mare ia apostolodoge egore bataru jipagi: - Ure turugadu cemeartoruwo Paoji ime ekori.

b: Ica, paomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure cewu tare bito tai bu i padui pugajejedu kejewu Jesus jewodudo.
source: Ica, paomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure cewu tare bito tai bu i padui pugajejedu kejewu Jesus jewodudo.

b: Tugera pemegareu tabore Pao ure rakojedo, ure boe eimejerado ema, ure boe einorudowudo ema, tuwo Israeldoge epemegado, tuwo ero pegareu okwado.
source: Tugera pemegareu tabore Pao ure rakojedo, ure boe eimejerado ema, ure boe einorudowudo ema, tuwo Israeldoge epemegado, tuwo ero pegareu okwado.

b: Awu inodu jire ceerdure, jire cereadodure, cewu Paore maku meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe etaiwu Aroe Pemegareu koia.
source: Awu inodu jire ceerdure, jire cereadodure, cewu Paore maku meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe etaiwu Aroe Pemegareu koia.

b:
Icare tumeardui nowu ewadaru jitu kejere icare nowu brae eiemejerage boe korire pudui, etaidure tuwo nowu apostolodoge ewido.
Gamaliel mearudae.
source:
Icare tumeardui nowu ewadaru jitu kejere icare nowu brae eiemejerage boe korire pudui, etaidure tuwo nowu apostolodoge ewido.
Gamaliel mearudae.

b: Boekimorema, ia nowu brae eimejerage ui mito tu jedu, ia fariseu iei Gamaliel cedu, jorduwa rakareu, boe eiamedu meartorure jiwu, ure turagojedo.
source: Boekimorema, ia nowu brae eimejerage ui mito tu jedu, ia fariseu iei Gamaliel cedu, jorduwa rakareu, boe eiamedu meartorure jiwu, ure turagojedo.

b: Makore boewo apostolodoge etawuje nowu piji biega tu je, du kejere akore tumedage ewiegai, akore: - Israeldoge ime, tameardae tugu, tameardae pemegado taromode awu ime eiwoji.
source: Makore boewo apostolodoge etawuje nowu piji biega tu je, du kejere akore tumedage ewiegai, akore: - Israeldoge ime, tameardae tugu, tameardae pemegado taromode awu ime eiwoji.

b: Tawiapagado: marigudu ia imedu iei Teuda cedu ure tuguwo tui tudo nono ia imedu kurireu ureore du tabo. Ia ime ei puredu tu 400 cedu ere tudo pui ae. Mare bitodure, du kejere icare meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe ere taodo, icare etagedure.
source: Tawiapagado: marigudu ia imedu iei Teuda cedu ure tuguwo tui tudo nono ia imedu kurireu ureore du tabo. Ia ime ei puredu tu 400 cedu ere tudo pui ae. Mare bitodure, du kejere icare meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe ere taodo, icare etagedure.

b: Awu rekodajire icare, Judas Galiléia pijiwu, ure turagojedo pugeje boere cie bu bapera kejedu kodiboe keje, ure tumugudo boe eiamedu boe keje toro pudabo, mare ema jamedu bire, du kodi icare uture rekodajiwuge eiamedu boe ere taodo boe paru kajeje, etagedure jamedu.
source: Awu rekodajire icare, Judas Galiléia pijiwu, ure turagojedo pugeje boere cie bu bapera kejedu kodiboe keje, ure tumugudo boe eiamedu boe keje toro pudabo, mare ema jamedu bire, du kodi icare uture rekodajiwuge eiamedu boe ere taodo boe paru kajeje, etagedure jamedu.

b: Oinore icare imode taerduwado taro pega kawo awu imei. Nowu ime epiji, etudo. Paga karega, etaidure jiboe, erore jiboe aregodure ime epiji ma, okwamode taobiji.
source: Oinore icare imode taerduwado taro pega kawo awu imei. Nowu ime epiji, etudo. Paga karega, etaidure jiboe, erore jiboe aregodure ime epiji ma, okwamode taobiji.

b: Mare aregodumode Pao piji ma, taroiwamodukare tawo okwado. Tamode tagonado Pao mitoduji. Icare emeartorure bataruji.
source: Mare aregodumode Pao piji ma, taroiwamodukare tawo okwado. Tamode tagonado Pao mitoduji. Icare emeartorure bataruji.

b: Emagore apostolodoge ewogai, ere boe edo iwara to ei. Du kejere icare emagore ei ekawo boe eerduwado Jesus ie tabo pugeje, icare ere tugera ra epiji, ere etudo.
source: Emagore apostolodoge ewogai, ere boe edo iwara to ei. Du kejere icare emagore ei ekawo boe eerduwado Jesus ie tabo pugeje, icare ere tugera ra epiji, ere etudo.

b: Icare apostolodoge ere tudawuje nowu brae eimejerage ere tudo puiwo piji tuiegare tabo, mare ure turugadu brae eroreruwo pudui Jesus ie koia du kodi.
source: Icare apostolodoge ere tudawuje nowu brae eimejerage ere tudo puiwo piji tuiegare tabo, mare ure turugadu brae eroreruwo pudui Jesus ie koia du kodi.

b: Meri jameduji jii je ere boe eerduwa eerduwado Pao uwai tada, boe ewai tada jamedu.
source: Meri jameduji jii je ere boe eerduwa eerduwado Pao uwai tada, boe ewai tada jamedu.

b: Diaconodoge.
source: Diaconodoge.

b: Nowu du kodi meartorureuge eidodu kuricigore, du kodire nowu Grécia o moto pijiwu ime emago pegagodure hebreudogei, paga karega, to okoge bokwareu areme eredugodure, nowu ei toroe pedo pudui du keje tu tu tu je.
source: Nowu du kodi meartorureuge eidodu kuricigore, du kodire nowu Grécia o moto pijiwu ime emago pegagodure hebreudogei, paga karega, to okoge bokwareu areme eredugodure, nowu ei toroe pedo pudui du keje tu tu tu je.

b: Du kodire icare nowu apostolodoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ere meartorureuge eto pui, egore ei: -Ukare turugadu cewo boe enoroe remagu, cei Pao bataru pijido du tabo.
source: Du kodire icare nowu apostolodoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ere meartorureuge eto pui, egore ei: -Ukare turugadu cewo boe enoroe remagu, cei Pao bataru pijido du tabo.

b: Du kodi icare, iwiemage, tamode ia ime pemegareuge, jorduwareuge, Aroe Pemegareu jore kejewuge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, tamode etawuje tabiji, duwugere cemode awu maragodae maku etai.
source: Du kodi icare, iwiemage, tamode ia ime pemegareuge, jorduwareuge, Aroe Pemegareu jore kejewuge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu, tamode etawuje tabiji, duwugere cemode awu maragodae maku etai.

b: Cegirema, cenogwamagudumode Paoji cereadodumode Pao bataruji.
source: Cegirema, cenogwamagudumode Paoji cereadodumode Pao bataruji.

b: Du kodi, ere tawujewuge reo: Estêvão, ia meartoru kurireu imedu, Aroe Pemegareu jore kejewu; Filipe, Prócoro, Nicanor, Timon, Parmena, mare ia meartorureu Antioquia pijiwu iei Nicolau cedu.
source: Du kodi, ere tawujewuge reo: Estêvão, ia meartoru kurireu imedu, Aroe Pemegareu jore kejewu; Filipe, Prócoro, Nicanor, Timon, Parmena, mare ia meartorureu Antioquia pijiwu iei Nicolau cedu.

b: Ere awuge erego apostolodoge etae, duwugere, togwamagudui Paoji eparu tabo du tabore icare ere tugera bu ewugeje.
source: Ere awuge erego apostolodoge etae, duwugere, togwamagudui Paoji eparu tabo du tabore icare ere tugera bu ewugeje.

b:
Icare Pao bataru ure taododu kuricigodo, meartorure Pao bataru jiwuge emagagodu remawu nure nowu Jerusalém tada, nowu judeudoge eno sacerdotedoge makaguragareuge emeartorure jamedu.
Diácono Estêvão.
source:
Icare Pao bataru ure taododu kuricigodo, meartorure Pao bataru jiwuge emagagodu remawu nure nowu Jerusalém tada, nowu judeudoge eno sacerdotedoge makaguragareuge emeartorure jamedu.
Diácono Estêvão.

b: Cewu Estêvão, Pao o boe pemegareu, ro rakareu jore kejewu imedu, ure turo kurireu towuje towuje boe etoiadoda.
source: Cewu Estêvão, Pao o boe pemegareu, ro rakareu jore kejewu imedu, ure turo kurireu towuje towuje boe etoiadoda.

b: Boekimorema, ia boe keje, ia sinagoga tadawuge, duwuge ekiere libertodoge ia Cirene pijiwuge, Alexandria pijiwuge; Cilícia, Asia pijiwuge eno sinagoga tadawu ia emage ere turagojedo tumago pegawo Estevaoji.
source: Boekimorema, ia boe keje, ia sinagoga tadawuge, duwuge ekiere libertodoge ia Cirene pijiwuge, Alexandria pijiwuge; Cilícia, Asia pijiwuge eno sinagoga tadawu ia emage ere turagojedo tumago pegawo Estevaoji.

b: Mare egoiwakare ji, jorduwa rakareure ema kodi, Aroe Pemegareu jore keje kodi.
source: Mare egoiwakare ji, jorduwa rakareure ema kodi, Aroe Pemegareu jore keje kodi.

b: Du kodi icare ere ia ime ero pegado emagowo tumearduie mako pegai Moisés jituji, Pao jituji.
source: Du kodi icare ere ia ime ero pegado emagowo tumearduie mako pegai Moisés jituji, Pao jituji.

b: Icare ere boe eiamedu boe, codudoge, escribadoge, eiodo tuwadaru keje Estevaoji. Icare ere tugeragu ji, ere reko toro brae eimejerage etae.
source: Icare ere boe eiamedu boe, codudoge, escribadoge, eiodo tuwadaru keje Estevaoji. Icare ere tugeragu ji, ere reko toro brae eimejerage etae.

b: Icare ere nowu batararodureu ime erego mato, duwuge egore: - Awu imedu mako pega pegare Pao uwaiji, Moisésre boe eroiaguduji jamedu.
source: Icare ere nowu batararodureu ime erego mato, duwuge egore: - Awu imedu mako pega pegare Pao uwaiji, Moisésre boe eroiaguduji jamedu.

b: Cemeardure makoi oinoduji: Jesus Nazaré pijiwu umoduie awu Pao uwai butudo, umoduie Moisere cerodo boe barigu puibagi.
source: Cemeardure makoi oinoduji: Jesus Nazaré pijiwu umoduie awu Pao uwai butudo, umoduie Moisere cerodo boe barigu puibagi.

b: Du kejere icare nowu brae eiemejerage eiamedu boe ere tuioku kidudo ji, etaiwore ji. Boekarema, je urugure nono ia Pao o tupare.
source: Du kejere icare nowu brae eiemejerage eiamedu boe ere tuioku kidudo ji, etaiwore ji. Boekarema, je urugure nono ia Pao o tupare.

b: Estêvão uwadodae.
source: Estêvão uwadodae.

b: Icare sacerdotedoge eimejera unoragodure ji, akore: - Oino rugaduna?
source: Icare sacerdotedoge eimejera unoragodure ji, akore: - Oino rugaduna?

b: Akore ei: -Iwiemage, imanamage, iogamage, tawiapagado mato. Pao Aroe Eimejera ure towadudo paedoga Abraão jekai, mugure Mesopotâmia kimo du tabo, kodumode tumuguwo Hara kejedu otodai.
source: Akore ei: -Iwiemage, imanamage, iogamage, tawiapagado mato. Pao Aroe Eimejera ure towadudo paedoga Abraão jekai, mugure Mesopotâmia kimo du tabo, kodumode tumuguwo Hara kejedu otodai.

b: Akore ji: Atawuje ako moto piji, awobe epiji, atudo toro imode aerdudo jiwu moto kae.
source: Akore ji: Atawuje ako moto piji, awobe epiji, atudo toro imode aerdudo jiwu moto kae.

b: Icare ure tudawuje Caldéia moto piji, uture toro Hara moto kae, du pijire, uo okware du keje, Pao Aroe Eimejera ure aru awu tumugure kejewu moto kae.
source: Icare ure tudawuje Caldéia moto piji, uture toro Hara moto kae, du pijire, uo okware du keje, Pao Aroe Eimejera ure aru awu tumugure kejewu moto kae.

b: Ukare ia moto makai o motoce rugadu, mare akore tumoduie makai, du kejere tumeduie maku ore etai, orekare roga du tabo.
source: Ukare ia moto makai o motoce rugadu, mare akore tumoduie makai, du kejere tumeduie maku ore etai, orekare roga du tabo.

b: Pao akore ji mugumoduie ia moto tuginoiwu keje, toroie ia brae emode tudugaregedo emage, erorerumode ei, jorumode ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du tonaji.
source: Pao akore ji mugumoduie ia moto tuginoiwu keje, toroie ia brae emode tudugaregedo emage, erorerumode ei, jorumode ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du tonaji.

b: Mare Pao akore oino jamedu: - Irorerumode rorerure eiwugei, du kejere etaregodumode nowu piji tumaragoduwo inai awu moto keje.
source: Mare Pao akore oino jamedu: - Irorerumode rorerure eiwugei, du kejere etaregodumode nowu piji tumaragoduwo inai awu moto keje.

b: Icare Paore tumeduiado Abraãoce, du kodire Abraão ure tuwiri kado, du kodire ure Isaac botudo, du kejere, merire ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du keje ure Isaac biri kado jamedu. Isaac ure tonaregedu Jacó biri kado jamedu, duwure tore ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ewiri kado jamedu, duwugere paedogamagere emage.
source: Icare Paore tumeduiado Abraãoce, du kodire Abraão ure tuwiri kado, du kodire ure Isaac botudo, du kejere, merire ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du keje ure Isaac biri kado jamedu. Isaac ure tonaregedu Jacó biri kado jamedu, duwure tore ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwurekotodu ewiri kado jamedu, duwugere paedogamagere emage.

b: Icare nowu Jacó ore ekorire tuwie José ji, du ere maku Egito kejewuge ekera kae. Mare Pao mugure apo.
source: Icare nowu Jacó ore ekorire tuwie José ji, du ere maku Egito kejewuge ekera kae. Mare Pao mugure apo.

b: Ure inorudo ucebae jamedu boe piji, ure jiwo aidugirido, ure jorduwa rakaguragaredu makai nowu Faraão, Egito kejewuge eimejera kurireu jekai, duwu ure Egito kejewuge eimejerado ema, ure jetudo tuwai jameduji jamedu.
source: Ure inorudo ucebae jamedu boe piji, ure jiwo aidugirido, ure jorduwa rakaguragaredu makai nowu Faraão, Egito kejewuge eimejera kurireu jekai, duwu ure Egito kejewuge eimejerado ema, ure jetudo tuwai jameduji jamedu.

b: Du kejere boe eke boi kurireure Egito kejewugei, boe ere tuiwo kuricigodo. Paedogamage eerduwakare kaboba emode ko.
source: Du kejere boe eke boi kurireure Egito kejewugei, boe ere tuiwo kuricigodo. Paedogamage eerduwakare kaboba emode ko.

b: Mare Paedoga Jacó jorduware trigoie Egito keje duji, du keje ure tore ekodudo toro boetoji.
source: Mare Paedoga Jacó jorduware trigoie Egito keje duji, du keje ure tore ekodudo toro boetoji.

b: Du rekodajire eture toro pugeje, du keje José ure tumanamage edo boe pa pudui, icare ure brae eimejera kurireu Faraão jordudo tuwobei.
source: Du rekodajire eture toro pugeje, du keje José ure tumanamage edo boe pa pudui, icare ure brae eimejera kurireu Faraão jordudo tuwobei.

b: Du kejere José makore tuo bogai uwobe eiamedu tabo, duwugere emagare, ere 75.
source: Du kejere José makore tuo bogai uwobe eiamedu tabo, duwugere emagare, ere 75.

b: Icare Jacó ure turawuje Egito kae, nonore akurure, paedogamagere jamedu.
source: Icare Jacó ure turawuje Egito kae, nonore akurure, paedogamagere jamedu.

b: Icare ere era reko jice Siquém moto kae ere etugu Abraão ure aruwu aroe eiaro tada. Ure nowu aroe eiaro aru mori kuri inodu tabo, Henoc ore ekera piji, duwu Henoc nowu Siquém kejewure ema.
source: Icare ere era reko jice Siquém moto kae ere etugu Abraão ure aruwu aroe eiaro tada. Ure nowu aroe eiaro aru mori kuri inodu tabo, Henoc ore ekera piji, duwu Henoc nowu Siquém kejewure ema.

b: Boe aregodure pudae Pao makore Abraão jiboe umode tudowuje du kae. Abraão uwobe eidodure, erijodure Egito keje.
source: Boe aregodure pudae Pao makore Abraão jiboe umode tudowuje du kae. Abraão uwobe eidodure, erijodure Egito keje.

b: Jii ia Egito kejewuge eimejera kurireu tuginoiwu boture, du jorduwakare José jiboeji.
source: Jii ia Egito kejewuge eimejera kurireu tuginoiwu boture, du jorduwakare José jiboeji.

b: Nowu brae eimejera pega remawu nure paobei, rorerure paomagei, ure edo tore ewarigu ewiwo.
source: Nowu brae eimejera pega remawu nure paobei, rorerure paomagei, ure edo tore ewarigu ewiwo.

b: Nowu du kodi Moisés boture. Moture Pao jekai, mugure tuwai tada arii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.
source: Nowu du kodi Moisés boture. Moture Pao jekai, mugure tuwai tada arii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

b: Du kejere, barigudure du keje, Faraão onaregedu aredu ure tugeragu ji, ure ricodudo umagai tonaregedu jiture.
source: Du kejere, barigudure du keje, Faraão onaregedu aredu ure tugeragu ji, ure ricodudo umagai tonaregedu jiture.

b: Moisés jorduwadodure Egito kejewuge eerduware jiboe jamedu boeji, ure tudurudo tuwadaru tabo, turo tabo.
source: Moisés jorduwadodure Egito kejewuge eerduware jiboe jamedu boeji, ure tudurudo tuwadaru tabo, turo tabo.

b: Aregodure tuioru ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogiduredu kae du keje, aidure tuiorduwo tuwobe Israeldogei.
source: Aregodure tuioru ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogiduredu kae du keje, aidure tuiorduwo tuwobe Israeldogei.

b: Nonore icare jordure ia Egito kejewu imedu rorerui ia jituji, aidure tuwo tugerabraredo ji, ure marenaru morido, ure nowu Ejito kejewu bito.
source: Nonore icare jordure ia Egito kejewu imedu rorerui ia jituji, aidure tuwo tugerabraredo ji, ure marenaru morido, ure nowu Ejito kejewu bito.

b: Upagare tuwobe emode boe pa Pao umoduie einorudo tugera taboduji, mare ekare boe pa.
source: Upagare tuwobe emode boe pa Pao umoduie einorudo tugera taboduji, mare ekare boe pa.

b: Nowu meri rekodajire icare, ia emage ei pobedu erugodu nure pui, icare jemarure tuwo ewudugugo pui. Icare akore ei: Imedage, tawobe nure puje, kodiba tagorigodu nure pui?
source: Nowu meri rekodajire icare, ia emage ei pobedu erugodu nure pui, icare jemarure tuwo ewudugugo pui. Icare akore ei: Imedage, tawobe nure puje, kodiba tagorigodu nure pui?

b: Mare nowu ure tuwie okoridowu akore ji: Ioguduba koiba ure cegimejerado aki?
source: Mare nowu ure tuwie okoridowu akore ji: Ioguduba koiba ure cegimejerado aki?

b: Amodukana iwido nowu aro magai Egito kejewu jitudu reore?
source: Amodukana iwido nowu aro magai Egito kejewu jitudu reore?

b: Awu bataru keje, Moisés rekodure, ure tuwiado, mugure Madian moto keje, tui nono ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu reore, torore ure toredo pobe.
source: Awu bataru keje, Moisés rekodure, ure tuwiado, mugure Madian moto keje, tui nono ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu reore, torore ure toredo pobe.

b: Joru makaguragare du kejere Pao ia o tupare towadudo jekai, toro boe pagawu tada, puredu Sinai torekoduji, ia botoguru uru oiabiji.
source: Joru makaguragare du kejere Pao ia o tupare towadudo jekai, toro boe pagawu tada, puredu Sinai torekoduji, ia botoguru uru oiabiji.

b: Icare Moisere tumeardaedo pudui, tuiordui nowu jitu koia, ure tuburedo tuiorduwo kaboba jiba inoba ureuba.
source: Icare Moisere tumeardaedo pudui, tuiordui nowu jitu koia, ure tuburedo tuiorduwo kaboba jiba inoba ureuba.

b: Du kejere Pao makore ji, akore: Imire aomage eno Aroe Eimejera nure imi, Abraão, Isaac, Jacó eno Aroe Eimejera nure imi. Icare Moisés pagudugodure, ukare tuioku awogado.
source: Du kejere Pao makore ji, akore: Imire aomage eno Aroe Eimejera nure imi, Abraão, Isaac, Jacó eno Aroe Eimejera nure imi. Icare Moisés pagudugodure, ukare tuioku awogado.

b: Icare Pao akore ji: Awure tadawu tawuje. Boe pagawu moto keje karega aragojere.
source: Icare Pao akore ji: Awure tadawu tawuje. Boe pagawu moto keje karega aragojere.

b: Iordu birigodure mugure Egito kejewu iwobe ecebaeji. Imeardure etoraguduji, icare itaregodure iwo edo cinorudo. Ica, mato, imode atudo Egito kae.
source: Iordu birigodure mugure Egito kejewu iwobe ecebaeji. Imeardure etoraguduji, icare itaregodure iwo edo cinorudo. Ica, mato, imode atudo Egito kae.

b: Awu Moisés mitodu, du ere barigu tagoi oino jitu tabo: Ioguduba ure cegimejerado aki? Emare Paore utudo tui boe eimejerado ema, tui boe einorudowudo ema du tabo, nowu ure towadudo botoguru tadawu Pao o tupa jetui jitu tabo.
source: Awu Moisés mitodu, du ere barigu tagoi oino jitu tabo: Ioguduba ure cegimejerado aki? Emare Paore utudo tui boe eimejerado ema, tui boe einorudowudo ema du tabo, nowu ure towadudo botoguru tadawu Pao o tupa jetui jitu tabo.

b: Emare ure paomage etawuje Egito piji, tui turo kurireu awadudo Egito keje, Pobo Kujagureu keje, boe pagawu keje jorure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du tonaji.
source: Emare ure paomage etawuje Egito piji, tui turo kurireu awadudo Egito keje, Pobo Kujagureu keje, boe pagawu keje jorure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure du tonaji.

b: Awu Moisés mitodu makore israeldogei, akore: Pao umode ia profeta tawuje tabiji tawogai, du umode nono ireore.
source: Awu Moisés mitodu makore israeldogei, akore: Pao umode ia profeta tawuje tabiji tawogai, du umode nono ireore.

b: Awu Moisés mitodu mugure paomage eedui boe matadu tadawuge ebo, mugure makore ji Sinai torekodu ao kejewu Pao o tupa apo jamedu. Aire boe eemode koiawu bataru makudure ai, tuwo maku cenai.
source: Awu Moisés mitodu mugure paomage eedui boe matadu tadawuge ebo, mugure makore ji Sinai torekodu ao kejewu Pao o tupa apo jamedu. Aire boe eemode koiawu bataru makudure ai, tuwo maku cenai.

b: Paomagerema, emeartorukare ji; tuwabo tadare ere tugirimi Egito kae.
source: Paomagerema, emeartorukare ji; tuwabo tadare ere tugirimi Egito kae.

b: Emagore Aarão biegai, egore: Ia aroe eimejerage etawuje cenai ewo cerego. Paga karega, ure cedawuje Egito pijiwu Moisés jire ceerduwakare kaiba kodure.
source: Emagore Aarão biegai, egore: Ia aroe eimejerage etawuje cenai ewo cerego. Paga karega, ure cedawuje Egito pijiwu Moisés jire ceerduwakare kaiba kodure.

b: Nowu du kodi ere ia tapira imedu to meriri ekureu tabo, tui ia aroe eimejera pagawudo ema, ere barege ewido jekai, eegarere nowu turore tugera tabo boeji.
source: Nowu du kodi ere ia tapira imedu to meriri ekureu tabo, tui ia aroe eimejera pagawudo ema, ere barege ewido jekai, eegarere nowu turore tugera tabo boeji.

b: Du kodi icare Pao ure tuiaedo epiji, ure epijido ewo tubujodo baru tadawu kuiejedogei, uwo magai atugododure profetadoge eno bapera keje du reore: “Israeldoge, tare barege ewido tawo ikurido, nowu boe matadu keje, jorure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure pugeje du tonaji?
source: Du kodi icare Pao ure tuiaedo epiji, ure epijido ewo tubujodo baru tadawu kuiejedogei, uwo magai atugododure profetadoge eno bapera keje du reore: “Israeldoge, tare barege ewido tawo ikurido, nowu boe matadu keje, jorure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure ikera pudogidure iwure pudogidure pugeje du tonaji?

b: Ukare ino. Mare tagaidure Maloque uwaiji, tagodure tao pagawu Refa awaraji, tare awague etowuje tagera tabo tawo tabujodo ei” (Am 5,2527).
source: Ukare ino. Mare tagaidure Maloque uwaiji, tagodure tao pagawu Refa awaraji, tare awague etowuje tagera tabo tawo tabujodo ei” (Am 5,2527).

b: Pao bataru jaira mugure paomage ebo boe pagawu tada. Awu Pao bataru jaira todure nono Pao makore Moisés jitu du reore.
source: Pao bataru jaira mugure paomage ebo boe pagawu tada. Awu Pao bataru jaira todure nono Pao makore Moisés jitu du reore.

b: Makudure paomage etai duwugere arego biri kadodukareuge eno moto kae, tugimejerai Josué du tonaji. Du kodi, Paore nowu biri kadodukareuge etawuje nowu piji, ure eiaedo paomage ei. Icare nowu Pao bataru jaira mugure toro ebo jii paomage eimejera Davi aregodu kae.
source: Makudure paomage etai duwugere arego biri kadodukareuge eno moto kae, tugimejerai Josué du tonaji. Du kodi, Paore nowu biri kadodukareuge etawuje nowu piji, ure eiaedo paomage ei. Icare nowu Pao bataru jaira mugure toro ebo jii paomage eimejera Davi aregodu kae.

b: Awu imedu pemegare Pao jekai, akore pudui tuwo ia bai mugudo Jacó o Aroe Eimejera ai.
source: Awu imedu pemegare Pao jekai, akore pudui tuwo ia bai mugudo Jacó o Aroe Eimejera ai.

b: Boekarema, paomage eimejera Salomão rugadure ure Pao kurireu uwai mugudo.
source: Boekarema, paomage eimejera Salomão rugadure ure Pao kurireu uwai mugudo.

b: Du inodu tabo, Pao Aroe Eimejera mugukare ime ere pemegadowu baidoge etada, ure nono profeta akore: 49”Barure imuga reno, motore iwure pa reno. Kakoduwu baiba tamode pemegado inai? Oinore Pao akore: Kakoduwu boe eedaba imugure tada?
source: Du inodu tabo, Pao Aroe Eimejera mugukare ime ere pemegadowu baidoge etada, ure nono profeta akore: 49”Barure imuga reno, motore iwure pa reno. Kakoduwu baiba tamode pemegado inai? Oinore Pao akore: Kakoduwu boe eedaba imugure tada?

b: Imi karega ire boe jamedu pemegado? “ (Is 66,12).
source: Imi karega ire boe jamedu pemegado? “ (Is 66,12).

b: Aora rakareu ime, birikadodukareu tawabo tawiaja tabowu ime, tare tadugu tadugu Aroe Pemegareu ro kuda. Taro tarore nono taedogamage ereore.
source: Aora rakareu ime, birikadodukareu tawabo tawiaja tabowu ime, tare tadugu tadugu Aroe Pemegareu ro kuda. Taro tarore nono taedogamage ereore.

b: Kakoduwu profetadoge eiba taomage ekodu kagirikare ei? Taomagere makore Imedu Pemegareu aregodumoduiedu jiwuge ewido, tagirema nowu Imedu Pemegareu maku, tare bito.
source: Kakoduwu profetadoge eiba taomage ekodu kagirikare ei? Taomagere makore Imedu Pemegareu aregodumoduiedu jiwuge ewido, tagirema nowu Imedu Pemegareu maku, tare bito.

b: Tagaire Moisés o boe eroiagu makudure tagai, Pao o tupadoge ekera piji, mare tameartorukare ji.
source: Tagaire Moisés o boe eroiagu makudure tagai, Pao o tupadoge ekera piji, mare tameartorukare ji.

b: Emeardui awu bataru jitu kejere icare, ekodu kagirire ji, ere boe to ji boe kori koia ji.
source: Emeardui awu bataru jitu kejere icare, ekodu kagirire ji, ere boe to ji boe kori koia ji.

b: Emarema, Aroe Pemegareu mugure apo, ure tuioku kidudo baruto, Aiwore Pao Aroe Eimejera uruguji.
source: Emarema, Aroe Pemegareu mugure apo, ure tuioku kidudo baruto, Aiwore Pao Aroe Eimejera uruguji.

b: Icare akore: - Ica, iordu nure barui tuiado duji, Imedu Onaregedu rakojei Pao Aroe Eimejera kana pemegareu jaogwai duji.
source: Icare akore: - Ica, iordu nure barui tuiado duji, Imedu Onaregedu rakojei Pao Aroe Eimejera kana pemegareu jaogwai duji.

b: Du keje icare enoiogwari kuricigore, ere tugera bu tuwiaja keje, eiamedure ere tubodo apo turugodu tabo ji, boe kori koia ji.
source: Du keje icare enoiogwari kuricigore, ere tugera bu tuwiaja keje, eiamedure ere tubodo apo turugodu tabo ji, boe kori koia ji.

b: Ere reko toro bakurireu kujebiji, ere tori to ji tuwo bito. Ure tori to jiwuge ere to aroia boareu tawuje, ere bu nono ia iparedu iei Saulo cedu apo.
source: Ere reko toro bakurireu kujebiji, ere tori to ji tuwo bito. Ure tori to jiwuge ere to aroia boareu tawuje, ere bu nono ia iparedu iei Saulo cedu apo.

b: Du kejere ere tori to nowu Estevaoji. Emarema okwamagudu nure Paoji, akore: - Ikimejera Jesus, akeragu itaroeji akabo
source: Du kejere ere tori to nowu Estevaoji. Emarema okwamagudu nure Paoji, akore: - Ikimejera Jesus, akeragu itaroeji akabo

b: Du kejere ure tubujodo, icare oiogwarire, akore: - Pao Aroe Eimejera, awiagodudo awuge eroi ii duji. Icare, awu tuwadaru kejere icare akurure.
source: Du kejere ure tubujodo, icare oiogwarire, akore: - Pao Aroe Eimejera, awiagodudo awuge eroi ii duji. Icare, awu tuwadaru kejere icare akurure.

b: Saulo.
source: Saulo.

b: Saulo jore ewugeje, ei nowu Estêvão bito duji. Nowu meri mitodu jire icare brae erugodu kuricigore Jerusalém kejewu meartorureugeidu ure tubaru towuje. Du kodi icare nowu meartorurewuge ere taodo Judéia kao, Samaria kao; tu apostolodoge emugure Jerusalém tada.
source: Saulo jore ewugeje, ei nowu Estêvão bito duji. Nowu meri mitodu jire icare brae erugodu kuricigore Jerusalém kejewu meartorureugeidu ure tubaru towuje. Du kodi icare nowu meartorurewuge ere taodo Judéia kao, Samaria kao; tu apostolodoge emugure Jerusalém tada.

b: Du tonajire ia meartorureu ime eemarure tuwo Estêvão tugu mototo, etoragudu kuricigore bukeje.
source: Du tonajire ia meartorureu ime eemarure tuwo Estêvão tugu mototo, etoragudu kuricigore bukeje.

b:
Saulo rema, kodu kagiri nure Igrajaji. Du kodire ure turemo baidoge eto, ure ime, areme etawuje nowu piji, ure erego baicoreuto.
Dicono Filipe maragodui Samaria kejedu.
source:
Saulo rema, kodu kagiri nure Igrajaji. Du kodire ure turemo baidoge eto, ure ime, areme etawuje nowu piji, ure erego baicoreuto.
Dicono Filipe maragodui Samaria kejedu.

b: Boekarema, ure taodowuge etu eture boe jamedu keje tureadodui Pao bataru jitu du tabo.
source: Boekarema, ure taodowuge etu eture boe jamedu keje tureadodui Pao bataru jitu du tabo.

b: Ia emage iei Filipe cedu, ure turawuje Samaria moto kae, readodure Cristoji mugure nowu moto kejewuge ewiegai.
source: Ia emage iei Filipe cedu, ure turawuje Samaria moto kae, readodure Cristoji mugure nowu moto kejewuge ewiegai.

b: Makareuge ewiapaga awadure nowu Filipe bataruji, ewiapagare ji, eerdure ro pemegareu kurireuji.
source: Makareuge ewiapaga awadure nowu Filipe bataruji, ewiapagare ji, eerdure ro pemegareu kurireuji.

b: Boekimorema, Aroe pegareure tudawuje Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epiji, tuiogwari kuricigo tabo. Jamedu meru bokwareu, pogora bokwareu makareuge epemegagodure jamedu.
source: Boekimorema, Aroe pegareure tudawuje Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epiji, tuiogwari kuricigo tabo. Jamedu meru bokwareu, pogora bokwareu makareuge epemegagodure jamedu.

b:
Du kodi icare boe eegare kuricigore nowu bakurireu tada.
Bari Simão.
source:
Du kodi icare boe eegare kuricigore nowu bakurireu tada.
Bari Simão.

b: Nonore ia imedu iei Simão cedu, mugure nono, dure turo rakareu to to bakurireu tada, du koiare Samaria kejewuge eebogodure roji, du ure nono ia bari ro rakareure.
source: Nonore ia imedu iei Simão cedu, mugure nono, dure turo rakareu to to bakurireu tada, du koiare Samaria kejewuge eebogodure roji, du ure nono ia bari ro rakareure.

b: Biegareuge, ricoreuge eiamedu boe ewiapagare ji, egore: - Awu imedu ure nono Aroe Eimejera iei Kuirireu cedu ro rakareboere.
source: Biegareuge, ricoreuge eiamedu boe ewiapagare ji, egore: - Awu imedu ure nono Aroe Eimejera iei Kuirireu cedu ro rakareboere.

b: Emeartorure ji, paga karega, marigudu ure eekuri paga pagado turoi bidugudugu jitu tabo eegai.
source: Emeartorure ji, paga karega, marigudu ure eekuri paga pagado turoi bidugudugu jitu tabo eegai.

b: Mare emeardure Filipe makoi Pao o boe pemegareuji, Jesus Cristo akaruji, du rekodajire icare emeartorure bataruji, icare ime, arema, etaidure tuwo tao pegodo.
source: Mare emeardure Filipe makoi Pao o boe pemegareuji, Jesus Cristo akaruji, du rekodajire icare emeartorure bataruji, icare ime, arema, etaidure tuwo tao pegodo.

b: Icare nowu Simão jamedu meartorure, icare ao pegododure. Icare ukare tuiaedo Filipeji, tuiebogodui ro pemegareu, ro kurireu makareuji.
source: Icare nowu Simão jamedu meartorure, icare ao pegododure. Icare ukare tuiaedo Filipeji, tuiebogodui ro pemegareu, ro kurireu makareuji.

b: Apostolodoge emugure Jerusalém tadadu, emeardure Samaria kejewuge ei tugeragu Pao bataru jituji, icare ere Pedro mare João etudo toro etae.
source: Apostolodoge emugure Jerusalém tadadu, emeardure Samaria kejewuge ei tugeragu Pao bataru jituji, icare ere Pedro mare João etudo toro etae.

b: Awuge etaregodure toro du kejere icare enogwamagudure Paoji nowu meartorure maiwuge eparu tabo, Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.
source: Awuge etaregodure toro du kejere icare enogwamagudure Paoji nowu meartorure maiwuge eparu tabo, Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.

b: Awurema karega, nowu du kodi Aroe Pemegareu makudukare ia etai ia etai roga, mare etao pegododure Jesus ie tabo tu je.
source: Awurema karega, nowu du kodi Aroe Pemegareu makudukare ia etai ia etai roga, mare etao pegododure Jesus ie tabo tu je.

b: Du kodi icare nowu apostolodoge ei pobedu ere tugera bu etaora keje Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai du bogai.
source: Du kodi icare nowu apostolodoge ei pobedu ere tugera bu etaora keje Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai du bogai.

b: Icare cewu Simão jordure Aroe Pemegareu makudui etai Apostolodoge ei tugera bu etaora keje du tabo duji, icare akore tumoduie diiero maku etai, tagoi oino du tabo: -
source: Icare cewu Simão jordure Aroe Pemegareu makudui etai Apostolodoge ei tugera bu etaora keje du tabo duji, icare akore tumoduie diiero maku etai, tagoi oino du tabo: -

b: Awu taro raka maku inai jamedu ma, imode ikera bu aora kejewu jamedu boe Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.
source: Awu taro raka maku inai jamedu ma, imode ikera bu aora kejewu jamedu boe Aroe Pemegareu makuduwo etai.

b: Icare Pedro akore bataru jipagi: - Ako diiero okwawo pi tuku akabo, ameardaere Pao o boe pemegareu akomoduie diiero morice du koia.
source: Icare Pedro akore bataru jipagi: - Ako diiero okwawo pi tuku akabo, ameardaere Pao o boe pemegareu akomoduie diiero morice du koia.

b: Awu Pao maragodae ia koborogu makudukare akai rugadu, paga karega, awabo rorogodure Pao jekai kodi.
source: Awu Pao maragodae ia koborogu makudukare akai rugadu, paga karega, awabo rorogodure Pao jekai kodi.

b: Akodorogado ai awu aro pegareuji, akogwamagududo Paoji, boe jokodu kare kare, awu aro pegareu okwawo.
source: Akodorogado ai awu aro pegareuji, akogwamagududo Paoji, boe jokodu kare kare, awu aro pegareu okwawo.

b: Mare paga karega, itaiwo nure ai, jirireboe kuricigoreu tadare amugure, boe pegareu ure akogudo.
source: Mare paga karega, itaiwo nure ai, jirireboe kuricigoreu tadare amugure, boe pegareu ure akogudo.

b: Icare nowu Simão akore: - Tagogwamagududo Paoji iparu tabo ma, tamagore jiboe iaboe iaboe ekawo tudowuje ii.
source: Icare nowu Simão akore: - Tagogwamagududo Paoji iparu tabo ma, tamagore jiboe iaboe iaboe ekawo tudowuje ii.

b:
Icare apostolodoge ereadodure Pao bataruji, tui tuiodo keje turo pemegareu tabo du tabo, du keje icare ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae. Ere Pao bataru kogado Samaria kejewuge eno moto kao.
Etiópia kejewuge eimejerago utugare kurireu.
source:
Icare apostolodoge ereadodure Pao bataruji, tui tuiodo keje turo pemegareu tabo du tabo, du keje icare ere tugirimi Jerusalém kae. Ere Pao bataru kogado Samaria kejewuge eno moto kao.
Etiópia kejewuge eimejerago utugare kurireu.

b: Icare Pao o tupa aregodure Filipe ae, akore ji: - Aragojedo, atudo woje cebegi, ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu nowu moto biororeu iei Gaza cedu kaewu awaraji.
source: Icare Pao o tupa aregodure Filipe ae, akore ji: - Aragojedo, atudo woje cebegi, ure turawuje Jerusalém pijiwu nowu moto biororeu iei Gaza cedu kaewu awaraji.

b: Icare Filipe ure turagojedo, uture toro. Boekarema, ia Etiopia kejewu ia eunuco imedu, duwure Etiopia kejewuge eimejerago iei Candace cedu utugare kurireu rema, jeture oroe jamedu boeji, du uture Jerusalemto togwamaguduwo Pao uwai tada.
source: Icare Filipe ure turagojedo, uture toro. Boekarema, ia Etiopia kejewu ia eunuco imedu, duwure Etiopia kejewuge eimejerago iei Candace cedu utugare kurireu rema, jeture oroe jamedu boeji, du uture Jerusalemto togwamaguduwo Pao uwai tada.

b: Icarema unure tugirimi to imaridoreu tabo, du tabore makore profeta Isaias o baperaji.
source: Icarema unure tugirimi to imaridoreu tabo, du tabore makore profeta Isaias o baperaji.

b: Icare Aroe Pemegareu makore Filipeji, akore: - Apuredu pemegado nowu imaridoreuji.
source: Icare Aroe Pemegareu makore Filipeji, akore: - Apuredu pemegado nowu imaridoreuji.

b: Icare Filipe ure tuburedo ji, meardure cewu eunuco makoi profeta Isaias o bapera 1atugoji. Icare unorare ji akore: - Are boe pa amagoi bapera jituji? Aerduware ji?
source: Icare Filipe ure tuburedo ji, meardure cewu eunuco makoi profeta Isaias o bapera 1atugoji. Icare unorare ji akore: - Are boe pa amagoi bapera jituji? Aerduware ji?

b: Akore: - Inoba iorduwamode, boekai inodu kogado iwiegai du tabo?  Icare makore Filipeji rutuwo uwo tumugudo tumegi.
source: Akore: - Inoba iorduwamode, boekai inodu kogado iwiegai du tabo?  Icare makore Filipeji rutuwo uwo tumugudo tumegi.

b: Boekare, padure bapera kejeboe reo: “Ere reko bitoduwo umagai ia barogo rogu ureore, umagai mako bokwareu ia cordeiro rogu du ere bu rogu kado du reore, du reorere ukare togwa jado.
source: Boekare, padure bapera kejeboe reo: “Ere reko bitoduwo umagai ia barogo rogu ureore, umagai mako bokwareu ia cordeiro rogu du ere bu rogu kado du reore, du reorere ukare togwa jado.

b: Ure tuwiegado du koiare ere pegado, Ioguduba umode ore eremagu? Paga karega bimode du kodi”. (Is 53,7s).
source: Ure tuwiegado du koiare ere pegado, Ioguduba umode ore eremagu? Paga karega bimode du kodi”. (Is 53,7s).

b: Icare nowu eunuco akore Filipeji: - Areadodudo iwiegai ioguduba jiba profeta akoino? pudumi na? ia tumeduiaji na?
source: Icare nowu eunuco akore Filipeji: - Areadodudo iwiegai ioguduba jiba profeta akoino? pudumi na? ia tumeduiaji na?

b: Du kodi icare readodure. Ure tuwadaru paru tawuje nowu padure bapera kejewu bataru piji, icare readodure biegai Jesus jiboeji.
source: Du kodi icare readodure. Ure tuwadaru paru tawuje nowu padure bapera kejewu bataru piji, icare readodure biegai Jesus jiboeji.

b: Eture todobiji, du tabore etaregodure ia pobo ja kae, icare nowu eunuco akore: - Pobo reo. Kodiba umodukare turugadu itao pegododuwo?
source: Eture todobiji, du tabore etaregodure ia pobo ja kae, icare nowu eunuco akore: - Pobo reo. Kodiba umodukare turugadu itao pegododuwo?

b: Icare Filipe akore: - Ameartorumode awabo jamedu tabo du keje, umode turugadu. Icare akore: - Imeartorure Pao Onaregedui Jesus Cristo ceduji.
source: Icare Filipe akore: - Ameartorumode awabo jamedu tabo du keje, umode turugadu. Icare akore: - Imeartorure Pao Onaregedui Jesus Cristo ceduji.

b: Ure imaridoreu buredo, icare ei pobedu ere turawuje pobo kae, icare Filipere nowu eunuco ao pegodo tu je.
source: Ure imaridoreu buredo, icare ei pobedu ere turawuje pobo kae, icare Filipere nowu eunuco ao pegodo tu je.

b: Ere tudawuje pobo piji kuri je du kejere icare Pao o Aroe Pemegareu ure tugeragu Filipeji pi tuku toro eunuco joku piji. Icare nowu eunuco uture todobiji tadawaraji, tuiegare kuricigo tabo.
source: Ere tudawuje pobo piji kuri je du kejere icare Pao o Aroe Pemegareu ure tugeragu Filipeji pi tuku toro eunuco joku piji. Icare nowu eunuco uture todobiji tadawaraji, tuiegare kuricigo tabo.

b:
Du tonajire Filipe rekodudodure Azoto kae. Icare uture toro kujebiji, ure Pao bataru kogado bakurireuge eiamedu tada, jii taregodui Cesaréia moto kae du kae




. Saulo meartorui Pagimejera bataru jidu.
source:
Du tonajire Filipe rekodudodure Azoto kae. Icare uture toro kujebiji, ure Pao bataru kogado bakurireuge eiamedu tada, jii taregodui Cesaréia moto kae du kae




. Saulo meartorui Pagimejera bataru jidu.

b: Icare Pedro ure tugera raido iera kae, ure turagojedo. Icare makore tuwiemage ewogai, nowu ukoge bokwareuge ewogai jamedu, ure maku etai jewodu tabo.
source: Icare Pedro ure tugera raido iera kae, ure turagojedo. Icare makore tuwiemage ewogai, nowu ukoge bokwareuge ewogai jamedu, ure maku etai jewodu tabo.

b: Awu akaru ure tumaedo Jope jameduji, du kodi icare makareuge emeartorure Paoji.
source: Awu akaru ure tumaedo Jope jameduji, du kodi icare makareuge emeartorure Paoji.

b: Pedro mugure Jope tada meri makaguragare, ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada.
source: Pedro mugure Jope tada meri makaguragare, ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada.

b: Judeukare emawu meartorure Pagimejeraji boetojiwu ia tugobaigarege eimejera iei Cornlio cedu.
source: Judeukare emawu meartorure Pagimejeraji boetojiwu ia tugobaigarege eimejera iei Cornlio cedu.

b: Nowu du kodi ia imedu iei Cornélio cedu, mugure Cesaréia keje, duwure ia Itália pijiwu tugobaigarege eimejera nure ema,
source: Nowu du kodi ia imedu iei Cornélio cedu, mugure Cesaréia keje, duwure ia Itália pijiwu tugobaigarege eimejera nure ema,

b: Rore nono Pao aidu reore. Meartorure Paoji tuwobe eiamedu tabo. Ure toroe maku makudu kuricigodo marenarue etai, okwamagudure jii je Paoji.
source: Rore nono Pao aidu reore. Meartorure Paoji tuwobe eiamedu tabo. Ure toroe maku makudu kuricigodo marenarue etai, okwamagudure jii je Paoji.

b: Ia meri keje, meri jogodu tabo, awu imedu jordu awadure ia Pao o tupai tuburedo pudui duji, akoi: - Cornélio, Cornélio. oino pudui duji.
source: Ia meri keje, meri jogodu tabo, awu imedu jordu awadure ia Pao o tupai tuburedo pudui duji, akoi: - Cornélio, Cornélio. oino pudui duji.

b: Icare Cornélio ure tuioku kidudo ji tubagudui ce du tabo, akore: - Kaboba, Ikimejera?  Nowu Pao o tupa akore: - Akogwamagudure bogaiboe, are maku marenarue etaiboe, aregodure Pao jekai du kodire biapagare ai.
source: Icare Cornélio ure tuioku kidudo ji tubagudui ce du tabo, akore: - Kaboba, Ikimejera?  Nowu Pao o tupa akore: - Akogwamagudure bogaiboe, are maku marenarue etaiboe, aregodure Pao jekai du kodire biapagare ai.

b: Du kodire amode ia ime etudo Jope bakurireu kae, emagowo ia imedu iere Simão cedu bogai, du ie bio Pedro rema, utuwo mato.
source: Du kodire amode ia ime etudo Jope bakurireu kae, emagowo ia imedu iere Simão cedu bogai, du ie bio Pedro rema, utuwo mato.

b: Emare mugure ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada. Uwai mugure pobo maereu okwai.
source: Emare mugure ia ure barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu iei Simão cedu uwai tada. Uwai mugure pobo maereu okwai.

b: Icare Pao o tupa uture piji du kejere, makore tudugarege ei pobedu ewogai, makore ia tugobaigare mugure pudabowu, meartorure Pao jiwu bogai.
source: Icare Pao o tupa uture piji du kejere, makore tudugarege ei pobedu ewogai, makore ia tugobaigare mugure pudabowu, meartorure Pao jiwu bogai.

b:
Icare readodure ewiegai tuiordure jiboe jamedu boeji, icare ure etudo Jope bakurireu kae.
Pedro jordure jiboe.
source:
Icare readodure ewiegai tuiordure jiboe jamedu boeji, icare ure etudo Jope bakurireu kae.
Pedro jordure jiboe.

b: Nowu meri rekodaji, emeru kimoi puredu tu nowu bakurireu jitu tonaji, meri pagaia keje, Pedro ruture bai ao boareu kae tuwo togwa kurido.
source: Nowu meri rekodaji, emeru kimoi puredu tu nowu bakurireu jitu tonaji, meri pagaia keje, Pedro ruture bai ao boareu kae tuwo togwa kurido.

b: Icare uke boire ji, icare aidure togwagewo. Mare ere uke pemegado du tonaji, ure tunuiao pemegado taci je.
source: Icare uke boire ji, icare aidure togwagewo. Mare ere uke pemegado du tonaji, ure tunuiao pemegado taci je.

b: Icare jordure barui tuiado duji, iaboe ure nono ia aroia kurireu ui turawuje baru piji moto kae, oto kogure pobe puibiji duji.
source: Icare jordure barui tuiado duji, iaboe ure nono ia aroia kurireu ui turawuje baru piji moto kae, oto kogure pobe puibiji duji.

b: Nowu aroia tadare barege eiamedu, kiege eiamedu, awague eiamedu meture tada.
source: Nowu aroia tadare barege eiamedu, kiege eiamedu, awague eiamedu meture tada.

b: Icare iaboe emagore ji: - Pedro, aragojedo, awo bito, awo kowuje.
source: Icare iaboe emagore ji: - Pedro, aragojedo, awo bito, awo kowuje.

b: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukare ino, Ikimejera! Ikare boe pegareu kowuje jii je rugadu.
source: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukare ino, Ikimejera! Ikare boe pegareu kowuje jii je rugadu.

b: Icare nowu boe emago akore ji pugeje: - Amago pega kaba Paore pemegado boeji, akagokaba pegaie.
source: Icare nowu boe emago akore ji pugeje: - Amago pega kaba Paore pemegado boeji, akagokaba pegaie.

b: Awu inodure tuguwo pobe pugeje. Du kejere nowu aroia kurireu todure baruto pugeje.
source: Awu inodure tuguwo pobe pugeje. Du kejere nowu aroia kurireu todure baruto pugeje.

b: Pedrore tumeardaedo nowu jordure jiboeji, kabobao? Du tonajire icare nowu Corneliore etudo torowu ime eragojere baiporo keje tuiemarui Simão uwai bogai.
source: Pedrore tumeardaedo nowu jordure jiboeji, kabobao? Du tonajire icare nowu Corneliore etudo torowu ime eragojere baiporo keje tuiemarui Simão uwai bogai.

b: Ere tugera to baiporoji, enorare boei Simão iei Pedro cedu mugu rakuduie nono du bogai.
source: Ere tugera to baiporoji, enorare boei Simão iei Pedro cedu mugu rakuduie nono du bogai.

b: Pedro meardu nure tuiordure jiboeji du tonajire icare Aroe Pemegareu akore ji: - Ica, imei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu eemaru nure awogai, duwuge emugure nono.
source: Pedro meardu nure tuiordure jiboeji du tonajire icare Aroe Pemegareu akore ji: - Ica, imei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu eemaru nure awogai, duwuge emugure nono.

b: Aragojedo, arawuje, atudo ebo apagudu bokwa tabo, inure etudo mato awogai du kodi.
source: Aragojedo, arawuje, atudo ebo apagudu bokwa tabo, inure etudo mato awogai du kodi.

b: Icare Pedrore turawuje, jordure nowu imei, icare akore ei: - Imireo. Taemarure bogaiwu imireo. Kaboba bogaiba taroino?
source: Icare Pedrore turawuje, jordure nowu imei, icare akore ei: - Imireo. Taemarure bogaiwu imireo. Kaboba bogaiba taroino?

b: Icare egore: - Tugobaigarege eimejera Cornélio, imedu pemegareu, meartorure Pao jiwu, duwure judeudoge eiamedu jordu pemegare ji, emare jordure Pao ia o tupaji, duwure akore ji makoiagu awogai, mearduwo awadaruji.
source: Icare egore: - Tugobaigarege eimejera Cornélio, imedu pemegareu, meartorure Pao jiwu, duwure judeudoge eiamedu jordu pemegare ji, emare jordure Pao ia o tupaji, duwure akore ji makoiagu awogai, mearduwo awadaruji.

b:
Icare Pedro makore ei ewo turemo. Icare ure emugudo tuwai tada, enuduwo nono. Barogwatore icare uture ebo, ia Jope kejewu uwiemage ebo jamedu.
Pedro rakojei Cesaréia kejedu.
source:
Icare Pedro makore ei ewo turemo. Icare ure emugudo tuwai tada, enuduwo nono. Barogwatore icare uture ebo, ia Jope kejewu uwiemage ebo jamedu.
Pedro rakojei Cesaréia kejedu.

b: Nowu meri rekodajire icare etaregodure Cesaréia kae. Nowu Cornélio upaga nure ewogai. Makore tuwobei, makore tumeardu kurire jiwu tumedagei, ure ewie, du kodire emugure uwai tada tubaga tabo ewogai.
source: Nowu meri rekodajire icare etaregodure Cesaréia kae. Nowu Cornélio upaga nure ewogai. Makore tuwobei, makore tumeardu kurire jiwu tumedagei, ure ewie, du kodire emugure uwai tada tubaga tabo ewogai.

b: Pedrore tuiagu turemo du kejere Cornélio ure tudawuje tuwo tugeragu ji, icare ure tubujodo Pedro bure paru tuwo tubujodo ji.
source: Pedrore tuiagu turemo du kejere Cornélio ure tudawuje tuwo tugeragu ji, icare ure tubujodo Pedro bure paru tuwo tubujodo ji.

b: Boekimorema, Pedrore rakojedo taci je, akore ji: - Pao Kurireu karega ure imi, imedu nure imi jamedu, aragojedo.
source: Boekimorema, Pedrore rakojedo taci je, akore ji: - Pao Kurireu karega ure imi, imedu nure imi jamedu, aragojedo.

b: Icare, makoi jitu tabore icare, Pedrore turemo uwaito, jordure boe makareuge eedui nonoduji, akore ei: -
source: Icare, makoi jitu tabore icare, Pedrore turemo uwaito, jordure boe makareuge eedui nonoduji, akore ei: -

b: Taerduware ukae turugadu ia judeu uwo tumeduiado ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu imeduji, iarema uwo turemo uwaito, macare Paore iorduwado ukae turugadu cewo iaboe iaboe ewarigu cebiji.
source: Taerduware ukae turugadu ia judeu uwo tumeduiado ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwu imeduji, iarema uwo turemo uwaito, macare Paore iorduwado ukae turugadu cewo iaboe iaboe ewarigu cebiji.

b: Du kodire itaregodure mato kuri je, boe emagore iwogai du keje. Kode, kodiba tagagoino iwogai?
source: Du kodire itaregodure mato kuri je, boe emagore iwogai du keje. Kode, kodiba tagagoino iwogai?

b: Icare Cornélio akore ji: - Merire pobe puibiji du otodaire, imugure iwai tada imagoi Pao jitu tabo, meri jogodu tabo, du tonajire icare ia aroia kigadureu meture jiwu imedu ure towadudo iegai, akore ii:
source: Icare Cornélio akore ji: - Merire pobe puibiji du otodaire, imugure iwai tada imagoi Pao jitu tabo, meri jogodu tabo, du tonajire icare ia aroia kigadureu meture jiwu imedu ure towadudo iegai, akore ii:

b: Cornélio, akogwamagudure bogaiboe aregodure Pao ae, Pao biabuture are maku marenarue etaiboe bukeje.
source: Cornélio, akogwamagudure bogaiboe aregodure Pao ae, Pao biabuture are maku marenarue etaiboe bukeje.

b: Du kodi icare amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae, makowo ia Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai, utuwo mato. Mugure ia barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu uwai tada, pobo maereu okwai.
source: Du kodi icare amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae, makowo ia Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai, utuwo mato. Mugure ia barege ewiri pemegadowu imedu uwai tada, pobo maereu okwai.

b: Du kodi icare ire boedo tumagowo awogai kuri je, atuwo mato, icare iegarere atui mato duji. Oinore icare, cegireo cedui pui Pao jekai, cemearduwo Paore amagodo cewiegaiboe jamedu boeji.
source: Du kodi icare ire boedo tumagowo awogai kuri je, atuwo mato, icare iegarere atui mato duji. Oinore icare, cegireo cedui pui Pao jekai, cemearduwo Paore amagodo cewiegaiboe jamedu boeji.

b: Icare Pedrore tuwadaru parudo, akore: - Boe jokodu iorduware Pao ukae iaboe iaboe kurido iaboe biegado pugori duji.
source: Icare Pedrore tuwadaru parudo, akore: - Boe jokodu iorduware Pao ukae iaboe iaboe kurido iaboe biegado pugori duji.

b: Mare boe eeda jamedu boe keje aidu pemegare meartorure jiwugei, ro pemegareuge eiamedu boeji.
source: Mare boe eeda jamedu boe keje aidu pemegare meartorure jiwugei, ro pemegareuge eiamedu boeji.

b: Paore tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etae, ure boe pemegareu, boe butugureu readodudo ewiegai Jesus Cristo okwabiji, dure boe eiamedu boe eimejera nure ema.
source: Paore tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etae, ure boe pemegareu, boe butugureu readodudo ewiegai Jesus Cristo okwabiji, dure boe eiamedu boe eimejera nure ema.

b: Taerduware awu jamedu boe ui tudowuje Judéia keje, tui paru tugu Galiléia piji, João o boe etaimodu rekodaji.
source: Taerduware awu jamedu boe ui tudowuje Judéia keje, tui paru tugu Galiléia piji, João o boe etaimodu rekodaji.

b: Taerduware Paoi Jesus Nazaré kejewu kurido Aroe Pemegareu tabo, turo raka tabo duji, du koiare ro pemegare, ure Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epemegago, Pao mugure apo du koia.
source: Taerduware Paoi Jesus Nazaré kejewu kurido Aroe Pemegareu tabo, turo raka tabo duji, du koiare ro pemegare, ure Aroe pegareu meture tadawuge epemegago, Pao mugure apo du koia.

b: Cegire ceerdure, cereadodure, ure towuje Judéia keje boeji, Jerusalém tada boeji. Du kejere ere bito, ere tugu i padui pugajejedu keje.
source: Cegire ceerdure, cereadodure, ure towuje Judéia keje boeji, Jerusalém tada boeji. Du kejere ere bito, ere tugu i padui pugajejedu keje.

b: Mare Paore jewodudo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, ure udo towadudo.
source: Mare Paore jewodudo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, ure udo towadudo.

b: Mare eiamedu eegai karega, mare tu Pao aidure jiwuge eegai, ceegai, duwuge cenogwagere apo, cegudure apo, jewoduredu rekodaji.
source: Mare eiamedu eegai karega, mare tu Pao aidure jiwuge eegai, ceegai, duwuge cenogwagere apo, cegudure apo, jewoduredu rekodaji.

b: Ure cemagodo tuwadaruji boe etae, ure cereadodu pemegado Pudumie Paore jereuge, bireuge eimejerado Pudumi duji.
source: Ure cemagodo tuwadaruji boe etae, ure cereadodu pemegado Pudumie Paore jereuge, bireuge eimejerado Pudumi duji.

b: Jire profetadoge eiamedu emagore meartorumode jiwuge eiamedu boe ero pegareu okwadodumoduie ie tabo.
source: Jire profetadoge eiamedu emagore meartorumode jiwuge eiamedu boe ero pegareu okwadodumoduie ie tabo.

b: Boekarema, Pedro akoinodu tonaji, Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje meardure bataru pemegareu jiwuge eiamedu boe ewugeje.
source: Boekarema, Pedro akoinodu tonaji, Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje meardure bataru pemegareu jiwuge eiamedu boe ewugeje.

b: Aregodure Pedro apowu meartorureu judeudoge eebogodu kuricigore tuiordui Aroe Pemegareu o boe pemegareu ui turorido biri kadodukareuge ewugeje jamedu jituji.
source: Aregodure Pedro apowu meartorureu judeudoge eebogodu kuricigore tuiordui Aroe Pemegareu o boe pemegareu ui turorido biri kadodukareuge ewugeje jamedu jituji.

b: Emeardure emagoi ia boe ewadaru tuginoiwu jituji, ei Pao kurido duji.
source: Emeardure emagoi ia boe ewadaru tuginoiwu jituji, ei Pao kurido duji.

b: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukana turugadu awuge etao pegododuwo? Awurema karega, Aroe Pemegareu makudure etai ui nono makudure cenai du reore.
source: Icare Pedro akore: - Umodukana turugadu awuge etao pegododuwo? Awurema karega, Aroe Pemegareu makudure etai ui nono makudure cenai du reore.

b: Icare ure boedo etao pegodo Jesus Cristo ie tabo. Du kodi icare enogwamagudure ji emuguwo pudabo biegatu kimo.
source: Icare ure boedo etao pegodo Jesus Cristo ie tabo. Du kodi icare enogwamagudure ji emuguwo pudabo biegatu kimo.

b: Pedro ui tuwiemage Jerusalém kejewuge edo boe pa turoinoduji.
source: Pedro ui tuwiemage Jerusalém kejewuge edo boe pa turoinoduji.

b: Du kejere icare apostolodoge, Judéia kejewu meartorureuge emeardure biri kadodukareuge ei tugeragu Pao bataruji jamedu duji.
source: Du kejere icare apostolodoge, Judéia kejewu meartorureuge emeardure biri kadodukareuge ei tugeragu Pao bataruji jamedu duji.

b: Du Kodi icare Pedro ruture Jerusalémto, du kejere icare enogituware ji.
source: Du Kodi icare Pedro ruture Jerusalémto, du kejere icare enogituware ji.

b: Egore: - Kodiba are aremo biri kadodukareuge ewaito, icare, akogwagere ebo?
source: Egore: - Kodiba are aremo biri kadodukareuge ewaito, icare, akogwagere ebo?

b: Macare Pedro readodure ewiegai ure tudowuje jamedu boeji, tagoi oino du tabo: -
source: Macare Pedro readodure ewiegai ure tudowuje jamedu boeji, tagoi oino du tabo: -

b: Inogwamagudu nure Paoji Jope bakurireu tada, icare ire ido ikinoi, du tabore iordure aroeji: iaboe ui nono aroia kurireu reore, oto kogure pobe puibiji, ure tudawuje baru piji puredu tu ii.
source: Inogwamagudu nure Paoji Jope bakurireu tada, icare ire ido ikinoi, du tabore iordure aroeji: iaboe ui nono aroia kurireu reore, oto kogure pobe puibiji, ure tudawuje baru piji puredu tu ii.

b: Itaiwo birigodure ji, icare iordu awadure barege, awague, kiege barege, emedui tada duji.
source: Itaiwo birigodure ji, icare iordu awadure barege, awague, kiege barege, emedui tada duji.

b: Icare imeardure ia boe emagoi iwiegai oino duji: Pedro, aragojedo awo bito, awo kowuje.
source: Icare imeardure ia boe emagoi iwiegai oino duji: Pedro, aragojedo awo bito, awo kowuje.

b: Imirema, inagore: Umodukare ino, Ikimejera, iaboe iaboe pegareu ukare turemo iiagi jii je.
source: Imirema, inagore: Umodukare ino, Ikimejera, iaboe iaboe pegareu ukare turemo iiagi jii je.

b: Icare cewu boe emago akore iwiegai baru piji pugeje, akore: Amagokaba Paore pemegado boeji akagokaba pegaie.
source: Icare cewu boe emago akore iwiegai baru piji pugeje, akore: Amagokaba Paore pemegado boeji akagokaba pegaie.

b: Awu inodu ure tudowuje pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, du kejere jamedu boe todure baruto pugeje.
source: Awu inodu ure tudowuje pobe ma jewu metuia bokware, du kejere jamedu boe todure baruto pugeje.

b: Du kejere icare ia ime ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu etaregodure nowu imugure tadawu bai kae, duwugere boere etudo iwogai Cesaréia piji.
source: Du kejere icare ia ime ei pobe ma jewu metuia bokwaredu etaregodure nowu imugure tadawu bai kae, duwugere boere etudo iwogai Cesaréia piji.

b: Boekimorema, Aroe Pemegareu akore ii ikoduwo ebo ipagudu bokwa tabo. Awu cewiemage ei ikera awubodure mito taci jedu ekodure itabo jamedu. Icare cere ceremo Cornélio uwaito.
source: Boekimorema, Aroe Pemegareu akore ii ikoduwo ebo ipagudu bokwa tabo. Awu cewiemage ei ikera awubodure mito taci jedu ekodure itabo jamedu. Icare cere ceremo Cornélio uwaito.

b: Emare icare readodure cewiegai tuiorduie ia Pao o tupa ui towadudo tuiegai akoi pudui oinodu jituji: Amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae tumagowo Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai.
source: Emare icare readodure cewiegai tuiorduie ia Pao o tupa ui towadudo tuiegai akoi pudui oinodu jituji: Amode iaboe etudo Jope bakurireu kae tumagowo Simão iei Pedro cedu bogai.

b: Emare makomode ai bakaru pemegareuji du koiare amode akinorudo, awobe eiamedu tabo.
source: Emare makomode ai bakaru pemegareuji du koiare amode akinorudo, awobe eiamedu tabo.

b: Icare ire iwadaru paru tawuje du tonajire kuri je Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje ewugeje ure nono ure turawuje pawugeje marigu du reore.
source: Icare ire iwadaru paru tawuje du tonajire kuri je Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje ewugeje ure nono ure turawuje pawugeje marigu du reore.

b: Du tabore icare iwiabuture Pagimejera akoino du keje: Joãore boe etao pegodo pobo tabo, tagirema tagao pegododumode Aroe Pemegareu tabo.
source: Du tabore icare iwiabuture Pagimejera akoino du keje: Joãore boe etao pegodo pobo tabo, tagirema tagao pegododumode Aroe Pemegareu tabo.

b: Kode makudure meartorure jiwuge cenaiwu Pao o boe pemegareu mitodu makudure etai jamedu ma, ioguduba imiba iwo ituu Pao Aroe Eimejera aidu kuda?
source: Kode makudure meartorure jiwuge cenaiwu Pao o boe pemegareu mitodu makudure etai jamedu ma, ioguduba imiba iwo ituu Pao Aroe Eimejera aidu kuda?

b:
Emeardure awu bataru jitu kejere icare emago bokware ji pugeje, ere Pao jekaredo, egore: - Kode, biri kadodukareuge etai jamedu Paore ero pegareu kiarigodae maku etai, etaregoduwo boe eerewo kae. 
Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe eparu ui tudowujedu.
source:
Emeardure awu bataru jitu kejere icare emago bokware ji pugeje, ere Pao jekaredo, egore: - Kode, biri kadodukareuge etai jamedu Paore ero pegareu kiarigodae maku etai, etaregoduwo boe eerewo kae. 
Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe eparu ui tudowujedu.

b: Du tonajire nowu ure taodo boe jamedu boe kaowuge, cewu brae etonare pudui boe keje, Estêvão o meri keje, etaregodure Fenícia kae, Chipre kae, Antioquia kae, tui Pao bataru kogado tu judeudoge ewiegai du tabo.
source: Du tonajire nowu ure taodo boe jamedu boe kaowuge, cewu brae etonare pudui boe keje, Estêvão o meri keje, etaregodure Fenícia kae, Chipre kae, Antioquia kae, tui Pao bataru kogado tu judeudoge ewiegai du tabo.

b: Mare ia Chipre kejewuge, ia Cirene kejewuge, enogore ekaodu, etaregodui Antioquia kae du keje, emagore gregodoge ei jamedu, ere Pagimejera o bakaru kogado ewiegai jamedu.
source: Mare ia Chipre kejewuge, ia Cirene kejewuge, enogore ekaodu, etaregodui Antioquia kae du keje, emagore gregodoge ei jamedu, ere Pagimejera o bakaru kogado ewiegai jamedu.

b: Pagimejera mugure ebo du kodire icare boe makareuge emeartorure, ere tugirimi Pao ae.
source: Pagimejera mugure ebo du kodire icare boe makareuge emeartorure, ere tugirimi Pao ae.

b: Awu boe jamedu boe akaru aregodure Jerusalém tadawu meartorureuge ewiegai. Du kodire ere Barnabé utudo Antioquia kae.
source: Awu boe jamedu boe akaru aregodure Jerusalém tadawu meartorureuge ewiegai. Du kodire ere Barnabé utudo Antioquia kae.

b: Aregodure toro du kejere jekarere tumeardui Pao o boe pemegareu jitu koia, icare makore ei emugu kiduwo Pao apo, turo raka tabo.
source: Aregodure toro du kejere jekarere tumeardui Pao o boe pemegareu jitu koia, icare makore ei emugu kiduwo Pao apo, turo raka tabo.

b: Paga karega, emare imedu pemegareu rema, meartoru kuricigore, Aroe Pemegareu mugure apo. Du kodire ia boe makareuge ere tumeduiado Paoce.
source: Paga karega, emare imedu pemegareu rema, meartoru kuricigore, Aroe Pemegareu mugure apo. Du kodire ia boe makareuge ere tumeduiado Paoce.

b: Kuri je du keje icare Barnabé uture toro Tarso kae, tuiemaruwo Saulo bogai, icare jordure ji, ure reko Antioquia kae.
source: Kuri je du keje icare Barnabé uture toro Tarso kae, tuiemaruwo Saulo bogai, icare jordure ji, ure reko Antioquia kae.

b: Joru mito tu jedu oto kae, etu eture meartorureuge ere tudo puiwo kae tu tu tu je, ere makaguragareuge eerduwado. Du kodire Antioquia kejere nowu meartorure Cristo jiwuge eiere cristãodoge oino boetoji.
source: Joru mito tu jedu oto kae, etu eture meartorureuge ere tudo puiwo kae tu tu tu je, ere makaguragareuge eerduwado. Du kodire Antioquia kejere nowu meartorure Cristo jiwuge eiere cristãodoge oino boetoji.

b: Nowu kodiboe keje ia profetadoge ere turawuje Jerusalém piji Antioquia kae.
source: Nowu kodiboe keje ia profetadoge ere turawuje Jerusalém piji Antioquia kae.

b: Ia emage ui mito tu jedu iei Agabo cedu, ure turagojedo, icare Aroe Pemegareu koiare readodure ia boe eke boi moduie boei du kuricigomode moto jamedu boe keje. Boekimorema, awu boe eke boi aregodure nowu Cláudio brae eimejera kurireui pudumi du tonaji.
source: Ia emage ui mito tu jedu iei Agabo cedu, ure turagojedo, icare Aroe Pemegareu koiare readodure ia boe eke boi moduie boei du kuricigomode moto jamedu boe keje. Boekimorema, awu boe eke boi aregodure nowu Cláudio brae eimejera kurireui pudumi du tonaji.

b: Du kodi icare Antioquia kejeu meartorureuge etaidure tuwo tugera braredo, tuwo toroe maku Judéia kejewu tumanamage etai, tu tu, turoia reore.
source: Du kodi icare Antioquia kejeu meartorureuge etaidure tuwo tugera braredo, tuwo toroe maku Judéia kejewu tumanamage etai, tu tu, turoia reore.

b:
Icare erore oino rugadu ere maku toro Barnabe, Saulo mage ekera tabo.

l2. Herodes onare Pao uwobei, ure Tiago bito.
source:
Icare erore oino rugadu ere maku toro Barnabe, Saulo mage ekera tabo.

l2. Herodes onare Pao uwobei, ure Tiago bito.

b: Barnabé mare Paulo emeru boetojiwu.
source: Barnabé mare Paulo emeru boetojiwu.

b: Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe etada profetadogere, jorduwareugere jamedu. Ia emage reo: Barnabé Simão iei Coreu cedu, Lúcio Cirene pijiwu, Manam cewu Herodes metuia tugodui puregodajidu kimoboe keje, mare Saulo.
source: Antioquia tadawu Pao uwobe etada profetadogere, jorduwareugere jamedu. Ia emage reo: Barnabé Simão iei Coreu cedu, Lúcio Cirene pijiwu, Manam cewu Herodes metuia tugodui puregodajidu kimoboe keje, mare Saulo.

b: Ia meri keje, awuge ere todorogado pudui, du kejere ere Pao jora ko, du tabore icare Aroe Pemegareu makore ei, akore: - Tamode Barnabé mare Saulo etawuje inai emaragoduwo itaidure jiboe keje.
source: Ia meri keje, awuge ere todorogado pudui, du kejere ere Pao jora ko, du tabore icare Aroe Pemegareu makore ei, akore: - Tamode Barnabé mare Saulo etawuje inai emaragoduwo itaidure jiboe keje.

b: Du kejere icare, ei todorogado pudui dukejere, ere togwakurido eparu tabo, icare ere tugera bu ewugeje, du kejere ere etudo.
source: Du kejere icare, ei todorogado pudui dukejere, ere togwakurido eparu tabo, icare ere tugera bu ewugeje, du kejere ere etudo.

b: Du koiare Aroe Pemegareu koiare ure etudo, du tabore eture bakurireu mugui pobo maereu okwai du iere Seléucia cedu kae. Du pijire eture ika kurireu tabo ia pobo aiare moto tabowu iei Chipre cedu kae.
source: Du koiare Aroe Pemegareu koiare ure etudo, du tabore eture bakurireu mugui pobo maereu okwai du iere Seléucia cedu kae. Du pijire eture ika kurireu tabo ia pobo aiare moto tabowu iei Chipre cedu kae.

b: Etaregodure Salamina bakurireuto du kejere ere Pao bataru kogado nono judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataru jiwu baidoge etada. João (Marcos) kodure ebo tuwo tugera braredo ei.
source: Etaregodure Salamina bakurireuto du kejere ere Pao bataru kogado nono judeudoge ere tudo pui tumagowo Pao bataru jiwu baidoge etada. João (Marcos) kodure ebo tuwo tugera braredo ei.

b: Du kejere emerure jii je, nowu pobo aiare moto tabowu kajeje jii etaregodure Pafos bakurireuto, du tadare eerdure ia judeu iei Barjesu ceduji, duwure boe eekuri pagado turo tuginoiwu tabo, profeta pagareu nure ema.
source: Du kejere emerure jii je, nowu pobo aiare moto tabowu kajeje jii etaregodure Pafos bakurireuto, du tadare eerdure ia judeu iei Barjesu ceduji, duwure boe eekuri pagado turo tuginoiwu tabo, profeta pagareu nure ema.

b: Mugure brae eimejera pemegareu iei Sérgio Paulo cedu apo. Awu brae eimejera makore Barnabé mare Saulo ewogai, aidure tumearduwo Pao bataruji kodi.
source: Mugure brae eimejera pemegareu iei Sérgio Paulo cedu apo. Awu brae eimejera makore Barnabé mare Saulo ewogai, aidure tumearduwo Pao bataruji kodi.

b: Icare nowu profeta paga pagareu, du iere jamedu Elimas cedu, ure tonado ei, aidure tuwo nowu brae eimejera meartoru kado Paoji.
source: Icare nowu profeta paga pagareu, du iere jamedu Elimas cedu, ure tonado ei, aidure tuwo nowu brae eimejera meartoru kado Paoji.

b: Du kodi icare Saulo, du iere Paulo, Aroe Pemegareu mugui apo du koia, ure tuioku kidudo ji, akore: -
source: Du kodi icare Saulo, du iere Paulo, Aroe Pemegareu mugui apo du koia, ure tuioku kidudo ji, akore: -

b: Aroe pegareu onaregedu, ure boe eekuri pagadowu, batararodureu, onare boe jetororeu jiwu imedu, anure Pao Aroe Eimejera utawara jetororeu meki mekido.
source: Aroe pegareu onaregedu, ure boe eekuri pagadowu, batararodureu, onare boe jetororeu jiwu imedu, anure Pao Aroe Eimejera utawara jetororeu meki mekido.

b: Ica, oinonore icare iera butumode awugeje, du koiare aeku bokwamode. Aerdumodukare meri jokuji jii boe emagomode ai pugeje du kae. Kuri je du kejere icare boeco buture joki, icare merure, ure taiado bai bai bai, jemarure ioguduba umode tugera maku pudai du bogai.
source: Ica, oinonore icare iera butumode awugeje, du koiare aeku bokwamode. Aerdumodukare meri jokuji jii boe emagomode ai pugeje du kae. Kuri je du kejere icare boeco buture joki, icare merure, ure taiado bai bai bai, jemarure ioguduba umode tugera maku pudai du bogai.

b:
Nowu brae eiemejera tuiordui nowu Saulo ro rakareu jitu kejere icare, meartorure Paoji, jeebogodu kuricigore Paulo makore jiboeji.
Paulo uwadodae Antioquia bakurireu mugui Pisídia kejewu keje.
source:
Nowu brae eiemejera tuiordui nowu Saulo ro rakareu jitu kejere icare, meartorure Paoji, jeebogodu kuricigore Paulo makore jiboeji.
Paulo uwadodae Antioquia bakurireu mugui Pisídia kejewu keje.

b: Du kejere icare Paulo uture tumedage ebo ika kurireu tabo nowu Pafos bakurireu piji, etaregodure Perge bakurireu mugui Panfília moto kejewu kae. Nonore icare cewu João Marcos uture epiji, ure tugirimi Jerusalemto pugeje.
source: Du kejere icare Paulo uture tumedage ebo ika kurireu tabo nowu Pafos bakurireu piji, etaregodure Perge bakurireu mugui Panfília moto kejewu kae. Nonore icare cewu João Marcos uture epiji, ure tugirimi Jerusalemto pugeje.
