source: Jire cereadodure, cenogituwai boe eiamedu boei du tabo, cei boe eiamedu boe eerduwado boe jetororeu jamedu boeji, ma, ime eiameduwo tuiedorodo Cristo tada.

b: Awu inodu koiare imaragodure, awu inodu koiare ire ipewudo Cristo ro raka ro rakai itada du tabo.
source: Awu inodu koiare imaragodure, awu inodu koiare ire ipewudo Cristo ro raka ro rakai itada du tabo.

b: Paulo morora amagadure Asia kejewu Pao uwobe eigoia.
source: Paulo morora amagadure Asia kejewu Pao uwobe eigoia.

b: Itaidure taerduwawo imaragodu rakai taigoia, mugure Laodicia kejewuge eigoia, jordukare ii kimowuge eiamedu koia jamedu duji.
source: Itaidure taerduwawo imaragodu rakai taigoia, mugure Laodicia kejewuge eigoia, jordukare ii kimowuge eiamedu koia jamedu duji.

b: Itaidure tameduwo tadoda, tameardu kuriwo pui, tameardu awadudodu kuricigowo, taerduwawo Pao o boe biadodureboe pemegareuji, dure Cristo rema.
source: Itaidure tameduwo tadoda, tameardu kuriwo pui, tameardu awadudodu kuricigowo, taerduwawo Pao o boe biadodureboe pemegareuji, dure Cristo rema.

b: Tadare boe eerduwadoboe jamedu boe, boe emeardae pemegareu jamedu boe meture tada.
source: Tadare boe eerduwadoboe jamedu boe, boe emeardae pemegareu jamedu boe meture tada.

b: Imagore oino tai iaboe iaboe ekawo taeku to pui tuwadodae pagareu tabo.
source: Imagore oino tai iaboe iaboe ekawo taeku to pui tuwadodae pagareu tabo.

b: Paga karega, ipuredukare tai ikodu tabo, mare iragojere tadoda itaroe tabo, iegarere iordui taro tagago, tawadaru pemegai, tarokai doi doi je tameartorui Cristo jitu tabo.
source: Paga karega, ipuredukare tai ikodu tabo, mare iragojere tadoda itaroe tabo, iegarere iordui taro tagago, tawadaru pemegai, tarokai doi doi je tameartorui Cristo jitu tabo.

b: Tamagai tare tageragu Cristo jitu reorere, tamerumode keje jamedu.
source: Tamagai tare tageragu Cristo jitu reorere, tamerumode keje jamedu.

b: Taragoje rakado keje, tagaba tawure taru piji, taiodo tameartorae keje, taerduwadodu magai du reore, tamedui tadoda du tabo, tamago pemegai jitu tabo.
source: Taragoje rakado keje, tagaba tawure taru piji, taiodo tameartorae keje, taerduwadodu magai du reore, tamedui tadoda du tabo, tamago pemegai jitu tabo.

b: Tameardu awadudo tai. Tagaba boedo taeku to pui tumagoi tuiorduwa paga pagareu jitu tabo, duwugere eiore ime eroia keje, awu moto kejeboe keje, mare eiokare Cristo keje.
source: Tameardu awadudo tai. Tagaba boedo taeku to pui tumagoi tuiorduwa paga pagareu jitu tabo, duwugere eiore ime eroia keje, awu moto kejeboe keje, mare eiokare Cristo keje.

b: Kejere paerdure paeku tabo Pao Aroe Eimejera remawuji.
source: Kejere paerdure paeku tabo Pao Aroe Eimejera remawuji.

b: Awu baru tadawu ro rakareboe eimejera nure ema, koiare boe pemegareu jamedu boe makudure tagai.
source: Awu baru tadawu ro rakareboe eimejera nure ema, koiare boe pemegareu jamedu boe makudure tagai.

b: Kruca padure tawugeje jamedu, mare boe ekera pijiwu kruca karega, mare Cristo o kruca, dure pai pagodu jiboe pijido dure ema.
source: Kruca padure tawugeje jamedu, mare boe ekera pijiwu kruca karega, mare Cristo o kruca, dure pai pagodu jiboe pijido dure ema.

b: Tai tagao pegodo du tabo tamedure Cristo apo moto tada, mare taewodure apo jamedu tameartorui Pao ro rakareu jitu koia, du ure jewodudo bireuge epiji.
source: Tai tagao pegodo du tabo tamedure Cristo apo moto tada, mare taewodure apo jamedu tameartorui Pao ro rakareu jitu koia, du ure jewodudo bireuge epiji.

b: Tawire taro pegareu kai, takai tawiri krucado du koia, mare Paore taewodudo Cristo apo. Ure paro pegareu barigu pabiji, butugugodure pai.
source: Tawire taro pegareu kai, takai tawiri krucado du koia, mare Paore taewodudo Cristo apo. Ure paro pegareu barigu pabiji, butugugodure pai.

b: Ure nowu bapera ui pawarigu boe pegareu todu pegado, ure okwado rugadu, butugugodure pai.
source: Ure nowu bapera ui pawarigu boe pegareu todu pegado, ure okwado rugadu, butugugodure pai.

b: Ure awu moto kejewu ro rakareuge ekera kedodo, tui boe redugodudo ei du tabo, tubadui i keje du tabo.
source: Ure awu moto kejewu ro rakareuge ekera kedodo, tui boe redugodudo ei du tabo, tubadui i keje du tabo.

b: Iaboe iaboe emago pega kawo tai tagogwagere jiboeji, tagudure ceboeji, iarema ia taegarei tai tago joru butu keje rabodu, iarema ia ari rutu keje rabodu, iarema ia Sábado meriji rabodu.
source: Iaboe iaboe emago pega kawo tai tagogwagere jiboeji, tagudure ceboeji, iarema ia taegarei tai tago joru butu keje rabodu, iarema ia ari rutu keje rabodu, iarema ia Sábado meriji rabodu.

b: Awu inodu jamedu boe aregodumode pagaiboe pemegareu o boetugu rema tu je. Boe riki remawure Cristo rema.
source: Awu inodu jamedu boe aregodumode pagaiboe pemegareu o boetugu rema tu je. Boe riki remawure Cristo rema.

b: Iaboe iaboe ekawo tagodu pemegare awara jiwu mori pemegareu aru tabiji, tui tuwiegadu du tabo, iarema tui tupadoge ekurido du tabo. Awu tunuiao tabore enure tuwarigu boeto, enure tojarodo pudui, enure togorawu awu moto kejeboe tabo.
source: Iaboe iaboe ekawo tagodu pemegare awara jiwu mori pemegareu aru tabiji, tui tuwiegadu du tabo, iarema tui tupadoge ekurido du tabo. Awu tunuiao tabore enure tuwarigu boeto, enure tojarodo pudui, enure togorawu awu moto kejeboe tabo.

b: Eiokare Pao uwobe etaorato, koiare ure boe eiamedu todui puidu ure enogwagedo, ricodudo, Pao meardae pemegareu rekodaji.
source: Eiokare Pao uwobe etaorato, koiare ure boe eiamedu todui puidu ure enogwagedo, ricodudo, Pao meardae pemegareu rekodaji.

b: Tawire awu moto kejeboeji Cristo keje ma, kodiba tare boedo takado tarodo, taragoje magai moto keje kimo du reore?
source: Tawire awu moto kejeboeji Cristo keje ma, kodiba tare boedo takado tarodo, taragoje magai moto keje kimo du reore?

b: Egore tai: Takaba tageragu, tagogwage kaba, tagogwa paga kaba. oino tai.
source: Egore tai: Takaba tageragu, tagogwage kaba, tagogwa paga kaba. oino tai.

b: Awu inodu jamedu iaboe iaboe karega ure ema, imei boe eroiagudu rema tu je.
source: Awu inodu jamedu iaboe iaboe karega ure ema, imei boe eroiagudu rema tu je.

b: Umode nono boe pemegareure, tui tuwiegado du tabo, tui tugodu okorido du tabo, mare nowu eroinodu paga nure, unure boe ekodu aidudo tu rugadu.
source: Umode nono boe pemegareure, tui tuwiegado du tabo, tui tugodu okorido du tabo, mare nowu eroinodu paga nure, unure boe ekodu aidudo tu rugadu.

b: Pae maiwu Cristo tadadu.
source: Pae maiwu Cristo tadadu.

b: U! Kode! Taewodure Cristo apo ma, tadudo cebojeboe bogai Cristo mugui Pao kana jetororeu jaogwai du kae.
source: U! Kode! Taewodure Cristo apo ma, tadudo cebojeboe bogai Cristo mugui Pao kana jetororeu jaogwai du kae.

b: Tagaidudo cebojeboeji, mare awu moto kejeboeji karega.
source: Tagaidudo cebojeboeji, mare awu moto kejeboeji karega.

b: Paga karega, tawire, taedodu biadodure Cristo apo Pao aroe Eimejera tada.
source: Paga karega, tawire, taedodu biadodure Cristo apo Pao aroe Eimejera tada.

b: Cristo, paere kejewu, umode towadudo du keje, towadodumode apo jamedu boe pemegareu keje.
source: Cristo, paere kejewu, umode towadudo du keje, towadodumode apo jamedu boe pemegareu keje.

b: Kodi icare, tadorogado tai awu moto kejeboe piji: boe erebarae, boe ero boe ego pegareu, boe ekiarigodae pegareu, boe etaidae pegareu, boe etogeae pegareu, du ure nono boei tubujodo Paokare emaboeji du reore.
source: Kodi icare, tadorogado tai awu moto kejeboe piji: boe erebarae, boe ero boe ego pegareu, boe ekiarigodae pegareu, boe etaidae pegareu, boe etogeae pegareu, du ure nono boei tubujodo Paokare emaboeji du reore.

b: Awu inodu koiare ure Pao kodu kagirido meartoru bokwareugei.
source: Awu inodu koiare ure Pao kodu kagirido meartoru bokwareugei.

b: Tagi jamedu ia boe keje tarore ino jamedu tamedui taro pegareu tada du tabo.
source: Tagi jamedu ia boe keje tarore ino jamedu tamedui taro pegareu tada du tabo.

b: Mare oino, tare tagera ra awu inodu piji: tagodu kagirae, boe ekorii taidu, tameardae pegareu, tamago pegai puidu, tawadaru me joi pugajejedu piji.
source: Mare oino, tare tagera ra awu inodu piji: tagodu kagirae, boe ekorii taidu, tameardae pegareu, tamago pegai puidu, tawadaru me joi pugajejedu piji.

b: Tawadararodu kaba pui jice woje jice woje, tare tagera ra boecodureu piji, ro boe piji.
source: Tawadararodu kaba pui jice woje jice woje, tare tagera ra boecodureu piji, ro boe piji.

b: Tare boe maiwudo tagi, tai tamaidudo tu tu je du tabo, tawo nono ure tadowujewure, taerduwa pemega tabo.
source: Tare boe maiwudo tagi, tai tamaidudo tu tu je du tabo, tawo nono ure tadowujewure, taerduwa pemega tabo.

b: Du kodire oino pugeje Grécia kejewu bokwa, Judéia kejewu bokwa, kruca padure kejewu bokwa, kruca padukare kejewu bokwa, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu bokwa, boe etugare emawu bokwa, boe etugarekare emawu bokwa, mare Cristo mitodure meture paiamedu tada.
source: Du kodire oino pugeje Grécia kejewu bokwa, Judéia kejewu bokwa, kruca padure kejewu bokwa, kruca padukare kejewu bokwa, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu bokwa, boe etugare emawu bokwa, boe etugarekare emawu bokwa, mare Cristo mitodure meture paiamedu tada.

b: Tagi, Pao Aroe Eimejera oge nure tagi, pemegareuge nure tagi, Pao meardu kurire jiwugere tagi, du kodire tawabo okorobadudo tagoiagudu tabo, tagaidu pemegareu tabo, tai tawiegado du tabo, tagai boedo tagi du tabo, tawugugugodu tabo.
source: Tagi, Pao Aroe Eimejera oge nure tagi, pemegareuge nure tagi, Pao meardu kurire jiwugere tagi, du kodire tawabo okorobadudo tagoiagudu tabo, tagaidu pemegareu tabo, tai tawiegado du tabo, tagai boedo tagi du tabo, tawugugugodu tabo.

b: Takaba tamedage ero korido tai, tawudugugo pui taro tawadaru pegare tu tu pui du keje. Paore butugugodu magai tai du reore, tawudugugodumode tamedage ei jamedu.
source: Takaba tamedage ero korido tai, tawudugugo pui taro tawadaru pegare tu tu pui du keje. Paore butugugodu magai tai du reore, tawudugugodumode tamedage ei jamedu.

b: Mare ema remawu tameardu kurido pui, awure pemega remawure.
source: Mare ema remawu tameardu kurido pui, awure pemega remawure.

b: Pagimejera Jesus Cristo metuwo tawabo tada, du bogaire Pao makore tawogai, tawo mito tu je. Tamode tukutaido tu tu Paoji jamedu.
source: Pagimejera Jesus Cristo metuwo tawabo tada, du bogaire Pao makore tawogai, tawo mito tu je. Tamode tukutaido tu tu Paoji jamedu.

b: Jesus Cristo o bataru muguwo tadoda taro pemegareu jamedu boe tabo ma, tawo taerduwado pui, tawo awu inodu awadudo pui taerduwa jamedu tabo. Pao o boe pemegareu mugui tadoda du koia, tarago Paoji tawabo jamedu tabo, Pao ukeroiaji, boe ekeroiaji, aroe ekeroiaji.
source: Jesus Cristo o bataru muguwo tadoda taro pemegareu jamedu boe tabo ma, tawo taerduwado pui, tawo awu inodu awadudo pui taerduwa jamedu tabo. Pao o boe pemegareu mugui tadoda du koia, tarago Paoji tawabo jamedu tabo, Pao ukeroiaji, boe ekeroiaji, aroe ekeroiaji.

b:
Taromode jiboe jamedu boe, tamagomode jiboe jamedu boe, tarodo tamagodo ji mare Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, tai tukutaidu Paoji apo du tabo.
Boe eiamedu boe eimejera Cristo rema.
source:
Taromode jiboe jamedu boe, tamagomode jiboe jamedu boe, tarodo tamagodo ji mare Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, tai tukutaidu Paoji apo du tabo.
Boe eiamedu boe eimejera Cristo rema.

b: Areme tameartorudo tagoge ewadaruji Pao aidu reore.
source: Areme tameartorudo tagoge ewadaruji Pao aidu reore.

b: Ime, tameardu kurido tawirei, tagaba etogorido, tagaba ekiarigo.
source: Ime, tameardu kurido tawirei, tagaba etogorido, tagaba ekiarigo.

b: Boe etore, tameartorudo taomagei boe jamedu boe keje, oinodu umode Pao jekaredo.
source: Boe etore, tameartorudo taomagei boe jamedu boe keje, oinodu umode Pao jekaredo.

b: Boe etuomage, boe etujemage, tarokowodu kaba tagorei, ero kawo doi doi boeji.
source: Boe etuomage, boe etujemage, tarokowodu kaba tagorei, ero kawo doi doi boeji.

b: Boe etugarege, tameartorudo awu moto kejewu tagimejerage ewadaruji, tamaragodui tu eegai tu je du karega, taemarui tawo ime eegaredo du bogai karega, mare tawabo jetorogodu tabo, tabagudui Paoce du tabo.
source: Boe etugarege, tameartorudo awu moto kejewu tagimejerage ewadaruji, tamaragodui tu eegai tu je du karega, taemarui tawo ime eegaredo du bogai karega, mare tawabo jetorogodu tabo, tabagudui Paoce du tabo.

b: Taromode jiboe jamedu boe tarodo ji tawabo jetorogodu tabo, boe ero magai Pao ai du reore, mare ime etai du reore karega.
source: Taromode jiboe jamedu boe tarodo ji tawabo jetorogodu tabo, boe ero magai Pao ai du reore, mare ime etai du reore karega.

b: Taerduware mori makudumode tagai Pao iera piji duji. Du kodi icare, tamaragodudo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ai.
source: Taerduware mori makudumode tagai Pao iera piji duji. Du kodi icare, tamaragodudo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ai.

b:
Ro pegareu imedu, ro pegareu mori makudumode ai, pakare paginoi paginoi Pao jekai kodi.

4.
source:
Ro pegareu imedu, ro pegareu mori makudumode ai, pakare paginoi paginoi Pao jekai kodi.

4.

b: Bapera paru.
source: Bapera paru.

b: Imi, Paulo, Jesus Cristo o apóstolo, Pao aidu reore, inure awu bapera atugodo Éfeso bakurireu kejewu Pao uwobe ewogai, meartorure Jesus Cristo jiwuge ewogai.
source: Imi, Paulo, Jesus Cristo o apóstolo, Pao aidu reore, inure awu bapera atugodo Éfeso bakurireu kejewu Pao uwobe ewogai, meartorure Jesus Cristo jiwuge ewogai.

b:
Pao Aroe Eimejera mare Jesus Cristo eno boe pemegareu, boe butugureu, muguwo tagabo.
Pao aidui boewo cinorudodu.
source:
Pao Aroe Eimejera mare Jesus Cristo eno boe pemegareu, boe butugureu, muguwo tagabo.
Pao aidui boewo cinorudodu.

b: Boewo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Uo akaru pemegado, duwu koiare ure baru tadawu boe pemegareu kurireudo pai Cristo tada.
source: Boewo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Uo akaru pemegado, duwu koiare ure baru tadawu boe pemegareu kurireudo pai Cristo tada.

b: Emare ure tugeragu pai, awu moto towujedumodedu otodai, pagiwo pabemegare, paedorore tuiegai.
source: Emare ure tugeragu pai, awu moto towujedumodedu otodai, pagiwo pabemegare, paedorore tuiegai.

b: Kuri boe paruto ure paenado torewo pagi, tumeardu kurii pai Cristo tada du koia, mare paga karega, aidure oinowo ure rugadu kodi.
source: Kuri boe paruto ure paenado torewo pagi, tumeardu kurii pai Cristo tada du koia, mare paga karega, aidure oinowo ure rugadu kodi.

b: Oinodu tabowo ture maku pagai tumeardu kurire jiwu tonaregedu tadawu to boe pemegareu urugu jowo boeto.
source: Oinodu tabowo ture maku pagai tumeardu kurire jiwu tonaregedu tadawu to boe pemegareu urugu jowo boeto.

b: Nowu tonaregedu ku koiare ure paginorudo boe pegareu piji, butugugodure pai paro pegareu jamedu boe keje, mare paga karega, emare to boe pemegareu kuricigore pudabo.
source: Nowu tonaregedu ku koiare ure paginorudo boe pegareu piji, butugugodure pai paro pegareu jamedu boe keje, mare paga karega, emare to boe pemegareu kuricigore pudabo.

b: Ure awu to boe pemegareu kurireu redo paiogi tuguricigoreu tabo tuiorduwa tabo, tubemega tabo.
source: Ure awu to boe pemegareu kurireu redo paiogi tuguricigoreu tabo tuiorduwa tabo, tubemega tabo.

b: Ure taidure jiboe pemegareu biareu udo turugadu kuri boe paru todu, ure awadudo oino pai.
source: Ure taidure jiboe pemegareu biareu udo turugadu kuri boe paru todu, ure awadudo oino pai.

b: Awu taidure ji boe pemegareu reo: Tuwo boe jamedu boe, moto kejeboe, baru tababoe, to pui Cristo tada.
source: Awu taidure ji boe pemegareu reo: Tuwo boe jamedu boe, moto kejeboe, baru tababoe, to pui Cristo tada.

b: Cewu ro rakare boe jamedu boe jiwu, taidu kejere ure cedawuje pubiji pudae Cristo tada.
source: Cewu ro rakare boe jamedu boe jiwu, taidu kejere ure cedawuje pubiji pudae Cristo tada.

b: Ure ceonado to boe pemegareu kurireuji, cebagare Cristo bogai jii boe paruto du kodi.
source: Ure ceonado to boe pemegareu kurireuji, cebagare Cristo bogai jii boe paruto du kodi.

b: Tagi jamedu tameardui boe jokoduwu bataru jitu keje, tameartorui umode taginorudowu bakaru pemegareu jitu keje, makudumode tagaiwu Aroe Pemegareu meture tai jamedu, Cristo tada.
source: Tagi jamedu tameardui boe jokoduwu bataru jitu keje, tameartorui umode taginorudowu bakaru pemegareu jitu keje, makudumode tagaiwu Aroe Pemegareu meture tai jamedu, Cristo tada.

b: Awu Aroe Pemegareu makudumode pagaiboe jokodudo, pabaga kimoi Pao ure tugeragu jiwuge einorudodu kororogodui taci je du bogai, boe emago pemegawo pudui du bogai.
source: Awu Aroe Pemegareu makudumode pagaiboe jokodudo, pabaga kimoi Pao ure tugeragu jiwuge einorudodu kororogodui taci je du bogai, boe emago pemegawo pudui du bogai.

b: Du kodi icare imi jamedu, imeardui boe egoi tameartoruie Cristo jitu, tameardu kurii cristaodoge eiamedu jitu du keje,
source: Du kodi icare imi jamedu, imeardui boe egoi tameartoruie Cristo jitu, tameardu kurii cristaodoge eiamedu jitu du keje,

b: Ikare itamudo imagoi Paoji tabaru tabo duji.
source: Ikare itamudo imagoi Paoji tabaru tabo duji.

b: Inogwamagudure Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Uo urugureuji, uwo taerduwa, tamearduwa awadudo tagai, taerduwawo pudui du bogai, 18uwo tawabo urugudo tawo boe pa Pao makore tawogai tabagawo bogaiboe kodiboeji: Tawo boe pa oinoie ro pemegareuge eonare jiwu boe pemegareu kuricigoreure.
source: Inogwamagudure Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Uo urugureuji, uwo taerduwa, tamearduwa awadudo tagai, taerduwawo pudui du bogai, 18uwo tawabo urugudo tawo boe pa Pao makore tawogai tabagawo bogaiboe kodiboeji: Tawo boe pa oinoie ro pemegareuge eonare jiwu boe pemegareu kuricigoreure.

b: Tawo boe pa oinoie ro rakareu kurireure pai, pameartorure marigudu du koia.
source: Tawo boe pa oinoie ro rakareu kurireure pai, pameartorure marigudu du koia.

b: Oinore ure turo rakareu kurireu awadudo Cristo tada, tui jewodudo bireuge epiji du tabo, tui mugudo tugana pemegareu jaogwai baru tada du tabo.
source: Oinore ure turo rakareu kurireu awadudo Cristo tada, tui jewodudo bireuge epiji du tabo, tui mugudo tugana pemegareu jaogwai baru tada du tabo.

b: Tui mugudo tupadoge epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe ewugeje, awu moto kejewuge eiamedu boe, baru tadawuge eiamedu boe ewugeje jamedu du tabo.
source: Tui mugudo tupadoge epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe ewugeje, awu moto kejewuge eiamedu boe, baru tadawuge eiamedu boe ewugeje jamedu du tabo.

b: Ure boe jamedu boe bu bure kuda, ure Igreja jamedu boe eimejerado ema.
source: Ure boe jamedu boe bu bure kuda, ure Igreja jamedu boe eimejerado ema.

b: Awu Igreja ure nono uredu rema, cewu meture boe jamedu boe tadawu ja rema.
source: Awu Igreja ure nono uredu rema, cewu meture boe jamedu boe tadawu ja rema.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu koiare ure meartorureuge einorudo.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu koiare ure meartorureuge einorudo.

b: Tagirema tawi nure marigudu taro pegareu koia.
source: Tagirema tawi nure marigudu taro pegareu koia.

b: Taro pegare ia kodiwu keje tagodui awu moto kejewu boe emeardae pegareu rekodaji, tagodui  Aroe pegareuge eimejera rekodaji; emare maragodu kimore meartoru bokwareuge ewabo tada kimo.
source: Taro pegare ia kodiwu keje tagodui awu moto kejewu boe emeardae pegareu rekodaji, tagodui  Aroe pegareuge eimejera rekodaji; emare maragodu kimore meartoru bokwareuge ewabo tada kimo.

b: Marigudu paiamedu tabore nowu inodure pagi, cewu pagodui parowo nono pagodu aidu reore du kodi, cewu paroi nono pagodu aidure jiwu boe pegareu jitu kodiboe keje. Pare nono pegareuge ereore, pawodure paenai Pao korigodumode pai kodiboe tabo dure.
source: Marigudu paiamedu tabore nowu inodure pagi, cewu pagodui parowo nono pagodu aidu reore du kodi, cewu paroi nono pagodu aidure jiwu boe pegareu jitu kodiboe keje. Pare nono pegareuge ereore, pawodure paenai Pao korigodumode pai kodiboe tabo dure.

b: Mare Pao okudae, oiagudae kuricigore, meardu kuricigore pai.
source: Mare Pao okudae, oiagudae kuricigore, meardu kuricigore pai.

b: Du koiare ure paeredu maku pagai Cristo apo, cewu pawire paro pegareu koia du kodiboe keje. Tamoridodure tamori bokwa tabo, mare Pao o boe pemegareu koia.
source: Du koiare ure paeredu maku pagai Cristo apo, cewu pawire paro pegareu koia du kodiboe keje. Tamoridodure tamori bokwa tabo, mare Pao o boe pemegareu koia.

b: Ure paewodudo Cristo apo du koiare, du apore, ure pamugudo baru tada.
source: Ure paewodudo Cristo apo du koiare, du apore, ure pamugudo baru tada.

b: Nowu inodu tabore ure to boe pemegareu awadudo boe eegai jii je rugadu, mare paga karega, meardu kuricigore pai du kodi.
source: Nowu inodu tabore ure to boe pemegareu awadudo boe eegai jii je rugadu, mare paga karega, meardu kuricigore pai du kodi.

b: Tameartoru koia taginorudodure tamori bokwa tabo, mare taigoia karega, nowu inodu makududodure Pao piji.
source: Tameartoru koia taginorudodure tamori bokwa tabo, mare taigoia karega, nowu inodu makududodure Pao piji.

b: Paro koia karega paginorudodure. Du kodire oino iaboe iaboe enojarokawo pudui nowu inodu koia.
source: Paro koia karega paginorudodure. Du kodire oino iaboe iaboe enojarokawo pudui nowu inodu koia.

b: Pao maragodae nure pagi, dure ure padowuje Cristo tada, du tabowo paro pemegareure nono ui paroiagudu reore.
source: Pao maragodae nure pagi, dure ure padowuje Cristo tada, du tabowo paro pemegareure nono ui paroiagudu reore.

b: Tagire judeudogekare tagi tawodu tabo, tagiedodure kruca padukare kejewuge, cewu kruca padure keje boe ekera tabowuge egoe.
source: Tagire judeudogekare tagi tawodu tabo, tagiedodure kruca padukare kejewuge, cewu kruca padure keje boe ekera tabowuge egoe.

b: Tawia jeto mariguduie Cristo mugukae tagabo duji. Nowu kodiwu keje Pao oge karega ure tagi, Pao meardu kuriae mugukare tagabo, tabagare bogaiboe bokware, Pao mugukare tagabo awu moto keje.
source: Tawia jeto mariguduie Cristo mugukae tagabo duji. Nowu kodiwu keje Pao oge karega ure tagi, Pao meardu kuriae mugukare tagabo, tabagare bogaiboe bokware, Pao mugukare tagabo awu moto keje.

b: Mare oino, Jesus Cristo ro koia, tagire taedu jaegirire Pao oge remawugei marigudu du taedure ebo pugeje Cristo ku koia.
source: Mare oino, Jesus Cristo ro koia, tagire taedu jaegirire Pao oge remawugei marigudu du taedure ebo pugeje Cristo ku koia.

b: Mare paga karega, emare boe ewudugugudae rema pai kodi, emare ure boei pobedu edo mito tu je, tui boe etonai puidu akedudo du tabo.
source: Mare paga karega, emare boe ewudugugudae rema pai kodi, emare ure boei pobedu edo mito tu je, tui boe etonai puidu akedudo du tabo.

b: Tugodu tabore ure boe eroiagudu okwado du tabowo ture boe ei pobedu edo imedu maiwudo mitotu tudada tui boe ewudugugo pui du tabo.
source: Tugodu tabore ure boe eroiagudu okwado du tabowo ture boe ei pobedu edo imedu maiwudo mitotu tudada tui boe ewudugugo pui du tabo.

b: Ure boe ei pobedu edo tudo pui Pao apo, tui edo mito tu je du kae, i padui pugajejedu koia, tui boe etonai puidu okwado keje du tabo.
source: Ure boe ei pobedu edo tudo pui Pao apo, tui edo mito tu je du kae, i padui pugajejedu koia, tui boe etonai puidu okwado keje du tabo.

b: Cristo aregodure tumagowo boe ewudugugodaeji jetu jaegirireuge tai, jetu puredureuge ei jamedu.
source: Cristo aregodure tumagowo boe ewudugugodaeji jetu jaegirireuge tai, jetu puredureuge ei jamedu.

b: Mare paga karega, koiare ure pai pobedu arego Pao ae Aroe Pemegareu mitodu tabo.
source: Mare paga karega, koiare ure pai pobedu arego Pao ae Aroe Pemegareu mitodu tabo.

b: Du kodi icare, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewuge karega ure tagi pugeje, iradureuge karega ure tagi pugeje jamedu, mare pemegareuge eno moto kejewuge nure tagi, tagire Pao uwobere tagi.
source: Du kodi icare, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewuge karega ure tagi pugeje, iradureuge karega ure tagi pugeje jamedu, mare pemegareuge eno moto kejewuge nure tagi, tagire Pao uwobere tagi.

b: Pao uwobe ure nono bai mugui bure jore kejewu tori rakareu aogejewu dure Apostolodogere emage, nowu bai mugure kejewu ema remawu torire Cristo rema.
source: Pao uwobe ure nono bai mugui bure jore kejewu tori rakareu aogejewu dure Apostolodogere emage, nowu bai mugure kejewu ema remawu torire Cristo rema.

b: Nowu tori aogejere bai imorododure Pao uwai pemegareuwo ema du bogai.
source: Nowu tori aogejere bai imorododure Pao uwai pemegareuwo ema du bogai.

b: Tagi jamedu, Aroe Pemegareu ro koia, tare taremo nowu bai ureduto dure ure Pao uwaido pudumi.
source: Tagi jamedu, Aroe Pemegareu ro koia, tare taremo nowu bai ureduto dure ure Pao uwaido pudumi.

b: Paulo maragodui Cristo o Igreja aidu.
source: Paulo maragodui Cristo o Igreja aidu.

b: Nowu inodu koia, imi, Paulo, ienai Cristo jitu, imugure baicoreu tada, imeardu kuri koia judeukare emawuge tai.
source: Nowu inodu koia, imi, Paulo, ienai Cristo jitu, imugure baicoreu tada, imeardu kuri koia judeukare emawuge tai.

b: Boe jokodu tare boe pa inoba taboba Paore awu to boe pemegareu maku inai tabaru tabo duji.
source: Boe jokodu tare boe pa inoba taboba Paore awu to boe pemegareu maku inai tabaru tabo duji.

b: Baru pijiboe koiare ure inagoiwado imagowo awu inagore oino maigodu tai jiwu boe biareu pemegareuji.
source: Baru pijiboe koiare ure inagoiwado imagowo awu inagore oino maigodu tai jiwu boe biareu pemegareuji.

b: Tamagoi awu bapera jitu keje, tamode boe pa kodiba iorduware Cristo o boe biareu pemegareu jituji.
source: Tamagoi awu bapera jitu keje, tamode boe pa kodiba iorduware Cristo o boe biareu pemegareu jituji.

b: Awu boe biareu pemegareu awadodukare ime ewiegai marigudu nono oino umagai Aroe Pemegareure awadudo pemegareu apostolodoge, profetadoge ewiegai du reore.
source: Awu boe biareu pemegareu awadodukare ime ewiegai marigudu nono oino umagai Aroe Pemegareure awadudo pemegareu apostolodoge, profetadoge ewiegai du reore.

b: Nowu boe biareu pemegareu reo: Judeukare emawuge etumanamagere judeudoge remawuge pagi, ere pagabodu paredure mito tu je, eonare Paore tuiagu maku pagaiboeji Cristo tada, Bakaru Maiwu Pemegareu koia.
source: Nowu boe biareu pemegareu reo: Judeukare emawuge etumanamagere judeudoge remawuge pagi, ere pagabodu paredure mito tu je, eonare Paore tuiagu maku pagaiboeji Cristo tada, Bakaru Maiwu Pemegareu koia.

b: Pao ro rakareu o boe pemegareu makudure inai du koiare ure imaragodudo Awu Bakaru Maiwu Pemegareuji.
source: Pao ro rakareu o boe pemegareu makudure inai du koiare ure imaragodudo Awu Bakaru Maiwu Pemegareuji.

b: Imire iwiega remawure pemegareuge etada, du kodi karega Pao o boe pemegareu makudure inai, du koiare imagore Cristo oroe pemegareu kuricigoreuji judeukare emawuge ewiegai.
source: Imire iwiega remawure pemegareuge etada, du kodi karega Pao o boe pemegareu makudure inai, du koiare imagore Cristo oroe pemegareu kuricigoreuji judeukare emawuge ewiegai.

b: Du kodire inure boe edo boe pa Pao aidure jiboe pemegareu biareuji. Awu inodu biadodure boe etai, ure boe jamedu boe towujewu Aroe Eimejera tada, jii paru piji jii oino.
source: Du kodire inure boe edo boe pa Pao aidure jiboe pemegareu biareuji. Awu inodu biadodure boe etai, ure boe jamedu boe towujewu Aroe Eimejera tada, jii paru piji jii oino.

b: Mare awu inodu otobiji Tupadoge eiamedu boe eerduwamode Pao jorduwa rakareuji, pagimejera uwobe paigoia.
source: Mare awu inodu otobiji Tupadoge eiamedu boe eerduwamode Pao jorduwa rakareuji, pagimejera uwobe paigoia.

b: Mare paga karega, taidure kuri boe paruto turowo jiboe ure towuje Pagimejera Jesus Cristo koia.
source: Mare paga karega, taidure kuri boe paruto turowo jiboe ure towuje Pagimejera Jesus Cristo koia.

b: Pameartorui jitu koiare, pameartoru kidare pagaregoduwo Pao ae.
source: Pameartorui jitu koiare, pameartoru kidare pagaregoduwo Pao ae.

b: Du kodire inogwamagudu nure oino tai tagugudugodu kawo awu icebaere oino tagai du kodi, mare paga karega, awu icebaere du koiare umode taegare kuricigodo.
source: Du kodire inogwamagudu nure oino tai tagugudugodu kawo awu icebaere oino tagai du kodi, mare paga karega, awu icebaere du koiare umode taegare kuricigodo.

b: Nowu inodu koiare inure ipujodo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Uo jokorai, 15koiare ure jereboe jamedu boe ekiedo baru tada, moto keje jamedu.
source: Nowu inodu koiare inure ipujodo Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Uo jokorai, 15koiare ure jereboe jamedu boe ekiedo baru tada, moto keje jamedu.

b: Inogwamagudu nure ji uwo Aroe Pemegareudo tabewu maku tagai tarijoduwo tadoda, oroe pemegareu kuricigoreu tabo.
source: Inogwamagudu nure ji uwo Aroe Pemegareudo tabewu maku tagai tarijoduwo tadoda, oroe pemegareu kuricigoreu tabo.

b: Uwo Cristo mugudo tawabo tada, tameartorae koia, tagidawo tai tagogudaeji, taiagudaeji.
source: Uwo Cristo mugudo tawabo tada, tameartorae koia, tagidawo tai tagogudaeji, taiagudaeji.

b: Du tabowo tare boe pa, pemegareuge ebo, inoba Cristo meardu kuriae ja torire, raire, ricore baruto, kore mototo, kurire boe eerduwa mearduwa jamedu boe kori duji.
source: Du tabowo tare boe pa, pemegareuge ebo, inoba Cristo meardu kuriae ja torire, raire, ricore baruto, kore mototo, kurire boe eerduwa mearduwa jamedu boe kori duji.

b: Du tabowo tagorobadure Pao o boe pemegareu kurireu jamedu boe tabo.
source: Du tabowo tagorobadure Pao o boe pemegareu kurireu jamedu boe tabo.

b: Pao roiware turowo pamagore bogaiboe jamedu boe kori, pameardaere jiboe kori remawu rugadu, turo rakareu mugui pudabo du tabo.
source: Pao roiware turowo pamagore bogaiboe jamedu boe kori, pameardaere jiboe kori remawu rugadu, turo rakareu mugui pudabo du tabo.

b: Jire boe eegare kuricigoreuwo Igreja tada, Jesus Cristo tada, jii boe ewodui puguda du tabo jii je. Oino godu.
source: Jire boe eegare kuricigoreuwo Igreja tada, Jesus Cristo tada, jii boe ewodui puguda du tabo jii je. Oino godu.

b: Boewo tudo pui Cristo tadadu.
source: Boewo tudo pui Cristo tadadu.

b: Du kodi icare, imi imugure baicoreu tadadu inogwamagudure tai tagidawo tai tameruwo Pao makore tawogai boe keje.
source: Du kodi icare, imi imugure baicoreu tadadu inogwamagudure tai tagidawo tai tameruwo Pao makore tawogai boe keje.

b: Tamode tarodo duku boe ekuda, tameardu kuriae tabo, tagaroe pemegareu tabo, tagoguduwo puapo, taiaguduwo puapo.
source: Tamode tarodo duku boe ekuda, tameardu kuriae tabo, tagaroe pemegareu tabo, tagoguduwo puapo, taiaguduwo puapo.

b: Taemaruwo tawo mitogodo Aroe Pemegareu tada, tameduiawo, tawobewo tu puje.
source: Taemaruwo tawo mitogodo Aroe Pemegareu tada, tameduiawo, tawobewo tu puje.

b: Tado nono tai mito tu je du kodiwore, mare paga karega, tagire Pao makore tawogai tabagare bogaiboewo nono pureore.
source: Tado nono tai mito tu je du kodiwore, mare paga karega, tagire Pao makore tawogai tabagare bogaiboewo nono pureore.

b: Pagimejera Kurireure mito tu je, pameartoraere mito tu je, pagao pegododaere mito tu je.
source: Pagimejera Kurireure mito tu je, pameartoraere mito tu je, pagao pegododaere mito tu je.

b: Pao ure mito tu je dure boe eiamedu etuore ema. Emare mugure boe eiamedu etao keje, rore boe jamedu boeji, mugure paiamedu boe tada.
source: Pao ure mito tu je dure boe eiamedu etuore ema. Emare mugure boe eiamedu etao keje, rore boe jamedu boeji, mugure paiamedu boe tada.

b: Mare boe pemegareu makudure pagai nono Cristo magai maku pagai du reore.
source: Mare boe pemegareu makudure pagai nono Cristo magai maku pagai du reore.

b: Kodire bapera atugododu akore: - Rutui baruto du tabo ure makareuge erego pudabo, ure ime enogorawu akiró pemegareu tabo.
source: Kodire bapera atugododu akore: - Rutui baruto du tabo ure makareuge erego pudabo, ure ime enogorawu akiró pemegareu tabo.

b: Akore: rutui  oino, mare paga karega, urade turawuje awu moto kae marigudu kodi.
source: Akore: rutui  oino, mare paga karega, urade turawuje awu moto kae marigudu kodi.

b: Cewu ure turawujewu ema mitodure ruture baruto, baru jamedu boe etaogeje tuwo boe jamedu boe ekororogodudo.
source: Cewu ure turawujewu ema mitodure ruture baruto, baru jamedu boe etaogeje tuwo boe jamedu boe ekororogodudo.

b: Ure apostolodogedo iagece, ure profetadogedo iagece, ure bakaru epagedo iagece, ure jeture boei boedo iagece, ure jorduwa rakareugedo iagece.
source: Ure apostolodogedo iagece, ure profetadogedo iagece, ure bakaru epagedo iagece, ure jeture boei boedo iagece, ure jorduwa rakareugedo iagece.

b: Ewo tubadui tu tu tumaragodae kejedu udo turugadu, du tabowo pemegareuge ere pemegareugedo pudumi rugadu ma, Cristo kororogoduwo pudumi rugadu tu je.
source: Ewo tubadui tu tu tumaragodae kejedu udo turugadu, du tabowo pemegareuge ere pemegareugedo pudumi rugadu ma, Cristo kororogoduwo pudumi rugadu tu je.

b: Awu inodu boere oino jii pameartorae ui mitogodu tu je du kae, jii paiamedu boe paerduwawo Pao Onaregedu jitu kae, jii pagaregodui imei pagi nono Cristo reore du kae.
source: Awu inodu boere oino jii pameartorae ui mitogodu tu je du kae, jii paiamedu boe paerduwawo Pao Onaregedu jitu kae, jii pagaregodui imei pagi nono Cristo reore du kae.

b: Pakawo nono negekugure ecedodu magai jice woje du reore pugeje, duwugere eio pagare jice woje bakuru reore boe eerduwa paga pagadodu kae, ime ero ego pegareu koia, ewadararodae boe koia.
source: Pakawo nono negekugure ecedodu magai jice woje du reore pugeje, duwugere eio pagare jice woje bakuru reore boe eerduwa paga pagadodu kae, ime ero ego pegareu koia, ewadararodae boe koia.

b: Mare paricodumode boe pemegareu padui pumekejedu jamedu boe tabo, pagogudui, paiagu ui boe ebo du tabo, Cristo tada, emare pagaora rema kodi.
source: Mare paricodumode boe pemegareu padui pumekejedu jamedu boe tabo, pagogudui, paiagu ui boe ebo du tabo, Cristo tada, emare pagaora rema kodi.

b: Cristo koiare ure pado nono boe eredu mito tu je du reore, du ure ricodudo boe enogudu kororogoduwo tu je du kae, paroi nono paromodedu reore tu tu je du tabo.
source: Cristo koiare ure pado nono boe eredu mito tu je du reore, du ure ricodudo boe enogudu kororogoduwo tu je du kae, paroi nono paromodedu reore tu tu je du tabo.

b: Kodi icare inagomode oino tai, inogwamagudumode tai Pagimejera ie tabo, taro kawo nono ao pegokareuge ero reore pugeje, duwugere ecedodure tumeardae paga pagareu rekodaji.
source: Kodi icare inagomode oino tai, inogwamagudumode tai Pagimejera ie tabo, taro kawo nono ao pegokareuge ero reore pugeje, duwugere ecedodure tumeardae paga pagareu rekodaji.

b: Emeardae mugure boeco tada, eiaere Paoji tuiorduwa bokwa koia, tuwabo kugudu kadu koia.
source: Emeardae mugure boeco tada, eiaere Paoji tuiorduwa bokwa koia, tuwabo kugudu kadu koia.

b: Ekiarire boe pemegareuji du koia ere tumagu turo pegareu kai, ere tumagu turowo nono boe epoguraere emaboe jamedu boe kai tagemo kuricigoreu tabo.
source: Ekiarire boe pemegareuji du koia ere tumagu turo pegareu kai, ere tumagu turowo nono boe epoguraere emaboe jamedu boe kai tagemo kuricigoreu tabo.

b: Tagirema karega, nowu inodu bogai karega tare Cristore jorduwadowugedo tagi.
source: Tagirema karega, nowu inodu bogai karega tare Cristore jorduwadowugedo tagi.

b: Mare tameardure boe egoi Jesus akaru jituji, boe egoi boe jokoduwu boe rikireu metui Jesus tada duji.
source: Mare tameardure boe egoi Jesus akaru jituji, boe egoi boe jokoduwu boe rikireu metui Jesus tada duji.

b: Tawo jaoboe pegareu mugui tawabo tadadu barigu tawabo piji.
source: Tawo jaoboe pegareu mugui tawabo tadadu barigu tawabo piji.

b: Du kodire boe pemegareu ui tudowuje tawabo tadadu itodudo gu gu gu todobiji.
source: Du kodire boe pemegareu ui tudowuje tawabo tadadu itodudo gu gu gu todobiji.

b: Tawo tado nono imedu maiwu reore du Paore towuje nono tureore du reore, boe jetororeu boe pemegareu rikireu tada.
source: Tawo tado nono imedu maiwu reore du Paore towuje nono tureore du reore, boe jetororeu boe pemegareu rikireu tada.

b: Kodire, batararodureboe pijido, tamagodo pui boe jokoduji, mare paga karega, paiamedu boe pare nono paredui mito tu je du kodiwore du kodi.
source: Kodire, batararodureboe pijido, tamagodo pui boe jokoduji, mare paga karega, paiamedu boe pare nono paredui mito tu je du kodiwore du kodi.

b: Boekori aregodumode tai du keje, mare taro pega kaba, tagaba meri butudo boekorii tai du tabo.
source: Boekori aregodumode tai du keje, mare taro pega kaba, tagaba meri butudo boekorii tai du tabo.

b: Tagaba Aroe pegareu  roiwado tai.
source: Tagaba Aroe pegareu  roiwado tai.

b: Ia tagire tagiwogu kigoduredu, tagiwogu kaba pugeje, mare oinore taromode: tamaragodudo boe pemegareu bogai tagera tabo, du kodiwo taroiware tawo tagogududo ia marenarue ebo.
source: Ia tagire tagiwogu kigoduredu, tagiwogu kaba pugeje, mare oinore taromode: tamaragodudo boe pemegareu bogai tagera tabo, du kodiwo taroiware tawo tagogududo ia marenarue ebo.

b: Ia tawadaru pegareu aregodu kaba taiabiji, mare tamagodo tu boe pemegareuji, umode turugadu tu biapagareuge eiduji jamedu.
source: Ia tawadaru pegareu aregodu kaba taiabiji, mare tamagodo tu boe pemegareuji, umode turugadu tu biapagareuge eiduji jamedu.

b: Tagaba Pao o Aroe Pemegareu kiarigo, du makududodure tagai, ure to kruca bu tagaroe keje jii ure paginorudowu aregodumode du kae.
source: Tagaba Pao o Aroe Pemegareu kiarigo, du makududodure tagai, ure to kruca bu tagaroe keje jii ure paginorudowu aregodumode du kae.

b: Boe ekiarigodu pegareu jamedu boe, boe ekodu kagireae, boe ewiri okeagirae, boe enoiogwari, boe ei pu roiadodae, boe pegareu jamedu boe jaedo tai.
source: Boe ekiarigodu pegareu jamedu boe, boe ekodu kagireae, boe ewiri okeagirae, boe enoiogwari, boe ei pu roiadodae, boe pegareu jamedu boe jaedo tai.

b: Taro pemegado pui, tagogududo taiamedu puapo, tawudugugo pui nono Pao butugugodui tai Cristo tada du reore.
source: Taro pemegado pui, tagogududo taiamedu puapo, tawudugugo pui nono Pao butugugodui tai Cristo tada du reore.

b: Boe erowo nono Aroe Eimejera ro reore.
source: Boe erowo nono Aroe Eimejera ro reore.

b: Du kodi icare tarodo nono Pao rore jiboe reore, mare paga karega, tagire meardu kurire jiwu ore tagi du kodi.
source: Du kodi icare tarodo nono Pao rore jiboe reore, mare paga karega, tagire meardu kurire jiwu ore tagi du kodi.

b: Tagogudae taiagudae itodudo todobiji, tarowo nono Cristo ro magai du reore, du ure tumagu Pao ai tuwo nono mori ro pemegareboe reore.
source: Tagogudae taiagudae itodudo todobiji, tarowo nono Cristo ro magai du reore, du ure tumagu Pao ai tuwo nono mori ro pemegareboe reore.

b: Boe ekera keadae, boe epogurae jamedu boe, akemore boe jiboe, tamago kaba ji jamedu, nono ure turugadu pemegareugei.
source: Boe ekera keadae, boe epogurae jamedu boe, akemore boe jiboe, tamago kaba ji jamedu, nono ure turugadu pemegareugei.

b: Tarokaba ino nowu inodu jamedu boeji, tamago paga pga kaba boeji, tamago kaba tamagomodukare jiboeji, mare taegaredo Paoji.
source: Tarokaba ino nowu inodu jamedu boeji, tamago paga pga kaba boeji, tamago kaba tamagomodukare jiboeji, mare taegaredo Paoji.

b: Mare paga karega, imagore oino tai, tawo boe pa ia ro pegareu, ia poguru bokwareu, ia akemo barikareu mugumodukare Cristo apo, Pao apo, eno boe pemegareu tada.
source: Mare paga karega, imagore oino tai, tawo boe pa ia ro pegareu, ia poguru bokwareu, ia akemo barikareu mugumodukare Cristo apo, Pao apo, eno boe pemegareu tada.

b: Iaboe iaboe ekawo taekuri pagado tuwadaru paga pagareu tabo, mare paga karega, nowu inodu jamedu boere Pao korigodae rema meartoru bokware puduiwugei.
source: Iaboe iaboe ekawo taekuri pagado tuwadaru paga pagareu tabo, mare paga karega, nowu inodu jamedu boere Pao korigodae rema meartoru bokware puduiwugei.

b: Tagaba tamedagedo emage.
source: Tagaba tamedagedo emage.

b: Ia kodiboe keje tare nono boecore, macare oino tare nono jorugure Pagimejera tada.
source: Ia kodiboe keje tare nono boecore, macare oino tare nono jorugure Pagimejera tada.

b: Aró, kode, urugureboere boe pemegareu, boe jetororeu boa jokoduwu towuje.
source: Aró, kode, urugureboere boe pemegareu, boe jetororeu boa jokoduwu towuje.

b: Du kodire tagi, taemarudo cewu umode Pao jekaredo du bogai.
source: Du kodire tagi, taemarudo cewu umode Pao jekaredo du bogai.

b: Tagaba tadugu ro pegare boecojiwuge etada, mare paci oino, ero perodudo tawadaru tabo.
source: Tagaba tadugu ro pegare boecojiwuge etada, mare paci oino, ero perodudo tawadaru tabo.

b: Mare paga karega, nowu ero podure jiboe boe epogurure tumagowo ji.
source: Mare paga karega, nowu ero podure jiboe boe epogurure tumagowo ji.

b: Mare nowu inodu jamedu boe, boei perodudo tuwadaru tabo du keje, umode nono jorugu jore kejeboere. Aró, kode, urugu jore kejeboe jamedu boe ure uruguboedo pudumi jamedu.
source: Mare nowu inodu jamedu boe, boei perodudo tuwadaru tabo du keje, umode nono jorugu jore kejeboere. Aró, kode, urugu jore kejeboe jamedu boe ure uruguboedo pudumi jamedu.

b: Du kodire bapera atugo pemegareu akore: “Anudu nure, aedadudo, aragojedo bireuge epiji, Pao urugu jore awugeje”  (Is 26,19; 60,1).
source: Du kodire bapera atugo pemegareu akore: “Anudu nure, aedadudo, aragojedo bireuge epiji, Pao urugu jore awugeje”  (Is 26,19; 60,1).

b: Du kodire icare, iwiemage, tameardu awadudo taro tagago jamedu boeji, tagaba tado nono aora bai baireuge ereore.
source: Du kodire icare, iwiemage, tameardu awadudo taro tagago jamedu boeji, tagaba tado nono aora bai baireuge ereore.

b: Mare tado nono jorduwa rakareuge ereore, tamaragodu pemegai jii je du tabo, mare paga karega, boe kodui puduidu pega.
source: Mare tado nono jorduwa rakareuge ereore, tamaragodu pemegai jii je du tabo, mare paga karega, boe kodui puduidu pega.

b: Tagaba mearudae bokwareboedo tagi, mare taemarudo taerduwawo Pao aidure jiboeji.
source: Tagaba mearudae bokwareboedo tagi, mare taemarudo taerduwawo Pao aidure jiboeji.

b: Tagaba kuru korireboe jetudo tai, duwu tadare boe poguru bokwareboe meture, mare tagogorawu Aroe Pemegareu tabo.
source: Tagaba kuru korireboe jetudo tai, duwu tadare boe poguru bokwareboe meture, mare tagogorawu Aroe Pemegareu tabo.

b: Tarado roiaoji, boe ekeroiare emaboeji; tarado, tarerudo, tai Pao kurido tawabo tada du tabo. 20. Tagimadudo Pao Aroe Eimejeraji boe jameduji jii je, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo.
source: Tarado roiaoji, boe ekeroiare emaboeji; tarado, tarerudo, tai Pao kurido tawabo tada du tabo. 20. Tagimadudo Pao Aroe Eimejeraji boe jameduji jii je, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo.

b: Tameartorudo pu bataruji tabagudui Cristoce du tabo.
source: Tameartorudo pu bataruji tabagudui Cristoce du tabo.

b: Areme emeartoruwo tugoge ewadaruji nono Pagimejerageie emage du kodiwore.
source: Areme emeartoruwo tugoge ewadaruji nono Pagimejerageie emage du kodiwore.

b: Mare paga karega, imedure aredu aora rema nono Igreja aora magai Cristoce du reore kodi. Igrejare nono Cristo uredu reoredure dure ure inorudo. Du reorere aredu umode imeduji.
source: Mare paga karega, imedure aredu aora rema nono Igreja aora magai Cristoce du reore kodi. Igrejare nono Cristo uredu reoredure dure ure inorudo. Du reorere aredu umode imeduji.

b: Igreja meartoru magai Cristo jitu reore, du reorere areme emeartorumode tugoge ewadaruji boe jamedu boe keje jamedu.
source: Igreja meartoru magai Cristo jitu reore, du reorere areme emeartorumode tugoge ewadaruji boe jamedu boe keje jamedu.

b: Ime, tameardu kurido tawirei, nono Cristo meardu kuri magai Igreja jitu reore, ure tumagu tuwidodu kai bukeje,
source: Ime, tameardu kurido tawirei, nono Cristo meardu kuri magai Igreja jitu reore, ure tumagu tuwidodu kai bukeje,

b: Tuwo pemegado, tui kabi boe etao pegododu epa pobo tabo, tuwadaru tabo du tabo.
source: Tuwo pemegado, tui kabi boe etao pegododu epa pobo tabo, tuwadaru tabo du tabo.

b: Aidure tuwo to Igrejado towadudo tuiegai metui turugu tada du tabo, ia gigirireu, ia periperireu, ia boe pegareu tabo karega, mare tubemega tabo, ia turo pegareu bokwa tabo.
source: Aidure tuwo to Igrejado towadudo tuiegai metui turugu tada du tabo, ia gigirireu, ia periperireu, ia boe pegareu tabo karega, mare tubemega tabo, ia turo pegareu bokwa tabo.

b: Du inodu reore ime emeardu kurimode tuwirei nono tumeardu kuri magai pudui du reore. Cewu meardu kurire toreduje jiwu, meardu kuri nure pudui jamedu.
source: Du inodu reore ime emeardu kurimode tuwirei nono tumeardu kuri magai pudui du reore. Cewu meardu kurire toreduje jiwu, meardu kuri nure pudui jamedu.

b: Iaboe iaboe kodu kagirikare pudui, mare paci oino, u rumode togwagedo, jetu rumode pudui, oinore Cristo rore tuwobe Igrejaji jamedu du reore.
source: Iaboe iaboe kodu kagirikare pudui, mare paci oino, u rumode togwagedo, jetu rumode pudui, oinore Cristo rore tuwobe Igrejaji jamedu du reore.

b: Pare nono Cristo uredu reore.
source: Pare nono Cristo uredu reore.

b: Du kodire, imedu umode tugera ra tuo piji, tuje piji, tumuguwo toreduje apo, duwuge ei pobedu emode mitotu turedu tabo.
source: Du kodire, imedu umode tugera ra tuo piji, tuje piji, tumuguwo toreduje apo, duwuge ei pobedu emode mitotu turedu tabo.

b: Awu boe biareu kuricigo, mare paga karega, boere udo nono Cristo magai Igreja jitu reore
source: Awu boe biareu kuricigo, mare paga karega, boere udo nono Cristo magai Igreja jitu reore

b: Ca, kode, tagi jamedu, tameardu kurido tu tu tawirei nono tameardu kuri magai tai du reore; kode, areme jamedu, tado nono iaboere boeji tagogei jamedu.
source: Ca, kode, tagi jamedu, tameardu kurido tu tu tawirei nono tameardu kuri magai tai du reore; kode, areme jamedu, tado nono iaboere boeji tagogei jamedu.

b: Boe etore, boe etuomage, boe etugarege, boe eimejerage eromodedu.
source: Boe etore, boe etuomage, boe etugarege, boe eimejerage eromodedu.

b: Boe etore, tameartorudo taomagei nono Pagimejera jitu reore. Nowu inodure pemegare.
source: Boe etore, tameartorudo taomagei nono Pagimejera jitu reore. Nowu inodure pemegare.

b: Bapera atugo pemegareu akore: Ameardu kurido aoji, ameardu kurido aceji. Awu inodure boetojiwu boe eroiagudu rema, du tabore ia makudumodeboe kodure.
source: Bapera atugo pemegareu akore: Ameardu kurido aoji, ameardu kurido aceji. Awu inodure boetojiwu boe eroiagudu rema, du tabore ia makudumodeboe kodure.

b: Du reo: “Du tabowo boe pemegare ai, aragoje raimode awu moto keje jamedu” (Deut 3, 15).
source: Du reo: “Du tabowo boe pemegare ai, aragoje raimode awu moto keje jamedu” (Deut 3, 15).

b: Tagirema, boe etore etuomage, tagaba tagore ekorigo, mare eerduwado tubemegamodewuji, tuiorduwamodewuji, nono Pagimejera Aroe Pemegareu aidu reore.
source: Tagirema, boe etore etuomage, tagaba tagore ekorigo, mare eerduwado tubemegamodewuji, tuiorduwamodewuji, nono Pagimejera Aroe Pemegareu aidu reore.

b: Boe etugarege, tarodo nono awu moto kejewu tagimejerage etaidu reore, tabagudu tabo, tai tado nono iaboere ei du tabo, nono Cristo jitu reore, tawabo pemegareu tabo.
source: Boe etugarege, tarodo nono awu moto kejewu tagimejerage etaidu reore, tabagudu tabo, tai tado nono iaboere ei du tabo, nono Cristo jitu reore, tawabo pemegareu tabo.

b: Mare tagaba tado nono boe eroreruraere emaboe ereore, tawo ime enojarodo du bogai karega, mare maragodu magai Cristo aiwuge ereore du reore, duwugere erore nono Pao aidu reore tuwabo pemegareu tabo.
source: Mare tagaba tado nono boe eroreruraere emaboe ereore, tawo ime enojarodo du bogai karega, mare maragodu magai Cristo aiwuge ereore du reore, duwugere erore nono Pao aidu reore tuwabo pemegareu tabo.

b: Tamaragodudo tagaidu pemegareu tabo, nono maragodure Pagimejera aiwuge emaragodu reore, mare ime etaidu reore karega.
source: Tamaragodudo tagaidu pemegareu tabo, nono maragodure Pagimejera aiwuge emaragodu reore, mare ime etaidu reore karega.

b: Taerduware Pagimejera umode maragodureuge emaragodae mori maku tu tu etai emaragodae reore duji, taiwo kadui kurimodewu, biegamodewu jitu tabo.
source: Taerduware Pagimejera umode maragodureuge emaragodae mori maku tu tu etai emaragodae reore duji, taiwo kadui kurimodewu, biegamodewu jitu tabo.

b: Tagi jamedu, boe eimejerage, tarodo oinono taeture jiwugei jamedu. Tagorigodu kaba ei; taerduware Pao baru tadawu eimejeraie ure ema duji, tagimejeraie ure ema duji jamedu, jekaire paiamedu boere nono pureore.
source: Tagi jamedu, boe eimejerage, tarodo oinono taeture jiwugei jamedu. Tagorigodu kaba ei; taerduware Pao baru tadawu eimejeraie ure ema duji, tagimejeraie ure ema duji jamedu, jekaire paiamedu boere nono pureore.

b: Tadugu tado Pagimejera ro rakareu tabo.
source: Tadugu tado Pagimejera ro rakareu tabo.

b: Pagimejera kurireu o tugobaigarege enoroe tugu tai, taragawo aroe pegareu rugodui tai, ui tureo mugudo tai du keje.
source: Pagimejera kurireu o tugobaigarege enoroe tugu tai, taragawo aroe pegareu rugodui tai, ui tureo mugudo tai du keje.

b: Mare paga karega, imei karega parugodumode, mare boeco tadaboe eimejeragei, aroe pegareuge eparadui baru otojiwugei.
source: Mare paga karega, imei karega parugodumode, mare boeco tadaboe eimejeragei, aroe pegareuge eparadui baru otojiwugei.

b: Du kodire tamode Pao o tugobaigarege enoroe tugu tai, duma tawo tabewudo tai boe pegareu kodiboe tada, duma tagidawo tai, tai tamorido onare taiwuge eiamedu boe jituji.
source: Du kodire tamode Pao o tugobaigarege enoroe tugu tai, duma tawo tabewudo tai boe pegareu kodiboe tada, duma tagidawo tai, tai tamorido onare taiwuge eiamedu boe jituji.

b: Du kodi icare, tabewudo tai, tado nono tugobaigaregere, tabora meriri bu tamorora bukeje, duwu boe jetororeboe, boe rikireboe rema.
source: Du kodi icare, tabewudo tai, tado nono tugobaigaregere, tabora meriri bu tamorora bukeje, duwu boe jetororeboe, boe rikireboe rema.

b: Tawure tadawu tugu tawureto, tagagemoi tawo Bakaru Pemegareu kogado boe pemegareu boe butugureu tabo du bogai.
source: Tawure tadawu tugu tawureto, tagagemoi tawo Bakaru Pemegareu kogado boe pemegareu boe butugureu tabo du bogai.

b: Tagedu meriri aiareuji, du tameartorae rema, tawo onare taiwuge etugo peagirido tabo.
source: Tagedu meriri aiareuji, du tameartorae rema, tawo onare taiwuge etugo peagirido tabo.

b: Umode taginorudowu tagao tadawu tugu tagaoto, tageragu Aroe Pemegareu utoriga bigoduji, dure Pao bataru rema.
source: Umode taginorudowu tagao tadawu tugu tagaoto, tageragu Aroe Pemegareu utoriga bigoduji, dure Pao bataru rema.

b: Tagogwa kurido tu tu jii je, boe enogwamagudae padui tu tu pumekeje du jamedu tabo Aroe Pemegareu ie tabo. Boecoji taedadudo tamagowo jii je ao pegoreuge eiamedu boe eparu tabo.
source: Tagogwa kurido tu tu jii je, boe enogwamagudae padui tu tu pumekeje du jamedu tabo Aroe Pemegareu ie tabo. Boecoji taedadudo tamagowo jii je ao pegoreuge eiamedu boe eparu tabo.

b: Tamagodo iparu tabo, du tabowo ikidare imagoi Bakaru Pemegareu o boe biareu pemegareuji.
source: Tamagodo iparu tabo, du tabowo ikidare imagoi Bakaru Pemegareu o boe biareu pemegareuji.

b:
Du bogaire irojaidodure, du koiare imedure oino baicoreu tada jamedu, imagowo ji boe eiamedu boe eegai, ipagudu bokwa tabo, iroiagudu reore.
Bapera ao.
source:
Du bogaire irojaidodure, du koiare imedure oino baicoreu tada jamedu, imagowo ji boe eiamedu boe eegai, ipagudu bokwa tabo, iroiagudu reore.
Bapera ao.

b: Pameardu kurire jiwu pawie Tíquico, duwure tugera braredo du pemegare ii Pagimejera koia, emare umode tawie inoba boere iiduji, inoba irore woe duji jamedu.
source: Pameardu kurire jiwu pawie Tíquico, duwure tugera braredo du pemegare ii Pagimejera koia, emare umode tawie inoba boere iiduji, inoba irore woe duji jamedu.

b: Nowu inodu boe koia ire utudo tawogai, du tabowo taerduware inaba boere cei woe, uwo tawabo jekaredo.
source: Nowu inodu boe koia ire utudo tawogai, du tabowo taerduware inaba boere cei woe, uwo tawabo jekaredo.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo eno boe pmegareu muguwo iwiemage ebo, boe emeardu kuriae, boe emeartorae muguwo ebo jamedu.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo eno boe pmegareu muguwo iwiemage ebo, boe emeardu kuriae, boe emeartorae muguwo ebo jamedu.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu jetuwo meardu kurire jii je Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jiwuge ebo.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu jetuwo meardu kurire jii je Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jiwuge ebo.

b: Imi, Paulo, imedui baicoreu tada Jesus Cristo bukeje, iwie Timóteo jamedu, cemeardu kurire jiwu, ierabrarere ceiwu Filemon awogai,
source: Imi, Paulo, imedui baicoreu tada Jesus Cristo bukeje, iwie Timóteo jamedu, cemeardu kurire jiwu, ierabrarere ceiwu Filemon awogai,

b: Paduie Apia bogai, pamaragodure apowu Arquipo bogai, Pao uwobe ei tudo pui awai kejedu bogai jamedu.
source: Paduie Apia bogai, pamaragodure apowu Arquipo bogai, Pao uwobe ei tudo pui awai kejedu bogai jamedu.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo eno boe pemegareu boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo eno boe pemegareu boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.

b: Iwiabuture awugeje imagoi Paoji du tabo, ire tukutaido ji jii je.
source: Iwiabuture awugeje imagoi Paoji du tabo, ire tukutaido ji jii je.

b: Paga karega, imeardure ameartoraeji, ameardu kurii Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jituji, meartorure jiwuge eiamedu jituji.
source: Paga karega, imeardure ameartoraeji, ameardu kurii Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jituji, meartorure jiwuge eiamedu jituji.

b: Inogwamagudu nure Paoji uwo ameartoraedo turugadu tuwo ado boe pa pagoroe jamedu boe ore Cristo rema.
source: Inogwamagudu nure Paoji uwo ameartoraedo turugadu tuwo ado boe pa pagoroe jamedu boe ore Cristo rema.

b: Iegare kuricigore nowu akogudui boe ebo du koia, paga karega, aki iwie, aigoia are pemegareuge ewabo butugugo kodi.
source: Iegare kuricigore nowu akogudui boe ebo du koia, paga karega, aki iwie, aigoia are pemegareuge ewabo butugugo kodi.

b: Iroiware iwo arodo aromode jiboeji, Jesus Cristo koia.
source: Iroiware iwo arodo aromode jiboeji, Jesus Cristo koia.

b: Mare itaidu pemegare inogwamaguduwo ai akoguduwo aiaguduwo tu je, imi Paulo, ipegagodui imidu tabo, imedui baicoreu tada du tabo.
source: Mare itaidu pemegare inogwamaguduwo ai akoguduwo aiaguduwo tu je, imi Paulo, ipegagodui imidu tabo, imedui baicoreu tada du tabo.

b: Inogwamagudu nure ai awu ire itonaregedudo baicoreu tadawu itonaregedu Onesimo paru tabo.
source: Inogwamagudu nure ai awu ire itonaregedudo baicoreu tadawu itonaregedu Onesimo paru tabo.

b: Marigudu boe karega ure ema akai, macare oino boe kurireu nure ema akai inai jamedu.
source: Marigudu boe karega ure ema akai, macare oino boe kurireu nure ema akai inai jamedu.

b: Imode utudo awogai pugeje nono iwaboie ure emadu kodiwore.
source: Imode utudo awogai pugeje nono iwaboie ure emadu kodiwore.

b: Itaiduia muguwo itabo taiwowo ii akarobi baicoreu tada bakaru pemegareu paru tabo.
source: Itaiduia muguwo itabo taiwowo ii akarobi baicoreu tada bakaru pemegareu paru tabo.

b: Mare imago kai ai du tabo, itaidukare irowo ia iro, duma aro pemegai iidu ukawo nono itaidu reore, mare akaidu reore.
source: Mare imago kai ai du tabo, itaidukare irowo ia iro, duma aro pemegai iidu ukawo nono itaidu reore, mare akaidu reore.

b: Boe jokodu ure turodo oino apiji ia kodiboe kodi mare makuduwo akai pugeje jii je du bogai.
source: Boe jokodu ure turodo oino apiji ia kodiboe kodi mare makuduwo akai pugeje jii je du bogai.

b: Mare atugarei ema du tabo pugeje karega, mare pawie ema du tabo. Imeardu kurire jiwu iwie nure ema, ameardu kurire jiwu awie remawu umode, mare boei pudumi du koia tu je karega, mare ema remawu meartorure Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jitu koia.
source: Mare atugarei ema du tabo pugeje karega, mare pawie ema du tabo. Imeardu kurire jiwu iwie nure ema, ameardu kurire jiwu awie remawu umode, mare boei pudumi du koia tu je karega, mare ema remawu meartorure Pagimejera Jesus Cristo jitu koia.

b: Amanamode imi pameartoru koia ma, akeragu ji amagai amode akeragu ii du reore.
source: Amanamode imi pameartoru koia ma, akeragu ji amagai amode akeragu ii du reore.

b: Marigudu ro pegare ai ma, iarema ukare iaboe morido akai ma, bu iwugeje.
source: Marigudu ro pegare ai ma, iarema ukare iaboe morido akai ma, bu iwugeje.

b: Imi, Paulo, inure awu bapera atugodo ikera tabo rugadu, imire imode morido akai, mare itaidukare awia jetuwo akie amode amorido inai duji.
source: Imi, Paulo, inure awu bapera atugodo ikera tabo rugadu, imire imode morido akai, mare itaidukare awia jetuwo akie amode amorido inai duji.

b: Iwie, itaidure awo awu iegareae maku inai, Pagimejera koia. Iwabo ro rakado Pagimejera keje.
source: Iwie, itaidure awo awu iegareae maku inai, Pagimejera koia. Iwabo ro rakado Pagimejera keje.

b: Imeartorure oinoie aromode duji, aromode nowu kori jamedu, du kodire ire bapera atugodo awu inoduji awogai.
source: Imeartorure oinoie aromode duji, aromode nowu kori jamedu, du kodire ire bapera atugodo awu inoduji awogai.

b: Nowu inodu boe tabo, tamode ia ipa pemegado, paga karega, ipagamode imaguduwo tagai pugeje, tamagoi iparu tabo du koia.
source: Nowu inodu boe tabo, tamode ia ipa pemegado, paga karega, ipagamode imaguduwo tagai pugeje, tamagoi iparu tabo du koia.

b: Epafras, mugure itabowu baicoreu tada Jesus Cristo koiadu, imadure tawogai.
source: Epafras, mugure itabowu baicoreu tada Jesus Cristo koiadu, imadure tawogai.

b: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas, Lucas, duwugere tugera braredo ii, eimadure tawogai jamedu.
source: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas, Lucas, duwugere tugera braredo ii, eimadure tawogai jamedu.

b: Pagimejera Jesus Cristo o boe pemegareu jetuwo tagaroe tabo.
source: Pagimejera Jesus Cristo o boe pemegareu jetuwo tagaroe tabo.

b: Bapera paru.
source: Bapera paru.

b: Imi, Paulo, mare Timóteo, Jesus Cristo utugarege, cenure awu bapera atugodo mugure Filipo bakurireu kejewu Jesus Cristo utugarege pemegareuge ewogai, bispodoge, diaconodoge ewogai jamedu.
source: Imi, Paulo, mare Timóteo, Jesus Cristo utugarege, cenure awu bapera atugodo mugure Filipo bakurireu kejewu Jesus Cristo utugarege pemegareuge ewogai, bispodoge, diaconodoge ewogai jamedu.

b: Pao Aroe Eimejera mare Pagimejera Jesus Cristo eno boe pemegareu, boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.
source: Pao Aroe Eimejera mare Pagimejera Jesus Cristo eno boe pemegareu, boe butugureu muguwo tagabo.

b: Iwiabutui tawugeje tu tu je du keje, ire tukutaido Paoji tu tu je.
source: Iwiabutui tawugeje tu tu je du keje, ire tukutaido Paoji tu tu je.

b: Imagoi tu tu baruto du keje, imago imagore tabaru tabo, iegare tabo.
source: Imagoi tu tu baruto du keje, imago imagore tabaru tabo, iegare tabo.

b: Tare tagera braredo ii jii boetojiwu meri piji jii oino Pao o Bakaru Maiwu uwo taodo boe etai du kodi.
source: Tare tagera braredo ii jii boetojiwu meri piji jii oino Pao o Bakaru Maiwu uwo taodo boe etai du kodi.

b: Iorduware cewu ure turo pemegareu paru tawuje tadodawu, umode pemegado jamedu, jii Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meri kae.
source: Iorduware cewu ure turo pemegareu paru tawuje tadodawu, umode pemegado jamedu, jii Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meri kae.

b: Ure turugadu imeardae pemegawo oinono taiameduji, inure tarego iwabo tada kodi, tare imedagedo tagi boe pemegareuji imugure baicoreu tada du keje kodi.
source: Ure turugadu imeardae pemegawo oinono taiameduji, inure tarego iwabo tada kodi, tare imedagedo tagi boe pemegareuji imugure baicoreu tada du keje kodi.

b: Pao jorduware inoba imeardu kurire tai Jesus Cristo okudu oiagudu tabo duji.
source: Pao jorduware inoba imeardu kurire tai Jesus Cristo okudu oiagudu tabo duji.

b: Inogwamagudui tabaru tabo du keje, imago imagore Paoji tameardu kuriae itoduwo jii je, taerduwa rakareu tabo, tamearduwa rakareu tabo.
source: Inogwamagudui tabaru tabo du keje, imago imagore Paoji tameardu kuriae itoduwo jii je, taerduwa rakareu tabo, tamearduwa rakareu tabo.

b: Du tabowo taerduware boe pemegareu remawuji ma, tawabo pemegawo, tawo tado tarugadu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meri kae.
source: Du tabowo taerduware boe pemegareu remawuji ma, tawabo pemegawo, tawo tado tarugadu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meri kae.

b:
Taro jetorowo Jesus Cristo koia, ma, boewo Pao ie kurido, boewo Pao akaru motudo.
Pao o Bakaru Maiwu Pemegareu ui towadudodu.
source:
Taro jetorowo Jesus Cristo koia, ma, boewo Pao ie kurido, boewo Pao akaru motudo.
Pao o Bakaru Maiwu Pemegareu ui towadudodu.

b: Itaidure taerduwawo ure tudo inaiboe jamedu boe uie turugadu tuwo Pao o Bakaru Maiwu utudo todobiji.
source: Itaidure taerduwawo ure tudo inaiboe jamedu boe uie turugadu tuwo Pao o Bakaru Maiwu utudo todobiji.

b: Awu Pretório kejewuge, iage eiamedu boe eerduware imugui baicoreu tada Cristo koia duji.
source: Awu Pretório kejewuge, iage eiamedu boe eerduware imugui baicoreu tada Cristo koia duji.

b: Awu imugui baicoreu tadadu koiare, pawobe emagaguragareuge enure tudurudo Cristo tada tumagowo Pao bataruji tubagudu bokwa tabo.
source: Awu imugui baicoreu tadadu koiare, pawobe emagaguragareuge enure tudurudo Cristo tada tumagowo Pao bataruji tubagudu bokwa tabo.

b: Boe jokodu, ia boe emagore Cristo jiboeji tugori tabo, tubegai pui du tabo, iagerema emagore ji tumeardae pemegareu tabo.
source: Boe jokodu, ia boe emagore Cristo jiboeji tugori tabo, tubegai pui du tabo, iagerema emagore ji tumeardae pemegareu tabo.

b: Awuge emagore ji toiagudu tabo, eerduware ienai iwo idurudo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareu jitu koia.
source: Awuge emagore ji toiagudu tabo, eerduware ienai iwo idurudo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareu jitu koia.

b: Nowugerema emagore Cristo jiboeji tuwo meartorureuge enogwacedo pubiji, emeardae jetorokare, emeardaere tuwo icebae itodudo imugui baicoreu tada du tabo.
source: Nowugerema emagore Cristo jiboeji tuwo meartorureuge enogwacedo pubiji, emeardae jetorokare, emeardaere tuwo icebae itodudo imugui baicoreu tada du tabo.

b: Mare imorora amagadukare. Cristo kogadodure eiamedu jabiji: meardae jetororeuge eiabiji, meardae jetorokareuge eiabiji, du ure iegaredo, umode iegaredo jii je rugadu.
source: Mare imorora amagadukare. Cristo kogadodure eiamedu jabiji: meardae jetororeuge eiabiji, meardae jetorokareuge eiabiji, du ure iegaredo, umode iegaredo jii je rugadu.

b: Iorduware awu jamedu boe pemegare ii iwo ikinorudo, tamago tamagore iparu tabo kodi, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Utaroe Pemegareu ure tugera braredo ii jamedu kodi.
source: Iorduware awu jamedu boe pemegare ii iwo ikinorudo, tamago tamagore iparu tabo kodi, Pagimejera Jesus Cristo Utaroe Pemegareu ure tugera braredo ii jamedu kodi.

b: Ipaga nure imodukare iwarigu boeto, mare awuji, boe jameduji, Cristo umode tugurido itada, iemode du keje, iarema iwimode du keje (iorduware awu inodu boe jokoduie duji).
source: Ipaga nure imodukare iwarigu boeto, mare awuji, boe jameduji, Cristo umode tugurido itada, iemode du keje, iarema iwimode du keje (iorduware awu inodu boe jokoduie duji).

b: Paga karega, iere, mare Cristo koia, iwimode mare iwo aidugiri rumode.
source: Paga karega, iere, mare Cristo koia, iwimode mare iwo aidugiri rumode.

b: Mare iemode iredu tada imaragodu pemegawo ma, iorduwakare kakodiwu jiba itaidu remawumode.
source: Mare iemode iredu tada imaragodu pemegawo ma, iorduwakare kakodiwu jiba itaidu remawumode.

b: Itaidure jiboe ure pobe: Itaidure ituwo imuguwo Cristo apo du pemegamode ii.
source: Itaidure jiboe ure pobe: Itaidure ituwo imuguwo Cristo apo du pemegamode ii.

b: Mare imuguwo woe ikodu tada, du ure turugadu tagai jamedu.
source: Mare imuguwo woe ikodu tada, du ure turugadu tagai jamedu.

b: Du kodire iorduware imugumode taiamedu apo kimo, boe pemegawo tai, taegarewo tameartoraeji.
source: Du kodire iorduware imugumode taiamedu apo kimo, boe pemegawo tai, taegarewo tameartoraeji.

b: Du kodire imode ikirimi tagae ma, taegaremode Jesus Cristoji pugeje.
source: Du kodire imode ikirimi tagae ma, taegaremode Jesus Cristoji pugeje.

b: Mare umode turugadu tawo tado nono Pagimejera Jesus Cristo o Bakaru Pemegareu ui taroiagudu reore. Ikodumode tagae, iarema ikodumodukare, mare itaidure imearduwo boe egoi tabewui puapo, tamaragodui puapo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareu jituji. Tabagudu kaba onare taiwugece rugadu.
source: Mare umode turugadu tawo tado nono Pagimejera Jesus Cristo o Bakaru Pemegareu ui taroiagudu reore. Ikodumode tagae, iarema ikodumodukare, mare itaidure imearduwo boe egoi tabewui puapo, tamaragodui puapo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareu jituji. Tabagudu kaba onare taiwugece rugadu.

b: Paga karega inodu umode ewogwado, mare tagi, umode taginorudo. Oinore Pao aidure.
source: Paga karega inodu umode ewogwado, mare tagi, umode taginorudo. Oinore Pao aidure.

b: Paga karega tagonagodure tameartorui Cristo jituji, mare tamearduwo tajebaeji Cristo koia jamedu duji.
source: Paga karega tagonagodure tameartorui Cristo jituji, mare tamearduwo tajebaeji Cristo koia jamedu duji.

b: Inoredure tabowu imaragodae mitodu tabore tagoredure tabo jamedu kodi.
source: Inoredure tabowu imaragodae mitodu tabore tagoredure tabo jamedu kodi.

b: Bakaru Maiwu ema remawu.
source: Bakaru Maiwu ema remawu.

b: Tagaidure tawo iegaredo Cristo tada, tagaidure tawo imeardu awadudo ii, tagaidure pameduiawo puje, tagogudure taiagudure itabo ma,
source: Tagaidure tawo iegaredo Cristo tada, tagaidure tawo imeardu awadudo ii, tagaidure pameduiawo puje, tagogudure taiagudure itabo ma,

b: Iegare kurido tameardu kurii pui du tabo. Tado tamidodudo tameardu kurii pui du tabo, tagaroedo mito tu je.
source: Iegare kurido tameardu kurii pui du tabo. Tado tamidodudo tameardu kurii pui du tabo, tagaroedo mito tu je.

b: Tarokaba ia taro tai tado mito mito du tabo, tagojaroi tai du tabo, mare tai tabiegado du tabo, tai tamedage ekodudo tagori du tabo.
source: Tarokaba ia taro tai tado mito mito du tabo, tagojaroi tai du tabo, mare tai tabiegado du tabo, tai tamedage ekodudo tagori du tabo.

b: Tawiapaga kaba tu tagaidure jiboeji, mare tamedage emeardaere jiboeji jamedu.
source: Tawiapaga kaba tu tagaidure jiboeji, mare tamedage emeardaere jiboeji jamedu.

b: Tado nono Cristore jiboeji.
source: Tado nono Cristore jiboeji.

b: Emare Aroe Eimejera rema, mare ocarokare pudui Aroe Eimejerai pudumi duji.
source: Emare Aroe Eimejera rema, mare ocarokare pudui Aroe Eimejerai pudumi duji.

b: Mare ure tuwiegado tui imedudo pudumi tui boe etugaredo pudumi du tabo.
source: Mare ure tuwiegado tui imedudo pudumi tui boe etugaredo pudumi du tabo.

b: Ure boe eerdudo imedui pudumi duji, ure tuwiegado pudui jii tui tumagu tuwidoduwo i padui pugajejedu keje du kae.
source: Ure boe eerdudo imedui pudumi duji, ure tuwiegado pudui jii tui tumagu tuwidoduwo i padui pugajejedu keje du kae.

b: Du kodire Pao okwa jerebarire apo boe jamedu boe kori, ure ie mugui boe eie jamedu boe aogejewu makai.
source: Du kodire Pao okwa jerebarire apo boe jamedu boe kori, ure ie mugui boe eie jamedu boe aogejewu makai.

b: Duma, boe eiamedu boe ere tubujodo Jesus ie otodai, baru tada, moto keje, joru tada jamedu.
source: Duma, boe eiamedu boe ere tubujodo Jesus ie otodai, baru tada, moto keje, joru tada jamedu.

b:
Duma, boe eiamedu boe egomode Jesus Cristoie tugimejera rema, du tabore Pao akaru kurimode.
Boei tudurudo tuwo tubemegadodu.
source:
Duma, boe eiamedu boe egomode Jesus Cristoie tugimejera rema, du tabore Pao akaru kurimode.
Boei tudurudo tuwo tubemegadodu.

b: Du kodire, imeardu kurire jiwuge tagi, meartorure Pao bataru jiwugere tagi, tamaragodudo tawo taginorudo du bogai, tabagudu tabo, taroi du du du je du tabo, mare iegai tu je karega, mare oino iiageje jamedu.
source: Du kodire, imeardu kurire jiwuge tagi, meartorure Pao bataru jiwugere tagi, tamaragodudo tawo taginorudo du bogai, tabagudu tabo, taroi du du du je du tabo, mare iegai tu je karega, mare oino iiageje jamedu.

b: Paga karega, Pao koiare ure tagaidudo, tarodo nono taidu reore kodi.
source: Paga karega, Pao koiare ure tagaidudo, tarodo nono taidu reore kodi.

b: Tamode boe jamedu boe towuje tamago pega kai du tabo, tabagudu bokwa tabo.
source: Tamode boe jamedu boe towuje tamago pega kai du tabo, tabagudu bokwa tabo.

b: Iaboe iaboe emago kawo tai, tameardae jetorogoduwo, Pao orewo tagi, iaboe iaboe pegareu jetu kawo tado, taedui ro pegareuge etada du tabo, taerugu jowo moto joki.
source: Iaboe iaboe emago kawo tai, tameardae jetorogoduwo, Pao orewo tagi, iaboe iaboe pegareu jetu kawo tado, taedui ro pegareuge etada du tabo, taerugu jowo moto joki.

b: Tanure bakaru jereu reko tagabo. Du inodu tabo, pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meri keje iegaremode iregodukai paga tu je duji.
source: Tanure bakaru jereu reko tagabo. Du inodu tabo, pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode kejewu meri keje iegaremode iregodukai paga tu je duji.

b: Iku umode ceredo tameartorui Pao jitu koia mode ma, iegarere, inure iie kurido tai.
source: Iku umode ceredo tameartorui Pao jitu koia mode ma, iegarere, inure iie kurido tai.

b: Tagi jamedu taegaredo, tagaidudo tai itabo.
source: Tagi jamedu taegaredo, tagaidudo tai itabo.

b: Ipagamode iwo Timóteo utudo toro tagae Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, iduruwo tagagaru aregodui iwogai du koia.
source: Ipagamode iwo Timóteo utudo toro tagae Pagimejera Jesus Cristo ie tabo, iduruwo tagagaru aregodui iwogai du koia.

b: Emare ure mito tu je itabo tumeardaewo tai.
source: Emare ure mito tu je itabo tumeardaewo tai.

b: Iage eiamedu eemarure taidure jiboe bogai, Mare Jesus Cristo aidure jiboe bogai karega.
source: Iage eiamedu eemarure taidure jiboe bogai, Mare Jesus Cristo aidure jiboe bogai karega.

b: Taerduware ro jetorogoduji, taerduware uie tumagu itabo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareu ai duji, tumagai itonaregedu reore.
source: Taerduware ro jetorogoduji, taerduware uie tumagu itabo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareu ai duji, tumagai itonaregedu reore.

b: Du kodire. ipagamode iwo utudo tagae, iordumode inoba boemode ii kuri je du keje.
source: Du kodire. ipagamode iwo utudo tagae, iordumode inoba boemode ii kuri je du keje.

b: Mare imeartorure Ikimijeraji imi jamedu ikodumode iorduwo tai kuri je jamedu.
source: Mare imeartorure Ikimijeraji imi jamedu ikodumode iorduwo tai kuri je jamedu.

b: Iordu pemegare jamedu iwo Epafrodito utudo tagae jamedu, du imeduia rema imaragodaeji, ieonare jiboeji, du tare utudo itae marigudu tuwo tugerabraredo ii akere ii boe keje.
source: Iordu pemegare jamedu iwo Epafrodito utudo tagae jamedu, du imeduia rema imaragodaeji, ieonare jiboeji, du tare utudo itae marigudu tuwo tugerabraredo ii akere ii boe keje.

b: Kiarigodure taiamedu boe bogai, morora amagadure taigoia, boere tawie tugogoduie ure du koia.
source: Kiarigodure taiamedu boe bogai, morora amagadure taigoia, boere tawie tugogoduie ure du koia.

b: Boe jokodu ure tuwiiagu tugogodae koia, mare Paore togududo apo. Mare apo tu je karega, itabo jamedu, ikiarigodae jokawo puwugeje du bogai.
source: Boe jokodu ure tuwiiagu tugogodae koia, mare Paore togududo apo. Mare apo tu je karega, itabo jamedu, ikiarigodae jokawo puwugeje du bogai.

b: Du kodire akere ii iwo utudo tagae, taegarewo taerdui ji pugeje duji, ikiarigodae butugugoduwo jamedu.
source: Du kodire akere ii iwo utudo tagae, taegarewo taerdui ji pugeje duji, ikiarigodae butugugoduwo jamedu.

b: Tageragu ji taegare tabo Paoji. Tagurido oinowu imei.
source: Tageragu ji taegare tabo Paoji. Tagurido oinowu imei.

b: Paga karega, Cristo ro koiare aregodure tuwimodedu kae, boce kodi ukare tumagu tuwiwo tuwo tugera braredo ii tagarobi.
source: Paga karega, Cristo ro koiare aregodure tuwimodedu kae, boce kodi ukare tumagu tuwiwo tuwo tugera braredo ii tagarobi.

b: Boewo tuiaedo jorduwa paga pagareuge epiji.
source: Boewo tuiaedo jorduwa paga pagareuge epiji.

b: Du keje icare, iwiemage, taegaredo Pagimejeraji. Ikare inogwa ra imago imagoi awu inoduji tai du piji, mare awu inodu pemegare tai.
source: Du keje icare, iwiemage, taegaredo Pagimejeraji. Ikare inogwa ra imago imagoi awu inoduji tai du piji, mare awu inodu pemegare tai.

b: Tameardu awadudo tai arigaodoge ereoreugei, maragodu pegareugei, nowu kruca padure tuwiri keje paga tu jewugei.
source: Tameardu awadudo tai arigaodoge ereoreugei, maragodu pegareugei, nowu kruca padure tuwiri keje paga tu jewugei.

b:
Paga karega, kruca padure kejewu remawugere cegi, cere Pao kurido, Pao Utaroe koia kodi, cere cegurido mare Cristo koia, cebaga kai boe ekodu jiboe bogai.
Paulore towujeboe Cristo aidu.
source:
Paga karega, kruca padure kejewu remawugere cegi, cere Pao kurido, Pao Utaroe koia kodi, cere cegurido mare Cristo koia, cebaga kai boe ekodu jiboe bogai.
Paulore towujeboe Cristo aidu.

b: Mare iiomode boe ekodu keje jamedu. Iaboe emeardaemode turowo oino du keje, imi kana iromodukare oino?
source: Mare iiomode boe ekodu keje jamedu. Iaboe emeardaemode turowo oino du keje, imi kana iromodukare oino?

b: Boe jokodu iwiri kadodure merire pagera awubodure mare pobe ma awu metuia bokware pagera awubowuto iwodu rekodaji, imire Israeldoge eno moto kejewure imi, Benjamim uwobe, Hebreudoge etonaregedu, hebreu nure imi jamedu, judeudoge eroia fariseu nure imi.
source: Boe jokodu iwiri kadodure merire pagera awubodure mare pobe ma awu metuia bokware pagera awubowuto iwodu rekodaji, imire Israeldoge eno moto kejewure imi, Benjamim uwobe, Hebreudoge etonaregedu, hebreu nure imi jamedu, judeudoge eroia fariseu nure imi.

b: Ipewui judeudoge eroiagudu jitu koiare itonare Igrejaji, iro irore nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore.
source: Ipewui judeudoge eroiagudu jitu koiare itonare Igrejaji, iro irore nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore.

b: Marigudu, awu iroi oinodu pemegare ii, mare iordui Cristo jitu keje, ire nowu inodu pijido.
source: Marigudu, awu iroi oinodu pemegare ii, mare iordui Cristo jitu keje, ire nowu inodu pijido.

b: Boe jokodu iordu pegare nowu inoduji, iorduwai Ikimejera Jesus Cristo jitu du keje. Du boe pemegareu remawu rema. Nowu jamedu boe ire pijido, ire udo nono barogo pere, duma Jesus Cristo makuduwo inai, imuguwo apo.
source: Boe jokodu iordu pegare nowu inoduji, iorduwai Ikimejera Jesus Cristo jitu du keje. Du boe pemegareu remawu rema. Nowu jamedu boe ire pijido, ire udo nono barogo pere, duma Jesus Cristo makuduwo inai, imuguwo apo.

b: Mare iroi nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore du koia karega, mare imeartorure Jesus Cristo jitu koia, itaidure Paowo ipemegado imeartorui jitu koia.
source: Mare iroi nono judeudoge eroiagudu reore du koia karega, mare imeartorure Jesus Cristo jitu koia, itaidure Paowo ipemegado imeartorui jitu koia.

b: Du inodu koiare iorduwamode Cristoji, iorduwamode duru aregodui tuiewodu piji duji jamedu. Iorduwamode ucebaeji. Uwo magai bire du reorere iwimode apo jamedu.
source: Du inodu koiare iorduwamode Cristoji, iorduwamode duru aregodui tuiewodu piji duji jamedu. Iorduwamode ucebaeji. Uwo magai bire du reorere iwimode apo jamedu.

b: Iwiapaga tabo, boe jokodumode du keje iewoduwo bireuge eewodu keje du bogai.
source: Iwiapaga tabo, boe jokodumode du keje iewoduwo bireuge eewodu keje du bogai.

b: Boe jokodu mori makudukare inai roga, mare iregodumode kimo, ipaga tabo mori makudumode inai du ogai. Paga karega, Cristore tugeragu ii kodi.
source: Boe jokodu mori makudukare inai roga, mare iregodumode kimo, ipaga tabo mori makudumode inai du ogai. Paga karega, Cristore tugeragu ii kodi.

b: Imeardaekare mori makudui inai marigudu duji, mare irore jiboe mitodu reo: Iwiagodure iro mariguduwu piji, ikodu nure gu itododai.
source: Imeardaekare mori makudui inai marigudu duji, mare irore jiboe mitodu reo: Iwiagodure iro mariguduwu piji, ikodu nure gu itododai.

b: Ikodumode itododai cewu ikodure kaeboe kae, nowu mori makuduwo inai, du Pao makoi iwogai Cristo tadadu rema.
source: Ikodumode itododai cewu ikodure kaeboe kae, nowu mori makuduwo inai, du Pao makoi iwogai Cristo tadadu rema.

b:
Du kodire, paiamedu boe, imei pagidu, pameardaemode oinono. Mare tameardaekare oinono du keje, Pao umode awadudo tagai jamedu.
Boe ekoduwo Paulo ro rekodajitu.
source:
Du kodire, paiamedu boe, imei pagidu, pameardaemode oinono. Mare tameardaekare oinono du keje, Pao umode awadudo tagai jamedu.
Boe ekoduwo Paulo ro rekodajitu.

b: Mare pagodure kejewo jamedu boe keje, pagoduwo pagododai pameardaei pu meardaeji du tabo.
source: Mare pagodure kejewo jamedu boe keje, pagoduwo pagododai pameardaei pu meardaeji du tabo.

b: Iwiemage, tarodo nono iro magadu reore, tagoe batodudo nowu rore nono cero reoreugei.
source: Iwiemage, tarodo nono iro magadu reore, tagoe batodudo nowu rore nono cero reoreugei.

b: Paga karega, makareuge etona nure Cristo o i padui pumekeje duji. Oinore imago imagore tai marigudu, oinorema, imago nure tai itoragudu tabo.
source: Paga karega, makareuge etona nure Cristo o i padui pumekeje duji. Oinore imago imagore tai marigudu, oinorema, imago nure tai itoragudu tabo.

b: Erumode tuwogwado, paga karega, tugurire to aroe eimejera rema, tojaraere tuboguru rema, ewiapagare tu awu moto kejeboeji.
source: Erumode tuwogwado, paga karega, tugurire to aroe eimejera rema, tojaraere tuboguru rema, ewiapagare tu awu moto kejeboeji.

b: Pagirema, baru tadawuge nure pagi: Pabagare ure paginorudowu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode baru piji du bogai.
source: Pagirema, baru tadawuge nure pagi: Pabagare ure paginorudowu Pagimejera Jesus Cristo aregodumode baru piji du bogai.

b: Umode awu pagodu pega boe udo nono tugodu urugu reore, emare roiware tuwo boe eiamedu boedo tubujodo pudui du koia.
source: Umode awu pagodu pega boe udo nono tugodu urugu reore, emare roiware tuwo boe eiamedu boedo tubujodo pudui du koia.

b: Boewo tudo pui Cristo tadadu.
source: Boewo tudo pui Cristo tadadu.

b: Du kodi icare, imeardu kurire jiwu, itaidure jiwu iwiemage, iegareae nure tagi, makudumode pemegareuge etaidu inodu nure tagi inai, tarodo oino taraga tabo Pagimejera ie tabo jii je.
source: Du kodi icare, imeardu kurire jiwu, itaidure jiwu iwiemage, iegareae nure tagi, makudumode pemegareuge etaidu inodu nure tagi inai, tarodo oino taraga tabo Pagimejera ie tabo jii je.

b: Inogwamagudu nure Evodiaji, Sintiqueji emugu butuguwo puapo Pao ie tabo.
source: Inogwamagudu nure Evodiaji, Sintiqueji emugu butuguwo puapo Pao ie tabo.

b: Aki jamedu, meardu kurire iiwu Sízigo, inogwamagudu nure ai awo akera braredo ei, paga karega, emage emaragodure itabo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareuji, Clemente apo, ia imedage ebo, du eie padure pemegareuge eie tabo.
source: Aki jamedu, meardu kurire iiwu Sízigo, inogwamagudu nure ai awo akera braredo ei, paga karega, emage emaragodure itabo Pao o Bakaru Pemegareuji, Clemente apo, ia imedage ebo, du eie padure pemegareuge eie tabo.

b: Taegaredo jii je Pagimejeraji. Du kodire inagoino tai pugeje: taegaredo.
source: Taegaredo jii je Pagimejeraji. Du kodire inagoino tai pugeje: taegaredo.

b: Boe eiamedu boe eerdudo tabemegaguragaji. Pagimejera puredugodu nure.
source: Boe eiamedu boe eerdudo tabemegaguragaji. Pagimejera puredugodu nure.

b: Tarokaba doi doi iaboeji iaboeji. Mare taro jamedu boe keje tamagodo Paoji tagaidure jiboe jamedu boeji, tagogwamagudui ji du tabo, tai tukutaido ji du tabo.
source: Tarokaba doi doi iaboeji iaboeji. Mare taro jamedu boe keje tamagodo Paoji tagaidure jiboe jamedu boeji, tagogwamagudui ji du tabo, tai tukutaido ji du tabo.

b: Pao o boe pemegareu kodui boe emeardae jamedu koriwu jetuwo tawaboji, tameardaeji, Jesus Cristo ie tabo.
source: Pao o boe pemegareu kodui boe emeardae jamedu koriwu jetuwo tawaboji, tameardaeji, Jesus Cristo ie tabo.

b: Icare, iwiemage, boe rikireu jamedu boe, boe pemegareu jamedu boe, boe jetororeu jamedu boe, iaboe iaboe kare jiboe jamedu boe, boe etaidu pemegare jiboe jamedu boe, akaru pemegareu jamedu boe, ure boe epemegadowu jamedu boe, boe enogwa jerebareae jamedu boe, jire tameardaemode.
source: Icare, iwiemage, boe rikireu jamedu boe, boe pemegareu jamedu boe, boe jetororeu jamedu boe, iaboe iaboe kare jiboe jamedu boe, boe etaidu pemegare jiboe jamedu boe, akaru pemegareu jamedu boe, ure boe epemegadowu jamedu boe, boe enogwa jerebareae jamedu boe, jire tameardaemode.

b:
Tarodo nono ire taerduwado jiboe jamedu boeji, ire maku tagaiboe jamedu boeji, imagore jiboe jamedu boeji, taerdure ii iroi jiboe jamedu boeji, tarodo ino jamedu ma, Pao o boe butugureu mugumode tagabo.
Ure tukutaido ei ere maku pudaiboeji.
source:
Tarodo nono ire taerduwado jiboe jamedu boeji, ire maku tagaiboe jamedu boeji, imagore jiboe jamedu boeji, taerdure ii iroi jiboe jamedu boeji, tarodo ino jamedu ma, Pao o boe butugureu mugumode tagabo.
Ure tukutaido ei ere maku pudaiboeji.

b: Iegare kuricigore Paoji, tameardu kurii iidu tudu pemegare kodi. Jii je tameardaere awu inoduji, mare boe aregodukare pudae roga tawo inodu awadudo.
source: Iegare kuricigore Paoji, tameardu kurii iidu tudu pemegare kodi. Jii je tameardaere awu inoduji, mare boe aregodukare pudae roga tawo inodu awadudo.
