b: Icare nowu aredu okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ikimejera, nowu akagoino jiwu ia pobo makinai, pobo boi kawo ii pugeje, itukawo mato iwo ikeragu awu poji pugeje.
source: Icare nowu aredu okwamagudure ji, akore: - Ikimejera, nowu akagoino jiwu ia pobo makinai, pobo boi kawo ii pugeje, itukawo mato iwo ikeragu awu poji pugeje.

b: Jesus akore ji: - Toro, amagodo akoredu bogai, akirimi mato.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Toro, amagodo akoredu bogai, akirimi mato.

b: Icare aredu akore ji: - Ikoge bokwa. Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe rugadu jire akagoino akoge bokwaie duji.
source: Icare aredu akore ji: - Ikoge bokwa. Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe rugadu jire akagoino akoge bokwaie duji.

b: Akogere ikera awubodure, awu mugure oino akabowu, akoredu karega, kodire amagore boe rikireuji. +Icare nowu aredu akore: - Cegimejera, icare iordure profetaie ure aki duji.
source: Akogere ikera awubodure, awu mugure oino akabowu, akoredu karega, kodire amagore boe rikireuji. +Icare nowu aredu akore: - Cegimejera, icare iordure profetaie ure aki duji.

b: Ceomage emagore Paoji awu torekodu aogeje, mare tagagore Jerusalém kejeie boe emagomode Paoji.
source: Ceomage emagore Paoji awu torekodu aogeje, mare tagagore Jerusalém kejeie boe emagomode Paoji.

b: Jesus akore: - Aredu, amearutorudo ii, boe puredugodu nure boe emago kawo Paoji ceboje, boe emago kawo ji awu torekodu aogeje, iarema Jerusalém keje du kae.
source: Jesus akore: - Aredu, amearutorudo ii, boe puredugodu nure boe emago kawo Paoji ceboje, boe emago kawo ji awu torekodu aogeje, iarema Jerusalém keje du kae.

b: Tare tabujodo cewu taerduwakare jiwuji, cere cebujodo ceerduware jiwuji; paga karega, Judéia kejewuge epijire umode boe einorudoboe aregodumode du kodi..
source: Tare tabujodo cewu taerduwakare jiwuji, cere cebujodo ceerduware jiwuji; paga karega, Judéia kejewuge epijire umode boe einorudoboe aregodumode du kodi..

b: Mare nowu kodiboe aregodumode, du aregodure, du kejewo upojó kigodureu ema remawuge emode tubujodo Paoji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada. Paga karega, Pao aidure nowu upujó kigodureuge ei.
source: Mare nowu kodiboe aregodumode, du aregodure, du kejewo upojó kigodureu ema remawuge emode tubujodo Paoji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada. Paga karega, Pao aidure nowu upujó kigodureuge ei.

b: Aroe nure Paoce, du kodi icare upujó kigodure jiwuge emode tubujodo ji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada.
source: Aroe nure Paoce, du kodi icare upujó kigodure jiwuge emode tubujodo ji tudaroe tada, boe rikireu tada.

b: Icare nowu aredu akore ji: - Iordiware Messias aregodumode duji (cewu iere Cristo cedu). Kode, aregodumode du keje, umode ceerduwado boe jamedu boeji.
source: Icare nowu aredu akore ji: - Iordiware Messias aregodumode duji (cewu iere Cristo cedu). Kode, aregodumode du keje, umode ceerduwado boe jamedu boeji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Cewu akagoino jiwu imi reo, du imire inagore oino imago tabo ai.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Cewu akagoino jiwu imi reo, du imire inagore oino imago tabo ai.

b: Nowu inodu tonaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaregodure, erore ta... tuiordui akoi tumago tabo ia aredu ji tuji. Mare ia emage egokare ji: - Kaba jiba anorare ji? Iarema: - Kaba jiba amagore ji? Inodukare. 28. Cewu aredu uture tubori piji nono, uture bakurireuto, makore nowu tadawu imei.
source: Nowu inodu tonaji, nowu ure jorduwadowuge etaregodure, erore ta... tuiordui akoi tumago tabo ia aredu ji tuji. Mare ia emage egokare ji: - Kaba jiba anorare ji? Iarema: - Kaba jiba amagore ji? Inodukare. 28. Cewu aredu uture tubori piji nono, uture bakurireuto, makore nowu tadawu imei.

b: Akore: - Mato taerduwo ia imeduji, du readodure iwiagai iro jamedu boeji. Cewu Cristo, ino jiwu, umodukana?
source: Akore: - Mato taerduwo ia imeduji, du readodure iwiagai iro jamedu boeji. Cewu Cristo, ino jiwu, umodukana?

b: Eture bakurireu piji Jesus ae.
source: Eture bakurireu piji Jesus ae.

b: Du inodu tada nowu ure jorduwadowuge enogwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, akogwagedo!
source: Du inodu tada nowu ure jorduwadowuge enogwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, akogwagedo!

b: Mare akore ei: - Ia ikere, mare taerduwakare ji.
source: Mare akore ei: - Ia ikere, mare taerduwakare ji.

b: Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge enorare jice woje pui, egore: - Ia boe kana ukerogu arego mato bogai?
source: Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge enorare jice woje pui, egore: - Ia boe kana ukerogu arego mato bogai?

b: Icare Jesus Akore ei: - Ikere iromode nono ure irojaiwu aidu reore du rema, iwo maragodae poru kororogo tu je du rema.
source: Icare Jesus Akore ei: - Ikere iromode nono ure irojaiwu aidu reore du rema, iwo maragodae poru kororogo tu je du rema.

b: Tagagokare arimoduie pobe puibiji du kejeie boe emode tugeragu boepa tadaboeji? Icá, kode inagomode oino tai: Tae aogado, tagaiwodo boepadogei: tadaboe kidu nure, ure turugadu kadoduwo.
source: Tagagokare arimoduie pobe puibiji du kejeie boe emode tugeragu boepa tadaboeji? Icá, kode inagomode oino tai: Tae aogado, tagaiwodo boepadogei: tadaboe kidu nure, ure turugadu kadoduwo.

b: Cewu ure boepa tadaboe kadowu mori makudumode ai, du umode boepa tadaboe to pui jere jii je boe kae.  Du tabore ure boe a tuguwu, ure kadowu, eegaremode puapo.
source: Cewu ure boepa tadaboe kadowu mori makudumode ai, du umode boepa tadaboe to pui jere jii je boe kae.  Du tabore ure boe a tuguwu, ure kadowu, eegaremode puapo.

b: Du ure nono boe egore: ure boe tuguwu ure tuginoi, ure kadowu ure tuginoi.
source: Du ure nono boe egore: ure boe tuguwu ure tuginoi, ure kadowu ure tuginoi.

b: Ire tarojai tawo boe kado iage emaragodure mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto.
source: Ire tarojai tawo boe kado iage emaragodure mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto mariguduwo keje; iage emaragodure, tare taremo emaragodaeto.

b: Nowu aredu bataru koiare makareu Samaria kejewuge emeartorure, cewu makoi ei du kodi: Makore ii iro jamedu boeji.
source: Nowu aredu bataru koiare makareu Samaria kejewuge emeartorure, cewu makoi ei du kodi: Makore ii iro jamedu boeji.

b: Du kodi icare Samaria kejewuge eture ae, enogwamagudure ji rakojewo pudabo. Kodi icare rakojere ebo meri pobe.
source: Du kodi icare Samaria kejewuge eture ae, enogwamagudure ji rakojewo pudabo. Kodi icare rakojere ebo meri pobe.

b: Kodi icare iage pugeje makareuge emeartorure ji makore ewiegai boe koia.
source: Kodi icare iage pugeje makareuge emeartorure ji makore ewiegai boe koia.

b:
Icare emago emagore nowu areduji: - Ica, mare awadaru koia karega cemeartorure, cegi rugadure cemeardure ji ceerduware moto inorudodu epaie ure ema duji.
Jesus ure ia brae eimejera kurireu utugare onaregedu pemegago.
source:
Icare emago emagore nowu areduji: - Ica, mare awadaru koia karega cemeartorure, cegi rugadure cemeardure ji ceerduware moto inorudodu epaie ure ema duji.
Jesus ure ia brae eimejera kurireu utugare onaregedu pemegago.

b: Meri pobe du keje, Jesus uture nowu piji Galiléia kae.
source: Meri pobe du keje, Jesus uture nowu piji Galiléia kae.

b: Ema mitodu akore marigudu, boe emeartorukae profetadogei eno moto keje.
source: Ema mitodu akore marigudu, boe emeartorukae profetadogei eno moto keje.

b: Du kodi icare, aregodui Galiléia kae du keje, nowu Galiléia kejewuge ere tugeragu ji tudada, mare paga karega, eerdure ro jamedu boeji toro Jerusalém tada, peta keje. Eturadu nowu peta kae jamedu du kodi.
source: Du kodi icare, aregodui Galiléia kae du keje, nowu Galiléia kejewuge ere tugeragu ji tudada, mare paga karega, eerdure ro jamedu boeji toro Jerusalém tada, peta keje. Eturadu nowu peta kae jamedu du kodi.

b: Ure tugirimi Galiléia tadawu Caná baboturogu kae, cewu ture parera kurudo pobo cewo kae. Nowu du kodi, brae eimejera kurireu ia utugare onaregedu kogodure, du rakojere Cafarnaum keje.
source: Ure tugirimi Galiléia tadawu Caná baboturogu kae, cewu ture parera kurudo pobo cewo kae. Nowu du kodi, brae eimejera kurireu ia utugare onaregedu kogodure, du rakojere Cafarnaum keje.

b: Nowu brae eimejera utugare tumeardui Jesus utui Jerusalém piji Galiléia kaedu jitu keje, uture ae, okwamagudure ji uwo tonaregedu pemegago puredugodure tuwiwo kodi.
source: Nowu brae eimejera utugare tumeardui Jesus utui Jerusalém piji Galiléia kaedu jitu keje, uture ae, okwamagudure ji uwo tonaregedu pemegago puredugodure tuwiwo kodi.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Taerdumodukare boe kodiboeji, boe ero kurireuji du keje, tameartorumodukare.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Taerdumodukare boe kodiboeji, boe ero kurireuji du keje, tameartorumodukare.

b: Mare nowu brae eimejera utugare okwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, arawuje toro, itonaegedu rogu bimodedu otodai.
source: Mare nowu brae eimejera utugare okwamagudure ji: - Cegimejera, arawuje toro, itonaegedu rogu bimodedu otodai.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Toro, akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu. Nowu imedu meartorure Jesus bataruji, uture taci je.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Toro, akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu. Nowu imedu meartorure Jesus bataruji, uture taci je.

b: Utugarege eridure togi awaraji, egore ji: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure.
source: Utugarege eridure togi awaraji, egore ji: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure.

b: Kodi icare unoragodure ei inobadu kejeba pemegagodure. Egore ji: - Jawuji, meri roi goroci je du keje biri uru ure tugera ra piji.
source: Kodi icare unoragodure ei inobadu kejeba pemegagodure. Egore ji: - Jawuji, meri roi goroci je du keje biri uru ure tugera ra piji.

b: Icare nowu uo ure boe pa Jesus akore: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu oino pudui du kejeie tonaregedu pemegagodure kuri je duji. Du kodi icare meartorure Paoji, nowu uwobe eiamedu boe emeartorure jamedu.
source: Icare nowu uo ure boe pa Jesus akore: - Akonaregedu pemegagodure marigudu oino pudui du kejeie tonaregedu pemegagodure kuri je duji. Du kodi icare meartorure Paoji, nowu uwobe eiamedu boe emeartorure jamedu.

b: Jesus ure awu turo kurireu towuje dure pobedu rema, tui tugirimi Judéia piji Galiléia kaedu rekodaji.
source: Jesus ure awu turo kurireu towuje dure pobedu rema, tui tugirimi Judéia piji Galiléia kaedu rekodaji.

b: Jesus ure ia pogora bireu imedu pemegago.
source: Jesus ure ia pogora bireu imedu pemegago.

b: Du keje icare judeudogere tuiagu ia peta towuje, du kodi icare Jesus ruture Jerusalém kae.
source: Du keje icare judeudogere tuiagu ia peta towuje, du kodi icare Jesus ruture Jerusalém kae.

b: Nono Jerusalém keje, ia pobo aia mugu puredure tu Ovelhadoge ewaiporoji, hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Betesda cedu, uwaiporodogere ikera awubodure.
source: Nono Jerusalém keje, ia pobo aia mugu puredure tu Ovelhadoge ewaiporoji, hebreudoge ewadaru tabo iere Betesda cedu, uwaiporodogere ikera awubodure.

b: Nowu baiporodoge ekuda, makareu kogodureuge emugure: joku bokwareuge, pogora pegareuge, pogora bireuge, tubaga tabo pobo amagadodumode du bogai.
source: Nowu baiporodoge ekuda, makareu kogodureuge emugure: joku bokwareuge, pogora pegareuge, pogora bireuge, tubaga tabo pobo amagadodumode du bogai.

b: Paga karega, ia kodiboe keje tu tu je Pao o tupa ure turawuje nowu pobo aia kae du kejere pobore tamagadudo. Cewu ure tuiodo ca boetoji nowu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu rekodajiwu, pemegagodure kuri, ia tugogodae boe piji.
source: Paga karega, ia kodiboe keje tu tu je Pao o tupa ure turawuje nowu pobo aia kae du kejere pobore tamagadudo. Cewu ure tuiodo ca boetoji nowu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu rekodajiwu, pemegagodure kuri, ia tugogodae boe piji.

b: Ia kogodureu imedu mugure nono, jorure ji nono ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure ikera awubodure pobe ma awu metuia bokware taci je du mugure nono. (38 anos).
source: Ia kogodureu imedu mugure nono, jorure ji nono ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure ikera awubodure pobe ma awu metuia bokware taci je du mugure nono. (38 anos).

b: Icare Jesus tuiordui padui nono, tuiorduwai mariguduie padure nonodu jitu keje, unorare ji: - Akaidure apemegagoduwo kuri je?
source: Icare Jesus tuiordui padui nono, tuiorduwai mariguduie padure nonodu jitu keje, unorare ji: - Akaidure apemegagoduwo kuri je?

b: Nowu kogodureu akore ji: -Ikimejera, ia ure iwu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu keje, boe bokwa, du kodire ikodu kimoi mai to du keje, iare marigudu ikoda piji.
source: Nowu kogodureu akore ji: -Ikimejera, ia ure iwu pobo aiato, pobo amagadu keje, boe bokwa, du kodire ikodu kimoi mai to du keje, iare marigudu ikoda piji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aragojedo, akeragu apaji, toro tabo.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Aragojedo, akeragu apaji, toro tabo.

b: Nowu inodu tonaji kuri je, nowu imedu pemegagodure, ure tugeragu tubaji, uture tabo. Aro kode, nowu meri sabadore jiwu meri.
source: Nowu inodu tonaji kuri je, nowu imedu pemegagodure, ure tugeragu tubaji, uture tabo. Aro kode, nowu meri sabadore jiwu meri.

b: Judeudoge rema emagore nowu imedu pemegagodureuji, egore: - Amodukare nowu apa rekodudo awu meriji.
source: Judeudoge rema emagore nowu imedu pemegagodureuji, egore: - Amodukare nowu apa rekodudo awu meriji.

b: Akore ei: - Cewu ure ipemegagowu akore ii: Akeragu apaji, amerudo.
source: Akore ei: - Cewu ure ipemegagowu akore ii: Akeragu apaji, amerudo.

b: Egore ji: - Kakoduwu ia imeduba akoino ai: Akeragu apaji, amerudo ino?
source: Egore ji: - Kakoduwu ia imeduba akoino ai: Akeragu apaji, amerudo ino?

b: Mare cewu pemegagodureu imedu jorduwakare iogudubaba, mare paga karega, Jesus ure tadawuje nowu boe makareuge eedui nonodu piji kodi.
source: Mare cewu pemegagodureu imedu jorduwakare iogudubaba, mare paga karega, Jesus ure tadawuje nowu boe makareuge eedui nonodu piji kodi.

b: Inodu rekodaji raka dugu je, Jesus jordure ji Pao uwai tada, akore ji: - Icare apemegagodure. Aro pega kaba pugeje, ia boe pegareu remawu ukawo ai pugeje du bogai.
source: Inodu rekodaji raka dugu je, Jesus jordure ji Pao uwai tada, akore ji: - Icare apemegagodure. Aro pega kaba pugeje, ia boe pegareu remawu ukawo ai pugeje du bogai.

b: Du keje icare nowu imedu readodure Jesus koiaie ure tubemegago duji.
source: Du keje icare nowu imedu readodure Jesus koiaie ure tubemegago duji.

b: Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etonare Jesusji, paga karega, ure awu turo kurireu towuje sabadore jiwu meri jitu koia.
source: Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etonare Jesusji, paga karega, ure awu turo kurireu towuje sabadore jiwu meri jitu koia.

b: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Ioga maragodure jii oino rugadu; imi jamedu, imaragodu nure jamedu.
source: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Ioga maragodure jii oino rugadu; imi jamedu, imaragodu nure jamedu.

b:
Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etagemo raka remawure tuwo bito, paga karega, ukare Sábado pegado tu rugadu, mare akore tuoie Pao rema; ica, nowu inodu tabo unure tudo nono Pao reore du koia.
Pao Onaregedu ro raka.
source:
Nowu inodu koia judeudoge etagemo raka remawure tuwo bito, paga karega, ukare Sábado pegado tu rugadu, mare akore tuoie Pao rema; ica, nowu inodu tabo unure tudo nono Pao reore du koia.
Pao Onaregedu ro raka.

b: Jesus akore pugeje: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Onaregedureboe tui mito tu jedu roiwakare iaboeji iaboeji. Romode tuiordure tuo rore jiboeji tu je. Tuo rore jiboe jamedu boeji, onaregedu romode ino jamedu.
source: Jesus akore pugeje: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Onaregedureboe tui mito tu jedu roiwakare iaboeji iaboeji. Romode tuiordure tuo rore jiboeji tu je. Tuo rore jiboe jamedu boeji, onaregedu romode ino jamedu.

b: Mare paga karega, Uo meardu kurire Tonaregeduji, ure jordudo turore jiboe jamedu boeji; umode jordudo ia turo kurireu remawuji kimo, duma taebogodu kuriwo.
source: Mare paga karega, Uo meardu kurire Tonaregeduji, ure jordudo turore jiboe jamedu boeji; umode jordudo ia turo kurireu remawuji kimo, duma taebogodu kuriwo.

b: Mare paga karega, Uo magai bireuge ewodudo, ure jereboe maku etai, du reorere Onaregedu umode jereboe maku taidure jiwuge etai jamedu.
source: Mare paga karega, Uo magai bireuge ewodudo, ure jereboe maku etai, du reorere Onaregedu umode jereboe maku taidure jiwuge etai jamedu.

b: Nowu inodu reorere, Uo umodukare tugogado iaboei iaboei, mare ure boei tugogadodu jamedu boe mugudo Tonaregedu apo.
source: Nowu inodu reorere, Uo umodukare tugogado iaboei iaboei, mare ure boei tugogadodu jamedu boe mugudo Tonaregedu apo.

b: Du tabowo boe emeartorumode Onaregeduji tumeartoru magai Uo jitu reore. cewu meartorukare Onaregedu jiwu, Uo koiare ure rojaidu, kode meartorukare Uoji jamedu.
source: Du tabowo boe emeartorumode Onaregeduji tumeartoru magai Uo jitu reore. cewu meartorukare Onaregedu jiwu, Uo koiare ure rojaidu, kode meartorukare Uoji jamedu.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Meardure iwadaru jiwu, meartorure ure irojaiwu jiwu, boe ewi bokwareu ure apo, utumodukare boe pegareuto, mare jepadure tuwi piji tuierewo kae.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Meardure iwadaru jiwu, meartorure ure irojaiwu jiwu, boe ewi bokwareu ure apo, utumodukare boe pegareuto, mare jepadure tuwi piji tuierewo kae.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Icare boe aregodumode pudae, puredugodu nure, icai bireuge emeardumode Pao mako jitu kae. Meardureuge eemode.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Icare boe aregodumode pudae, puredugodu nure, icai bireuge emeardumode Pao mako jitu kae. Meardureuge eemode.

b: Mare paga karega, nono Uo o magai jereboece tu taobiji, ure maku tonaregedu ai owo jereboece taobiji jamedu.
source: Mare paga karega, nono Uo o magai jereboece tu taobiji, ure maku tonaregedu ai owo jereboece taobiji jamedu.

b: Ure ro raka maku tonaregedu ai uwo tugogado boei, mare paga karega, Imedu Onareedu rema kodi.
source: Ure ro raka maku tonaregedu ai uwo tugogado boei, mare paga karega, Imedu Onareedu rema kodi.

b: Taro kaba ta... je awu inagoino jiboeji. Boe aregodumode du keje meture tuiao tadawuge eiamedu boe emeardumode Imedu Onaregedu makoji, emode tuiebu mako padui boe kajeje du kae.
source: Taro kaba ta... je awu inagoino jiboeji. Boe aregodumode du keje meture tuiao tadawuge eiamedu boe emeardumode Imedu Onaregedu makoji, emode tuiebu mako padui boe kajeje du kae.

b: Ro pemegareuge eewodumode tuiwo pemegareu kae. Ro pegareuge eewodumode mare tuiwo pega remawureu kae.
source: Ro pemegareuge eewodumode tuiwo pemegareu kae. Ro pegareuge eewodumode mare tuiwo pega remawureu kae.

b: Imi itaobiji ikare iaboe iaboe to. Imeardae tugudure imeardure jiboe reore. Itugure jiboe boe jokodu nure ema. Mare paga karega, iemarukare irowo nono itaidu reore, mare cewu ure irojaiwu aidu reore.
source: Imi itaobiji ikare iaboe iaboe to. Imeardae tugudure imeardure jiboe reore. Itugure jiboe boe jokodu nure ema. Mare paga karega, iemarukare irowo nono itaidu reore, mare cewu ure irojaiwu aidu reore.

b: Imagomode imi rugaduie iroino ma, imagoi oinodu umodukare turugadu.
source: Imagomode imi rugaduie iroino ma, imagoi oinodu umodukare turugadu.

b: Iare tagoi imi rugaduie iroino, iorduware cewu akoino boe jokodu rugaduie duji.
source: Iare tagoi imi rugaduie iroino, iorduware cewu akoino boe jokodu rugaduie duji.

b: Tare iaboe erojai João ae, makore boe jokoduji boe ewiegai.
source: Tare iaboe erojai João ae, makore boe jokoduji boe ewiegai.

b: Iomodukare iaboe iaboe ewugeje. Imagore oino, mare taginorudoduwo du bogaire inagoino.
source: Iomodukare iaboe iaboe ewugeje. Imagore oino, mare taginorudoduwo du bogaire inagoino.

b: Jorugu ja ururireu urugureu nure Joãoce. Tagire tagaidure taegarewo biegatu je nowu urugu tabo.
source: Jorugu ja ururireu urugureu nure Joãoce. Tagire tagaidure taegarewo biegatu je nowu urugu tabo.

b: Mare imirema ia iore kejewure du kodure João kori. Paga karega, Iogare iroiagudu jire iroino, du tabore boere boe pa Iogai irojai duji.
source: Mare imirema ia iore kejewure du kodure João kori. Paga karega, Iogare iroiagudu jire iroino, du tabore boere boe pa Iogai irojai duji.

b: Ioga, koiare ure irojaiwu, bataru jore iwugeje jamedu. Tagire tameardu kigodukare makoji, taerdu kigodukare jeji.
source: Ioga, koiare ure irojaiwu, bataru jore iwugeje jamedu. Tagire tameardu kigodukare makoji, taerdu kigodukare jeji.

b: Bataru metukare tawabo tada, tameartorukare cewu ure rojaiwu jitu kodi.
source: Bataru metukare tawabo tada, tameartorukare cewu ure rojaiwu jitu kodi.

b: Tare taeku tugu bapera atugoto, tadugu tado taerdumode boe ewi boekwareu jitu bogai. Kode ica, nowu bapera mitodure makore ii.
source: Tare taeku tugu bapera atugoto, tadugu tado taerdumode boe ewi boekwareu jitu bogai. Kode ica, nowu bapera mitodure makore ii.

b: Mare tagi tagaidukare taduwo itae, taewo du bogai.
source: Mare tagi tagaidukare taduwo itae, taewo du bogai.

b: Ipaga kare imewo inojorodo du bogai.
source: Ipaga kare imewo inojorodo du bogai.

b: Imire iorduware tai. Pao meardu kuriae metukare tadoda.
source: Imire iorduware tai. Pao meardu kuriae metukare tadoda.

b: Itaregodure Ioga ie tabo, mare tagare tageragu ii. Mare ia aregodumode cie tabo ma, tamode tageragu ji.
source: Itaregodure Ioga ie tabo, mare tagare tageragu ii. Mare ia aregodumode cie tabo ma, tamode tageragu ji.

b: Inobadu taboba tameartorumode? Tagi taemarure pui puwo tugurido du bogai, mare taemarukare tawo Pao Aroe Eimejera mitotu jewu akaru kurido du bogai.
source: Inobadu taboba tameartorumode? Tagi taemarure pui puwo tugurido du bogai, mare taemarukare tawo Pao Aroe Eimejera mitotu jewu akaru kurido du bogai.

b: Tadugu kaba imago pegamode tai Ioga biegai duji. Okirure taiboere Moisés rema, duwu kejere tare tabagaredu bu.
source: Tadugu kaba imago pegamode tai Ioga biegai duji. Okirure taiboere Moisés rema, duwu kejere tare tabagaredu bu.

b: Mare tameartorumode Moisesji ma, boe jokodu jire tameartorumode ii jamedu, ure bapera atugodo iiboe jitu kodi.
source: Mare tameartorumode Moisesji ma, boe jokodu jire tameartorumode ii jamedu, ure bapera atugodo iiboe jitu kodi.

b: Mare tameartorukare o bapera atugoji ma, kode, inoba taboba tameartorumode iwadaruji?
source: Mare tameartorukare o bapera atugoji ma, kode, inoba taboba tameartorumode iwadaruji?

b: Jesus ure boe makareuge enogwagedo.
source: Jesus ure boe makareuge enogwagedo.

b: Du keje icare Jesus ure pagado Galiléia kejewu kuruga bakowu kae (Tiberades kejewu kuruga).
source: Du keje icare Jesus ure pagado Galiléia kejewu kuruga bakowu kae (Tiberades kejewu kuruga).

b: Boe makareuge ekodure rekodaji, eerdure ro kurireui kogodureuge eidu jitu koia.
source: Boe makareuge ekodure rekodaji, eerdure ro kurireui kogodureuge eidu jitu koia.

b: Icare Jesus ruture ia torekodu ao kae; nono ure tumugudo ture jorduwadowuge ebo.
source: Icare Jesus ruture ia torekodu ao kae; nono ure tumugudo ture jorduwadowuge ebo.

b: Boe puredugodure judeudoge eno peta iei Páscoa cedu kae.
source: Boe puredugodure judeudoge eno peta iei Páscoa cedu kae.

b: Jesus ure tuie aogado nowu kodure pudaewu boe makareuge ei, akore Filipeji: - Kaiba pamode akirodo amireuji awuge eiamedu boe ewo kowuje?
source: Jesus ure tuie aogado nowu kodure pudaewu boe makareuge ei, akore Filipeji: - Kaiba pamode akirodo amireuji awuge eiamedu boe ewo kowuje?

b: Akore oinono tui turokagado ji du tabo, mare jorduware inoba turomode duji.
source: Akore oinono tui turokagado ji du tabo, mare jorduware inoba turomode duji.

b: Icare Filipe akore ji: - Diiero umode 200 ma, umodukare turugadu eiamedu boe ekewo ia koboroguce.
source: Icare Filipe akore ji: - Diiero umode 200 ma, umodukare turugadu eiamedu boe ekewo ia koboroguce.

b: Icare ia nowu ure jorduwadowuge, iere André cedu, Simão Pedro uwie, akore ji: -
source: Icare ia nowu ure jorduwadowuge, iere André cedu, Simão Pedro uwie, akore ji: -

b: Ia negedurogu rakojere woe, du o amireure ikera awubodure tu je, kare kugurere pobe tu je, mare inoba nowu inodu rogu umode awu boe emaga inodu ai?
source: Ia negedurogu rakojere woe, du o amireure ikera awubodure tu je, kare kugurere pobe tu je, mare inoba nowu inodu rogu umode awu boe emaga inodu ai?

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Edo tumugudo. Boekarema, boebutu kuricigore nono du imere cinco mil cedu ere tumugudo nono.
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Edo tumugudo. Boekarema, boebutu kuricigore nono du imere cinco mil cedu ere tumugudo nono.

b: Icare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amireu roguji, makore baruto keje, du kejere ure pedo nowu mugure nonowu boe etai. Du reorere rore cewu kare kugurei pobe tu jeduji, ure maku nowu boe etai etaidu reore.
source: Icare Jesus ure tugeragu nowu amireu roguji, makore baruto keje, du kejere ure pedo nowu mugure nonowu boe etai. Du reorere rore cewu kare kugurei pobe tu jeduji, ure maku nowu boe etai etaidu reore.

b: Icare ekuredure. Du kejere icare akore nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore: - Nowu kobo jetu onareu to pui, tawo jetu otorogado ma, ia okwa kawo.
source: Icare ekuredure. Du kejere icare akore nowu ture jorduwadowugei, akore: - Nowu kobo jetu onareu to pui, tawo jetu otorogado ma, ia okwa kawo.

b: Ere to pui. Ica, cewu iro amireu rogui ikera awubodure tu jedu kobo jetu kimoi tuiagejedu, eiamedu boe enogwage akedu rekodaji, ere kododoge ikera awubodure pobe taci ikare awubowutodu enogorobadudo tabo.
source: Ere to pui. Ica, cewu iro amireu rogui ikera awubodure tu jedu kobo jetu kimoi tuiagejedu, eiamedu boe enogwage akedu rekodaji, ere kododoge ikera awubodure pobe taci ikare awubowutodu enogorobadudo tabo.

b: Tuiordui nowu Jesus ro kurireu jitu keje, nowu boe egore: - Awure cewu aregodumode awu moto kaewu profeta remawu rema.
source: Tuiordui nowu Jesus ro kurireu jitu keje, nowu boe egore: - Awure cewu aregodumode awu moto kaewu profeta remawu rema.

b:
Icare Jesus tui boe pawuje ei tuiagu tugeragu pudui, tuwo boe eimejerado pudumi, du keje, ure tudawuje epiji pugeje tuginoigodu ia torekodu ao kae.
Jesus merui pobo ao jitu.
source:
Icare Jesus tui boe pawuje ei tuiagu tugeragu pudui, tuwo boe eimejerado pudumi, du keje, ure tudawuje epiji pugeje tuginoigodu ia torekodu ao kae.
Jesus merui pobo ao jitu.

b: Meri rekodure du tabore nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere turawuje kuruga kurireu jipa kae.
source: Meri rekodure du tabore nowu ure jorduwadowuge ere turawuje kuruga kurireu jipa kae.

b: Tui taredo ia ika kuireuto du keje, ere pagado nowu kuruga kurireu kajeje nowu Cafarnaum bakurireu kae. Icare boecodure Jesus aregodukai etae du keje.
source: Tui taredo ia ika kuireuto du keje, ere pagado nowu kuruga kurireu kajeje nowu Cafarnaum bakurireu kae. Icare boecodure Jesus aregodukai etae du keje.

b: Du tonajire icare pobo maereu amagadure, ia bakuru rakareu buture du koia.
source: Du tonajire icare pobo maereu amagadure, ia bakuru rakareu buture du koia.

b: Icare ere turaiga jodo keje jii je, du kejere icare ere boe pa Jesus ui tuburedo nowu ika kurireu jituji, tumerui pobo aoji du tabo. Du kejere icare epagudugodure.
source: Icare ere turaiga jodo keje jii je, du kejere icare ere boe pa Jesus ui tuburedo nowu ika kurireu jituji, tumerui pobo aoji du tabo. Du kejere icare epagudugodure.

b: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Imire iroino. Tabagudu kaba.
source: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Imire iroino. Tabagudu kaba.

b:
Etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji nowu ika kurireuto, mare ika aregodure kuri taregodumodewo kae. 
Boe eemarui Jesus bogaidu.
source:
Etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji nowu ika kurireuto, mare ika aregodure kuri taregodumodewo kae. 
Boe eemarui Jesus bogaidu.

b: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, jeture bakowu kejewu boe makareuge ere boe pa Jesus mitotu jedu ukai taredo nowu ika kurireuto nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo, mare awuge etuie tuginoiduji.
source: Nowu meri rekodajiwu meriji, jeture bakowu kejewu boe makareuge ere boe pa Jesus mitotu jedu ukai taredo nowu ika kurireuto nowu ture jorduwadowuge ebo, mare awuge etuie tuginoiduji.

b: Icare ia ika kurireuge etaregodure Tiberade bakurireu piji, puredu tu cewu enogwagere amireuji, cewu Pagimejerare tuwadaru pemegareu bu keje du kae.
source: Icare ia ika kurireuge etaregodure Tiberade bakurireu piji, puredu tu cewu enogwagere amireuji, cewu Pagimejerare tuwadaru pemegareu bu keje du kae.

b:
Du karega icare, nowu boe makareuge tui boe pa Jesus mare ure jorduwadowuge edukai nonoduji, du koiare icare ere taredo nowu ika kurireuge eto, kodure tai Cafarnaum kae tuiemaru tabo bogai.
Ure boe eedowu boe eke Jesus rema.
source:
Du karega icare, nowu boe makareuge tui boe pa Jesus mare ure jorduwadowuge edukai nonoduji, du koiare icare ere taredo nowu ika kurireuge eto, kodure tai Cafarnaum kae tuiemaru tabo bogai.
Ure boe eedowu boe eke Jesus rema.

b: Eerdure ji nowu bakowu keje, icare egore ji: - Cegimejera, inoba boere du kejeba akaregodure woe?
source: Eerdure ji nowu bakowu keje, icare egore ji: - Cegimejera, inoba boere du kejeba akaregodure woe?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: taemarure iwogai mare taerdure cewu iro kurireu jitu koia, tare amireu kowuje, tagoredure tabo du koia.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: taemarure iwogai mare taerdure cewu iro kurireu jitu koia, tare amireu kowuje, tagoredure tabo du koia.

b: Tamaragodudo, mare boe eke akedure kuri jewu koia karega, mare ure boe eedo jii boe ewi bokwareu kaewu boe eke koia, du Imedu Onaregedu umode maku tagai. Paga karega, Uore to kruca bu keje kodi.
source: Tamaragodudo, mare boe eke akedure kuri jewu koia karega, mare ure boe eedo jii boe ewi bokwareu kaewu boe eke koia, du Imedu Onaregedu umode maku tagai. Paga karega, Uore to kruca bu keje kodi.

b: Icare enoragodure ji: - Inoba ceromode cerowo nono Pao aidu reore.
source: Icare enoragodure ji: - Inoba ceromode cerowo nono Pao aidu reore.

b: Jesus akore ei: - Pao aidure jiboe reo: Tameartoruwo cewu ure rojaiwuji.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Pao aidure jiboe reo: Tameartoruwo cewu ure rojaiwuji.

b: Icare enoragodure ji: - Kakoduwu aro kurireumodedu jiba ceerdumode du koiawo cemeartorumode ai? Kaboba amode towuje?
source: Icare enoragodure ji: - Kakoduwu aro kurireumodedu jiba ceerdumode du koiawo cemeartorumode ai? Kaboba amode towuje?

b: Ica, ceomagere maná kowuje toro boe makodu tada, nono bapera atugo reore: “Aregodure baru pijiwu amireu ure maku etai enogwagewo ji“ (Sl 77,24).
source: Ica, ceomagere maná kowuje toro boe makodu tada, nono bapera atugo reore: “Aregodure baru pijiwu amireu ure maku etai enogwagewo ji“ (Sl 77,24).

b:
Icare Jesus akore ei:-
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Moisés ukare baru pijiwu amireu maku tagai, mare Ioga koiare ure baru pijiwu boe jokoduwu remawu amireu maku tagai.
source:
Icare Jesus akore ei:-
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Moisés ukare baru pijiwu amireu maku tagai, mare Ioga koiare ure baru pijiwu boe jokoduwu remawu amireu maku tagai.

b: Paga karega, Pao o amireu, cewu ure turawuje baru pijiwu amireu rema, koiare ure awu moto keje boe eedo.
source: Paga karega, Pao o amireu, cewu ure turawuje baru pijiwu amireu rema, koiare ure awu moto keje boe eedo.

b: Icare egore ji: - Cegimejera, nowu amireu maku jii je cenai.
source: Icare egore ji: - Cegimejera, nowu amireu maku jii je cenai.

b: Jesus akore ei: - Imire ure boe eedowu amireure imi. Cewu utumode itaewu uke boimodukare pudui jii pugeje, cewu meartorure iiwu, pobo boimodukare ji jii je pugeje.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Imire ure boe eedowu amireure imi. Cewu utumode itaewu uke boimodukare pudui jii pugeje, cewu meartorure iiwu, pobo boimodukare ji jii je pugeje.

b: Mare imagomode tai: taerdure ii mare tameartorukare ii.
source: Mare imagomode tai: taerdure ii mare tameartorukare ii.

b: Cewu Iogare maku inai boe jamedu boe utumode itae, cewu utumode itaewu imodukare barigu.
source: Cewu Iogare maku inai boe jamedu boe utumode itae, cewu utumode itaewu imodukare barigu.

b: Paga karega, ire irawuje baru piji, mare irowo nono itaidu reore karega, mare irowo nono ure irojaiwu aidu reore.
source: Paga karega, ire irawuje baru piji, mare irowo nono itaidu reore karega, mare irowo nono ure irojaiwu aidu reore.

b: Mare cewu ure irojaiwu aidure jiboe reo: ikaiagu cewu ture maku inaiboe ia rogu okwadodudo, mare iiagu jewodudo boigoduwu meriji.
source: Mare cewu ure irojaiwu aidure jiboe reo: ikaiagu cewu ture maku inaiboe ia rogu okwadodudo, mare iiagu jewodudo boigoduwu meriji.

b: U! Oinore Ioga aidure. Cewu jordure Onaregeduji, meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe, boe ewi bokwareuwo etai; imode eewodudo boigoduwu meriji.
source: U! Oinore Ioga aidure. Cewu jordure Onaregeduji, meartorure jiwuge eiamedu boe, boe ewi bokwareuwo etai; imode eewodudo boigoduwu meriji.

b: Du kodi icare judeudoge ewadaru pega kuricigore ji, awu akoinodu koia: - Imire amireu aregodui baru piji dure imi.
source: Du kodi icare judeudoge ewadaru pega kuricigore ji, awu akoinodu koia: - Imire amireu aregodui baru piji dure imi.

b: Egore: - Iarema cewu Jesus kanao? Kode, kodiba icare akore. Ire irawuje baru piji oino?
source: Egore: - Iarema cewu Jesus kanao? Kode, kodiba icare akore. Ire irawuje baru piji oino?

b: Jesus akore: - Tawadaru pega kaba tadoda.
source: Jesus akore: - Tawadaru pega kaba tadoda.

b: Iaboe iaboe etumodukare itae, ure irojaiwu Ioga ukai utudo itae du keje. Duwuge imode eewodudo boigoduwu meriji.
source: Iaboe iaboe etumodukare itae, ure irojaiwu Ioga ukai utudo itae du keje. Duwuge imode eewodudo boigoduwu meriji.

b: Profetadogere inodu bu bapera keje: “Eiamedu boe jorduwadodumode Pao Aroe Eimejera koia” (Is 54,13). Du kodire cewu meardure Pao bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe, jorduwadodure Pao koiawuge eiamedu boe, etumode itae.
source: Profetadogere inodu bu bapera keje: “Eiamedu boe jorduwadodumode Pao Aroe Eimejera koia” (Is 54,13). Du kodire cewu meardure Pao bataru jiwuge eiamedu boe, jorduwadodure Pao koiawuge eiamedu boe, etumode itae.

b: Mare boe eerdukarega ure Paoji kodi karega, mare cewu aregodure Pao pijiwu jordure tu Paoji.
source: Mare boe eerdukarega ure Paoji kodi karega, mare cewu aregodure Pao pijiwu jordure tu Paoji.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: meartorure iiwuge eiamedu boe, ewi bokwareu makodure etai.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: meartorure iiwuge eiamedu boe, ewi bokwareu makodure etai.

b: Boe eedoduwowu amireu imireo.
source: Boe eedoduwowu amireu imireo.

b: Taomage enogwagere manaji boe makodu tada, mare ewire.
source: Taomage enogwagere manaji boe makodu tada, mare ewire.

b: Ure turawuje baru pijiwu amireu awureo, umode kowujewuge eiamedu boe ewi kawo.
source: Ure turawuje baru pijiwu amireu awureo, umode kowujewuge eiamedu boe ewi kawo.

b: Aregodure baru pijiwu amireu jereu imireo. Umode awu amireu kowujewuge eemaemode jii je. Imode makuwu amireu ikodu rema, awu moto kejewuge einorudoduwo.
source: Aregodure baru pijiwu amireu jereu imireo. Umode awu amireu kowujewuge eemaemode jii je. Imode makuwu amireu ikodu rema, awu moto kejewuge einorudoduwo.

b: Awu bataru keje, judeudoge enorare jice woje, jice woje pui: - Inoba awu imedu romode tuwo pagogwagedo tugoduji?
source: Awu bataru keje, judeudoge enorare jice woje, jice woje pui: - Inoba awu imedu romode tuwo pagogwagedo tugoduji?

b: Kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomde oino tai: Tamodukare Imedu Onaregedu kodu kowuje, tagudumodukare kuce ma, taemodukare tadoda.
source: Kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomde oino tai: Tamodukare Imedu Onaregedu kodu kowuje, tagudumodukare kuce ma, taemodukare tadoda.

b: Cewu ure ikodu kowujewu, kudure iku cewuge eiamedu boe jemaere jii jeboe jetu nure ebo. Imode eewodudo boigoduwu meriji.
source: Cewu ure ikodu kowujewu, kudure iku cewuge eiamedu boe jemaere jii jeboe jetu nure ebo. Imode eewodudo boigoduwu meriji.

b: Paga karega, boe eke jokoduwure ikodu rema, boe ekudure ceboe jokodu remawureu iku rema.
source: Paga karega, boe eke jokoduwure ikodu rema, boe ekudure ceboe jokodu remawureu iku rema.

b: Cewu okwagere ikodu jiwuge, kudure iku cewuge eiamedu boe, emedure itada, imedure etada jamedu.
source: Cewu okwagere ikodu jiwuge, kudure iku cewuge eiamedu boe, emedure itada, imedure etada jamedu.

b: Ure irojaiwu Ioga jemagadu reorere, iere koia jamedu, du reorere ure ikowujewu jemode igoia jamedu.
source: Ure irojaiwu Ioga jemagadu reorere, iere koia jamedu, du reorere ure ikowujewu jemode igoia jamedu.

b: Awure ure turawuje baru pijiwu amireu rema. Cewu taomagere kowujewu maná inodu karega, ere kowuje mare ewire, du inodu karega. Umode awu amireu kowujewu jemode jii je.
source: Awure ure turawuje baru pijiwu amireu rema. Cewu taomagere kowujewu maná inodu karega, ere kowuje mare ewire, du inodu karega. Umode awu amireu kowujewu jemode jii je.

b: Awu inodu jire Jesus ure boe eerduwado sinagoga tada, Cafarnaum bakurireu keje.
source: Awu inodu jire Jesus ure boe eerduwado sinagoga tada, Cafarnaum bakurireu keje.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge ia makareuge, tumeardui ji tu keje, egore: - Nowu inodu raka remawu nure. Ioguduba aidumode nowu inoduji?
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge ia makareuge, tumeardui ji tu keje, egore: - Nowu inodu raka remawu nure. Ioguduba aidumode nowu inoduji?

b: Jesus jorduware nowu ture jorduwadowuge ekorigodui nowu inodu koia duji, icare unoragodure ei: - Nowu inodu jetu pegare tai.
source: Jesus jorduware nowu ture jorduwadowuge ekorigodui nowu inodu koia duji, icare unoragodure ei: - Nowu inodu jetu pegare tai.

b: Kode, inoba umode taerdumode Imedu Onaregedu rutui turagojere kejewu turagoja kae du keje?
source: Kode, inoba umode taerdumode Imedu Onaregedu rutui turagojere kejewu turagoja kae du keje?

b: Aroe koiare ure boe eedo, boe karega boe ekodu rema. Imagore tai jiwu iwadaru emare aroe rema, boe eereu rema.
source: Aroe koiare ure boe eedo, boe karega boe ekodu rema. Imagore tai jiwu iwadaru emare aroe rema, boe eereu rema.

b: Mare ia tagi tameartorukare. Mare paga karega, kuri boe paruto Jesus jorduware kakoduwuba emeartoru bokware duji, cewu umode tumaguwuji jamedu.
source: Mare ia tagi tameartorukare. Mare paga karega, kuri boe paruto Jesus jorduware kakoduwuba emeartoru bokware duji, cewu umode tumaguwuji jamedu.

b: Makore kimo pugeje, akore: - Du kodire inagore iaboe iaboe etumodukae itae Ioga aiduka du keje.
source: Makore kimo pugeje, akore: - Du kodire inagore iaboe iaboe etumodukae itae Ioga aiduka du keje.

b: Kuri je nowu kodiwu piji makareu ia ure jorduwadowuge ere tuiaedo ji, du emerukare apo pugeje.
source: Kuri je nowu kodiwu piji makareu ia ure jorduwadowuge ere tuiaedo ji, du emerukare apo pugeje.

b: Du kodi icare Jesus unoragodure nuwu ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwureko towugei, akore ei: -Tagi jamedu tagaidure tawo taiaedo ii jamedu?
source: Du kodi icare Jesus unoragodure nuwu ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwureko towugei, akore ei: -Tagi jamedu tagaidure tawo taiaedo ii jamedu?

b: Icare Simão Pedro akore ji: - Cegimejera, kode ioguduba ae cedumode? Boe ewi bokwareure awadaru rema.
source: Icare Simão Pedro akore ji: - Cegimejera, kode ioguduba ae cedumode? Boe ewi bokwareure awadaru rema.

b: Cegi cemeartorure, ceerduware akie Pao Aroe Eimejera o Imedu Pemegareuie akiduji.
source: Cegi cemeartorure, ceerduware akie Pao Aroe Eimejera o Imedu Pemegareuie akiduji.

b: Jesus akore pugeje: - Ikare tado ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwureko todu ire tadawuje tamedage epiji? Mare Aroe pegareure ia tagi kodi karega .
source: Jesus akore pugeje: - Ikare tado ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwureko todu ire tadawuje tamedage epiji? Mare Aroe pegareure ia tagi kodi karega .

b: Judas Iscariote jire akoino, cewu Simão Iscariote onaregedu, emare umode maku kodi. Ica, nowu ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwureko todu ia nure ema kodi karega.
source: Judas Iscariote jire akoino, cewu Simão Iscariote onaregedu, emare umode maku kodi. Ica, nowu ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwureko todu ia nure ema kodi karega.

b: Jesus mare uwiemage.
source: Jesus mare uwiemage.

b: Nowu inodu rekodaji, Jesus kodure jice woje, jice woje Galiléia kao, aidukare tumeruwo Judéia keje, judeudoge ere tuiagu bito du koia.
source: Nowu inodu rekodaji, Jesus kodure jice woje, jice woje Galiléia kao, aidukare tumeruwo Judéia keje, judeudoge ere tuiagu bito du koia.

b: Judeudoge eno peta puredugodu nure du iere Tabernáculos (boe ewadaru ure oino: Aroia baidoge jiwu peta).
source: Judeudoge eno peta puredugodu nure du iere Tabernáculos (boe ewadaru ure oino: Aroia baidoge jiwu peta).

b: Icare Jesus uwiemage eegore ji: - Atudo awu piji Judéia kae, nowu are jorduwadowuge eerduwo aro boeji.
source: Icare Jesus uwiemage eegore ji: - Atudo awu piji Judéia kae, nowu are jorduwadowuge eerduwo aro boeji.

b: Paga karega, cewu aidure boe eerduwawo puduiwu rokare ia turo jiboe podu tu je. Kode arore oino du kodi, akowadudo awu moto kejewuge eegai.
source: Paga karega, cewu aidure boe eerduwawo puduiwu rokare ia turo jiboe podu tu je. Kode arore oino du kodi, akowadudo awu moto kejewuge eegai.

b: Mare uwiemage emeartorukare ji jamedu.
source: Mare uwiemage emeartorukare ji jamedu.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Boe aregodukare pudae ii roga. Mare tagairema boere turugadu tu tu tagai boe jameduji.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Boe aregodukare pudae ii roga. Mare tagairema boere turugadu tu tu tagai boe jameduji.

b: Awu moto kodu kagirimodukare tai, mare iire kodu kagirire, imire ireadodure ro pegareuji kodi.
source: Awu moto kodu kagirimodukare tai, mare iire kodu kagirire, imire ireadodure ro pegareuji kodi.

b: Toro, taru toro peta kae, mare imirema, ikodumodukare, boe aregodukare pudae ii roga kodi.
source: Toro, taru toro peta kae, mare imirema, ikodumodukare, boe aregodukare pudae ii roga kodi.

b:
Tagoi oino du keje, rakojere Galiléia keje.
Jesus rutui Aroiabaidoge eiwu peta kaedu.
source:
Tagoi oino du keje, rakojere Galiléia keje.
Jesus rutui Aroiabaidoge eiwu peta kaedu.

b: Mare uwiemage erudui toro du keje, ruture jamedu nowu peta kae, mare tui boe eerdudo pudui du tabo karega, mare podu tabo.
source: Mare uwiemage erudui toro du keje, ruture jamedu nowu peta kae, mare tui boe eerdudo pudui du tabo karega, mare podu tabo.

b: Judeudoge eemarure bogai nowu peta keje; enorare bogai, egore: - Kaiba rakojere?
source: Judeudoge eemarure bogai nowu peta keje; enorare bogai, egore: - Kaiba rakojere?

b: Nowu boe makareuge etada boe emago nure tu ji rugadu. Iage egore: - Imedu pemegareu reno. Du kejewuge egore: - Boro, ukare ino, ure boe eekuri pagado.
source: Nowu boe makareuge etada boe emago nure tu ji rugadu. Iage egore: - Imedu pemegareu reno. Du kejewuge egore: - Boro, ukare ino, ure boe eekuri pagado.

b: Mare du inodu tabo, boe emago awadukare ji, tubagudu koia judeudogece.
source: Mare du inodu tabo, boe emago awadukare ji, tubagudu koia judeudogece.

b: Nowu peta oia bukejere icare Jesus ruture Pao uwaito tui boe eerduwado du tabo.
source: Nowu peta oia bukejere icare Jesus ruture Pao uwaito tui boe eerduwado du tabo.

b: Judeudoge erore ta... je, egore: - Awu imedu jorduwadodukare. Kode, kaiba awu jorduware bapera atugo jitu aregodure?
source: Judeudoge erore ta... je, egore: - Awu imedu jorduwadodukare. Kode, kaiba awu jorduware bapera atugo jitu aregodure?

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Awu iorduware oino jiboe, inoe karega, mare ure irojaiwu oe.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Awu iorduware oino jiboe, inoe karega, mare ure irojaiwu oe.

b: Iaboe etaidumode turowo nono Pao aidu reore ma, eerduwamode imagore jiboe aregoduie Pao piji duji, iarema ipijie aregodure duji.
source: Iaboe etaidumode turowo nono Pao aidu reore ma, eerduwamode imagore jiboe aregoduie Pao piji duji, iarema ipijie aregodure duji.

b: Makore taobijiwu jemaru nure tuguriwo boe eegai du bogai, mare cewu jemarure tuwo ure rojaiwu kurido du bogaiwu, ure turugadu boe emeartoruwo ji, boe ekuri pagadodureu ukare apo.
source: Makore taobijiwu jemaru nure tuguriwo boe eegai du bogai, mare cewu jemarure tuwo ure rojaiwu kurido du bogaiwu, ure turugadu boe emeartoruwo ji, boe ekuri pagadodureu ukare apo.

b: Kode, Moisés koia karega ure boe eroiagudu maku tagai? Du inodu tabo ia tagi ia tagi tagodukare ui boe eroiaguduji.
source: Kode, Moisés koia karega ure boe eroiagudu maku tagai? Du inodu tabo ia tagi ia tagi tagodukare ui boe eroiaguduji.

b: Kodiba tagaidre tawo iwido?  Nowu boe egore ji: - Ia Aroe pegareu mugure akabo! Ioguduba aidure tuwo awido?
source: Kodiba tagaidre tawo iwido?  Nowu boe egore ji: - Ia Aroe pegareu mugure akabo! Ioguduba aidure tuwo awido?

b: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Ia irore jiboere mito tu je. Ica, taiamedu boe jordu pegare inoduji.
source: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Ia irore jiboere mito tu je. Ica, taiamedu boe jordu pegare inoduji.

b: Moisés ure kruca maku tagai (mare Moisés oe karega, mare uomage kurireuge enoe), tare kruca bu boe ewugeje jii sabadore jiwu meriji jamedu.
source: Moisés ure kruca maku tagai (mare Moisés oe karega, mare uomage kurireuge enoe), tare kruca bu boe ewugeje jii sabadore jiwu meriji jamedu.

b: Aró, kode, Moisésre boe eroiagudu kadodu kawore kruca padumode ia imedu keje sabadore jiwu meriji ma, kode, kodiba tagorigodure ii ire ia imedu uredu jamedu boe pemegago sabadore jiwu meriji du koia?
source: Aró, kode, Moisésre boe eroiagudu kadodu kawore kruca padumode ia imedu keje sabadore jiwu meriji ma, kode, kodiba tagorigodure ii ire ia imedu uredu jamedu boe pemegago sabadore jiwu meriji du koia?

b:
Tadugu kaba ure tudo boe eegaiboe rekodaji, mare tadugudo boe jetororeu rekodaji tu rugadu.
Judeudoge emeardaei Jesus jitu.
source:
Tadugu kaba ure tudo boe eegaiboe rekodaji, mare tadugudo boe jetororeu rekodaji tu rugadu.
Judeudoge emeardaei Jesus jitu.

b: Jerusalém kejewuge ia boe egore: - Awu karega cewu eemarure bogai tuwo bito?
source: Jerusalém kejewuge ia boe egore: - Awu karega cewu eemarure bogai tuwo bito?

b: Kode, emare akore tumago tabo boe etoiabiji oinono, mare boe emagokare ji. Kode, boe eimejerage kana ere boe pa Cristoie ure ema duji? Mare ceerduware kaiba awu imedu buture duji.
source: Kode, emare akore tumago tabo boe etoiabiji oinono, mare boe emagokare ji. Kode, boe eimejerage kana ere boe pa Cristoie ure ema duji? Mare ceerduware kaiba awu imedu buture duji.

b: Mare Cristo aregodumode du keje, iaboe iaboe eerduwamodukare kaiba aregodure duji.
source: Mare Cristo aregodumode du keje, iaboe iaboe eerduwamodukare kaiba aregodure duji.

b: Jesus, tui boe eerduwado Pao uwai tada du tabo, akore: - Taerduware ii kaiba itaregodure duji. Ipiji karega itaregodure. Mare cewu ure irojaiwure, boe jokoduwu jamedu boere apo, mare taerduwakare ji.
source: Jesus, tui boe eerduwado Pao uwai tada du tabo, akore: - Taerduware ii kaiba itaregodure duji. Ipiji karega itaregodure. Mare cewu ure irojaiwure, boe jokoduwu jamedu boere apo, mare taerduwakare ji.

b: Imirema iorduware ji, itaregodure piji kodi, emare ure irojai jamedu kodi.
source: Imirema iorduware ji, itaregodure piji kodi, emare ure irojai jamedu kodi.

b: Icare eemarure tuwo tugeragu ji, mare iaboe iaboe ekare tugera puredudo ji, boe aregodukare pudae ji roga kodi.
source: Icare eemarure tuwo tugeragu ji, mare iaboe iaboe ekare tugera puredudo ji, boe aregodukare pudae ji roga kodi.

b: Mare nowu inodu jamedu boe tada, makareu boe emeartorure ji, enorare jice woje, jice woje pui: -Kode, Cristo aregodumode du keje, ro pemegareu kurireu kodumode awu ro kori?
source: Mare nowu inodu jamedu boe tada, makareu boe emeartorure ji, enorare jice woje, jice woje pui: -Kode, Cristo aregodumode du keje, ro pemegareu kurireu kodumode awu ro kori?

b: Fariseudogere boe pa boe egoi Jesus jiboe jituji, du kodi icare ere mare sacerdotedoge eimejerage ere torigaraidoge etudo bogai ewo tugeragu ji.
source: Fariseudogere boe pa boe egoi Jesus jiboe jituji, du kodi icare ere mare sacerdotedoge eimejerage ere torigaraidoge etudo bogai ewo tugeragu ji.

b: Jesus akore: - Iragojemode tagabo biega tu je kimo, dukeje itumode ure irojaiwu ae.
source: Jesus akore: - Iragojemode tagabo biega tu je kimo, dukeje itumode ure irojaiwu ae.

b: Taemarumode iwogai, mare taerdumodukare ii, taroiwamodukare taduwo ikodumodewo kae
source: Taemarumode iwogai, mare taerdumodukare ii, taroiwamodukare taduwo ikodumodewo kae

b: Icare judeudoge enoragodure pui: - Kaiba kodumode paerdukawo pudui? Iarema utu kana umode cewu rakojere gregodoge etadawu judeudoge etae, tuwo nowu moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eerduwado?
source: Icare judeudoge enoragodure pui: - Kaiba kodumode paerdukawo pudui? Iarema utu kana umode cewu rakojere gregodoge etadawu judeudoge etae, tuwo nowu moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eerduwado?

b:
Inobadu jiba akore oino pai: Taemarumode iwogai mare taerdumodukare ii, taroiwamodukare taduwo ikodumodewo kae oino? 
Ure boe eedowu pobojari.
source:
Inobadu jiba akore oino pai: Taemarumode iwogai mare taerdumodukare ii, taroiwamodukare taduwo ikodumodewo kae oino? 
Ure boe eedowu pobojari.

b: Nowu peta jiwu boigoduwu meriji, kodure tumedage ekoriwu meriji, Jesus mako rakare turagojei, akore: - Ia tagi pobo boimode tai ma, mato itae, taguduwo.
source: Nowu peta jiwu boigoduwu meriji, kodure tumedage ekoriwu meriji, Jesus mako rakare turagojei, akore: - Ia tagi pobo boimode tai ma, mato itae, taguduwo.

b: Cewu meartorure iiwu, ure nono cewu bapera atugo ako magadu reore: “Pobojari jereuge emode tudawuje piji” (Za 14,8; ls 8,11).
source: Cewu meartorure iiwu, ure nono cewu bapera atugo ako magadu reore: “Pobojari jereuge emode tudawuje piji” (Za 14,8; ls 8,11).

b: Makore awu inoduji, tui inodu jeonado Aroe Pemegareu jitu tabo, du makudumode meartorumode puduiwuge etai, du jire akoino. Mare Aroe Pemegareu makudukare roga, Jesus aregodukare tugurimodewo kae roga kodi.
source: Makore awu inoduji, tui inodu jeonado Aroe Pemegareu jitu tabo, du makudumode meartorumode puduiwuge etai, du jire akoino. Mare Aroe Pemegareu makudukare roga, Jesus aregodukare tugurimodewo kae roga kodi.

b: Nowu boe makareuge, iage, tumeardui nowu bataru inodu jitu keje, egore: - Boe jokodu remawu profeta reo.
source: Nowu boe makareuge, iage, tumeardui nowu bataru inodu jitu keje, egore: - Boe jokodu remawu profeta reo.

b: Iage egore: - Awure Cristo remawure ema. Mare iage egore nowu egoinodu me keje tu oino: - Kode, Galiléia kejewu bai piji kana Cristo aregodumode?
source: Iage egore: - Awure Cristo remawure ema. Mare iage egore nowu egoinodu me keje tu oino: - Kode, Galiléia kejewu bai piji kana Cristo aregodumode?

b: Kode, bapera atugo akore oino: Davi rekodajiwuge epijire Cristo aregodumode, cewu babuturogu iei Belém cedu piji, Davi o moto piji. Oino karega?
source: Kode, bapera atugo akore oino: Davi rekodajiwuge epijire Cristo aregodumode, cewu babuturogu iei Belém cedu piji, Davi o moto piji. Oino karega?

b: Kodire boe ewadaru pegare pui jice woje, jice woje, Jesus koia.
source: Kodire boe ewadaru pegare pui jice woje, jice woje, Jesus koia.

b:
Iaboe etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji, mare ekare tugera puredudo ji.
Judeudoge eimejerage emeartorukare.
source:
Iaboe etaidure tuwo tugeragu ji, mare ekare tugera puredudo ji.
Judeudoge eimejerage emeartorukare.

b: Torigaraidoge ere tugirimi sacerdotedoge eimejerage, fariseudoge etai tuibagi pugeje, duwuge enoragodure ei, egore: - Kodiba takare arego?
source: Torigaraidoge ere tugirimi sacerdotedoge eimejerage, fariseudoge etai tuibagi pugeje, duwuge enoragodure ei, egore: - Kodiba takare arego?

b: Torigaraidoge egore ei: - Ia imedu boe makokare awu imedu mako reore.
source: Torigaraidoge egore ei: - Ia imedu boe makokare awu imedu mako reore.

b: Icare fariseudoge egore ei: - Kode, boe kana ure tawogado boeto jamedu?
source: Icare fariseudoge egore ei: - Kode, boe kana ure tawogado boeto jamedu?

b: Iarema ia boe eimejerage, ia fariseudoge emeartorure ji?
source: Iarema ia boe eimejerage, ia fariseudoge emeartorure ji?

b: Mare awu boe onawuge, eerduwakare boe eroiagudu jitu, boe pegareuge nure emage.
source: Mare awu boe onawuge, eerduwakare boe eroiagudu jitu, boe pegareuge nure emage.

b: Mare ia emage, iei Nicodemo cedu, cewu jemarure bogai boecojiwu, akore ei: -
source: Mare ia emage, iei Nicodemo cedu, cewu jemarure bogai boecojiwu, akore ei: -

b: Ceroiagudu umode ia imedu barigu boe pegareuto tumeardui, tuiordui ro boe jitu otodai?
source: Ceroiagudu umode ia imedu barigu boe pegareuto tumeardui, tuiordui ro boe jitu otodai?

b: Egore ji: - Iarema galileu kana ure aki jamedu? Aerduwa pemegado aerduwo ia profeta aregodumodukai Galiléia pijiduji.
source: Egore ji: - Iarema galileu kana ure aki jamedu? Aerduwa pemegado aerduwo ia profeta aregodumodukai Galiléia pijiduji.

b: Du kejere ere tugirimi tu tu tuwai kae.
source: Du kejere ere tugirimi tu tu tuwai kae.

b: Aredu ro pegareudo.
source: Aredu ro pegareudo.

b: Jesus kodure Oliveira tadawu torekodu kae.
source: Jesus kodure Oliveira tadawu torekodu kae.

b: Barogwa kododu tabore ure tugirimi Pao uwaito; boe eiamedu boere tudo pui ae. Ure tumugudo tu je, du tabore icare ure eerduwado.
source: Barogwa kododu tabore ure tugirimi Pao uwaito; boe eiamedu boere tudo pui ae. Ure tumugudo tu je, du tabore icare ure eerduwado.

b: Icare escribadoge, fariseudoge ere ia boe eerdure ro okeadui aredu reko mto ae.
source: Icare escribadoge, fariseudoge ere ia boe eerdure ro okeadui aredu reko mto ae.

b: Ere rakojedo tu nowu boe makareuge etoiadoda, egore Jesusji: - Cegimejera, maigodu boe ere tugeragu awu areduji ro keadu tonaji.
source: Ere rakojedo tu nowu boe makareuge etoiadoda, egore Jesusji: - Cegimejera, maigodu boe ere tugeragu awu areduji ro keadu tonaji.

b: Moisesre bapera atugodo ceiagu tori to awu rore oinowu areme eiduji. Inoba akagomode awu inoduji?
source: Moisesre bapera atugodo ceiagu tori to awu rore oinowu areme eiduji. Inoba akagomode awu inoduji?

b: Ere tunorado ji tuiaki turoiwawo tuwo tugeragu ji ia bataru keje du bogai, tagowo, onoie akore. Jesusrema, ure tuie jodo mototo, ure moto atugodo tugerako tabo.
source: Ere tunorado ji tuiaki turoiwawo tuwo tugeragu ji ia bataru keje du bogai, tagowo, onoie akore. Jesusrema, ure tuie jodo mototo, ure moto atugodo tugerako tabo.

b: Enora kimo jitu koiare, ure taogado taci je, akore ei: - Ia ro pegakareu ia tagi umode tori to ca boetoji ji.
source: Enora kimo jitu koiare, ure taogado taci je, akore ei: - Ia ro pegakareu ia tagi umode tori to ca boetoji ji.

b: Ure tuie jodo gu moto kae pugeje, ure moto atugodo tugerako tabo pugeje.
source: Ure tuie jodo gu moto kae pugeje, ure moto atugodo tugerako tabo pugeje.

b: Awu bataru keje, tui boe pa pudumiraboduie tuwogware boetodu jitu koia, ere tudawuje, ere tudo mito taci jii boigoduwu ae, tui paru bu codureuge ewugeje du piji. Du kodire Jesus mugure tuginoigodu, cewu aredu rakojere nono jamedu.
source: Awu bataru keje, tui boe pa pudumiraboduie tuwogware boetodu jitu koia, ere tudawuje, ere tudo mito taci jii boigoduwu ae, tui paru bu codureuge ewugeje du piji. Du kodire Jesus mugure tuginoigodu, cewu aredu rakojere nono jamedu.

b: Du kejere icare ure taogado taci je. Boekarema, tuiordui cewu aredu ui mito tu jedu jitu keje, unoragodure ji, akore: - Aredu, kaiba cewu akoino aiwuge ekodure? Iaboe iaboe ekare awarigu boe pegareuto?
source: Du kejere icare ure taogado taci je. Boekarema, tuiordui cewu aredu ui mito tu jedu jitu keje, unoragodure ji, akore: - Aredu, kaiba cewu akoino aiwuge ekodure? Iaboe iaboe ekare awarigu boe pegareuto?

b:
Akore: 
Ikimejera, boe bokwa. 

Kodi icare Jesus akore ji: - U! Imi jamedu imodukare awarigu boe pegareuto. Toro! Akaba akirimi aro pegareuto pugeje.
Moto kejewu urugureboe nure Jesusce.
source:
Akore: 
Ikimejera, boe bokwa. 

Kodi icare Jesus akore ji: - U! Imi jamedu imodukare awarigu boe pegareuto. Toro! Akaba akirimi aro pegareuto pugeje.
Moto kejewu urugureboe nure Jesusce.

b: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Imire moto kejewu urugureboere imi. Cewu kodure itabowu, merumodukare boeco tada, mare jereboe urugumode ji.
source: Jesus akore ei pugeje: - Imire moto kejewu urugureboere imi. Cewu kodure itabowu, merumodukare boeco tada, mare jereboe urugumode ji.

b: Nonore icare fariseudoge egore ji: - Akire amagore aiboeji, nowu akagoi aidu ukare turugadu boe emeartoruwo ji.
source: Nonore icare fariseudoge egore ji: - Akire amagore aiboeji, nowu akagoi aidu ukare turugadu boe emeartoruwo ji.

b: Jesus akore ei: - Imire inagomode ii rugadu ma, imagore jiboere turugadu boe emeartoraeji. Paga karega, iorduware kaiba itaregodure duji, kaiba ikodumode duji jamedu. Mare tagi taerduwakare kaiba pijiba itaregodure, kaiba ikodumode duji jamedu.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Imire inagomode ii rugadu ma, imagore jiboere turugadu boe emeartoraeji. Paga karega, iorduware kaiba itaregodure duji, kaiba ikodumode duji jamedu. Mare tagi taerduwakare kaiba pijiba itaregodure, kaiba ikodumode duji jamedu.

b: Tare tagogado ure taegaiboeji. Imi ikare ikogado iaboei iaboei.
source: Tare tagogado ure taegaiboeji. Imi ikare ikogado iaboei iaboei.

b: Imode ikogado boei ma, ire ikogado jiboe jetorogodumode jamedu, paga karega, ikare ikinoi tu je du kodi, Ioga mugure itabo jamedu kodi.
source: Imode ikogado boei ma, ire ikogado jiboe jetorogodumode jamedu, paga karega, ikare ikinoi tu je du kodi, Ioga mugure itabo jamedu kodi.

b: Ica, taroiagudu akore: “Boei pobe tu jedu eioi puwugejedu ure turugadu boe emeartoruwo ji” (Deut 19, 15).
source: Ica, taroiagudu akore: “Boei pobe tu jedu eioi puwugejedu ure turugadu boe emeartoruwo ji” (Deut 19, 15).

b: Imi imagore ii itaobiji rugadu, mare ure irojaiwu Ioga jore iwugeje jamedu.
source: Imi imagore ii itaobiji rugadu, mare ure irojaiwu Ioga jore iwugeje jamedu.

b: Icare enoragodure ji: - Kaiba Ao rakojere?  Jesus akore: - Taerduwakare ii, taerduwakare Iogaji jamedu. Taerduwamode ii ma, taerduwamode Iogaji jamedu.
source: Icare enoragodure ji: - Kaiba Ao rakojere?  Jesus akore: - Taerduwakare ii, taerduwakare Iogaji jamedu. Taerduwamode ii ma, taerduwamode Iogaji jamedu.

b: Makore awu tuwadaruji tui boe eerduwado Pao uwai tada du keje, puredu tu boere to mearogu tugu towu iraji. Mare iaboe iaboe ekare tugeragu ji, boe aregodukare pudae roga kodi.
source: Makore awu tuwadaruji tui boe eerduwado Pao uwai tada du keje, puredu tu boere to mearogu tugu towu iraji. Mare iaboe iaboe ekare tugeragu ji, boe aregodukare pudae roga kodi.

b: Jesus akore ei kimo: -Itumode du keje, taemarumode iwogai, mare tawimode taro pegareu tada, paga karega, taroiwamodukare tagoduwo ikodumodewo kae.
source: Jesus akore ei kimo: -Itumode du keje, taemarumode iwogai, mare tawimode taro pegareu tada, paga karega, taroiwamodukare tagoduwo ikodumodewo kae.

b: Icare judeudoge egore: - Ukana umode tuwido? Akore: Taroiwamodukare tagoduwo ikodumodewo kae. Kodiba akoino?
source: Icare judeudoge egore: - Ukana umode tuwido? Akore: Taroiwamodukare tagoduwo ikodumodewo kae. Kodiba akoino?

b: Icare akore ei: - Woje comoroiwuge tagireo; cebojewu imireo. Awu moto kejewuge nure tagi, mare imi karega.
source: Icare akore ei: - Woje comoroiwuge tagireo; cebojewu imireo. Awu moto kejewuge nure tagi, mare imi karega.

b: Inagore tai tawimoduie taro pegareu tadaduji, mare paga karega, tameartorumodukare imie rugadu ma, tawimode taro pegareu tada.
source: Inagore tai tawimoduie taro pegareu tadaduji, mare paga karega, tameartorumodukare imie rugadu ma, tawimode taro pegareu tada.

b:
Du kodi icare enoragodure ji: -Ioguduba akibao?  Jesus akore ei: 
Cewu inagore tai boe paru toboe nure imi.
source:
Du kodi icare enoragodure ji: -Ioguduba akibao?  Jesus akore ei: 
Cewu inagore tai boe paru toboe nure imi.

b: Imagowo taiboe, iwo ikogado taiboe makaguragare. Mare ure irojaiwu boe rikireu nure ema; imeardure ji pijiboe imagore ji moto kejewugei.
source: Imagowo taiboe, iwo ikogado taiboe makaguragare. Mare ure irojaiwu boe rikireu nure ema; imeardure ji pijiboe imagore ji moto kejewugei.

b: Mare ekare boe pa makoi Tuo jiboeji.
source: Mare ekare boe pa makoi Tuo jiboeji.

b: Du kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Tamode Imedu Onaregedu aogado du keje, taerduwamode ioguduba imiba; taerduwamode irore jiboe ukae itaobiji, mare imagoi nono Iogare iorduwado jiboe reore duji.
source: Du kodi icare Jesus akore ei: - Tamode Imedu Onaregedu aogado du keje, taerduwamode ioguduba imiba; taerduwamode irore jiboe ukae itaobiji, mare imagoi nono Iogare iorduwado jiboe reore duji.

b: Cewu ure irojaiwu ure itabo; ukare ido ikinoi tu je, paga karega, irore nono aidu magai du reore jii je du kodi.
source: Cewu ure irojaiwu ure itabo; ukare ido ikinoi tu je, paga karega, irore nono aidu magai du reore jii je du kodi.

b:
Nowu akoi oinono du keje, makareuge emeartorure ji.
Jesus mare Abraão.
source:
Nowu akoi oinono du keje, makareuge emeartorure ji.
Jesus mare Abraão.

b: Jesus akore nowu meartorure puduiwu judeudogei: - Taedumode iwadaru keje ma, ire jorduwadowu boe jokoduwuge rumodedo tagi.
source: Jesus akore nowu meartorure puduiwu judeudogei: - Taedumode iwadaru keje ma, ire jorduwadowu boe jokoduwuge rumodedo tagi.

b: Taerduwamode boe rikireuji, boe rikireu umode taginorudo.
source: Taerduwamode boe rikireuji, boe rikireu umode taginorudo.

b: Egore ji: - Abraão ore nure cegi, boe etugarege karega ure cegi jii je, kodiba icare akagore: Taginorudodumode ino cei?
source: Egore ji: - Abraão ore nure cegi, boe etugarege karega ure cegi jii je, kodiba icare akagore: Taginorudodumode ino cei?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ure tumagu turo pegareu kaiwu ime eiamedu boe, ere turo pegareu utugarege nure emage.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ure tumagu turo pegareu kaiwu ime eiamedu boe, ere turo pegareu utugarege nure emage.

b: Aró, kode, boe etugare mugumodukare boe etuo uwai keje, mare tu onaregedu mugumode uwai keje jii je.
source: Aró, kode, boe etugare mugumodukare boe etuo uwai keje, mare tu onaregedu mugumode uwai keje jii je.

b: Du kodi icare Onaregedu umode taginorudo ma, boe etugarege emodukare tagi rugadu.
source: Du kodi icare Onaregedu umode taginorudo ma, boe etugarege emodukare tagi rugadu.

b: Iorduwa pemega nure Abraão oreie tagiduji, mare tagaidure tawo iwido, mare iwadaru remodukare tadoda du koia.
source: Iorduwa pemega nure Abraão oreie tagiduji, mare tagaidure tawo iwido, mare iwadaru remodukare tadoda du koia.

b: Imire imagore iordure Ioga apo boeji. Tagirema, tarore nono tameardure tao okwabiji boeji.
source: Imire imagore iordure Ioga apo boeji. Tagirema, tarore nono tameardure tao okwabiji boeji.

b: Egore ji: - Ceore Abraão rema. Jesus akore ei: - Abraão ore rumode tagi du keje, taromode nono Abraão rore jiboeji.
source: Egore ji: - Ceore Abraão rema. Jesus akore ei: - Abraão ore rumode tagi du keje, taromode nono Abraão rore jiboeji.

b: Imire imagore tai boe jokodure ema boeji imeardui Pao piji duji, macare tagaidure tawo iwido. Abraão rokare ino.
source: Imire imagore tai boe jokodure ema boeji imeardui Pao piji duji, macare tagaidure tawo iwido. Abraão rokare ino.

b: Tarore tao roiaji. Egore ji: - Boe ekera keadu koia kerega ure cedowuje: ceore ia ceoce, dure Pao Aroe Eimejera rema.
source: Tarore tao roiaji. Egore ji: - Boe ekera keadu koia kerega ure cedowuje: ceore ia ceoce, dure Pao Aroe Eimejera rema.

b: Jesus akore: - Taomode Aroe Eimejera ma, tameardu kurimode ii, paga karega, Aroe Eimejera pijire itawujedure, pijire itaregodure. Ipiji karega itaregodure, mare koiare ure irojai.
source: Jesus akore: - Taomode Aroe Eimejera ma, tameardu kurimode ii, paga karega, Aroe Eimejera pijire itawujedure, pijire itaregodure. Ipiji karega itaregodure, mare koiare ure irojai.

b: Kodiba takare iwadaru pawuje? Taroiwakare tamearduwo iwadaru jitu kodi.
source: Kodiba takare iwadaru pawuje? Taroiwakare tamearduwo iwadaru jitu kodi.

b: Taore Aroe pegareu rema, tagaidure tarowo tao aidure jiboe reore. Boe paru tore boe ewidodu epa rema; rakojekare boe rikireu tabo, boe rikireu bokware apo kodi. Tagoi tuwadararodae jitu keje, pudui rugadure akoino, paga karega, batararodu barikare kodi, emare boe ewadararodae uo rema.
source: Taore Aroe pegareu rema, tagaidure tarowo tao aidure jiboe reore. Boe paru tore boe ewidodu epa rema; rakojekare boe rikireu tabo, boe rikireu bokware apo kodi. Tagoi tuwadararodae jitu keje, pudui rugadure akoino, paga karega, batararodu barikare kodi, emare boe ewadararodae uo rema.

b: Mare imi imagore boe rikireu jitu koia, tameartorukare iwadaruji.
source: Mare imi imagore boe rikireu jitu koia, tameartorukare iwadaruji.

b: Kakoduwu tagiba tamode ikiegi iro pegareu tabo?
source: Kakoduwu tagiba tamode ikiegi iro pegareu tabo?

b: Pao ore emawuge emeardure bataruji, tagirema tameardukare ji orekare tagi kodi.
source: Pao ore emawuge emeardure bataruji, tagirema tameardukare ji orekare tagi kodi.

b: Nonore icare judeudoge egore ji: - Kode cemagokare boe jokoduji akie samaritanore aki, atadaie Aroe pegareu meture?
source: Nonore icare judeudoge egore ji: - Kode cemagokare boe jokoduji akie samaritanore aki, atadaie Aroe pegareu meture?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Aroe pegareu metukare itada, mare ire Ioga kurido. Tagirema, tare iwarigududo.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Aroe pegareu metukare itada, mare ire Ioga kurido. Tagirema, tare iwarigududo.

b: Iemarukare ikuriwo du bogai; mare iare ikurido, du umode tugogado boei.
source: Iemarukare ikuriwo du bogai; mare iare ikurido, du umode tugogado boei.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Iaboe umode iwadaru jetu otorogado ma, bimodukare jii je.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Iaboe umode iwadaru jetu otorogado ma, bimodukare jii je.

b: Judeudoge egore ji: - Icare ceerdure Aroe pegareu metui atoda duji. Abraão bire, profetadoge ewire jamedu. Icare akagore umoduie awadaru jetu otorogadowu bimodukae jii je?
source: Judeudoge egore ji: - Icare ceerdure Aroe pegareu metui atoda duji. Abraão bire, profetadoge ewire jamedu. Icare akagore umoduie awadaru jetu otorogadowu bimodukae jii je?

b: Kode, akina akodure paedoga Abraão kori? Ema bire, profetadoge ewire jamedu kaboba ameardaere uwo aki?
source: Kode, akina akodure paedoga Abraão kori? Ema bire, profetadoge ewire jamedu kaboba ameardaere uwo aki?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Imode boe kurireudo imi itaobiji ma, boe kurireu imidu boe karega. Iogare ure ikurido. Cewu tagagore tago Aroe Eimejeraie emawu.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Imode boe kurireudo imi itaobiji ma, boe kurireu imidu boe karega. Iogare ure ikurido. Cewu tagagore tago Aroe Eimejeraie emawu.

b: Mare taerduwakare ji. Imagomode iorduwakae ji ma, iwadararodumode nono tawadararodu reore. Mare iorduware ji, irore nono bataru reore jamedu.
source: Mare taerduwakare ji. Imagomode iorduwakae ji ma, iwadararodumode nono tawadararodu reore. Mare iorduware ji, irore nono bataru reore jamedu.

b: Taedoga Abraão jekarere tumeardui tuiordumode ino meri jituji. Jordure ji, icare jekare kuricigore.
source: Taedoga Abraão jekarere tumeardui tuiordumode ino meri jituji. Jordure ji, icare jekare kuricigore.

b: Icare judeudoge egore ji: - Ako joru ukare 50 ce roga, mare icare aerdure Abraãoji?
source: Icare judeudoge egore ji: - Ako joru ukare 50 ce roga, mare icare aerdure Abraãoji?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Abraão butumodedu otodai, ire marigudu.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Abraão butumodedu otodai, ire marigudu.

b: Nowu akoinodu kejere icare, ere tugeragu toriji tuwo tori to ji. Mare Jesus ure tuwogwado pi tuku je, ure tudawuje nowu Pao uwai piji.
source: Nowu akoinodu kejere icare, ere tugeragu toriji tuwo tori to ji. Mare Jesus ure tuwogwado pi tuku je, ure tudawuje nowu Pao uwai piji.

b: Jesus ure ia buture tuioku bokwa tabowu pemegago.
source: Jesus ure ia buture tuioku bokwa tabowu pemegago.

b: Icare Jesus, tugodui ia tugodu kae du keje, jordure ia buture tuioku bokwa tabowu imeduji.
source: Icare Jesus, tugodui ia tugodu kae du keje, jordure ia buture tuioku bokwa tabowu imeduji.

b: Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji: - Cegimejera, ioguduba ro pegare du koiaba awu imedu buture tuioku bokwa tabo? Ema kana, iarema uomage kana?
source: Icare nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji: - Cegimejera, ioguduba ro pegare du koiaba awu imedu buture tuioku bokwa tabo? Ema kana, iarema uomage kana?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Awu ro pegareu koia karega, uomage eigoia karega jamedu, mare Pao uwo turo pemegareu kurireu awadudo ji du bogai.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Awu ro pegareu koia karega, uomage eigoia karega jamedu, mare Pao uwo turo pemegareu kurireu awadudo ji du bogai.

b: Meri jetu kimo tabore, ure turugadu iwo ure irojaiwu ro pemegareu kurireuge eiado. Boeco aregodumode du keje boe emaragodumodukare pugeje.
source: Meri jetu kimo tabore, ure turugadu iwo ure irojaiwu ro pemegareu kurireuge eiado. Boeco aregodumode du keje boe emaragodumodukare pugeje.

b: Du kodire, iragojei moto keje du tonaji, urugure moto jiboe nure imi.
source: Du kodire, iragojei moto keje du tonaji, urugure moto jiboe nure imi.

b: Tagoinodu tabore, ure todoguru to co mototo, ure moto gurugurudo todoguru tabo, du kejere icare ure nowu moto guruguru rogu reko nowu joku bokwareu jokuji.
source: Tagoinodu tabore, ure todoguru to co mototo, ure moto gurugurudo todoguru tabo, du kejere icare ure nowu moto guruguru rogu reko nowu joku bokwareu jokuji.

b: Du kejere akore ji: - Toro, akabi boe etaimoda iei Zilo cedu keje (boe ewadaru tabo iere Roiaidodureboe oino). Icare nowu joku bokwareu uture toro rugadu, icare ure tugirimi taiwo tabo.
source: Du kejere akore ji: - Toro, akabi boe etaimoda iei Zilo cedu keje (boe ewadaru tabo iere Roiaidodureboe oino). Icare nowu joku bokwareu uture toro rugadu, icare ure tugirimi taiwo tabo.

b: Kodi icare cewu puredure jiwuge, jordure okwamagudui tu tu jedu jiwuge, enorare pui, egore: - Cewu okwamagudu kigodure tu tu tumugu tabowu karegao?
source: Kodi icare cewu puredure jiwuge, jordure okwamagudui tu tu jedu jiwuge, enorare pui, egore: - Cewu okwamagudu kigodure tu tu tumugu tabowu karegao?

b: Iage egore: - U! Ema. Iagerema egore: - Ema karega, mare reoreu. Emarema akore: - Imi rugadu.
source: Iage egore: - U! Ema. Iagerema egore: - Ema karega, mare reoreu. Emarema akore: - Imi rugadu.

b: Kodi icare enoragodure ji: - Inoba taboba aekure tuiado?
source: Kodi icare enoragodure ji: - Inoba taboba aekure tuiado?

b: Akore ei: - Cewu iere Jesus cewu imedu ure moto gurugurudo, ure reko iokuji, akore ii: Toro aia iei Zilo cedu kae, awo kabi. Iture rugadu, ire ikabi, ica, oino itaiwore.
source: Akore ei: - Cewu iere Jesus cewu imedu ure moto gurugurudo, ure reko iokuji, akore ii: Toro aia iei Zilo cedu kae, awo kabi. Iture rugadu, ire ikabi, ica, oino itaiwore.

b: Icare enoragodure ji: - Kaiba nowu imedu rakojere?  Akore: - Iorduwa bokwa.
source: Icare enoragodure ji: - Kaiba nowu imedu rakojere?  Akore: - Iorduwa bokwa.

b:
Du kodi icare ere cewu joku bokwareu reko fariseudoge etae.
Fariseudoge enorai joku bokwareu jidu.
source:
Du kodi icare ere cewu joku bokwareu reko fariseudoge etae.
Fariseudoge enorai joku bokwareu jidu.

b: Aró kode, sabadore jiwu meriji Jesus ure moto guruguru towuje, ur nowu imedu jokudo tuiado.
source: Aró kode, sabadore jiwu meriji Jesus ure moto guruguru towuje, ur nowu imedu jokudo tuiado.

b: Du kodi icare fariseudoge enorare ji pugeje inoba rakuduie aiwore. Akore ei: Ure moto guruguru maedo ioku joki, du keje icare ire ikabi, ica, oino itaiwore.
source: Du kodi icare fariseudoge enorare ji pugeje inoba rakuduie aiwore. Akore ei: Ure moto guruguru maedo ioku joki, du keje icare ire ikabi, ica, oino itaiwore.

b: Ia fariseudoge egore: - Pao koia karega ure nowu imedu rojai, mare paga karega, maragodure sabadore jiwu meriji. Iage egore: - Inobadu kodiba ro pegareu imedu umode cewu turo kurireu kuo?  Enora korire pui jice woje, jice woje.
source: Ia fariseudoge egore: - Pao koia karega ure nowu imedu rojai, mare paga karega, maragodure sabadore jiwu meriji. Iage egore: - Inobadu kodiba ro pegareu imedu umode cewu turo kurireu kuo?  Enora korire pui jice woje, jice woje.

b: Enoragodure kimo nowu joku bokwareuji, egore: - Inoba ameardaere nowu ure aekudo tuiadowuji?  Akore ei: - Ia profeta nure ema.
source: Enoragodure kimo nowu joku bokwareuji, egore: - Inoba ameardaere nowu ure aekudo tuiadowuji?  Akore ei: - Ia profeta nure ema.

b: Mare judeudoge emeartorukare nowu imedu joku bokwaie duji, du kaegae icare jokuie duji, icare emago jokodure uomage ewogai.
source: Mare judeudoge emeartorukare nowu imedu joku bokwaie duji, du kaegae icare jokuie duji, icare emago jokodure uomage ewogai.

b: Enoragodure ei: - Tagonaregedu nao? Tagagomode boe jokoduie buture tuioku bokwa tabo? Macare inobadu taboba aiwore oino?
source: Enoragodure ei: - Tagonaregedu nao? Tagagomode boe jokoduie buture tuioku bokwa tabo? Macare inobadu taboba aiwore oino?

b: Uomage egore: - Ceerduware awuie cedonaregedu rema duji, butuie tuioku bokwa tabo duji.
source: Uomage egore: - Ceerduware awuie cedonaregedu rema duji, butuie tuioku bokwa tabo duji.

b: Mare ceerduwakare inobadu tabore aiwore oino. Tanorado ji nowu inoduji. O joru butu makare du je. Ema rugadure umode kogado tawiegai.
source: Mare ceerduwakare inobadu tabore aiwore oino. Tanorado ji nowu inoduji. O joru butu makare du je. Ema rugadure umode kogado tawiegai.

b: Uomage egore oino tubagudu koia judeudogece, mare paga karega, cewu meartorure Cristoie Jesus cedu jiwuge eiamedu boe eire judeudoge egore tumoduie etawuje sinagoga piji tugorigodui ei du tabo.
source: Uomage egore oino tubagudu koia judeudogece, mare paga karega, cewu meartorure Cristoie Jesus cedu jiwuge eiamedu boe eire judeudoge egore tumoduie etawuje sinagoga piji tugorigodui ei du tabo.

b: Du kodire uomage egore. O joru butu makare, tanorado ji nowu inoduji, oino.
source: Du kodire uomage egore. O joru butu makare, tanorado ji nowu inoduji, oino.

b: Icare emagore nowu joku bokwareu bogai kimo pugeje, egore ji: - Pao kurido. Ceerduware ro pegareuie nowu imeduce duji.
source: Icare emagore nowu joku bokwareu bogai kimo pugeje, egore ji: - Pao kurido. Ceerduware ro pegareuie nowu imeduce duji.

b: Akore ei: - Iorduwakare ro pegareu rakuduie, iorduware tu jiboe reo: Ioku bokware, du karega icare iokure oino.
source: Akore ei: - Iorduwakare ro pegareu rakuduie, iorduware tu jiboe reo: Ioku bokware, du karega icare iokure oino.

b: Icare enoragodu pemegare ji pugeje; - Inoba ure turodo ai? Inoba rore tuwo aeku jado?
source: Icare enoragodu pemegare ji pugeje; - Inoba ure turodo ai? Inoba rore tuwo aeku jado?

b: Akore: - Ire tawie marigudu, mare takare tawiapagado iwadaruji, kodiba tagaidure tamearduwo pugeje? Iarema tagaidukana ure nowu ure jorduwadowuge ia etumedagewo tagi?
source: Akore: - Ire tawie marigudu, mare takare tawiapagado iwadaruji, kodiba tagaidure tamearduwo pugeje? Iarema tagaidukana ure nowu ure jorduwadowuge ia etumedagewo tagi?

b: Nonore icare ere tuwadaru pegareu rorido joki, egore ji: - Akire ia ure jorduwadowure aki, cegire Moisesre jorduwadowugere cegi.
source: Nonore icare ere tuwadaru pegareu rorido joki, egore ji: - Akire ia ure jorduwadowure aki, cegire Moisesre jorduwadowugere cegi.

b: Ceerduware Pao makoi Moisés jituji, mare awu ceerduwakare kaibawuba ure ema.
source: Ceerduware Pao makoi Moisés jituji, mare awu ceerduwakare kaibawuba ure ema.

b: Icare cewu imedu akore: - Ie rore ta... taerduwakai kaibawuba ure ema duji. Mare du inodu tabo ure iokudo tuiado.
source: Icare cewu imedu akore: - Ie rore ta... taerduwakai kaibawuba ure ema duji. Mare du inodu tabo ure iokudo tuiado.

b: Jamedu ceerduware Pao biapagakai ro pegareuge eiduji, mare biapagae okwamagudure puduiwugei, rore nono taidu reoreuge eiduji.
source: Jamedu ceerduware Pao biapagakai ro pegareuge eiduji, mare biapagae okwamagudure puduiwugei, rore nono taidu reoreuge eiduji.

b: Iaboe iaboe emeardukare tu iaboei ia boture tuioku bokwa tabowu joku jado duji.
source: Iaboe iaboe emeardukare tu iaboei ia boture tuioku bokwa tabowu joku jado duji.

b: Pao omodukare awu imeduce ma, romodukare ia turo.
source: Pao omodukare awu imeduce ma, romodukare ia turo.

b: Egore ji: - Awudure aro pegareu rorii aiogi du tabo, macare are ceerduwado?  Du kejere ere barigu tubiji.
source: Egore ji: - Awudure aro pegareu rorii aiogi du tabo, macare are ceerduwado?  Du kejere ere barigu tubiji.

b: Jesus jorduware ei barigu duji, icare tuiordui jitu keje, unoragodure ji: - Ameartorure Imedu Onaregeduji?
source: Jesus jorduware ei barigu duji, icare tuiordui jitu keje, unoragodure ji: - Ameartorure Imedu Onaregeduji?

b: Akore: - Ioguduba ure ema, ikimejera, imeartoruwo ji?
source: Akore: - Ioguduba ure ema, ikimejera, imeartoruwo ji?

b: Jesus akore ji: - Aerdure ji, emare makore oino ai.
source: Jesus akore ji: - Aerdure ji, emare makore oino ai.

b: Akore: Imeartorure, Ikimejera. Icare ure tubujodo ji, ure boe kurireudo ema.
source: Akore: Imeartorure, Ikimejera. Icare ure tubujodo ji, ure boe kurireudo ema.

b: Du kodi icre Jesus akore: - Itaregodure awu moto kae iwo boe ewu tuwugeje: iwo jordukareuge eerdudo, jordureuge ewo tuioku bokwado.
source: Du kodi icre Jesus akore: - Itaregodure awu moto kae iwo boe ewu tuwugeje: iwo jordukareuge eerdudo, jordureuge ewo tuioku bokwado.

b: Ia fariseudoge eedure apodu emeardure akoinoduji, egore ji: - Cegi jamedu kana ceeku bokware?
source: Ia fariseudoge eedure apodu emeardure akoinoduji, egore ji: - Cegi jamedu kana ceeku bokware?

b: Jesus akore ei: - Taeku bokwamode ma, taro pegamodukare, macare tameardaere taerduie duji, du kodi icare taro pegareu uture todobiji.
source: Jesus akore ei: - Taeku bokwamode ma, taro pegamodukare, macare tameardaere taerduie duji, du kodi icare taro pegareu uture todobiji.

b: Jeture ovelhadoge eiwu pemegareu. -
source: Jeture ovelhadoge eiwu pemegareu. -

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: cewu ukare turemo ovelhadoge ewaiporoji eeda towu, mare ure turemo to boekare turemowo jitu keje, iwogu kigodureu nure ema, boe ewidodu epa nure ema.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: cewu ukare turemo ovelhadoge ewaiporoji eeda towu, mare ure turemo to boekare turemowo jitu keje, iwogu kigodureu nure ema, boe ewidodu epa nure ema.

b: Mare cewu ure turemo baiporo jiwu, jeture ovelhadoge eiwu nure ema.
source: Mare cewu ure turemo baiporo jiwu, jeture ovelhadoge eiwu nure ema.

b: Duwure baiporo epare baiporo jado ai, ovelhadoge emeardumode makoji, makomode etae eie tabo, umode ecedo enogwagemodewo kae.
source: Duwure baiporo epare baiporo jado ai, ovelhadoge emeardumode makoji, makomode etae eie tabo, umode ecedo enogwagemodewo kae.

b: Tui ovelhadoge eiamedu boedo tuiebu du keje, kodumode etododai, nowu ovelhadoge ekodumode rekodaji, eerduware makoji kodi.
source: Tui ovelhadoge eiamedu boedo tuiebu du keje, kodumode etododai, nowu ovelhadoge ekodumode rekodaji, eerduware makoji kodi.

b: Mare etumodukare ia tuiorduwakare jiboe rekodaji, mare eregodu rumode piji, eerduwakare tuiorduwakare jiwuge emagoji kodi.
source: Mare etumodukare ia tuiorduwakare jiboe rekodaji, mare eregodu rumode piji, eerduwakare tuiorduwakare jiwuge emagoji kodi.

b: Jesus makore ei awu bakaruji mare ekare boe pa kaba jiba aidure tumagowo nowu tagoino du tabo.
source: Jesus makore ei awu bakaruji mare ekare boe pa kaba jiba aidure tumagowo nowu tagoino du tabo.

b: Icare Jesus makore ei pugeje, akore: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Imire ovelhadoge ewaiporore imi.
source: Icare Jesus makore ei pugeje, akore: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Imire ovelhadoge ewaiporore imi.

b: Cewu kodure itododai boetojiwuge eiamedu boere iwogu kigodureugere emage, boe ewidodu epagere emage.
source: Cewu kodure itododai boetojiwuge eiamedu boere iwogu kigodureugere emage, boe ewidodu epagere emage.

b: Imire baiporore imi, iaboe umode turemo ii ma, umode cinorudo: umode turemo, umode tuiebu, jordumode togwagemodewoji.
source: Imire baiporore imi, iaboe umode turemo ii ma, umode cinorudo: umode turemo, umode tuiebu, jordumode togwagemodewoji.

b: Iwogu kigodureuge etaregodumode ma, cioguwo du bogai, tuwo boe ewidodu bogai, tuwo boe pegadodu bogai tu je. Mare itaregodure ovelhadoge eewo du bogai, jereboe kuriwo ebo du bogai.
source: Iwogu kigodureuge etaregodumode ma, cioguwo du bogai, tuwo boe ewidodu bogai, tuwo boe pegadodu bogai tu je. Mare itaregodure ovelhadoge eewo du bogai, jereboe kuriwo ebo du bogai.

b: Imire jeture ovalhadoge eiwu pemegareure imi. Jeture ovelhadoge eiwu pemegareu ure tumagu ewugeje.
