source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe eroiagudu jamedu boe duwu boetojiwu reo: Tawiapagado, Israeldoge, Pagimejera pago Aroe Eimejera ure Boe Eimejera mito tu jewu rema.

b: Ameardu kurido Akimejera Aroe Eimejeraji, awabo jamedu tabo, akaroe jamedu tabo, ameardae jamedu tabo, aro raka jamedu boe tabo.
source: Ameardu kurido Akimejera Aroe Eimejeraji, awabo jamedu tabo, akaroe jamedu tabo, ameardae jamedu tabo, aro raka jamedu boe tabo.

b: Ica, rekodajiwu reo: Ameardu kurimode ameduiaji, ameardu kurimagai ai du reore. Ia boe eroiagudu kurireu ukare awu piji pugeje.
source: Ica, rekodajiwu reo: Ameardu kurimode ameduiaji, ameardu kurimagai ai du reore. Ia boe eroiagudu kurireu ukare awu piji pugeje.

b: Nowu escriba akore: - Pemega remawu nure, ikimejera, amago pemegare. Akagore Aroe Eimejera mito tu je, kodie ia kae pugeje.
source: Nowu escriba akore: - Pemega remawu nure, ikimejera, amago pemegare. Akagore Aroe Eimejera mito tu je, kodie ia kae pugeje.

b: Kodie boe emeardu kuriiagu ji tuwabo jamedu tabo, tumeardae jamedu tabo, tudaroe jamedu tabo; jamedu boe emeardu kuriiagu tumeduiaji, nono tumeardu kuri magai pudui du reore, awu inodure pemega remawuie boere maku Pao aiboe jamedu boe kori.
source: Kodie boe emeardu kuriiagu ji tuwabo jamedu tabo, tumeardae jamedu tabo, tudaroe jamedu tabo; jamedu boe emeardu kuriiagu tumeduiaji, nono tumeardu kuri magai pudui du reore, awu inodure pemega remawuie boere maku Pao aiboe jamedu boe kori.

b:
Icare Jesus tuiordui akoi tuiorduwa pemegareu tabo duji du keje, akore ji: Aiaekare Pao o boe pemegareuji. Nowu inodu otobiji, iaboe iaboe ekidakare tunorawo ji pugeje.
Jesus makoi boe eroiagudu epage eidu.
source:
Icare Jesus tuiordui akoi tuiorduwa pemegareu tabo duji du keje, akore ji: Aiaekare Pao o boe pemegareuji. Nowu inodu otobiji, iaboe iaboe ekidakare tunorawo ji pugeje.
Jesus makoi boe eroiagudu epage eidu.

b: Jesus uwadodure Pao uwai tada, du keje akore ei: - Kodiba escribadoge egore Davi onaregeduie ure Cristoce?
source: Jesus uwadodure Pao uwai tada, du keje akore ei: - Kodiba escribadoge egore Davi onaregeduie ure Cristoce?

b: Mare paga karega, Aroe Pemegareu koiare ure Davi akodo oino: Pao akore Ikimejeraji: ”Amugudo ikana pemegareu jaogwai jii ii onare ewu awure kuda du kae” (Sl 109,1).
source: Mare paga karega, Aroe Pemegareu koiare ure Davi akodo oino: Pao akore Ikimejeraji: ”Amugudo ikana pemegareu jaogwai jii ii onare ewu awure kuda du kae” (Sl 109,1).

b: Aró, kode, Davi akore cimejeraie ema, kodiba icare onaregedu umode ema?  Boekimorema, nowu boe makareuge emeardure ji taidu tabo tuiegare tabo.
source: Aró, kode, Davi akore cimejeraie ema, kodiba icare onaregedu umode ema?  Boekimorema, nowu boe makareuge emeardure ji taidu tabo tuiegare tabo.

b: Makore ei, ure eerduwado: - Tameardu awadudo tai escribadogei, duwuge etaidure tumeruwo tugudae rai tabo duji.
source: Makore ei, ure eerduwado: - Tameardu awadudo tai escribadogei, duwuge etaidure tumeruwo tugudae rai tabo duji.

b: Etaidu barikare tui boe eimadudo pudui ba oiagi duji, etaidure tui tumugudo boetojiwu boe emuga keje, sinagoga tadaduji, boetojiwu boe emuga togwage kejewo keje duji.
source: Etaidu barikare tui boe eimadudo pudui ba oiagi duji, etaidure tui tumugudo boetojiwu boe emuga keje, sinagoga tadaduji, boetojiwu boe emuga togwage kejewo keje duji.

b:
Ekigodure ukoge bireu areme enoroe boe akedudo epiji, ere boe eerdudo togwa kuridodu raicigoie ure duji. Nowu inoduwugere Pao umode tugogadodu kurido.
Oredu bire pijiwu aredu ui toroe makudu.
source:
Ekigodure ukoge bireu areme enoroe boe akedudo epiji, ere boe eerdudo togwa kuridodu raicigoie ure duji. Nowu inoduwugere Pao umode tugogadodu kurido.
Oredu bire pijiwu aredu ui toroe makudu.

b: Ia boe keje, Jesus ure tumugudo boere tubaru kejewu emawu diiero meriri tugu tugudure towu ira jokorato, oebatodure inoba boere diiero bu bu tada duji. Boekarema o diiero kurireuge ere diiero makudu kuricigore.
source: Ia boe keje, Jesus ure tumugudo boere tubaru kejewu emawu diiero meriri tugu tugudure towu ira jokorato, oebatodure inoba boere diiero bu bu tada duji. Boekarema o diiero kurireuge ere diiero makudu kuricigore.

b: Ia marenaru aredu oredu bire pijiwudo aregodure, ure ia diiero meriri rogu ui pobe tu jedu tugu to.
source: Ia marenaru aredu oredu bire pijiwudo aregodure, ure ia diiero meriri rogu ui pobe tu jedu tugu to.

b:
Icare Jesus makore ture jorduwadowuge ewogai, akore ei: - 
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Awu marenaru aredu ure diiero makado nowu o makareuge eno diiero kori irato.
source:
Icare Jesus makore ture jorduwadowuge ewogai, akore ei: - 
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Awu marenaru aredu ure diiero makado nowu o makareuge eno diiero kori irato.

b: Mare paga karega, eiamedu boe ere to diiero kuri inodu gigudurogu ere tugu. Mare awudorema, ure diiero bu marenarui pudumi du tabo, jeture pudabowu jamedu boe ure maku.
source: Mare paga karega, eiamedu boe ere to diiero kuri inodu gigudurogu ere tugu. Mare awudorema, ure diiero bu marenarui pudumi du tabo, jeture pudabowu jamedu boe ure maku.

b: Jesus makoi boe pegamoduie Pao uwai jitudu.
source: Jesus makoi boe pegamoduie Pao uwai jitudu.

b: Ere tuiebu Pao uwai piji, du keje ure jorduwadowuge ia makore Jesusji, akore: - Cegimejera, akaiwodo awu tori awu bai cedu motuji.
source: Ere tuiebu Pao uwai piji, du keje ure jorduwadowuge ia makore Jesusji, akore: - Cegimejera, akaiwodo awu tori awu bai cedu motuji.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Ica, aerdure awu bai kuri oinoduji? Awu kuri inodu ia ri padumodukare puaogeje.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Ica, aerdure awu bai kuri oinoduji? Awu kuri inodu ia ri padumodukare puaogeje.

b: Icare ure tumugudo Oliveira kejewu torekodu aogeje, Pao uwai jokorato, du keje icare Pedro, João, André, enoragodure ji tu tuginoi.
source: Icare ure tumugudo Oliveira kejewu torekodu aogeje, Pao uwai jokorato, du keje icare Pedro, João, André, enoragodure ji tu tuginoi.

b: Egore: - Amagodo cei, inoba boemodedu kejeba nowu inodu umode tudowuje? Inoba boemode tudo tuwo boe pawuje nowu inodu umode tudowuje du keje duji?
source: Egore: - Amagodo cei, inoba boemodedu kejeba nowu inodu umode tudowuje? Inoba boemode tudo tuwo boe pawuje nowu inodu umode tudowuje du keje duji?

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Taeto tai, takawo boedo taekuri pagado.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Taeto tai, takawo boedo taekuri pagado.

b: Makareuge etaregodumode ikie tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Imireo. Emode makareuge eekuri pagado.
source: Makareuge etaregodumode ikie tabo, tagoi oino du tabo: - Imireo. Emode makareuge eekuri pagado.

b: Tameardumode boe erugodumode puidu padui boekajeje duji ma, tabagudu kaba; paga karega, nowu inodu umode tudowuje rugadu, mare oto pa rugadu karega roga.
source: Tameardumode boe erugodumode puidu padui boekajeje duji ma, tabagudu kaba; paga karega, nowu inodu umode tudowuje rugadu, mare oto pa rugadu karega roga.

b: Moto padui pudabowuge erugodumode pui jice woje, jice woje; moto amagadumode makareu boe eeda joki, boe eke boimode boei; nowu inodu okorimodeboe boe paru rema.
source: Moto padui pudabowuge erugodumode pui jice woje, jice woje; moto amagadumode makareu boe eeda joki, boe eke boimode boei; nowu inodu okorimodeboe boe paru rema.

b: Taeto tai, boe emode tumugudo tawugeje brae eimejerage etoiagi, boe emode boe to tai sinagogadoge etada, tajedodumode brae eimejerage etae igoia, tamagowo iiboe jokoduji eegai.
source: Taeto tai, boe emode tumugudo tawugeje brae eimejerage etoiagi, boe emode boe to tai sinagogadoge etada, tajedodumode brae eimejerage etae igoia, tamagowo iiboe jokoduji eegai.

b: Mare ema remawure Pao o bakaru maiwu pemegareu kuodumode moto jamedu boe keje boe akedumodedu otodai.
source: Mare ema remawure Pao o bakaru maiwu pemegareu kuodumode moto jamedu boe keje boe akedumodedu otodai.

b: Tajedodumode tajebage etae du keje, tameardaekaba tamagomode jiboe bogai, mare tamagomode padure cai tagajejewu tawadaruji. Mare paga karega, tagi karega tagagomode oinono, mare Aroe Pemegareure makomode taiabiji.
source: Tajedodumode tajebage etae du keje, tameardaekaba tamagomode jiboe bogai, mare tamagomode padure cai tagajejewu tawadaruji. Mare paga karega, tagi karega tagagomode oinono, mare Aroe Pemegareure makomode taiabiji.

b: Umanareboe umode tuwie bito, uoreboe umode tonaregedu bito. Boe etore etonamode tuomagei tuwo ewido.
source: Umanareboe umode tuwie bito, uoreboe umode tonaregedu bito. Boe etore etonamode tuomagei tuwo ewido.

b: Boe eiamedu boe ekodu kagirimode tai ikie koia. Mare iedu rakamode pudui jii nowu inodu oto kaewu, inorudodumode.
source: Boe eiamedu boe ekodu kagirimode tai ikie koia. Mare iedu rakamode pudui jii nowu inodu oto kaewu, inorudodumode.

b: Taerdumode boe pegareu remawu jetui boe pemegareu muga keje (makomode awu atugododure jiwu umode pawuje), kode, jeture Judéia kejewuge eregodudo torekare boeto.
source: Taerdumode boe pegareu remawu jetui boe pemegareu muga keje (makomode awu atugododure jiwu umode pawuje), kode, jeture Judéia kejewuge eregodudo torekare boeto.

b: Jeture bai aogejewuge ekaba turawuje tuwo turemo baito tuwo iaboe reko piji.
source: Jeture bai aogejewuge ekaba turawuje tuwo turemo baito tuwo iaboe reko piji.

b: Jeture toro boe tadawuge ekaba tugirimi tuwai kae tugudae bogai.
source: Jeture toro boe tadawuge ekaba tugirimi tuwai kae tugudae bogai.

b: Jiwo pegamode cewu kuiarureu areme, cewu ure tore kugure enogwagirido kimowuge!
source: Jiwo pegamode cewu kuiarureu areme, cewu ure tore kugure enogwagirido kimowuge!

b: Tagogwamagududo nowu inodu ukawo tudowuje biaku butu tabo.
source: Tagogwamagududo nowu inodu ukawo tudowuje biaku butu tabo.

b: Paga karega, nowu kodiwu keje boe ecebae kuricigomode. Pao ui boe etowujedu paru piji jii oino, umodukare ino pugeje jamedu.
source: Paga karega, nowu kodiwu keje boe ecebae kuricigomode. Pao ui boe etowujedu paru piji jii oino, umodukare ino pugeje jamedu.

b: Pao umodukare boe koborido ma, iaboe iaboe umodukare cinorudo. Mare umode boe koborido, tuwiapaga tabo ture tugeragu pudaewu pemegareugei.
source: Pao umodukare boe koborido ma, iaboe iaboe umodukare cinorudo. Mare umode boe koborido, tuwiapaga tabo ture tugeragu pudaewu pemegareugei.

b: Du kodi care, iaboe egomode: - Cristo reo. Emarice!  oino tai ma, tameartorukaba ji.
source: Du kodi care, iaboe egomode: - Cristo reo. Emarice!  oino tai ma, tameartorukaba ji.

b: Paga karega, makareuge emode Cristodo pudumi paga tu je, emode profetadogedo pudumi paga tu je, emode ia turo kurireu towuje tuwo pemegareuge eekuri pagado jamedu, turoiwamode du keje.
source: Paga karega, makareuge emode Cristodo pudumi paga tu je, emode profetadogedo pudumi paga tu je, emode ia turo kurireu towuje tuwo pemegareuge eekuri pagado jamedu, turoiwamode du keje.

b:
Tagirema, tameardu awadudo tai. Ica, inure taiagu tado tarugadu.
Imedu Onaregedu aregodomodedu.
source:
Tagirema, tameardu awadudo tai. Ica, inure taiagu tado tarugadu.
Imedu Onaregedu aregodomodedu.

b: Nowu kodiwu keje, nowu boe ecebae rekodaji, meri joku urugumodukare, ari urugumodukare.
source: Nowu kodiwu keje, nowu boe ecebae rekodaji, meri joku urugumodukare, ari urugumodukare.

b: Kuiejedoge ewudumode baru piji, baru tadawu ro rakareboe akedumode.
source: Kuiejedoge ewudumode baru piji, baru tadawu ro rakareboe akedumode.

b: Kode, du kejere icare boe eerdumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodui boetugu aogeje duji, turo rakareu tabo, turugu motu rakaguragareu tabo.
source: Kode, du kejere icare boe eerdumode Imedu Onaregedu aregodui boetugu aogeje duji, turo rakareu tabo, turugu motu rakaguragareu tabo.

b: Umode to tupadoge etarego tuwo baru paru jamedu jiwu pemegareuge eiamedu boe edo tudo pui.
source: Umode to tupadoge etarego tuwo baru paru jamedu jiwu pemegareuge eiamedu boe edo tudo pui.

b: Tado boe pa awu inodu remagudui figueira i jitu duji: itura boe kugudure du keje, aru botugodure du keje, taerduware butao oto aregoduie ure duji.
source: Tado boe pa awu inodu remagudui figueira i jitu duji: itura boe kugudure du keje, aru botugodure du keje, taerduware butao oto aregoduie ure duji.

b: Du reorere taerdumode icai inodu ui tudowuje du keje, taerduwamode Imedu Onaregedu puredugoduie ure baiporo kae duji.
source: Du reorere taerdumode icai inodu ui tudowuje du keje, taerduwamode Imedu Onaregedu puredugoduie ure baiporo kae duji.

b: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Awu inodu kodumodukare awu maiwu boe ekori.
source: Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Awu inodu kodumodukare awu maiwu boe ekori.

b: Moto, baru akedumode, mare iwadaru rema okwamodukare.
source: Moto, baru akedumode, mare iwadaru rema okwamodukare.

b: Mare nowu inodu umode tudowuje jiwu meri iaboe iaboe eerduwakare ji, jamedu baru tadawu tupadoge eerduwakare jamedu; ica, Imedu Onaregedu jorduwakare ji jamedu, mare tu Pao tu rugadu.
source: Mare nowu inodu umode tudowuje jiwu meri iaboe iaboe eerduwakare ji, jamedu baru tadawu tupadoge eerduwakare jamedu; ica, Imedu Onaregedu jorduwakare ji jamedu, mare tu Pao tu rugadu.

b: Tado nono iaboere nowu bakaruji, tameardu awadudo tai, mare paga karega, taerduwakare inoba boemodedu kejeba.
source: Tado nono iaboere nowu bakaruji, tameardu awadudo tai, mare paga karega, taerduwakare inoba boemodedu kejeba.

b: Umode nono ia imedu utumode tuwai pijidu, umode tudugarege eetudo tuwaiji, tui pu jorduwado tumaragodae boe jitu umode ia baiporo epa jetudo ei du reore.
source: Umode nono ia imedu utumode tuwai pijidu, umode tudugarege eetudo tuwaiji, tui pu jorduwado tumaragodae boe jitu umode ia baiporo epa jetudo ei du reore.

b: Kode, tagoebatodudo, paga karega, taerduwakare inoba boemodedu kejeba nowu cimejera aregodumode tuwai kae duji: meri rekodu tabo rabodu, iarema boecoji rakudu, iarema kogorigadoge egogodumode du keje rabodu, barogwa kododu tabo rabodu.
source: Kode, tagoebatodudo, paga karega, taerduwakare inoba boemodedu kejeba nowu cimejera aregodumode tuwai kae duji: meri rekodu tabo rabodu, iarema boecoji rakudu, iarema kogorigadoge egogodumode du keje rabodu, barogwa kododu tabo rabodu.

b: Paga karega, aregodumode du keje, jetukawo pa je tanu padu pagaji.
source: Paga karega, aregodumode du keje, jetukawo pa je tanu padu pagaji.

b: Imagore tai boe jamedu boe imagomode ino boe eiamedu boei: Tameardu awadudo tai.
source: Imagore tai boe jamedu boe imagomode ino boe eiamedu boei: Tameardu awadudo tai.

b: Boe emeardaere tuwo Jesus bito.
source: Boe emeardaere tuwo Jesus bito.

b: Meri pobe du rekodaji, petamode Pascoaji, amireu rokareuji jamedu. Boekarema, sacerdotedoge eimejerage, mare escribadoge eemarure tuwo tugeragu ji, je paga inoduji, tuwo bito du bogai.
source: Meri pobe du rekodaji, petamode Pascoaji, amireu rokareuji jamedu. Boekarema, sacerdotedoge eimejerage, mare escribadoge eemarure tuwo tugeragu ji, je paga inoduji, tuwo bito du bogai.

b:
Mare egore nowu peta keje kaegae, boe jokodukare kare boe erugodukawoe pui nowu inodu koia.
Jesus rakojei Betânia kejedu.
source:
Mare egore nowu peta keje kaegae, boe jokodukare kare boe erugodukawoe pui nowu inodu koia.
Jesus rakojei Betânia kejedu.

b: Jesus rakojere Betânia keje, Simão moci bare jiwu uwai tada. Mugure ira keje du kaere ia aredu ure turemo mato ia ruwobo motureu tabo okorobadui nardo oku roreu awadu tabo, mori kuricigore du tabo; ure nowu ruwobo motureu bowuje, ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aoto.
source: Jesus rakojere Betânia keje, Simão moci bare jiwu uwai tada. Mugure ira keje du kaere ia aredu ure turemo mato ia ruwobo motureu tabo okorobadui nardo oku roreu awadu tabo, mori kuricigore du tabo; ure nowu ruwobo motureu bowuje, ure nowu roreboe redo Jesus aoto.

b: Boekarema, ia emage ekorigodure, egore tudada: - Kodiba ure awu roreboe roto ja je?
source: Boekarema, ia emage ekorigodure, egore tudada: - Kodiba ure awu roreboe roto ja je?

b: Uia umode akirodo diieroi 300 cedu tabo uwo maku maku marenarue etai. Ekorigodure ji.
source: Uia umode akirodo diieroi 300 cedu tabo uwo maku maku marenarue etai. Ekorigodure ji.

b: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Piji, kodiba tagagoino ji? Unure turu pemegareudo ii.
source: Mare Jesus akore ei: - Piji, kodiba tagagoino ji? Unure turu pemegareudo ii.

b: Paga karega, marenarue emode tu tu tadoda; tagaidukeje taro pemegamode ei, mare imirema, imodukare jii oino tagabo.
source: Paga karega, marenarue emode tu tu tadoda; tagaidukeje taro pemegamode ei, mare imirema, imodukare jii oino tagabo.

b: Rore roiware tu jiboeji. Ure boekaguru roreu reko iiogi imedumode moto tadawu paru kae.
source: Rore roiware tu jiboeji. Ure boekaguru roreu reko iiogi imedumode moto tadawu paru kae.

b:
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Pao o bakaru maiwu kogadodumode kejewu moto jamedu boe, reorere awu roi iidu kogadodumode jamedu, boe ewia jetuwo ji.
Judas ui Jesus makudu.
source:
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Pao o bakaru maiwu kogadodumode kejewu moto jamedu boe, reorere awu roi iidu kogadodumode jamedu, boe ewia jetuwo ji.
Judas ui Jesus makudu.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge iai mito tu je du, iere Judas cedu, uture jice sacerdotedoge eimejera ae tuwo Jesus maku ai.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge iai mito tu je du, iere Judas cedu, uture jice sacerdotedoge eimejera ae tuwo Jesus maku ai.

b:
Awu inodu akaru koiare icare eegare kuricigore, egore tumoduie ia diiero maku ai. Icare jeemarure kakoduwu ia kodiboe kejeba tumode maku etai du bogai.
Jesus ui Páscoa towujedu.
source:
Awu inodu akaru koiare icare eegare kuricigore, egore tumoduie ia diiero maku ai. Icare jeemarure kakoduwu ia kodiboe kejeba tumode maku etai du bogai.
Jesus ui Páscoa towujedu.

b: Amireu rokare jiwu boetojiwu meri nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji: - Kaiba akaidumode cewo cegera pemegado pagogwagewo Pascoaji.
source: Amireu rokare jiwu boetojiwu meri nowu ure jorduwadowuge enoragodure ji: - Kaiba akaidumode cewo cegera pemegado pagogwagewo Pascoaji.

b: Icare ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge edo pobe tagoi ei oino du tabo: - Toro bakurireuto. Nono ia imedu kodumode tadogi pori tabo, pobo tabo.
source: Icare ure nowu ture jorduwadowuge edo pobe tagoi ei oino du tabo: - Toro bakurireuto. Nono ia imedu kodumode tadogi pori tabo, pobo tabo.

b: Tagodumode apo. Ure turemo baitowu keje tamagomode nowu uwaire nowu bai cewu imeduji: Cegimejera unorare ai kakoduwu bai tadaba inogwagemode ire jorduwadowuge ebo Pascoaji?
source: Tagodumode apo. Ure turemo baitowu keje tamagomode nowu uwaire nowu bai cewu imeduji: Cegimejera unorare ai kakoduwu bai tadaba inogwagemode ire jorduwadowuge ebo Pascoaji?

b: Umode taerdudo tu ia bai mugui puaogejedu ema remawuji ui turugadu duji. Nono tamode boedo turugadu nono.
source: Umode taerdudo tu ia bai mugui puaogejedu ema remawuji ui turugadu duji. Nono tamode boedo turugadu nono.

b: Icare cewu ure jorduwadowuge ei pobedu eture toro bakurireuto rugadu. Eerdure Jesus akoi umoduie duji rugadu, nonore icare ere Pascoamodedu udo turugadu nono.
source: Icare cewu ure jorduwadowuge ei pobedu eture toro bakurireuto rugadu. Eerdure Jesus akoi umoduie duji rugadu, nonore icare ere Pascoamodedu udo turugadu nono.

b: Meri rekodu tabore icare uture toro nowu ture jorduwadowuge eiamedu apo.
source: Meri rekodu tabore icare uture toro nowu ture jorduwadowuge eiamedu apo.

b: Emugui ira keje togwage tabo du keje, Jesus akore: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ia tai mito tu jedu, okwagere itabowu, koiare umode imagu.
source: Emugui ira keje togwage tabo du keje, Jesus akore: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ia tai mito tu jedu, okwagere itabowu, koiare umode imagu.

b: Ekiarigodure tu je, enoragodure tu ji puregodaji, egore: - Imi kana?
source: Ekiarigodure tu je, enoragodure tu ji puregodaji, egore: - Imi kana?

b: Akore ei: - Tai ikera pudogiduredu pobe taci iwurekotowuge ia tagi, okwage nure iprato mitoduto itabowu.
source: Akore ei: - Tai ikera pudogiduredu pobe taci iwurekotowuge ia tagi, okwage nure iprato mitoduto itabowu.

b:
Imedu Onaregedu kodumode, bapera atugoi pudui du reore. Mare jiwo pegamode nowu imedu ro koia ure Imedu Onaregedu makududodumode tuwidoduwo. Ema remawuia botumodukare du rema.
Jesus ui boe ekedo pudumidu.
source:
Imedu Onaregedu kodumode, bapera atugoi pudui du reore. Mare jiwo pegamode nowu imedu ro koia ure Imedu Onaregedu makududodumode tuwidoduwo. Ema remawuia botumodukare du rema.
Jesus ui boe ekedo pudumidu.

b: Enogwage tonaji, Jesus ure tugeragu amireuji, ure togwakurido tu je, du kejere ure tugera bu kajeje, ure maku etai, tagoi oino du tabo: - Emareo, kowuje, ikodu reo.
source: Enogwage tonaji, Jesus ure tugeragu amireuji, ure togwakurido tu je, du kejere ure tugera bu kajeje, ure maku etai, tagoi oino du tabo: - Emareo, kowuje, ikodu reo.

b: Du kejere ure tugeragu parera kuru ja roguji, ure togwa kurido tabo pugeje, ure maku etai, eiamedu kudure ce.
source: Du kejere ure tugeragu parera kuru ja roguji, ure togwa kurido tabo pugeje, ure maku etai, eiamedu kudure ce.

b: Akore ei: - Awu ikureo, bakaru maiwu jiwu iku, dure redodumode makareuge etai.
source: Akore ei: - Awu ikureo, bakaru maiwu jiwu iku, dure redodumode makareuge etai.

b:
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ikudumodukare parera kuruce pugeje jii, ikudumode ce pugeje Pao o boe pemegareu keje du kae.
Jesus ure Pedro bie.
source:
Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino tai: Ikudumodukare parera kuruce pugeje jii, ikudumode ce pugeje Pao o boe pemegareu keje du kae.
Jesus ure Pedro bie.

b: Turagodui tugeroia jitu akedu keje, eture toro Oliveira kejewu torekodu kae.
source: Turagodui tugeroia jitu akedu keje, eture toro Oliveira kejewu torekodu kae.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Taiamedu boe meardae begamode, mare paga karega, atugododure oino: Imode jeture nowu barege kugure eiwu korido, dukeje eromode ja tuku je (Zac 8,7).
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Taiamedu boe meardae begamode, mare paga karega, atugododure oino: Imode jeture nowu barege kugure eiwu korido, dukeje eromode ja tuku je (Zac 8,7).

b: Mare iewodumode du rekodaji ipagamode tawogai Galiléia keje.
source: Mare iewodumode du rekodaji ipagamode tawogai Galiléia keje.

b: Mare Pedro akore ji: - Boe eiamedu boe emeardae begamode ai ma, imodukare ino rugadu.
source: Mare Pedro akore ji: - Boe eiamedu boe emeardae begamode ai ma, imodukare ino rugadu.

b: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: Awu boeco rugadu jire kogariga akogodumode pobe du otodai, amode aerduwa bokwado ii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.
source: Icare Jesus akore ji: - Boe jokodu jire inagomode oino ai: Awu boeco rugadu jire kogariga akogodumode pobe du otodai, amode aerduwa bokwado ii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

b:
Mare Pedro akore ji pugeje: - Iwidodumode akabo, mare iwo iorduwa bokwado ai du umodukare. Eiamedu boe egore oinoduji jamedu.
Jesus makoi tuoji Getsmani kejedu.
source:
Mare Pedro akore ji pugeje: - Iwidodumode akabo, mare iwo iorduwa bokwado ai du umodukare. Eiamedu boe egore oinoduji jamedu.
Jesus makoi tuoji Getsmani kejedu.

b: Du kejere eture ia boe eeda iei Getsmani cedu kae. Nonore icare Jesus akore ture jorduwadowugei: - Tamugudo tu woe jao imagoi baruto du tonaji.
source: Du kejere eture ia boe eeda iei Getsmani cedu kae. Nonore icare Jesus akore ture jorduwadowugei: - Tamugudo tu woe jao imagoi baruto du tonaji.

b: Ure Pedro, Tiago, João eko pudabo. Icare kugudugodure tu pudabo, kiarigodure tu je.
source: Ure Pedro, Tiago, João eko pudabo. Icare kugudugodure tu pudabo, kiarigodure tu je.

b:
Icare akore ei: -
Itaroe kiarigodure iwimodedu kae, taedo woe, tagurodudo tu je.
source:
Icare akore ei: -
Itaroe kiarigodure iwimodedu kae, taedo woe, tagurodudo tu je.

b: Icare ure tuwure taru tu epiji, nonore ure tubujodo kuri tuku mototo, makore Paoji, akore uia turugadu awu boemode inowu koduia tugori.
source: Icare ure tuwure taru tu epiji, nonore ure tubujodo kuri tuku mototo, makore Paoji, akore uia turugadu awu boemode inowu koduia tugori.

b: Akore: - Ioga, aroiware boe jameduji, awu icebae roto oino ipiji, mare ukaba itaidu reore, mare udo nono akaidu reore.
source: Akore: - Ioga, aroiware boe jameduji, awu icebae roto oino ipiji, mare ukaba itaidu reore, mare udo nono akaidu reore.

b: Du kejere uture nowu ture jorduwadowuge etae, boekarema jeture pa enu padu pagaji.
source: Du kejere uture nowu ture jorduwadowuge etae, boekarema jeture pa enu padu pagaji.

b: Akore Pedroji: Simão, anudu nure? Akurodumodukare tu jao. Tagurodudo, tamagodo tabaru tabo, tameardae pegareu butu kawo tawugeje, mare paga karega, boe etaroere turugadu, mare boe ekodu rema kugudugodu nure.
source: Akore Pedroji: Simão, anudu nure? Akurodumodukare tu jao. Tagurodudo, tamagodo tabaru tabo, tameardae pegareu butu kawo tawugeje, mare paga karega, boe etaroere turugadu, mare boe ekodu rema kugudugodu nure.

b: Ure turodo boku ei pugeje, makore Paoji pugeje, tumagoi cewu tuwadaru mitodu jitu tabo.
source: Ure turodo boku ei pugeje, makore Paoji pugeje, tumagoi cewu tuwadaru mitodu jitu tabo.

b: Tui tugirimi du tabo, jordure enu padu biji pugeje. Paga karega nore kori remawu nure eeku jitu kodi. Eerduwakare inoba tagomode duji.
source: Tui tugirimi du tabo, jordure enu padu biji pugeje. Paga karega nore kori remawu nure eeku jitu kodi. Eerduwakare inoba tagomode duji.

b: Boekarema, ure tugirimi pugeje, tagoi ei du tabo: - Tanududo, tagamudo. Urugadu. Boe aregodure pudae. Imedu Onaregedu makudumode ro pegareuge ekera kai.
source: Boekarema, ure tugirimi pugeje, tagoi ei du tabo: - Tanududo, tagamudo. Urugadu. Boe aregodure pudae. Imedu Onaregedu makudumode ro pegareuge ekera kai.

b:
Taragojedo, marigu paduwo! Cewu umode imaguwu puredugodure. 
- Boei tugeragu Jesus jidu.
source:
Taragojedo, marigu paduwo! Cewu umode imaguwu puredugodure. 
- Boei tugeragu Jesus jidu.

b: Mako kimoredu kaere, Judas Iscarite, nowu ia ure jorduwadowu, aregodure. Apore ia makareuge ekodure, tugedui toriga jitu tabo, ipo jitu tabo. Baire eimejerage, escribadoge, boe codudoge, eigoiare ere erodo ino.
source: Mako kimoredu kaere, Judas Iscarite, nowu ia ure jorduwadowu, aregodure. Apore ia makareuge ekodure, tugedui toriga jitu tabo, ipo jitu tabo. Baire eimejerage, escribadoge, boe codudoge, eigoiare ere erodo ino.

b: Boekare, cewu umode edo turugadu jiwu ure bakarudo turugadu ei, akore: - Cewu imode inogwabi jiwu, ema reno, tageragu ji, reko toro, mare butugu tabo.
source: Boekare, cewu umode edo turugadu jiwu ure bakarudo turugadu ei, akore: - Cewu imode inogwabi jiwu, ema reno, tageragu ji, reko toro, mare butugu tabo.

b: Icare tui tuburedo Jesus jitu tabo, akore ji: - Ikimejera. Ure togwabi ji tu je.
source: Icare tui tuburedo Jesus jitu tabo, akore ji: - Ikimejera. Ure togwabi ji tu je.

b: Icare ere taredo ai, ere tugeragu ji.
source: Icare ere taredo ai, ere tugeragu ji.

b: Icare nowu ia rakoje puredure nono jiwu, ure tariga raireu tawuje, ure nowu baire eimejera ia utugare bia kado.
source: Icare nowu ia rakoje puredure nono jiwu, ure tariga raireu tawuje, ure nowu baire eimejera ia utugare bia kado.

b: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tare tarodo nono boe ero magai ia ropegareu jitu reore taroi tariga raireu tabo, ipo tabo iwogai duji.
source: Icare Jesus akore ei: - Tare tarodo nono boe ero magai ia ropegareu jitu reore taroi tariga raireu tabo, ipo tabo iwogai duji.

b: Mare nowu inodu boe tada, iragojere tagabo meri jameduji, ii boe eerduwado Pao uwai tada du tabo, mare takare tageragu ii. Mare oino awu inodu ure tudowuje, uwo nono bapera atugo pemegareu reore.
source: Mare nowu inodu boe tada, iragojere tagabo meri jameduji, ii boe eerduwado Pao uwai tada du tabo, mare takare tageragu ii. Mare oino awu inodu ure tudowuje, uwo nono bapera atugo pemegareu reore.

b: Nonore icare eiamedu boe ere pijido, eregodure piji.
source: Nonore icare eiamedu boe ere pijido, eregodure piji.

b: Ia iparedu kodure rekodaji aroia kigadu upoi tu pudabo. Boekarema, ere tugeragu ji.
source: Ia iparedu kodure rekodaji aroia kigadu upoi tu pudabo. Boekarema, ere tugeragu ji.

b:
Mare ure tugera ra nowu opore pudabowu aroia piji, rekodure tuwiri kedo tabo.
Jesus rakojei judeudoge eimejerage ei tudo puidu eegoraidu.
source:
Mare ure tugera ra nowu opore pudabowu aroia piji, rekodure tuwiri kedo tabo.
Jesus rakojei judeudoge eimejerage ei tudo puidu eegoraidu.

b: Ekodure Jesus apo baire eimejerage ewai kae. Cewu baire, escribadoge, boe codudoge ere tudo puiwo kae.
source: Ekodure Jesus apo baire eimejerage ewai kae. Cewu baire, escribadoge, boe codudoge ere tudo puiwo kae.

b: Pedro kodure rekodaji, tui tuiedu jaedo jitu tabo kuri tuku ewororo kae. Nonore ure tumugudo tu oebatodureuge ebo, joru okwai, ure towarudo tu je.
source: Pedro kodure rekodaji, tui tuiedu jaedo jitu tabo kuri tuku ewororo kae. Nonore ure tumugudo tu oebatodureuge ebo, joru okwai, ure towarudo tu je.

b: Baire eimejerage, nowu jeture nonowuge eiamedu boe eemarure pui kakoduwu ia puba readodumode roji tuwo maku bitoduwo du bogai. Mare eerdukare iaboeji iaboeji.
source: Baire eimejerage, nowu jeture nonowuge eiamedu boe eemarure pui kakoduwu ia puba readodumode roji tuwo maku bitoduwo du bogai. Mare eerdukare iaboeji iaboeji.

b: Makareuge enogiru pegare ji, mare nowu egoi jitu ukare turugadu pui.
source: Makareuge enogiru pegare ji, mare nowu egoi jitu ukare turugadu pui.

b: Icarema iagere turagojedo tuwadararodui jitu tabo.
source: Icarema iagere turagojedo tuwadararodui jitu tabo.

b: Egore: - Cemeardure akoi: Imode awu Pao uwai todui ime ekera tabodu butudo, mare meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, imode ia to pugeje, mare ime ekera tabowu karega, oinoduji
source: Egore: - Cemeardure akoi: Imode awu Pao uwai todui ime ekera tabodu butudo, mare meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje, imode ia to pugeje, mare ime ekera tabowu karega, oinoduji

b: Mare nowu egoi jitu jetukare ji.
source: Mare nowu egoi jitu jetukare ji.

b: Icare baire eimejera ure turagojedo taci tumedage etoiabiji, unoragodure Jesusji, akore ji: - Inoba ure? Amagomodukare iaboeji iaboeji? Kakodiboe jiba egore oino ai?
source: Icare baire eimejera ure turagojedo taci tumedage etoiabiji, unoragodure Jesusji, akore ji: - Inoba ure? Amagomodukare iaboeji iaboeji? Kakodiboe jiba egore oino ai?

b: Mare Jesus ukare tagodo ia tago. Icare baire eimejera unoragodure ji pugeje: - Akina Cristore aki? Aroe Eimejera Pemegareu Onaregedu nure aki?
source: Mare Jesus ukare tagodo ia tago. Icare baire eimejera unoragodure ji pugeje: - Akina Cristore aki? Aroe Eimejera Pemegareu Onaregedu nure aki?

b: Jesus akore: - U! Imi rugadu. Taerdumode Imedu Onaregedu mugui Pao ro rakareu kana pemegareu jaogwai duji, aregodui baru pijiwu boetugu aogeje duji.
source: Jesus akore: - U! Imi rugadu. Taerdumode Imedu Onaregedu mugui Pao ro rakareu kana pemegareu jaogwai duji, aregodui baru pijiwu boetugu aogeje duji.

b: Du kodi icare nowu baire eimejera, ure tugerado ja... tugudae keje. Icare tumago raka tabo akore: - Kodiba paemarumode ia boe readodui ro pegareuji du bogai pugeje?
source: Du kodi icare nowu baire eimejera, ure tugerado ja... tugudae keje. Icare tumago raka tabo akore: - Kodiba paemarumode ia boe readodui ro pegareuji du bogai pugeje?

b: Tameardure bataru pegareuji oino. Inoba ure taegai?  Eiamedu boe egore uie turugadu bitoduwo.
source: Tameardure bataru pegareuji oino. Inoba ure taegai?  Eiamedu boe egore uie turugadu bitoduwo.

b:
Kodi icare iagere todoguru to ji, ere aroia upodo je tabo, ere tugimori to ji, egore ji: - Roinowu pawuje.
Pedro ui tuiorduwa bokwado Jesus jitu.
source:
Kodi icare iagere todoguru to ji, ere aroia upodo je tabo, ere tugimori to ji, egore ji: - Roinowu pawuje.
Pedro ui tuiorduwa bokwado Jesus jitu.

b: Pedro mugui toro comoroi ewororo keje du kejere, nowu baire eimejera ia utugare aredu aregodure.
source: Pedro mugui toro comoroi ewororo keje du kejere, nowu baire eimejera ia utugare aredu aregodure.

b: Ure tuioku kidudo Pedroji tu... ui towarudo duji, akore: - Aki jamedu aragojere Jesus Nazaré kejewu apo.
source: Ure tuioku kidudo Pedroji tu... ui towarudo duji, akore: - Aki jamedu aragojere Jesus Nazaré kejewu apo.

b: Akore: - Iorduwakare akagoino jiboeji. Ikare akagoino jiboe pawuje. Ure tuiebu ewororo kaewu baiporoji. Du kejere icare kogariga akogodure.
source: Akore: - Iorduwakare akagoino jiboeji. Ikare akagoino jiboe pawuje. Ure tuiebu ewororo kaewu baiporoji. Du kejere icare kogariga akogodure.

b: Cewu jordure jiwu aredu akore nonowugei: - Awu meture ecewuge etada.
source: Cewu jordure jiwu aredu akore nonowugei: - Awu meture ecewuge etada.

b: Icare Pedrore tuiorduwa bokwado pobe ji. Inodu rekodaji kuri je, nowu jeture nonowuge egore Pedroji pugeje: - Boe jokodu ecewuge etumeduia akireo. Paga karega, Galiléia pijiwu nure aki.
source: Icare Pedrore tuiorduwa bokwado pobe ji. Inodu rekodaji kuri je, nowu jeture nonowuge egore Pedroji pugeje: - Boe jokodu ecewuge etumeduia akireo. Paga karega, Galiléia pijiwu nure aki.

b: Du kejere icare bataru pegare, akore: - Iorduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji. Oinore akore tugorigodu pegareu tabo.
source: Du kejere icare bataru pegare, akore: - Iorduwakare nowu tagagoino jiwu imeduji. Oinore akore tugorigodu pegareu tabo.

b: Nowu inodu keje kuri je, kogariga akogodure pugeje pobe. Icare Pedro biabuture cewu Jesus akore puduiwo keje: - Kogariga akogodumode pobe du otodai, amode aerduwa bokwado ii pobe ma awu metuia bokware. Boekare akore kui... toragudu tabo.
source: Nowu inodu keje kuri je, kogariga akogodure pugeje pobe. Icare Pedro biabuture cewu Jesus akore puduiwo keje: - Kogariga akogodumode pobe du otodai, amode aerduwa bokwado ii pobe ma awu metuia bokware. Boekare akore kui... toragudu tabo.

b: Jesus rakojei Pilato jokoraidu.
source: Jesus rakojei Pilato jokoraidu.

b: Kuri barogwa kododu tabo, baire eimejerage, codureu boe, escribadoge, ere tudo pui. Ere Jesus ieragogudo, ere reko Pilato ae ere maku ai tu je.
source: Kuri barogwa kododu tabo, baire eimejerage, codureu boe, escribadoge, ere tudo pui. Ere Jesus ieragogudo, ere reko Pilato ae ere maku ai tu je.

b: Icare Pilato unorare ji: - Akina judeudoge eimejera kurireure aki?  Akore: - U!
source: Icare Pilato unorare ji: - Akina judeudoge eimejera kurireure aki?  Akore: - U!

b: Du tonajire icare baire eimejerage ere roiaododu kuricigodo.
source: Du tonajire icare baire eimejerage ere roiaododu kuricigodo.

b: Pilato unoragodure ji pugeje, akore: - Amagomodukare? Awiapagakare awuge egoi aro pegareu boe jituji?
source: Pilato unoragodure ji pugeje, akore: - Amagomodukare? Awiapagakare awuge egoi aro pegareu boe jituji?

b: Mare Jesus makokare iaboeji iaboeji pugeje. Du koiare Pilato je rore ta je.
source: Mare Jesus makokare iaboeji iaboeji pugeje. Du koiare Pilato je rore ta je.

b: Boekarema, roiare tui ia meture baicoreu tadawuge ia tawuje petare tu tu jiwu meriji, cewu enogwamagudumode jiwuji.
source: Boekarema, roiare tui ia meture baicoreu tadawuge ia tawuje petare tu tu jiwu meriji, cewu enogwamagudumode jiwuji.

b: Ia iei Barrabás cedu mugure nono du ere tugeragu ji ia metage pegareuge ebo, ure ia tumeduia bito du kodi.
source: Ia iei Barrabás cedu mugure nono du ere tugeragu ji ia metage pegareuge ebo, ure ia tumeduia bito du kodi.

b: Boe erudure toro ae, enogwamagudure ji nowu roia bogai.
source: Boe erudure toro ae, enogwamagudure ji nowu roia bogai.

b: Pilato akore ei: - Tagaidukana iwo judeudoge eimejera inorudo?  10(Jorduware baire eimejerageie maku tugori koia jitu duji, du koiare akoino).
source: Pilato akore ei: - Tagaidukana iwo judeudoge eimejera inorudo?  10(Jorduware baire eimejerageie maku tugori koia jitu duji, du koiare akoino).

b: Mare baire eimejerage egore boei boe enogwamaguduwo Barrabás ema remawuie tawujedumode dure ema.
source: Mare baire eimejerage egore boei boe enogwamaguduwo Barrabás ema remawuie tawujedumode dure ema.

b: Icare Pilato akore: - Inoba tagaidure irowo tagagore judeudoge eimejeraie emawuji?
source: Icare Pilato akore: - Inoba tagaidure irowo tagagore judeudoge eimejeraie emawuji?

b: Icare ere toiogwarido pugeje, egore: - Bu i keje!
source: Icare ere toiogwarido pugeje, egore: - Bu i keje!

b: Pilato akore: - Kode inoba ro pegareu ure?  Ere toiogwari rakado pugeje, egore: - Bu i keje!
source: Pilato akore: - Kode inoba ro pegareu ure?  Ere toiogwari rakado pugeje, egore: - Bu i keje!

b:
Pilato aidure tuwo nowu boe eegaredo, du kodire icare ure Barrabás inorudo etai, ure Jesus maku etai ewo bu i keje, tui boe to jitu rekodaji.
Tugobaigaregere turo tago amado Jesus jitu.
source:
Pilato aidure tuwo nowu boe eegaredo, du kodire icare ure Barrabás inorudo etai, ure Jesus maku etai ewo bu i keje, tui boe to jitu rekodaji.
Tugobaigaregere turo tago amado Jesus jitu.

b: Utorigaraidoge ere Jesus reko toro ia boiadowu ewororo kae, nowu tugobaigarege ewaito, nono ere tugobaigarege epadui pumekejedu boe eto pui nono.
source: Utorigaraidoge ere Jesus reko toro ia boiadowu ewororo kae, nowu tugobaigarege ewaito, nono ere tugobaigarege epadui pumekejedu boe eto pui nono.

b: Ere aroia urugureu tugu tu Jesusji, ere boto enado ere udo nono boe etaogajejewu reore, du ere to coku aoto.
source: Ere aroia urugureu tugu tu Jesusji, ere boto enado ere udo nono boe etaogajejewu reore, du ere to coku aoto.

b: Icare ere cimadudo apo tagoi oino du tabo: - Aegaredo, judeudoge eimejera kurireu!
source: Icare ere cimadudo apo tagoi oino du tabo: - Aegaredo, judeudoge eimejera kurireu!

b: Ere tugeragu ia ipoji, ere to aoraji, ere todoguru to ji, ere tubujodo ji, tui turo amado jitu tabo.
source: Ere tugeragu ia ipoji, ere to aoraji, ere todoguru to ji, ere tubujodo ji, tui turo amado jitu tabo.

b:
Tui turorerudo jitu akedu keje, ere cewu aroia urugureu tawuje piji, ere cewu ukudae maku ai pugeje, ere tuiebu apo tuwo bu i padui pugajejedu keje.
Jesus padui i padui pugajejedu keje.
source:
Tui turorerudo jitu akedu keje, ere cewu aroia urugureu tawuje piji, ere cewu ukudae maku ai pugeje, ere tuiebu apo tuwo bu i padui pugajejedu keje.
Jesus padui i padui pugajejedu keje.

b: Cirene pijiwu ia imedu, kodure nonodu, iei Simão cedu, aregodui boepa pijidu, Alexandre, Rufo etuo, ere udo tudugu nowu Jesus o i padui pugajeje duji.
source: Cirene pijiwu ia imedu, kodure nonodu, iei Simão cedu, aregodui boepa pijidu, Alexandre, Rufo etuo, ere udo tudugu nowu Jesus o i padui pugajeje duji.

b: Ere Jesus reko ia iere Gólgota, ino jiboe kae. Awu iere oinowu ure oino “Boe etaora ra jeta”.
source: Ere Jesus reko ia iere Gólgota, ino jiboe kae. Awu iere oinowu ure oino “Boe etaora ra jeta”.

b: Ere kududo kuru jirireboe metui parera kuru tadaduce. Mare aidukare ji.
source: Ere kududo kuru jirireboe metui parera kuru tadaduce. Mare aidukare ji.

b: Tui bu i padui pugajejedu keje, ere ukudae pedo pui, kakoduwu, ia pudumiba jeonamode jitu bogai.
source: Tui bu i padui pugajejedu keje, ere ukudae pedo pui, kakoduwu, ia pudumiba jeonamode jitu bogai.

b: Meri jetui baru oiadoda, ere bu i padui pugajejedu keje.
source: Meri jetui baru oiadoda, ere bu i padui pugajejedu keje.

b: Nowu padure kejewu i ao keje ere bapera atugo bu, akore: “Judeudoge Eimejera Kurireu”
source: Nowu padure kejewu i ao keje ere bapera atugo bu, akore: “Judeudoge Eimejera Kurireu”

b: Ere ia ro pegareuge ewu i keje apodu ere pobe: ia okwacere kana pemegareu jaogwai, ia okwacere kana koboreu jaogwai.
source: Ere ia ro pegareuge ewu i keje apodu ere pobe: ia okwacere kana pemegareu jaogwai, ia okwacere kana koboreu jaogwai.

b: Oinore bapera atugo kodui pudui dure oino: “Iegidodure boe pegareuge ebo”.
source: Oinore bapera atugo kodui pudui dure oino: “Iegidodure boe pegareuge ebo”.

b: Cewu kodure nono koriwu boe erorerure ji, ere taora roto bai bai, tagoi oino du tabo: - Aró! Kode, akire Pao uwai butudo, pemegadoduwo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje.
source: Cewu kodure nono koriwu boe erorerure ji, ere taora roto bai bai, tagoi oino du tabo: - Aró! Kode, akire Pao uwai butudo, pemegadoduwo meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du keje.

b: Kode akinorudo akaobiji. Arawuje nowu i piji.
source: Kode akinorudo akaobiji. Arawuje nowu i piji.

b: Du reorere baire eimejerage, escribadoge egore pui tui togorido jitu tabo, egore : - Ure iaboe einorudo, pudumire icare roiwakare tuwo cinorudo.
source: Du reorere baire eimejerage, escribadoge egore pui tui togorido jitu tabo, egore : - Ure iaboe einorudo, pudumire icare roiwakare tuwo cinorudo.

b:
Kode Israeldoge eimejera kurireu nure ema, kode udo turawuje i piji ma, paerduwo, pameartoruwo. Nowu padure i keje apowuge emago pegare ji jamedu.
Jesus biredu.
source:
Kode Israeldoge eimejera kurireu nure ema, kode udo turawuje i piji ma, paerduwo, pameartoruwo. Nowu padure i keje apowuge emago pegare ji jamedu.
Jesus biredu.

b: Meri jetui baru oia keje du piji jii meri jogodu kae, boeco kurireu mugure moto jamedu boe keje.
source: Meri jetui baru oia keje du piji jii meri jogodu kae, boeco kurireu mugure moto jamedu boe keje.

b: Meri jogodu kejere, Jesusre toiogwari rakaguragado tagoi oino du tabo: - Eloi, Eloi, lamma sabactani  Dure oino: - Ioga, Ioga, kodiba are ipijido?
source: Meri jogodu kejere, Jesusre toiogwari rakaguragado tagoi oino du tabo: - Eloi, Eloi, lamma sabactani  Dure oino: - Ioga, Ioga, kodiba are ipijido?

b: Icare ia jeture nonowuge, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, egore: - Mako nure Elias bogai.
source: Icare ia jeture nonowuge, tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, egore: - Mako nure Elias bogai.

b: Nowu ia mito tu jedu rekodure, ure boe otogugudu tugu ia pagodureboe kuruto, ure bu tu ia ipobigodu oto keje, ure kududo ce, tagoi oino du tabo: - Pawo pagado tu Eliasmode turawuje du bogai.
source: Nowu ia mito tu jedu rekodure, ure boe otogugudu tugu ia pagodureboe kuruto, ure bu tu ia ipobigodu oto keje, ure kududo ce, tagoi oino du tabo: - Pawo pagado tu Eliasmode turawuje du bogai.

b: Jesus oiogwari rakareu padure boe kajeje.
source: Jesus oiogwari rakareu padure boe kajeje.

b: Inodu tonaji, Pao uwai tadawu aroia boareu ure tuwowuje togwa cobojewu piji ja tuku woje moto kae. Kodi icare megare pobe tu je.
source: Inodu tonaji, Pao uwai tadawu aroia boareu ure tuwowuje togwa cobojewu piji ja tuku woje moto kae. Kodi icare megare pobe tu je.

b: Torigaraidoge eimejera rakojere Jesus jokorai toebatodu tabo ji, tuiordui akurui toiogwari rakareu tabodu jitu keje, akore: - Awu imedu boe jokoduradu Pao Onaregedu rema.
source: Torigaraidoge eimejera rakojere Jesus jokorai toebatodu tabo ji, tuiordui akurui toiogwari rakareu tabodu jitu keje, akore: - Awu imedu boe jokoduradu Pao Onaregedu rema.

b: Ia areme eedure nonodu etaiwore ae turagoje jaei jitu tabo. Du etada Maria Madalenare, Maria, Tiago biegareu mare José etujere, Salomere,
source: Ia areme eedure nonodu etaiwore ae turagoje jaei jitu tabo. Du etada Maria Madalenare, Maria, Tiago biegareu mare José etujere, Salomere,

b:
Duwugere ekodure apo, eeture ji, rakojei Galiléia tada du keje. Iage emagare pugeje, duwugere ekodure apo Jerusalém kae.
Jesus tugudui tori todu.
source:
Duwugere ekodure apo, eeture ji, rakojei Galiléia tada du keje. Iage emagare pugeje, duwugere ekodure apo Jerusalém kae.
Jesus tugudui tori todu.

b: Icare, meri rekodure du keje, (nowu meri jire boere tugera pemegado petaji, sabadore jiwu okea keje).
source: Icare, meri rekodure du keje, (nowu meri jire boere tugera pemegado petaji, sabadore jiwu okea keje).

b: Icare José Arimatia pijiwu, jorduwa rakareu imedu, upagare jamedu Pao o boe pemegareu bogaidu, aregodure, ure tugidado pudui taci Pilato ae, okwamagudure ji uwo Jesus maku pudai.
source: Icare José Arimatia pijiwu, jorduwa rakareu imedu, upagare jamedu Pao o boe pemegareu bogaidu, aregodure, ure tugidado pudui taci Pilato ae, okwamagudure ji uwo Jesus maku pudai.

b: Pilato jerore ta... Jesus akuru marigudui kuri je duji. Kodi icare, Pilato makore torigaraidoge eimejera bogai, unoragodure ji marigudu rakuduie Jesus akurure du bogai.
source: Pilato jerore ta... Jesus akuru marigudui kuri je duji. Kodi icare, Pilato makore torigaraidoge eimejera bogai, unoragodure ji marigudu rakuduie Jesus akurure du bogai.

b: Nowu torigaraidoge eimejera akore uie, boe rugaduie. Kodi icare akore uiagu maku cewu okwamagudure bogaiwu ai.
source: Nowu torigaraidoge eimejera akore uie, boe rugaduie. Kodi icare akore uiagu maku cewu okwamagudure bogaiwu ai.

b: Josere ia aroia kigadureu aru, icare ure rawuje i padui pugajejedu piji, ure aroia upodo apo, ure tugu ia aroe eiao mugui tori poroto duto. Kodi icare ure ia tori roto kororo jice tuwo bu je keje du bogai.
source: Josere ia aroia kigadureu aru, icare ure rawuje i padui pugajejedu piji, ure aroia upodo apo, ure tugu ia aroe eiao mugui tori poroto duto. Kodi icare ure ia tori roto kororo jice tuwo bu je keje du bogai.

b: Maria Madalena, mare José uce Maria, enoebatodure jice ure tuguwo kae.
source: Maria Madalena, mare José uce Maria, enoebatodure jice ure tuguwo kae.

b: Jesus jewodu.
source: Jesus jewodu.

b: Sabadore jiwu meri akedure du keje, Maria Madalena, mare Tiago uce Maria, mare Salom ere akirodo ia roreboeji tuwo reko Jesus joki.
source: Sabadore jiwu meri akedure du keje, Maria Madalena, mare Tiago uce Maria, mare Salom ere akirodo ia roreboeji tuwo reko Jesus joki.

b: Icare semanamode turemo jiwu meri boetojiwuji, meri rutu keje kuri je, eture toro meturewo kae.
source: Icare semanamode turemo jiwu meri boetojiwuji, meri rutu keje kuri je, eture toro meturewo kae.

b: Egore pui: - Ioguduba umode nowu tori roto oino pagai meturewo je piji?
source: Egore pui: - Ioguduba umode nowu tori roto oino pagai meturewo je piji?

b: Icarema, tui tuie awogado du tabo, eerdure nowu tori kurireu padukai tumuga kejeduji.
source: Icarema, tui tuie awogado du tabo, eerdure nowu tori kurireu padukai tumuga kejeduji.

b: Icare ere turemo nowu aroe eiaoto, du tadare eerdure ia iparedu mugui kana pemegareu jaogwai tugudae kigadu tabo duji, icare epagudugodure.
source: Icare ere turemo nowu aroe eiaoto, du tadare eerdure ia iparedu mugui kana pemegareu jaogwai tugudae kigadu tabo duji, icare epagudugodure.

b: Icare akore ei: - Tabagudu kaba. Jesus Nazaré pijiwu, padudodui i kejedu bogaire taroino. Boekimo. Padukare woe. Jewodure marigudu. Ica: padurewo reo.
source: Icare akore ei: - Tabagudu kaba. Jesus Nazaré pijiwu, padudodui i kejedu bogaire taroino. Boekimo. Padukare woe. Jewodure marigudu. Ica: padurewo reo.

b: Kodi icare, toro! Tamagodo nowu ture jorduwadowugei. Pedroji jamedu. Tamagodo ei akoe tubagamode ewogai Galiléia keje, toroie taerdumode pudui, cewu tagore tai du reore.
source: Kodi icare, toro! Tamagodo nowu ture jorduwadowugei. Pedroji jamedu. Tamagodo ei akoe tubagamode ewogai Galiléia keje, toroie taerdumode pudui, cewu tagore tai du reore.

b:
Kodi icare eture nowu aroe eiao piji, tamagadui, tubagudu tabo du tabo. Emagokare iaboei iaboei tubagudu koia.
Jesus ui towadudo Maria Madalena aidu.
source:
Kodi icare eture nowu aroe eiao piji, tamagadui, tubagudu tabo du tabo. Emagokare iaboei iaboei tubagudu koia.
Jesus ui towadudo Maria Madalena aidu.

b: Jesus, tuiewodui barogwa kododu tabo, semanamode turemo jiwu meri boetojiwu jitu keje, ure towadudo boetoji Maria Madalena jekai. Cewu ure  Aroe pegareuge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu ewarigu pijiwudo.
source: Jesus, tuiewodui barogwa kododu tabo, semanamode turemo jiwu meri boetojiwu jitu keje, ure towadudo boetoji Maria Madalena jekai. Cewu ure  Aroe pegareuge ei ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowutodu ewarigu pijiwudo.

b: Duwudo koiare ure mugure Jesus apowuge ewie, duwugere ekiarigodu kuricigore, etoragudu kuricigo nure.
source: Duwudo koiare ure mugure Jesus apowuge ewie, duwugere ekiarigodu kuricigore, etoragudu kuricigo nure.

b:
Icare, tumeardui Jesus jewoduie pugejedu, emaie jordure jitudu, etaidukare tumeartoruwo ji.
Jesus ui towadudo ture jorduwadowuge etaidu.
source:
Icare, tumeardui Jesus jewoduie pugejedu, emaie jordure jitudu, etaidukare tumeartoruwo ji.
Jesus ui towadudo ture jorduwadowuge etaidu.

b: Ia kodiboe keje pugeje, ure towadudo pugeje ia turewo tabo nowuia ei pobedu etai etui boepato du keje.
source: Ia kodiboe keje pugeje, ure towadudo pugeje ia turewo tabo nowuia ei pobedu etai etui boepato du keje.

b: Kodi icare eture toro togwajetuwo ji tumedage ewiegai, mare jamedu emeartorukare jamedu.
source: Kodi icare eture toro togwajetuwo ji tumedage ewiegai, mare jamedu emeartorukare jamedu.

b: Icare ure towadudo nowu ture jorduwadowuge eiamedu jekai, emugui ira keje du keje. Kodi icare okituware ei emeartoru bokwa remawu raboduie, ewabo raka remawu raboduie, nowu emeartorukai nowu jordure puduiwuge eerdui tuiewodu jituji.
source: Icare ure towadudo nowu ture jorduwadowuge eiamedu jekai, emugui ira keje du keje. Kodi icare okituware ei emeartoru bokwa remawu raboduie, ewabo raka remawu raboduie, nowu emeartorukai nowu jordure puduiwuge eerdui tuiewodu jituji.

b: Akore ei: - Tadudo, tagaodo moto jamedu boe kao, tareadodudo awu bakaru pemegareu maiwuji boe eiamedu boe ewiegai.
source: Akore ei: - Tadudo, tagaodo moto jamedu boe kao, tareadodudo awu bakaru pemegareu maiwuji boe eiamedu boe ewiegai.

b: Cewu meartorureuge eiamedu boe etao pegododumode, duwugere epemegadodumode. Mare meartorukareuge ewarigudumode boe pegareuto.
source: Cewu meartorureuge eiamedu boe etao pegododumode, duwugere epemegadodumode. Mare meartorukareuge ewarigudumode boe pegareuto.

b: Awu ro rakareu kuodumode meartorureuge eigoia: Emode  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu ikie tabo, emagomode boe ewadaru maiwuji.
source: Awu ro rakareu kuodumode meartorureuge eigoia: Emode  Aroe pegareuge ewarigu ikie tabo, emagomode boe ewadaru maiwuji.

b:
Emode tugeragu awaguei, ekudumode jorubo pegareu kuruce ma, ro pegamodukare ei. Emode tugera bu kogodureuge ewugeje ma, epemegagodumode.
Jesus rutui baru todu.
source:
Emode tugeragu awaguei, ekudumode jorubo pegareu kuruce ma, ro pegamodukare ei. Emode tugera bu kogodureuge ewugeje ma, epemegagodumode.
Jesus rutui baru todu.

b: Pagimejera Jesus, tumagoi ei du keje, rutudodure baruto tumugui Pao kana pemegareu jaogwai du kae.
source: Pagimejera Jesus, tumagoi ei du keje, rutudodure baruto tumugui Pao kana pemegareu jaogwai du kae.

b: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge eture tuwadodui boe ewiegai boe eiamedu boe joki du tabo. Pagimejera jeture ei, ierabrarere ei, ure ewadaru boedo pudumi rugadu, ei turo pemegareu kurireu kuo du tabo.
source: Nowu ure jorduwadowuge eture tuwadodui boe ewiegai boe eiamedu boe joki du tabo. Pagimejera jeture ei, ierabrarere ei, ure ewadaru boedo pudumi rugadu, ei turo pemegareu kurireu kuo du tabo.

b: Jesus Cristo otodaiwuge.
source: Jesus Cristo otodaiwuge.

b: Jesus Cristo, Davi Onaregedu, Abraão onaregedu, jeture otojiwu uwobe ekie epadui bapera kejedu.
source: Jesus Cristo, Davi Onaregedu, Abraão onaregedu, jeture otojiwu uwobe ekie epadui bapera kejedu.

b: Abraão ure Isaac towuje. Isaac ure Jacó towuje. Jacó ure Judá towuje, ure Judá umanamage uwiemage etowuje jamedu.
source: Abraão ure Isaac towuje. Isaac ure Jacó towuje. Jacó ure Judá towuje, ure Judá umanamage uwiemage etowuje jamedu.

b: Judá mare Tamar ere Farés mare Zara etowuje. Farés ure Esron towuje. Esron ure Arão towuje.
source: Judá mare Tamar ere Farés mare Zara etowuje. Farés ure Esron towuje. Esron ure Arão towuje.

b: Arão ure Aminadabe towuje. Aminadabe ure Naasson towuje. Naasson ure Salmon towuje.
source: Arão ure Aminadabe towuje. Aminadabe ure Naasson towuje. Naasson ure Salmon towuje.

b: Salmon mare Raabe ere Booz towuje. Booz mare Rute ere Obede towuje. Obede ure Jessé towuje. Jessé ure brae eimejera Davi towuje.
source: Salmon mare Raabe ere Booz towuje. Booz mare Rute ere Obede towuje. Obede ure Jessé towuje. Jessé ure brae eimejera Davi towuje.

b: Uria bokware pijiwu aredu apore, brae eimejera Davi ure Salomão towuje.
source: Uria bokware pijiwu aredu apore, brae eimejera Davi ure Salomão towuje.

b: Salomão ure Roboão towuje. Roboão ure Abias towuje. Abias ure Asa towuje.
source: Salomão ure Roboão towuje. Roboão ure Abias towuje. Abias ure Asa towuje.

b: Asa ure Josafá towuje. Josafá ure Jorão towuje. Jorão ure Ozias towuje.
source: Asa ure Josafá towuje. Josafá ure Jorão towuje. Jorão ure Ozias towuje.

b: Ozias ure Joatão towuje. Joatão ure Acaz towuje. Acaz ure Ezequias towuje.
source: Ozias ure Joatão towuje. Joatão ure Acaz towuje. Acaz ure Ezequias towuje.

b: Ezequias ure Manassés towuje. Manassés ure Amon towuje. Amon ure Josias towuje.
source: Ezequias ure Manassés towuje. Manassés ure Amon towuje. Amon ure Josias towuje.

b: Josias ure Jeconias towuje, ure umanamage etowuje jamedu, Babilônia rorerui Judeudoge eidu kodiwu keje.
source: Josias ure Jeconias towuje, ure umanamage etowuje jamedu, Babilônia rorerui Judeudoge eidu kodiwu keje.

b: Nowu Babilônia rorerui judeudoge eidu kodiwu rekodaji, Jeconias ure Salatiel towuje. Salatiel ure Zorobabel towuje.
source: Nowu Babilônia rorerui judeudoge eidu kodiwu rekodaji, Jeconias ure Salatiel towuje. Salatiel ure Zorobabel towuje.

b: Zorobabel ure Abiude towuje. Abiude ure Eleacim towuje. Eleacim ure Azor towuje.
source: Zorobabel ure Abiude towuje. Abiude ure Eleacim towuje. Eleacim ure Azor towuje.

b: Azor ure Sadoc towuje. Sadoc ure Aquim towuje. Aquim ure Eliude towuje.
source: Azor ure Sadoc towuje. Sadoc ure Aquim towuje. Aquim ure Eliude towuje.

b: Eliude ure Eleazar towuje. Eleazar ure Matam towuje. Matam ure Jacó towuge.
source: Eliude ure Eleazar towuje. Eleazar ure Matam towuje. Matam ure Jacó towuge.

b: Jacó ure José towuje. José mugure Maria apo, du tabore Jesus ure tudowuje ai, dure iere Cristo.
source: Jacó ure José towuje. José mugure Maria apo, du tabore Jesus ure tudowuje ai, dure iere Cristo.

b:
Du kodire ere pudato pudatodure ikera pudogidure ewudure iwurekoto pobe puibiji Abraão piji jii Davi ae. Jii Davi piji Babilônia rorerurewo kae dure ikera pudogidure ewudure pobe puibiji iwurekoto jii Cristo ae.
Jesus buturedu.
source:
Du kodire ere pudato pudatodure ikera pudogidure ewudure iwurekoto pobe puibiji Abraão piji jii Davi ae. Jii Davi piji Babilônia rorerurewo kae dure ikera pudogidure ewudure pobe puibiji iwurekoto jii Cristo ae.
Jesus buturedu.

b: Ica, Jesus butu kodiwu: Uce Maria mare José ei tuienado puidu, emugumode puapodu otodaire, awu inodure tudowuje Mariaji: Kuiarure Aroe Pemegareu koia.
source: Ica, Jesus butu kodiwu: Uce Maria mare José ei tuienado puidu, emugumode puapodu otodaire, awu inodure tudowuje Mariaji: Kuiarure Aroe Pemegareu koia.

b: Nowu mugumode apowu José, imedu jetororeu, aidukare akaru pegawo: icare padure tugajeje tuwo turodo oino piji podu tabo.
source: Nowu mugumode apowu José, imedu jetororeu, aidukare akaru pegawo: icare padure tugajeje tuwo turodo oino piji podu tabo.

b: Meardaere oino kimo, du kejere icare Pao Aroe Eimejera ia o Tupare towadudo ji unuiao tada. Akore: - José, Davi onaregedu, apagudu kaba Maria makuduwo akai akoredujece. Paga karega, kejere Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje keje.
source: Meardaere oino kimo, du kejere icare Pao Aroe Eimejera ia o Tupare towadudo ji unuiao tada. Akore: - José, Davi onaregedu, apagudu kaba Maria makuduwo akai akoredujece. Paga karega, kejere Aroe Pemegareu ure turawuje keje.

b: Ema kuributumode ia tonaregedu rogu apo, dure amode iedo Jesusce; emare umode tuwobe einorudo turo pegareu piji kodi.
source: Ema kuributumode ia tonaregedu rogu apo, dure amode iedo Jesusce; emare umode tuwobe einorudo turo pegareu piji kodi.

b: Nowu inodu jamedu ure tudowuje uwo nono Aroe Eimejera makore profetadogei jiboe reore.
source: Nowu inodu jamedu ure tudowuje uwo nono Aroe Eimejera makore profetadogei jiboe reore.

b: "Ica, ia virgem kuiarumode, onaregedu butumode, du iemode Emanuel  (nowu bataru inodure oino: Aroe Eimejera mugui pagabodu) (Is 7,14).
source: "Ica, ia virgem kuiarumode, onaregedu butumode, du iemode Emanuel  (nowu bataru inodure oino: Aroe Eimejera mugui pagabodu) (Is 7,14).

b: Icare, tuiedadu kejere, José rore nono Tupai turoiagudu reore. Ure tugeragu ji pudae rugadu.
source: Icare, tuiedadu kejere, José rore nono Tupai turoiagudu reore. Ure tugeragu ji pudae rugadu.

b: Boekarema, emugukai puapo du tabo, Maria onaregedure, dure ure iedo Jesusce.
source: Boekarema, emugukai puapo du tabo, Maria onaregedure, dure ure iedo Jesusce.

b: Magodoge etaregoduredu.
source: Magodoge etaregoduredu.

b: Jesus buture ia Judéia kejewu bakurireu iei Belém cedu keje, brae eimejerai Herodes cedu kodiwu kodi. Du kejere icare magodoge etaregodure meri rutu piji nowu bakurireu iei Jerusalém cedu kae.
source: Jesus buture ia Judéia kejewu bakurireu iei Belém cedu keje, brae eimejerai Herodes cedu kodiwu kodi. Du kejere icare magodoge etaregodure meri rutu piji nowu bakurireu iei Jerusalém cedu kae.

b: Enorare: - Kaiba judeudoge eimejera buture? Ceerdure o kuieje kurireuji meri rutu kuda, kodire cedaregodure cewo cebujodo ji.
source: Enorare: - Kaiba judeudoge eimejera buture? Ceerdure o kuieje kurireuji meri rutu kuda, kodire cedaregodure cewo cebujodo ji.

b: Tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, nowu brae eimejera Herodes rore toku, nowu Jerusalém kejewuge erore toku apo jamedu.
source: Tumeardui nowu inodu jitu keje, nowu brae eimejera Herodes rore toku, nowu Jerusalém kejewuge erore toku apo jamedu.

b: Icare ure baire eimejerage, escribadoge, ure edo tudo pui, unorare ei kaibamodeba Cristo butumode.
source: Icare ure baire eimejerage, escribadoge, ure edo tudo pui, unorare ei kaibamodeba Cristo butumode.

b: Icare egore ji: - Belém keje, Judéia moto keje, oinore bapera atugododure profeta koia:
source: Icare egore ji: - Belém keje, Judéia moto keje, oinore bapera atugododure profeta koia:

b: Aki, Belém, Judéia kejewu, aki boe biegareu karega ure aki Judéia kejewu bakurireuge etada. Paga karega, apijire boe eimejera jetumode inore emawuge Israeldogeiwu umode tudawuje (Miq 5,2).
source: Aki, Belém, Judéia kejewu, aki boe biegareu karega ure aki Judéia kejewu bakurireuge etada. Paga karega, apijire boe eimejera jetumode inore emawuge Israeldogeiwu umode tudawuje (Miq 5,2).

b: Kodire Herodes mako podure nowu magodoge ewogai. Icare unorare ei kakoduwu ia boe kejeba nowu kuieje kurireu ure towadudo eegai.
source: Kodire Herodes mako podure nowu magodoge ewogai. Icare unorare ei kakoduwu ia boe kejeba nowu kuieje kurireu ure towadudo eegai.

b: Ure etuiagu nowu Belém kae, akore ei: - Toro taerduwa birigodudo nowu negedurogu bogai. Taerdui jitu kejere tamode iwie, ituwo bogai, iwo ipujodo ji jamedu.
source: Ure etuiagu nowu Belém kae, akore ei: - Toro taerduwa birigodudo nowu negedurogu bogai. Taerdui jitu kejere tamode iwie, ituwo bogai, iwo ipujodo ji jamedu.

b: Tumeardui nowu brae eimejera bataru jitu kejere icare, eture pugeje. Icarema, cewu eerdure ji meri rutu kudawu kuieje kurireu kodure etododai jii cewu negedurogu mugurewo kae, nonore icare ure tuwuredo.
source: Tumeardui nowu brae eimejera bataru jitu kejere icare, eture pugeje. Icarema, cewu eerdure ji meri rutu kudawu kuieje kurireu kodure etododai jii cewu negedurogu mugurewo kae, nonore icare ure tuwuredo.

b: Cewu kuieje kurireu ui towadudo du koiare icare ure aidureu gigireu jekarereu ure enogorawu tabo.
source: Cewu kuieje kurireu ui towadudo du koiare icare ure aidureu gigireu jekarereu ure enogorawu tabo.

b: Tui turemo du kejere eerdure cewu negeduroguji tuje Maria apo. Ere turodo tuku. Ere tubujodo ji, tui kurido du tabo: tui toroe jado du keje, ere meriri ekureu bu tu je, ere kidoguru roreu, kidoguru jirireu, ere bu tu pugeje, ere jodo tuku keje.
source: Tui turemo du kejere eerdure cewu negeduroguji tuje Maria apo. Ere turodo tuku. Ere tubujodo ji, tui kurido du tabo: tui toroe jado du keje, ere meriri ekureu bu tu je, ere kidoguru roreu, kidoguru jirireu, ere bu tu pugeje, ere jodo tuku keje.

b:
Ewiedure tunuiao tada ekawo tugirimi cewu Herodes ae, du kodi icare ere tugirimi to moto kae ia awara tuginoiwuji pugeje. 
Jesus uo, uce, eregodui apo Egito kaedu.
source:
Ewiedure tunuiao tada ekawo tugirimi cewu Herodes ae, du kodi icare ere tugirimi to moto kae ia awara tuginoiwuji pugeje. 
Jesus uo, uce, eregodui apo Egito kaedu.

b: Etu uiagejere icare ia Tupare towadudo José unuiao tada, akore ji: - Aragojedo, akeragu nowu negeduroguji, uceji, tarego Egito kae, taedudo toro jii imode tawie pugeje du kae, mare paga karega, Herodes jemarumode nowu negedurogu bogai tuwo bito.
source: Etu uiagejere icare ia Tupare towadudo José unuiao tada, akore ji: - Aragojedo, akeragu nowu negeduroguji, uceji, tarego Egito kae, taedudo toro jii imode tawie pugeje du kae, mare paga karega, Herodes jemarumode nowu negedurogu bogai tuwo bito.

b: Icare José ure turagojedo, boeco kao rugadu, ure tugeragu nowu negeduroguji, uceji jamedu, icare uture ebo Egito kae.
source: Icare José ure turagojedo, boeco kao rugadu, ure tugeragu nowu negeduroguji, uceji jamedu, icare uture ebo Egito kae.

b:
Nonore eragojere jii Herodes bi kae. Boe koduwo Aroe Eimejerare profetadoge egoiaguwo reore: “Imagore itonaregedu bogai Egito piji”. (Os 11.1).
Herodes ui boe etore ewidodu.
source:
Nonore eragojere jii Herodes bi kae. Boe koduwo Aroe Eimejerare profetadoge egoiaguwo reore: “Imagore itonaregedu bogai Egito piji”. (Os 11.1).
Herodes ui boe etore ewidodu.

b: Herodes, tui boe pa magodogei tuie kuri pagadodu jitu du keje, bire boe kori koia; ure boe etore o joru buture pobe tu tu jewuge eeda kedodo Belém keje, oiei jamedu, cewu tunorai magodogei du tonaji, du kejere roino.
source: Herodes, tui boe pa magodogei tuie kuri pagadodu jitu du keje, bire boe kori koia; ure boe etore o joru buture pobe tu tu jewuge eeda kedodo Belém keje, oiei jamedu, cewu tunorai magodogei du tonaji, du kejere roino.

b: Kodire Profeta Jeremias makore jiboe ure pudumi rugadu:
source: Kodire Profeta Jeremias makore jiboe ure pudumi rugadu:

b:
"Rama moto kejere boe emeardure ia makoreu makoji, boe etoragudui boei maidoduji: boekarema, Raquel rabodure akoino toragudu tabo tore ewogai; ia butugugodure kejeboe bokwa, emagigokare kodi” (Jer 31,15).
Jesus uo, uce, ei tugirimi apo Egito pijidu.
source:
"Rama moto kejere boe emeardure ia makoreu makoji, boe etoragudui boei maidoduji: boekarema, Raquel rabodure akoino toragudu tabo tore ewogai; ia butugugodure kejeboe bokwa, emagigokare kodi” (Jer 31,15).
Jesus uo, uce, ei tugirimi apo Egito pijidu.

b: Herodes bi rekodaji, Pao o tupa ure towadudo José jekai unuiao tada, akore ji:
source: Herodes bi rekodaji, Pao o tupa ure towadudo José jekai unuiao tada, akore ji:

b: "Aragojedo, akeragu nowu negeduroguji, nowu uceji, akirimi Israeldoge eno moto kae; mare paga karega, cewu onare awu negedurogu jiwuge ewire”.
source: "Aragojedo, akeragu nowu negeduroguji, nowu uceji, akirimi Israeldoge eno moto kae; mare paga karega, cewu onare awu negedurogu jiwuge ewire”.

b: Kodi icare José ure turagojedo, ure tugeragu nowu negeduroguji, nowu uceji, uture Israeldoge eno moto kae.
source: Kodi icare José ure turagojedo, ure tugeragu nowu negeduroguji, nowu uceji, uture Israeldoge eno moto kae.

b: Boekarema, tumeardui Arquelao jetui Judéiaji tuo Herodes mugato du keje, pagudugodure tuduwo toro. Tumeardu birigodui tunuiao tada pugeje du keje, ure turodo paci woje Galiléia moto kae.
source: Boekarema, tumeardui Arquelao jetui Judéiaji tuo Herodes mugato du keje, pagudugodure tuduwo toro. Tumeardu birigodui tunuiao tada pugeje du keje, ure turodo paci woje Galiléia moto kae.

b: Aregodure, ure turagojedo Nazaré bakurireu keje, boewo nono profetadoge emagore jiboe reore: - Ema iemode Nazareno. (Is 11,1).
source: Aregodure, ure turagojedo Nazaré bakurireu keje, boewo nono profetadoge emagore jiboe reore: - Ema iemode Nazareno. (Is 11,1).

b: João Batista uwadodae.
source: João Batista uwadodae.

b: Nowu du kodi, João Batista ure towadudo tumago tabo, tuwadaru tabo, boe matadu keje, Judéia moto keje.
source: Nowu du kodi, João Batista ure towadudo tumago tabo, tuwadaru tabo, boe matadu keje, Judéia moto keje.

b: Akore: - Tagodorogado tai. Pao o boe pemegareu puredugodu nure.
source: Akore: - Tagodorogado tai. Pao o boe pemegareu puredugodu nure.

b: Awu jire profeta Isaia makore, cewu akoi oinodu kodiwu: Ia akoreu akore toro boe makodu tada: Boedo turugadu Aroe Eimejera togi, utawara jetorodo  (Is 0,3).
source: Awu jire profeta Isaia makore, cewu akoi oinodu kodiwu: Ia akoreu akore toro boe makodu tada: Boedo turugadu Aroe Eimejera togi, utawara jetorodo  (Is 0,3).

b: João, barege ewiri meture ji, ia iku kogure kajeje. wagere bokokwadogei, okwagere moiawei.
source: João, barege ewiri meture ji, ia iku kogure kajeje. wagere bokokwadogei, okwagere moiawei.

b: Jerusalém ejewuge eiamedu boe, Judéia kejewuge eiamedu boe, Jordão ieiwu boe, etu kigodure ae.
source: Jerusalém ejewuge eiamedu boe, Judéia kejewuge eiamedu boe, Jordão ieiwu boe, etu kigodure ae.

b: Emagore turo pegareuji biegai, ure etao pego pegodo, nowu Jordão po tada.
source: Emagore turo pegareuji biegai, ure etao pego pegodo, nowu Jordão po tada.

b: Mare tuiordui fariseudoge, saduceudoge etu kigodui to boe etao pegododu kae du keje, João akore ei: - Awague etumedage, ioguduba ure taerduwado tawo taginorudo aregodumodewu boe ekorigodae piji?
source: Mare tuiordui fariseudoge, saduceudoge etu kigodui to boe etao pegododu kae du keje, João akore ei: - Awague etumedage, ioguduba ure taerduwado tawo taginorudo aregodumodewu boe ekorigodae piji?

b: Boe eerdudo tagodorogai tai boe rugaduji.
source: Boe eerdudo tagodorogai tai boe rugaduji.

b: Tamago kaba tadoda: Ceore Abraão rema. Oino. Kode, inagomode tai: Pao roiware tuwo Abraão onaregedudo awu torice.
source: Tamago kaba tadoda: Ceore Abraão rema. Oino. Kode, inagomode tai: Pao roiware tuwo Abraão onaregedudo awu torice.

b: Paro padure urugadu iguru ukwa paru tada; pemegakareu iguru kadodumode bariguduwo joruto.
source: Paro padure urugadu iguru ukwa paru tada; pemegakareu iguru kadodumode bariguduwo joruto.

b: Ire tagao pegodo pobo tabo uwo nono tagodorogai taidure; mare aregodumode iregodajiwu, emare ro raka remawure ikori, ikare irugadu iwo bure tadawu reko ai. Ema umode tagao pegodo Aroe Pemegareu tabo, joru tabo.
source: Ire tagao pegodo pobo tabo uwo nono tagodorogai taidure; mare aregodumode iregodajiwu, emare ro raka remawure ikori, ikare irugadu iwo bure tadawu reko ai. Ema umode tagao pegodo Aroe Pemegareu tabo, joru tabo.

b:
Iedure bakuji tuwo to iro bakujukodo, tuwo to iro tugu tuiato, tuwo iwo barigu joruto, bi bokwareu joruto.
Jesus ui taopegododu.
source:
Iedure bakuji tuwo to iro bakujukodo, tuwo to iro tugu tuiato, tuwo iwo barigu joruto, bi bokwareu joruto.
Jesus ui taopegododu.

b: Jesus uture Galiléia moto piji, Jordão kae, João bogai, uwo taopegodo.
source: Jesus uture Galiléia moto piji, Jordão kae, João bogai, uwo taopegodo.

b: Icare Joãore turodo duku tuibagi, akore: Itaopegododumode akera tabo, macare ature itae?
source: Icare Joãore turodo duku tuibagi, akore: Itaopegododumode akera tabo, macare ature itae?

b: Mare Jesus akore: - Nowu inodu piji jao. Parowo nono Pao aidu reore. Kodi icare Joãore turodo duku tuibagi akoinodu keje.
source: Mare Jesus akore: - Nowu inodu piji jao. Parowo nono Pao aidu reore. Kodi icare Joãore turodo duku tuibagi akoinodu keje.

b: Jesus ure tudawuje pobo piji taopegododu rekodaji. Du kejere icare barure tuiado, du kejere jordure Pao Utaroe ui nono metugu reore duji ui tudawuje tuwugeje duji.
source: Jesus ure tudawuje pobo piji taopegododu rekodaji. Du kejere icare barure tuiado, du kejere jordure Pao Utaroe ui nono metugu reore duji ui tudawuje tuwugeje duji.

b: Aroe pegareuge eimejera ui turokogado Jesus jitu.
source: Aroe pegareuge eimejera ui turokogado Jesus jitu.

b: Du kejere Aroe Pemegareu ure Jesus reko toro boe mataduto Aroe pegareu wo turokogado jitu bogai.
source: Du kejere Aroe Pemegareu ure Jesus reko toro boe mataduto Aroe pegareu wo turokogado jitu bogai.

b: Jesus otorogare pudui meri ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure, ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure. Du kejere icare uke boi buture keje.
source: Jesus otorogare pudui meri ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure, ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure. Du kejere icare uke boi buture keje.

b: Podure jiwu ure tuburedo ji, akore ji: - Aroe Eimejera Onaregedumode aki du keje, amagodo awu toriguruji tuwo amireudo pudumi.
source: Podure jiwu ure tuburedo ji, akore ji: - Aroe Eimejera Onaregedumode aki du keje, amagodo awu toriguruji tuwo amireudo pudumi.

b: Icare Jesus akore: - Bapera atugo pemegareu keje atugododure oino: Amireu mitodu tabo karega imedu jere, mare Pao bataru jamedu boe tabo (Deut 8,3).
source: Icare Jesus akore: - Bapera atugo pemegareu keje atugododure oino: Amireu mitodu tabo karega imedu jere, mare Pao bataru jamedu boe tabo (Deut 8,3).

b: Du kejere icare Aroe pegareu re Jesus reko bakurireu pemegareu kae, ure rakojedo Pao uwai oto mitodu keje, akore ji: -
source: Du kejere icare Aroe pegareu re Jesus reko bakurireu pemegareu kae, ure rakojedo Pao uwai oto mitodu keje, akore ji: -

b: Aroe Eimejera Onaregedu nure aki rugadu du keje, akaredo moto kae. Paga karega, bapera atugododure oino: “Ure to tupadogedo tudo turugadu ai. Etumode ai tugera tabo, akawo awure okorido ia tori tabo” (Sl 90,1112).
source: Aroe Eimejera Onaregedu nure aki rugadu du keje, akaredo moto kae. Paga karega, bapera atugododure oino: “Ure to tupadogedo tudo turugadu ai. Etumode ai tugera tabo, akawo awure okorido ia tori tabo” (Sl 90,1112).

b: Jesus akore: - Jamedu bapera atugododure: “Akaba akimejera Aroe Eimejera matadudo aegai” (Deut 6,16).
source: Jesus akore: - Jamedu bapera atugododure: “Akaba akimejera Aroe Eimejera matadudo aegai” (Deut 6,16).

b: Du kejere icare Aroe pegareu  re Jesus reko pugeje ia tori raicigoreu ao kae, ure jordudo moto jamedu boeji, motui puduiduji jamedu, akore ji: -
source: Du kejere icare Aroe pegareu  re Jesus reko pugeje ia tori raicigoreu ao kae, ure jordudo moto jamedu boeji, motui puduiduji jamedu, akore ji: -

b: Imode awu jamedu boe makakai, ai apujodo ii du keje.
source: Imode awu jamedu boe makakai, ai apujodo ii du keje.

b: Jesus akore bataru jipagi: - Toro aibagi, Satans! Paga karega, atugodure oino jamedu: “Amode apujodo akimejera Aroe Eimejeraji, jire awiapagamode tu rugadu”  (Deut 6,13).
source: Jesus akore bataru jipagi: - Toro aibagi, Satans! Paga karega, atugodure oino jamedu: “Amode apujodo akimejera Aroe Eimejeraji, jire awiapagamode tu rugadu”  (Deut 6,13).

b:
Du inodu keje, Aroe pegareu re tugera ra piji, du kejere tupadoge ere tuburedo ji tuwo tuwiapagado ji.
Jesui tugirini Galiléia kaedu.
source:
Du inodu keje, Aroe pegareu re tugera ra piji, du kejere tupadoge ere tuburedo ji tuwo tuwiapagado ji.
Jesui tugirini Galiléia kaedu.

b: Jesus, tumeardui boei tugeragu João jitu kejere icare ure turodo oino Galiléia kae.
source: Jesus, tumeardui boei tugeragu João jitu kejere icare ure turodo oino Galiléia kae.

b: Tui tugera ra Nazaré jitu kodi, rakojere Cafarnaum keje, ia kuruga kurireu jipa keje, Zabulon, Neftali eno moto keje.
source: Tui tugera ra Nazaré jitu kodi, rakojere Cafarnaum keje, ia kuruga kurireu jipa keje, Zabulon, Neftali eno moto keje.

b: Uwo nono Profeta Isaia makore jiboere:
source: Uwo nono Profeta Isaia makore jiboere:

b: "Zabulon, Neftali eno moto, puredu pobo maereu okwa kejewu, Jordão kejewu moto, Galiléia kejewu boe.
source: "Zabulon, Neftali eno moto, puredu pobo maereu okwa kejewu, Jordão kejewu moto, Galiléia kejewu boe.

b: Nowu boe emedure boeco tadawuge, icare eerdure ia boe urugu kurireu ui boe awadudoduji. Barogwa kododureure nowuge ebo, ewi tugui eidu kajeje”  (Is 9,1).
source: Nowu boe emedure boeco tadawuge, icare eerdure ia boe urugu kurireu ui boe awadudoduji. Barogwa kododureure nowuge ebo, ewi tugui eidu kajeje”  (Is 9,1).

b:
Nowu piji mato icare Jesus okituware boei, akore: - Tagodorogado tai. Pao o boe pemegareu puredugodu nure.
Jesus makoi kare ecebage ei pobe puibijidu bogai.
source:
Nowu piji mato icare Jesus okituware boei, akore: - Tagodorogado tai. Pao o boe pemegareu puredugodu nure.
Jesus makoi kare ecebage ei pobe puibijidu bogai.

b: Jesus, tumerui Galiléia kejewu pobo maereu jipa jitu du tabo, jordure boei pobeduji: umana, uwie. Simão duwure iere Pedro, mare uwie André, ei buke barigu poboto duji; icarema kare ecebage rabodu.
source: Jesus, tumerui Galiléia kejewu pobo maereu jipa jitu du tabo, jordure boei pobeduji: umana, uwie. Simão duwure iere Pedro, mare uwie André, ei buke barigu poboto duji; icarema kare ecebage rabodu.

b: Akore ei: - Mato iregodaji, iwo uwogure boe remawuge eiwugedo tagi.
source: Akore ei: - Mato iregodaji, iwo uwogure boe remawuge eiwugedo tagi.

b: Ako oinodu kejere, ere tugera ra tuwuge piji, ekodure apo.
source: Ako oinodu kejere, ere tugera ra tuwuge piji, ekodure apo.

b: Tugodui tododai du tabo, jordure iage ei pobe pugeje duji, umana, uwie pugeje: Tiago, Zebedeu onaregedu, mare uwie João, eeduradure tuo Zebedeu apo, enure tuwuge pemegado. Makore etae.
source: Tugodui tododai du tabo, jordure iage ei pobe pugeje duji, umana, uwie pugeje: Tiago, Zebedeu onaregedu, mare uwie João, eeduradure tuo Zebedeu apo, enure tuwuge pemegado. Makore etae.

b:
Ere ika pijido, ere tuo pijido, ekodure apo.

Jesus ui boe eerduwado, ui boe makareuge epemegago.
source:
Ere ika pijido, ere tuo pijido, ekodure apo.

Jesus ui boe eerduwado, ui boe makareuge epemegago.

b: Jesus merure Galiléia oiagi, tui boe eerduwado du tabo sinagoga keje, tui boe eerduwado Pao o boe pemegareuji, ciogoi ekogodae pegareu jamedu boe, okorireboe, urureboe jitu du tabo etada.
source: Jesus merure Galiléia oiagi, tui boe eerduwado du tabo sinagoga keje, tui boe eerduwado Pao o boe pemegareuji, ciogoi ekogodae pegareu jamedu boe, okorireboe, urureboe jitu du tabo etada.

b: Du kodi icare akaru ure tumaedo Síria moto jamedu boe joki, boe eture ae kogodureuge ebo, boe okorire, boe urure jiwuge ebo, Aroe pegareu re taredo towuge ebo, aora bai baireuge ebo, pogora koboreuge ebo, Ure eiamedu boe epemegago.
source: Du kodi icare akaru ure tumaedo Síria moto jamedu boe joki, boe eture ae kogodureuge ebo, boe okorire, boe urure jiwuge ebo, Aroe pegareu re taredo towuge ebo, aora bai baireuge ebo, pogora koboreuge ebo, Ure eiamedu boe epemegago.

b: Kodi icare boere turodo taci apo: Galiléia kejewuge, Decápole kejewuge, Jerusalém kejewuge, Judéia kejewuge, Jordão okwa bakowu kejewuge eiamedu.
source: Kodi icare boere turodo taci apo: Galiléia kejewuge, Decápole kejewuge, Jerusalém kejewuge, Judéia kejewuge, Jordão okwa bakowu kejewuge eiamedu.

b: Jesus makoi tori aoporu kejedu.
source: Jesus makoi tori aoporu kejedu.

b: Jesus, tuiordui nowu boe emagai jitu du keje, ruture ia boe aoporu ao kae. Ure tumugudo tu je, du kejere ure jorduwadowuge ere tuburedo ji. 2 Icare makore ei, ure eerduwado tagoi oino du tabo:
source: Jesus, tuiordui nowu boe emagai jitu du keje, ruture ia boe aoporu ao kae. Ure tumugudo tu je, du kejere ure jorduwadowuge ere tuburedo ji. 2 Icare makore ei, ure eerduwado tagoi oino du tabo:

b: "Uwabore nono marenarue ewabo reoreuge eiwo aidugirimode, eonare Pao o boe pemegareuji kodi.
source: "Uwabore nono marenarue ewabo reoreuge eiwo aidugirimode, eonare Pao o boe pemegareuji kodi.

b: Oragudureuge, boe birigodure jiwugere emage, butugugodureboe makudumode etai kodi.
source: Oragudureuge, boe birigodure jiwugere emage, butugugodureboe makudumode etai kodi.

b: Boe okori bokware jiwuge, eiwo aidugirimode, emage enomode motoce.
source: Boe okori bokware jiwuge, eiwo aidugirimode, emage enomode motoce.

b: Boe jetororeu boire jiwuge, eiwo aidugirimode, ewudugugodumode kodi.
source: Boe jetororeu boire jiwuge, eiwo aidugirimode, ewudugugodumode kodi.

b: Okudureuge, oiagudureuge, eiwo aidugirimode, okudureboe, oiagudureboe makudumode etai kodi.
source: Okudureuge, oiagudureuge, eiwo aidugirimode, okudureboe, oiagudureboe makudumode etai kodi.

b: Uwabo pemegareuge tuwabo pemega koia, eiwo aidugirimode, eerdumode Paoji kodi.
source: Uwabo pemegareuge tuwabo pemega koia, eiwo aidugirimode, eerdumode Paoji kodi.

b: Ure boe butugugodudowuge, eiwo aidugirimode, ekiemode Pao oreie ure emage kodi.
source: Ure boe butugugodudowuge, eiwo aidugirimode, ekiemode Pao oreie ure emage kodi.

b: Boe etonare jiwuge, egoi boe jetorogodureboeji du kodiwuge, eiwo aidugirimode, eonare Pao o boe pemegareu ji kodi.
source: Boe etonare jiwuge, egoi boe jetorogodureboeji du kodiwuge, eiwo aidugirimode, eonare Pao o boe pemegareu ji kodi.

b: Boe emode taroiaododu pegado du keje, boe etonamode tai du keje, boe emode tuwadararodaedo tai du keje ma, taiwo aidugirimode.
source: Boe emode taroiaododu pegado du keje, boe etonamode tai du keje, boe emode tuwadararodaedo tai du keje ma, taiwo aidugirimode.

b:
Taegaredo tai, tagaidudo tai, more kuricigomode tagai baru tada; kode, oinonore onare profetadoge eiwuge etonare ei, duwugere ekodure tagododai.
Sal mare urugureboe, jiwu bakaru.
source:
Taegaredo tai, tagaidudo tai, more kuricigomode tagai baru tada; kode, oinonore onare profetadoge eiwuge etonare ei, duwugere ekodure tagododai.
Sal mare urugureboe, jiwu bakaru.

b: Tagire sal reoreboemode tagi moto keje. Sal rododu okwamode taci piji ma, inoba umode pudae pugeje? Kiogwamodukare pugeje, ure turugadu bariguduwo, boe ewure jowo keje.
source: Tagire sal reoreboemode tagi moto keje. Sal rododu okwamode taci piji ma, inoba umode pudae pugeje? Kiogwamodukare pugeje, ure turugadu bariguduwo, boe ewure jowo keje.

b: Tagire moto kejewu boe urugureboere tagi. Ia bakurireu padui torekodu oagejedu boe eroiwamodukare tuwo biado.
source: Tagire moto kejewu boe urugureboere tagi. Ia bakurireu padui torekodu oagejedu boe eroiwamodukare tuwo biado.

b: Jamedu, boe emodukare ia jorugu mugudo aria kuda, mare jorugu mugumode tumuga keje, uruguwo mugure bai tadawuge eiamedu boeji.
source: Jamedu, boe emodukare ia jorugu mugudo aria kuda, mare jorugu mugumode tumuga keje, uruguwo mugure bai tadawuge eiamedu boeji.

b:
Oinore tarugureboe awadudo boe eegai; nowu inodu koia umode boe eerdudo taro pemegareuji, ewo aidureudo, ewo gigireudo Tao baru tadawuji.


Boe eroiagudu.
source:
Oinore tarugureboe awadudo boe eegai; nowu inodu koia umode boe eerdudo taro pemegareuji, ewo aidureudo, ewo gigireudo Tao baru tadawuji.


Boe eroiagudu.

b: Tadugu kaba itaregoduie iwo profetadoge ero, ego, ewadaru okwado. Iwo okwado karega, mare iwo uporu kororogo pudui.
source: Tadugu kaba itaregoduie iwo profetadoge ero, ego, ewadaru okwado. Iwo okwado karega, mare iwo uporu kororogo pudui.

b: Ica, boe jokodu jire inagore tai: baru, moto, okwamode mare ia Pao bataru paru rogu okwamodukare.
source: Ica, boe jokodu jire inagore tai: baru, moto, okwamode mare ia Pao bataru paru rogu okwamodukare.

b: Ure Pao bataru biega inodu rogu uredugodudowu, umode boe eerduwado nowu inodu jitu keje, biega torimode baru tada. Mare cewu rore nono Pao bataru reore, umode boe eerduwadowu, ie kurimode baru tada.
source: Ure Pao bataru biega inodu rogu uredugodudowu, umode boe eerduwado nowu inodu jitu keje, biega torimode baru tada. Mare cewu rore nono Pao bataru reore, umode boe eerduwadowu, ie kurimode baru tada.

b: Kode, inagomode oino tai: taro jetororeu kurimodukare nowu fariseudoge, escribadoge ero kori ma, tamodukare taremo baruto.
source: Kode, inagomode oino tai: taro jetororeu kurimodukare nowu fariseudoge, escribadoge ero kori ma, tamodukare taremo baruto.

b: Tameardure mariguduboe eiwu bakaruji: Tagaba boe ewido. Ure boe ewidowuge emagere boe eimejerage erorerumode ei.
source: Tameardure mariguduboe eiwu bakaruji: Tagaba boe ewido. Ure boe ewidowuge emagere boe eimejerage erorerumode ei.

b: Mare inagomode oino tai: Kodu kagirire tumana, tuwie jiwu, jiwomode ema remawu boe eimejerage enogituwa koia. Cewu akore: Boe kioga karega ino jiwu, boe eimejerage emode boe pegado ji; akomode: “Aora bai baireu” oino jiwu, jiwomode joruce.
source: Mare inagomode oino tai: Kodu kagirire tumana, tuwie jiwu, jiwomode ema remawu boe eimejerage enogituwa koia. Cewu akore: Boe kioga karega ino jiwu, boe eimejerage emode boe pegado ji; akomode: “Aora bai baireu” oino jiwu, jiwomode joruce.
